title: Freelance Mechanical CFD Engineer - AI Trainer
description:
About the role

Help train and evaluate AI agents on expert-level fluid simulation tasks. You'll take CAD geometry, set up and run simulations, build verified reference solutions, and write Python checks for the agent's results.

Requirements

  • A degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or a related field such as energy or oil & gas. A PhD is preferred but not required.
  • Several years of hands-on industry or research CFD with OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent/CFX or STAR-CCM+, including meshing.
  • Solid verification and validation practice: mesh-independence studies, and validation against experiment or benchmarks.
  • Comfortable with Python and GitHub.
  • English at B2 level or above.
  • Nice to have: aerospace, automotive, offshore or turbomachinery background; multiphase or particle-laden flow experience.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $17 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

title: Certified Restorative Aide
description:
JOB PURPOSE\:

Performs restorative nursing procedures that maximize the patient’s existing abilities, emphasizes independence instead of dependence, and minimizes the negative effects of disability with an attitude of realistic optimism under the supervision of a restorative nurse. Should be classified as a Certified Nursing Assistant Preceptor to meet eligibility requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES\:

1. Provides care ensuring patient/resident safety

2. May be required to assist with feeding of patients.

3. May be required to weigh patients.

4. Conducts passive range of motion (PROM), for upper and lower extremities.

5. Conducts active range of motion (AROM), for upper and lower extremities.

6. Provides assistance with ambulation.

7. Provides assistance in patient transfer (chair to chair, chair to bed etc.)

8. Provides assistance in dressing for upper and lower extremities.

9. Provides assistance in grooming and hygiene techniques.

10. Utilizes feeding devices (special plates, spoons etc.)

11. Assists with swallowing problems.

12. Uses facial exercises.

13. Applies splints appropriately.

14. Reviews requests for restorative and compares physician’s orders.

15. Conveys use of positioning and positioning devices.

16. Interviews patient to schedule therapy

17. Provides rehabilitative and therapeutic activities and exercises based on medical and social history of patients, as instructed.

18. Briefs patients of procedures involved in restorative care and prepare necessary equipment.

19. Assists in transporting patient to and from therapy room/area.

20. Follows the procedures involved in the treatment process.

21. Performs restorative care treatments in patients room as necessary

22. Reassures patient before and during therapy treatment.

23. Prepares patient for treatment by dress/position and administers restorative care in accordance with established procedural guidelines.

24. Encourages patients to perform or participate in ADL functions.

25. Instructs and supervises patient during therapy.

26. Assists patients in ambulatory training as necessary.

27. Provides that restorative care notes and documentation is informative, timely and descriptive of the treatment provided and of the patient’s response to the care.

title: Admissions Advisor
description:
Admissions Advisor

About The Job

Fortis Institute in Birmingham is seeking an energetic and highly motivated Admissions Advisor. If you possess a desire to help others succeed, this is an opportunity for you to positively impact the lives and careers of our students and graduates.

Fortis provides educational programs that deliver essential career skills in high-demand occupations that lead to employment upon graduation and a lifetime of professional growth.

Job Description

We are seeking an energetic and enthusiastic individual to be a part of the Admissions team. This is a full-time, professional position reporting directly to the Director of Admissions. This position may require some evening and Saturday hours.

The Admissions Advisor is responsible for the recruitment and enrollment of students at the campus. Duties include taking lead calls, tracking lead inquiries, managing enrollment activity and paperwork, and properly completing student files; tracking marketing and sales activities and producing reports as required; representing the school in career fairs, job fairs, and other similar activities; and participating in student orientation and registration activities.

Requirements

  • Must have obtained the highest degree offered at the campus. An associate degree is required; a bachelor degree preferred.
  • Highly motivated and solution-oriented in alignment with our campus’s core values of integrity, commitment, student-focused outcomes, respect, and service excellence.
  • Sales, marketing, and referral-lead-generating experience are preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills. Public speaking experience is a plus.
  • Outstanding customer service skills and desire to see others succeed.
  • Ability to set and achieve short- and long-term goals with measurable results.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Remote, US-based. Full time

About the Role

Every day, pet owners walk out of a vet's office having just said no to a treatment their pet needed, not because they didn't care, but because they couldn't afford it. Pawlicy Advisor exists to eliminate this problem. Pawlicy Advisor is a profitable venture-backed startup building the infrastructure that connects pet owners to the right financial protection for their pets, starting with the most trusted pet insurance marketplace in the US, distributed through thousands of veterinary practices nationwide. The company has delivered over 1 million unique quotes, has raised $19M+, has found product-market fit, and is now scaling. Pawlicy Advisor is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own day-to-day product execution: what gets built, why, and how success is measured. You will own the backlog, design and analyze the A/B tests that drive conversion and revenue, and be the product voice with the insurance carriers and partners that power the marketplace. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, on an outstanding team of five engineers, a data analyst, a senior product designer, and an engineering manager.

What You Own

Product Prioritization

  • Determine what engineering builds each sprint, prioritizing features, experiments, tech debt, and requests by expected impact vs effort.
  • Organize and define the backlog, keeping it refined and keeping engineering focused on the highest priority items.
  • Write well-scoped tasks with clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Triage incoming bugs: assess severity, reproduce, prioritize, and route to the right owner.

Product Development

  • Set requirements for A/B tests, build dashboards to monitor results, call statistical significance, and decide ship, iterate, or kill.
  • Write product one pagers framing the problem, opportunity, proposed solution, and success metrics before work is committed.
  • Ensure timelines are met for key projects and features.
  • Keep internal stakeholders updated on project progress, priorities, and data results, including the roadmap and reasoning behind next steps.
  • Partner with design on user research and competitive analysis.

Partnership Support

  • Work closely with each insurance carrier partner to handle outstanding requests, integration changes, and performance reporting.
  • Represent Product in D2C and vet partnerships to scale the business and outline timelines.
  • Proactively identify new business and Product opportunities by contextualizing partner needs with internal OKRs, learnings and roadmaps.
  • Manage the partner report intake process for off-site policy attribution.

Where You Partner

  • Engineering: sprint scope, priorities, and delivery with the engineering manager; tasks scoped so engineers can build without a meeting.
  • Design: user research and competitive analysis with the senior product designer.
  • Data and analytics: experiment design, dashboards, and significance calls with the data analyst in Mixpanel.
  • Partnerships and leadership: carrier requests, integration changes, performance reporting, and strategizing on opportunities alongside the Partnerships lead and the CEO.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

  • The backlog is refined, prioritized by impact vs effort, and engineering is focused on the highest priority items.
  • The A/B testing cadence is running: requirements, dashboards, significance calls, and ship, iterate, or kill decisions.
  • Initial product roadmap based on OKRs for the company is shared with the team
  • Stakeholders receive regular updates on progress, priorities, and data results, including the roadmap doc.

First 12 months

  • Conversion is measurably improved, with a documented record of tests shipped, iterated, and killed.
  • Carrier partners treat product as a responsive, trusted counterpart.
  • Specs and one pagers set the bar: engineers build from them without a meeting.
  • User research runs continuously and changes what gets built.
  • Product OKR reporting is consistently transparent, dependable, and easily accessible
  • Pawlicy team members understand Pawlicy’s Product roadmap and annual Product plans

Requirements

  • 5-7 years of product management experience, ideally at an early stage startup or fast-moving environment.
  • Experience optimizing conversion in a B2B2C platform or marketplace: you understand the funnel, the levers, and how to move them.
  • Deep fluency with A/B testing, from designing experiments to extracting real signal from results (Mixpanel or similar analytics experience a plus).
  • A track record of ruthless data- and OKR-driven prioritization and decision making.
  • Strong external communication skills: comfortable owning relationships with enterprise partners and representing Product in external conversations.
  • A genuine love of user research: you talk to users a lot, and let those conversations change your mind.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Must be based in the USA.
  • Preferred: experience in insurance or fintech. Extra points if you love animals and believe pet healthcare is a serious, underserved problem.

How You Work

  • You do your best work with real autonomy: you set your own agenda as the only PM, with no one checking your work daily.
  • You ship things that started as your own idea and generate roadmaps rather than inherit them.
  • You hold strong opinions, loosely held: a clear point of view on how to solve user problems without being precious about it.
  • You push back, disagree, and align without it becoming political.
  • You thrive in a high pace environment.
  • You use AI tools daily to compound the company’s output.

AI and the Hiring Process

We embrace AI at Pawlicy and our work still relies on what the humans bring to it.

So please leave the AI out of interviews and case studies. Prep with it all you like, but in the room, we want your thinking, your questions, your judgment. These stages exist so we can get to know you and how you'd work with our team. We're hiring you, not a model and it is you we want to see.

To be concrete: no AI assistants or chatbots on any device during interviews, and nobody else feeding you answers. Spell-check, autocomplete and notes you wrote yourself are all completely fine.

If it turns out AI was used where we've asked you not to, it may end your candidacy.

If any part of our process is a barrier because of how you read, write or communicate, email careers@pawlicy.com before that stage and we'll talk through the options. The skills we're assessing stay the same; what changes is the format. Asking has no bearing on how we assess you.

Benefits

  • Base salary range: $165,000 to $200,000.
  • Startup equity grant.
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) employer contributions; flexible vacation.
  • Remote-first within the United States.

Career Path

This role is the only product manager seat at a company of ~20 today, growing to 25-30 in 2027, reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, with a path to product leadership as the team scales. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in NYC, Pawlicy Advisor is a licensed insurance agency and the leading pet insurance marketplace in the US.

If you do your best work with real autonomy, thrive in a high pace environment, and deeply understand users, Pawlicy would like to talk. Learn more at

title: AI (artificial intelligence) Developer - Hybrid
description:
As an Artificial Intelligence Solution Developer, you design and implement AI solutions aligned with business needs and ISAAC’s strategic direction. You work across the full solution lifecycle, from needs analysis to deployment and evolution, in close collaboration with product, BI, data science and DevOps teams. You contribute to the quality, integration and security of our solutions through a collaborative and ethical approach that supports innovation and continuous improvement.

Success in this role is measured by the robustness, reproducibility and performance of solutions in production, their compliance with security and ethical requirements, and the value they bring to business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate business needs into functional and technical requirements for AI solutions
  • Collaborate with product, BI and data science teams to clarify use cases and define success indicators
  • Design the logical architecture of AI solutions (models, services, integrations)
  • Assess technical feasibility and propose appropriate approaches
  • Contribute to the technical framing of prototypes according to the intended uses
  • Convert exploratory prototypes into robust, repeatable machine learning pipelines ready for production
  • Develop APIs and services to expose AI models in production
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure solution integration and deployment
  • Implement AI model governance (registry, promotion, traceability) and automate MLOps
  • Ensure the robustness, traceability, security, compliance and stability of deployed solutions
  • Document the technical choices, assumptions, limitations and quality criteria of solutions
  • Support the maintenance and continuous evolution of solutions with stakeholders
  • Track AI trends and integrate relevant open-source libraries and tools
  • Make AI concepts accessible and share knowledge with stakeholders
  • Evolve development practices to increase the efficiency and value of solutions
  • Align with ISAAC’s objectives and foster a climate of inclusion, feedback and recognition by embodying its values.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, software engineering, data science or a related field
  • 5 to 8 years of experience developing artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions, including design, model training and validation, deployment, monitoring and governance
  • Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch and other machine learning frameworks
  • Backend development, preferably for ML services (FastAPI or equivalent, API creation)
  • Fluency in French and English, both oral and written (multilingual internal clientele with no duplication of roles).

Assets:

  • In-depth knowledge of the road transport sector and its specific challenges
  • Experience deploying containerized services (Docker, image management and container runtime).

Collaborators are at the center of ISAAC’s interests and values. This explains the numerous benefits of working at ISAAC, namely:

  • varied career opportunities
  • a stimulating work environment focused on innovation
  • enthusiastic and collaborative teams
  • competitive salaries and benefits promoting work-life balance: a complete group insurance plan, group RRSP, an EAP, flexible hours, 4 weeks of vacation, etc.
  • various social activities and free snacks and coffee every day.

title: Temporary Research Participant (Dutch Language) - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Dutch speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Dutch actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Dutch speaker who grew up in the Netherlands.
  • You use Dutch in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Udvikler til vores AI-team
description:
Vil du bygge AI-løsninger, der bliver brugt hver dag i et advokathus, og ikke blot stoppe ved prototypen? Er du stærk i backend og integrationer og har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med de mennesker, der skal bruge det, du bygger? Og vil du være med til at forme en rolle i et felt, der stadig tager form? Så er det dig, vi mangler.

Vi søger en erfaren full stack-udvikler til vores AI-team. Du bliver en del af et IT-team på 13 kolleger, hvor der er plads til både høj kvalitet og godt humør. Vi arbejder agilt i tæt samarbejde med forretningsudvikling, og vi tager os tid til at fejre det, der lykkes. Du får stort ansvar for at gøre vores AI-løsninger færdige, sikre og brugbare.

Stillingen

Vi er rigtig gode til at bruge AI, og det har været en central del af Bruun & Hjejle i flere år. Nu skal vi bygge endnu mere selv. Du bliver den, der gør det muligt, oven på de platforme, vi allerede har, og med de systemer, vi arbejder i hver dag. Du skal bidrage til både interne og klientvendte løsninger.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Integrationer: Bygge forbindelser mellem AI og vores systemer, herunder MCP-forbindelser mod Microsoft 365, iManage og øvrige systemer
  • Applikationer: Færdigbygge og videreudvikle løsninger med både backend og brugergrænseflade, så de bliver noget, advokaterne faktisk kan bruge
  • Skills og agents: Udvikle de mere komplekse skills, agents og komponenter i vores AI-værktøjer, hvor der kræves kode eller integration
  • Teknisk drift af egne løsninger: Logging, overvågning og support, så det, vi bygger, også virker i hverdagen
  • Automatisering: Udvikle parsere, flows og andre løsninger, der fjerner gentagne opgaver
  • Adgang og sikkerhed: Sikre identitets- og adgangsstyring for interne og eksterne brugere i samarbejde med vores løsningsarkitekt

Du arbejder tæt sammen med forretningen og får mulighed for at præge både teknologivalg og retning.

”I Bruun & Hjejle får du en afvekslende hverdag med højt tempo og gode muligheder for spændende ansvarsområder. I vores IT-team sætter vi en ære i at levere god service og gå den ekstra mil for vores kolleger. Vi har et rigtig godt, socialt sammenhold, og vi er gode til at sparre med hinanden,” fortæller Marcus Nørbjerg Bjarnholt, IT-konsulent i Bruun & Hjejle.

Om dig

Vi søger en udvikler med 3+ års erfaring, gerne fra et reguleret miljø eller en konsulentrolle. Du arbejder selvstændigt, tager ejerskab for dine løsninger og kan sige fra, når noget ikke bør bygges. Juridisk baggrund er ikke et krav.

Vi tror, du vil trives hos os, hvis du:

  • Har stærk erfaring med backend og integrationer, herunder API’er, authentication og authorization
  • Har praktisk erfaring med Azure, gerne med identitets- og adgangsstyring (Entra) og eksterne brugere
  • Har bygget konkrete løsninger med LLM-API’er og gerne vil bygge flere
  • Har en god forståelse for sikkerhed, klientdata og compliance
  • Trives med at sidde tæt på dem, der bruger det, du bygger
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk på et højt niveau

Erfaring med frontend og brugergrænseflader, god udviklingspraksis (versionskontrol, test og CI/CD), retrieval, MCP, agenter, Azure AI Foundry, Infrastructure as Code og evaluering af AI-kvalitet er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du et forspring i et felt, der stadig er ved at tage form. Du får reel indflydelse på, hvordan vi bygger, og hvilke løsninger vi satser på. Du ser løsninger, du selv har bygget, blive brugt i nogle af de største danske og internationale sager og transaktioner, og du får en rolle, der kan vokse i takt med, at vores behov gør det.

Vi er store nok til at tiltrække de store komplekse sager, men små nok til, at alle kender alle i teamet. Det betyder, at vi i vores dagligdag har en uformel omgangstone og kommer hinanden ved både fagligt og socialt. Vi har stor respekt for, at vi som individer er forskellige, og at karriere ikke kun handler om dygtiggørelse, specialisering og det næste skridt på karrierestigen. For os handler det også om at skabe et arbejdsliv, som harmonerer med alt det andet, livet også byder på. Derudover prioriterer vi det sociale sammenhold og støtter op om en sund livsstil gennem en række sociale aktiviteter og events på tværs af forretningen.

Ansøg hurtigst muligt

Søg stillingen nedenfor, og vedhæft ansøgning, CV og uddannelsespapirer. I din ansøgning vil vi gerne høre, hvad du har bygget med LLM’er, og hvad du kunne tænke dig at bygge hos os. Vi vurderer ansøgninger og kalder til samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 8. november. Søg kun stillingen gennem linket og ikke mail, grundet GDPR. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR-konsulent Emilie Kempf-Amkær på emke@bruunhjejle.dk. Vil du lære os bedre at kende, kan du følge os på LinkedIn og læse mere om os på .

Vi ønsker en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces, hvor alle har lige muligheder, derfor beder vi dig undlade at tilføje et billede til dit CV.

title: ANESTHESIA TECH
description:
Shift Options\:

Taking call is required.

WHY UT SOUTHWESTERN?
With over 75 years of excellence in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, UT Southwestern is committed to excellence, innovation, teamwork, and compassion. As a world-renowned medical and research center, we strive to provide the best possible care, resources, and benefits for our valued employees. Ranked as the No. 1 hospital in Dallas-Fort Worth according to U.S. News & World Report, we invest in you with opportunities for career growth and development to align with your future goals. Our highly competitive benefits package offers healthcare, PTO and paid holidays, on-site childcare, wage, merit increases and so much more. We invite you to be a part of the UT Southwestern team where you’ll discover a culture of teamwork, professionalism, and a rewarding career!

UT Southwestern is proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. Our benefits are designed to support your overall wellbeing, and include\:
• PPO medical plan, available day one at no cost for full-time employee-only coverage
• 100% coverage for preventive healthcare-no copay

• Retirement Programs through the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS)
• Paid Parental Leave Benefit
• Wellness programs

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

Required
• Education
High School Diploma or equivalent.

1 year of related hospital experience, and successful completion of internal skills assessment within one month orientation period or
Certified Anes Tech

(BLS) BASIC LIFE SUPPORT , course accredited by the American Heart Association (AHA) or American Red Cross (ARC).
Preferred

JOB DUTIES
• Perform daily care and maintenance of CVIR/OR anesthesia machine by inspecting machine for proper working order, cleanliness, appropriate pipeline supply of gases and cylinder gas pressures, proper valve and circuit controls, leaks, and proper calibrations. Removes improperly working anesthesia machines from service and immediately notifies the CVIR/OR leadership.
• Assist the Anesthesiologist with patient transport, technical and support services, and patient care during the induction process.
• Assist the Anesthesiologist with set-up and placement of invasive monitoring lines and dressing application relative to age specific concerns for children, adolescents, adults, and older adults.
• Assists in performing blood gas assessment analysis, labs as appropriate, and distribute results to the CVIR/OR in an efficient and timely manner.
• Perform proper end-of-procedure anesthesia decontamination procedures. Discards all disposable patient care items in the appropriate color coded bag and decontaminates reusable anesthesia equipment using an appropriate hospital grade disinfectant. Cleans the anesthesia machine and prepares CVIR/OR for the following procedure by replacing all disposable items.
• Exhibit a positive attitude in support of the hospital and management including decisions made by the administration and/or management. Refrains from making negative comments about UTSW, medical staff, managers, and/or coworkers.
• Maintain an adequate inventory of CVIR/OR anesthesia supplies and equipment in a cost effective manner. Stocks CVIR/OR anesthesia carts to appropriate PAR's, assists in transporting patients as needed, and assists in room turnover as needed.
• Communicate unresolved issues (relative to staffing, the environment, and performance) to CVIR/OR leadership in an objective and timely manner.
• Operate, clean, and process anesthesia equipment according to manufacturer's instructions. Perform routine maintenance on anesthesia related equipment to ensure proper working order and report all safety hazards.
• Serve as a professional and technical subject matter expert, resource person, and/or preceptor to new staff and complete written clinical performance evaluation form in a timely manner.
• Ensure adequate oxygen supplies are in CVIR/OR. Not to exceed compartment requirements.
• Organize and prioritize anesthesia tasks based on identified need and perform anesthesia duties in a manner that is cost effective without compromising quality patient care. Participate in unit performance improvement activities.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Able to operate basic/standard anesthesia equipment.
• Able to serve as a professional and technical subject matter expert

title: Engr, Software 1
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


Responsibilities

Engineers in the Software team will be working on building and maintaining infrastructure vital for large scale experimentation and deployment of HPC solutions. Domains in which a successful candidate will be encouraged to chip in, will include, data management and data loading, support for machine learning and deep learning model training.

Although familiarity with Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions would be a huge plus, this is primarily a Software Engineering position. Successful candidates are passionate about software and will have outstanding skills and hands on experience with development in C/C++ and Python in a Windows/Linux environment. Deep conceptual understanding of multi-threaded, multi process and distributed software systems is vital.


Crucial Skills

Object Oriented Design & Programming in Java or C++ Scripting languages like Java Script, Python; Data Structures and algorithms Linux System Programming Distributed systems


Desirable Skills

Cloud technologies for network, storage, containerization and compute clusters. Building and configuring Linux kernels, and designing and fixing network infrastructure; Linux Device Driver Development Understanding of various networking stacks GPU Architectures and CUDA (CuGraph, CuData, CuML etc). Distributing computing frameworks like Apache Spark, DASK; Creating the techniques and methods to integrate multiple hardware and software subsystems to seek sophisticated technical challenges;

Data science skills to acquire, transform and present data from various sources to build powerful debugging and analysis software


Qualifications

BS in Math, CS, Engineering or related field.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.



Total Rewards

Base Pay Range: $67,500.00 - $99,033.00 Annually
Primary Location: USA-MI-Ann Arbor-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.


At Sparta, we’re on a mission to build the next generation of commodity trading platforms - replacing the fragmented tools that traders typically rely on with a single, powerful dashboard. Our product is a data-driven platform that aggregates real-time feeds from across the commodities domain, transforming them into intuitive, actionable visualisations within one unified interface. Users can explore pre-built data views or define their own custom formulas to create tailored insights.

To deliver on this vision, our engineers tackle real distributed systems problems on a daily basis, where designing for reliability and performance at scale is essential to a seamless user experience. As we unlock the next level of scale, those problems get harder and more interesting. This role is for an engineer who wants to own meaningful parts of that system now, and grow into the technical decisions that shape it.

We’re looking for people who thrive in an empowered environment - engineers who are comfortable being given problems to solve rather than solutions to implement. You should enjoy working at pace, value autonomy, and prefer to ask for forgiveness rather than permission. You won’t be handed tickets. You’ll be handed context, and trusted to work out the right thing to build.

Whereas Sparta is a remote-first company, for this role we’re looking for someone who values a hybrid working style, which in a typical week could involve spending a couple of days in the office - with flexibility built in.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Design, build and maintain the backend services behind our real-time and analytical data processing.

  • Own features end to end, from shaping the approach to running them in production.

  • Optimise pipelines and services for low latency, high throughput and scale.

  • Work with engineers, product and stakeholders to stay aligned on direction.

  • Contribute to design reviews with a clear view on the trade-offs.

  • Keep your services healthy - observability, feedback loops, incident response.

  • Raise the bar around you through code review, pairing and knowledge sharing.


ABOUT YOU:

  • 4+ years as a software engineer, with production systems you’ve built and supported.

  • High ownership tendencies

  • Experience in a product-focused organisation, working cross-functionally.

  • Comfortable across multiple languages. We mainly use Kotlin, Java, Python and TypeScript.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs - throughput, latency, consistency, cost - and explain them.

  • At home in system design and in low-level implementation detail.

  • Experience building and deploying services on AWS or GCP.

  • Hands-on exposure to Kafka, Flink, Redis or clustered Postgres, and an appetite for more.

  • Comfortable with agent-based development tools. We use Claude Code; any equivalent is fine.

  • A clear communicator and a pragmatic problem-solver.


NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE:

  • Data-intensive applications at scale.

  • Building and interpreting observability - metrics, logging, tracing.

  • Working within or alongside DevOps, SRE or infrastructure teams.

  • Complex distributed environments - high throughput, low latency, large datasets.

  • Any exposure to commodities, energy or financial markets. Useful, but we’ll teach you the domain.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Optical Engineer I
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions

OPTICAL ENGINEER I

Based out of Rocket Lab's site Sinclair Interplanetary in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, the Optical Engineer II reports to the optical lead and is responsible for supporting development and maintenance of star tracker products.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Undertake design, analysis and test to develop new star tracker products and maintain existing products
  • Develop, integrate and commission test setups for star tracker production, and research & development
  • Complete data collection and analysis to quantify part level and unit level performance
  • Support the quality team as needed for root cause analysis and disposition of non-conformances
  • Support the production team as needed to complete assembly, integration and test of star tracker products
  • Support the business development team in responding to customer inquiries

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science or engineering
  • Experience in mechanical engineering or related field
  • Experience designing, developing, or testing optical systems

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • 2+ years of experience in mechanical engineering or related field
  • 2+ years of experience designing, developing, or testing optical systems
  • Master’s degree in physics or aerospace engineering
  • Experience with optical design and Zemax OpticStudio
  • Familiarity with optomechanical design and sourcing/selection of optomechanical components
  • Familiarity with spacecraft system design and the space environment
  • Familiarity with lens manufacture and assembly
  • Familiarity with stray light analysis and stray light mitigation techniques
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills
  • Experience with data analysis, visualization and interpretation using Python or Matlab
  • Experience with source control technologies like GIT or SVN
  • Experience with embedded microcontroller development in C

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; RRSP retirement plan options; paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave; paid parental leave; and other discounts and perks.

The expected salary range for the position is displayed in accordance with the Ontario Pay Transparency Act. Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)
$108,000—$113,000 CAD
Base Salary
$81,000—$102,000 CAD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Satellite Systems Engineer (m/w/d), Space & Defense Industry
description:
About the Company

Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore.

The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension.

With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector.

Infinite Orbits is looking for the founding team for its Munich site. Candidates who bring entrepreneurial drive, thrive in ambiguity, want ownership over what they build, and want to make a real difference in space are invited to explore the open positions on the company's website.

Job Description

About the Role

As Satellite Systems Engineer, you own the spacecraft. You turn the agreed mission concept into a buildable, verifiable spacecraft solution covering platform, payload, and their interfaces, drawing on the Infinite Orbits Group's platforms and on German suppliers and partners.

Proposal preparation is a core part of this role: you author the spacecraft design sections of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids, RFI/RFP responses, and funding applications. You substantiate sizing, heritage, and maturity, consolidate supplier input, and make sure that what we offer can be built, verified, and delivered within the cost and schedule we commit to. You work hand in hand with the Mission Systems Engineer, who owns the mission concept, and the Proposal & Project Manager, who runs the proposal process.

Once contracts are won, you carry the spacecraft design through reviews, verification, and integration, and you help build up spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Munich as our German hardware content grows.

  • Spacecraft proposal content: Author the spacecraft design sections of RFI/RFP responses, customer proposals, and national and European funding applications, covering configuration, subsystem and payload selection, spacecraft budgets, heritage and maturity (TRL) justification, compliance, and technical risks.
  • Cost & schedule input for bids: Provide the Proposal & Project Manager with the technical basis for proposal cost and schedule, including make-or-buy decisions, supplier selection, procurement lead times, and verification and integration effort.
  • Supplier & partner input: Request, assess, and consolidate technical offers from suppliers and partners into a coherent proposal baseline.
  • Spacecraft requirements & budgets: Own spacecraft-level requirements derived from the mission baseline and manage spacecraft budgets (mass, power, thermal, link, pointing, propellant) through design and delivery.
  • Interfaces & integration: Define and manage platform, payload, and subsystem interfaces (ICDs), including the integration of payloads and subsystems from German partners.
  • Design reviews & verification: Prepare spacecraft design reviews and own verification and test planning at spacecraft level.
  • Project execution: Own spacecraft engineering workstreams on won contracts, ensuring delivery against technical and contractual requirements.
  • Group coordination: Work closely with platform engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to reuse existing designs and keep the spacecraft baseline consistent across the Group.
  • Capability build-up: Support the build-up of spacecraft integration and verification capability in Germany as the German hardware share grows.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Engineering degree in aerospace, space systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience in spacecraft systems engineering, ideally at platform, prime, or integrator level.
  • Experience contributing spacecraft design, cost, or schedule content to technical proposals in the space or defense sector.
  • Experience with spacecraft integration, verification, or AIT is a plus.

Skills & Other Requirements

  • Strong command of spacecraft subsystems and their interactions (AOCS/GNC, power, thermal, propulsion, communications, structures, data handling).
  • Working knowledge of ECSS standards and spacecraft verification approaches.
  • Ability to size and defend spacecraft solutions, including heritage and maturity claims, under customer or stakeholder scrutiny.
  • Excellent structured writing: able to turn design work into clear, compliant proposal content under deadline pressure.
  • Experience working with suppliers and partners on technical offers and interface definitions.
  • Autonomy and ownership: comfortable owning workstreams independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment, working closely with Group entities in France and beyond.
  • Fluent in German and English.
  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).
  • Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations.

What we offer

  • A founding technical role with direct ownership of spacecraft design and proposal content in a growing European space and defense company.
  • Direct influence on how Infinite Orbits builds spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Germany, in close collaboration with the Infinite Orbits Group.

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Infrastructure Lead to provide full-time, on-site IT support for our Bangalore VLSI design center and its growing team of design engineers. This is a hands-on senior role covering end-user computing (Windows/Mac/Linux), enterprise networking, and server and cloud infrastructure, working as part of the broader Mythic IT function. The role coordinates closely with Mythic HQ IT on standards, security, infrastructure, tools, and support processes, and follows global IT policies and architecture rather than defining separate local processes. The ideal candidate is a strong, hands-on senior engineer who can manage local vendor relationships and act as the local resource and liaison for India IT needs.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Site IT Operations & Global Coordination Provide and own day-to-day, on-site IT support for the design center and act as the local point of contact and liaison for IT matters; implement and follow Mythic's global IT policies, asset management processes, and support standards rather than defining separate local processes; coordinate closely with Mythic HQ IT/security teams on standards, security, infrastructure, tools, support processes, audits, and compliance; manage local vendor relationships for hardware, software, networking, and EDA licensing; support and coordinate any additional India-based IT resources as part of the broader Mythic IT function.

  1. End-User Computing Support (Must Have) Maintain and troubleshoot Windows, Mac, and Linux laptops/desktops and peripherals for the local design engineering team; manage the full hardware lifecycle including procurement, imaging, patching, warranty, and asset tracking; ensure minimal downtime through proactive monitoring and rapid issue resolution; standardize OS images, software deployment, and security configurations across all three platforms.

  1. Identity, Endpoint & Security Administration (Must Have) Administer Mythic's global identity and access standards locally, including single sign-on and multi-factor authentication enrollment, group-based access and local approval of access requests; operate unified endpoint management, disk encryption and patch compliance across the local fleet; execute onboarding and offboarding in line with global joiner, mover and leaver processes; produce the evidence required for customer and third-party security assessments.

  1. Networking & Security Configure and maintain networking equipment (switches, routers, firewalls) in coordination with the global IT team; manage and troubleshoot site-to-site VPN connectivity between our sites; administer firewall rules, access policies, and network security configurations; monitor network performance and proactively resolve connectivity issues affecting design workflows.

  1. Linux Server, Remote Desktop & Cloud Infrastructure (Must Have) Install, configure, and maintain Linux servers supporting design and compute workloads; own the local remote desktop and virtual workstation experience that the design team depends on, including performance troubleshooting across long-haul links to our other sites; provision and manage cloud computing resources as required by project needs; perform server administration including user management, storage, backups, patching, and performance tuning; support compute farm and job scheduling environments used for EDA workloads where applicable.

  1. Containers & Automation (Must Have): Build, run, and maintain container images and container-based build and CI environments used by local engineering teams; troubleshoot containerized workloads; use scripting and configuration management to automate routine administration rather than performing it by hand.

  1. EDA Tool Support (Good to Have): Assist with installation, configuration, and licensing of EDA tools on Linux servers and workstations; support license server troubleshooting; coordinate with design teams and EDA vendors during upgrades or issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or related field

  • 8–10 years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior/lead capacity

  • Strong hands-on expertise across Windows, Mac, and Linux desktop support

  • Solid Linux server administration skills (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, security hardening) across both major distribution families

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and containers, including building and maintaining images and running container-based build or CI environments

  • Working knowledge of networking: VPN, firewalls, switches, routing, VLANs

  • Experience administering an enterprise identity provider (SSO and MFA) and an MDM or unified endpoint management platform

  • Exposure to cloud platforms for compute provisioning

  • Experience supporting remote desktop or virtual workstation environments for technical users

  • Proven ability to run on-site IT operations for a site/center while working within a central/global IT team, including vendor and stakeholder management

  • Excellent communication skills to coordinate with global (US) teams across time zones

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and process-orientation

Good to Have

  • Experience with EDA tool installation and license management

  • Familiarity with compute farm/job scheduler tools

  • Certifications such as CCNA, RHCE, Apple Certified support, or cloud certifications

  • Experience supporting semiconductor/VLSI design flows

  • Scripting skills (Bash, Python) for automation

Requirements

Senior IT Infrastructure Lead – Mythic India

Experience: 8–10 years

Location: Bangalore

Reports to: Director, IT & DevOps (with local, day-to-day coordination with the India Center Director)

title: Tech Communications Lead
description:
Mercury is building the financial and banking* products founders actually want: one that’s fast, intuitive, and crafted to help them do more with their money. As AI changes how companies are built and run, we’re rethinking what Mercury can do for the people running them. We’re looking for a Tech Communications Lead to tell that story and to make Mercury the company founders, builders, and the broader tech world think of when it comes to AI and innovation in finance and banking. This includes:

  • Shaping and owning Mercury’s technology and innovation narrative, including how we’re building AI that helps founders and entrepreneurs run better
  • Partner with our co-founder and senior product and AI leaders to bring that story to market through integrated comms: podcasts, events, content, social, press, and more

In this role, you will report to our Head of Comms and own how the world understands Mercury’s approach to technology and AI. You’ll turn what our product and AI teams are building into stories that resonate with customers, prospects, future teammates, and investors, and you’ll put our leaders in the rooms and conversations that matter. You’ll join a creative, scrappy, and highly collaborative comms team where ideas move fast and you’ll have real ownership from day one. If you love sitting at the intersection of product, storytelling, and the startup ecosystem, and want to build something rather than maintain it, this role is for you.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

  • Develop and own Mercury’s technology, AI, and innovation narrative, translating complex product and engineering work into clear, compelling stories for founders/entrepreneurs, SMBs, and the broader tech community
  • Partner closely with our co-founder and senior product and AI leaders to build their thought leadership platforms, including messaging, talking points, bylines, and social presence
  • Build and run an integrated comms program across podcasts, speaking opportunities, events, owned content, social media, and press to grow Mercury’s reputation in AI and innovation
  • Identify and secure high-impact podcast, conference, and media opportunities that put our leaders in front of customers, prospects, talent, and investors
  • Lead comms for product and AI launches in partnership with product marketing, ensuring every launch ladders up to a cohesive innovation story
  • Cultivate relationships with tech, AI, and startup journalists, creators, and podcast hosts
  • Create and edit content such as blog posts, executive social posts, talks, and briefing docs, and coach spokespeople to deliver them with confidence
  • Keep a pulse on the AI and fintech landscape, spotting trends, competitive moves, and moments where Mercury can lead the conversation
  • Measure what’s working and use those insights to sharpen strategy over time
  • Use AI tools to scale the team’s output and experiment with new formats, workflows, and ways of reaching our audiences

You should:

  • Have 7-10 years of experience in communications with significant time spent on tech, product, or AI storytelling at a high-growth startup or tech company
  • Be a hands-on, fluent user of AI tools in your own work, whether for research, workflow automation, or content and be excited to find new ways AI can make a small comms team punch above its weight
  • Have a track record of building executive and founder thought leadership programs, especially across podcasts, speaking, and social
  • Be able to take technical concepts like AI products and infrastructure and make them clear, human, and exciting without losing accuracy
  • Be an exceptional writer and editor with a sharp sense of narrative and voice
  • Have strong relationships with, or a clear ability to build relationships with, tech and AI media, podcasters, and creators
  • Be comfortable working directly with founders and senior leaders, earning their trust and pushing back when needed
  • Be a builder at heart: scrappy, resourceful, and energized by creating programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment
  • Be genuinely curious about AI, startups, and the founder journey
  • Bonus: experience in fintech or communicating with founder and SMB audiences

title: Sr. Strategic Commercial Banking Consultant
description:
Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best & Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy - transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary - come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S.


As a remote-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title.


Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn!

The Sr Strategic Commercial Banking Consultant serves as a highly specialized subject matter expert responsible for guiding the successful implementation and optimization of Alkami’s commercial banking capabilities across complex and strategic financial institution engagements. This role applies broad expertise in commercial banking operations, business process consulting, implementation strategy, and client advisory services to ensure Alkami’s platform aligns with customer operational models, regulatory considerations, and business banking objectives. The position partners closely with executive client stakeholders, Product, Implementation, Technical Consulting, and Customer Success teams to influence solution design, identify operational gaps, and drive scalable implementation outcomes that improve customer readiness and long-term platform adoption. The Sr Strategic Commercial Banking Consultant is recognized as a trusted advisor and thought leader who shapes commercial banking implementation practices, influences product direction, and contributes to organizational strategy through expertise in business banking operations, client delivery, and operational transformation initiatives.



Essential Duties & Responsibilities


● Lead strategic commercial banking implementation engagements by advising financial institution stakeholders on solution design, operational alignment, and best practices for Alkami’s business banking capabilities

● Serve as the senior subject matter expert for Alkami commercial banking functionality including Business ACH, Business Wires, Business Admin, Business Reports, BAI2, Limit Management, Import Mapper, Householding, and Auto Billing

● Partner with executive customer stakeholders by analyzing complex commercial banking operational models, identifying business requirements, and recommending scalable implementation approaches aligned with customer goals and regulatory considerations

● Drive strategic solution design activities by mapping client commercial banking operations to Alkami platform capabilities, identifying process gaps, and recommending workflow, product, or operational improvements that support long-term customer success

● Influence implementation strategy and customer onboarding outcomes by advising cross-functional implementation teams on business banking operational impacts, configuration decisions, and customer readiness requirements

● Lead hosted commercial user acceptance testing activities by facilitating testing sessions, validating business workflows, refining platform configurations, and reducing operational issues prior to production deployment

● Serve as the primary liaison between customer stakeholders and internal implementation, technical consulting, engineering, and product teams by translating business banking requirements into actionable technical and operational recommendations

● Provide thought leadership on commercial banking operations and platform utilization by advising customers and internal stakeholders on best practices, evolving industry trends, and operational optimization opportunities

● Analyze complex implementation challenges and operational risks by evaluating customer processes, integration dependencies, business workflows, and organizational impacts to develop strategic mitigation recommendations

● Drive cross-functional coordination efforts by aligning implementation priorities, operational readiness activities, and customer expectations across internal teams and external stakeholders

● Influence Alkami product strategy and roadmap discussions by communicating customer feedback, operational pain points, feature enhancement opportunities, and evolving commercial banking requirements to Product and Engineering leadership

● Develop scalable implementation guidance, operational frameworks, and best practices documentation that improve consistency, customer adoption, and implementation efficiency across commercial banking engagements

● Mentor and guide implementation consultants and customer-facing teams by sharing expertise related to business banking operations, client advisory approaches, and commercial implementation methodologies

● Support strategic customer relationships by serving as a trusted advisor during escalations, operational reviews, and implementation planning discussions involving executive stakeholders

● Contribute to organizational growth and operational excellence initiatives by influencing commercial banking consulting methodologies, implementation standards, and customer engagement strategies that improve client outcomes and delivery scalability


Recommended Experience & Education

Minimum Years of Experience


10–15 years of experience leading commercial banking consulting engagements, enterprise banking implementations, treasury management operations, or client-facing business banking transformation initiatives within fintech, digital banking, financial services, or related environments, including experience advising executive stakeholders and driving complex operational implementations.

Education Level


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Banking, or a related field.


Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications


Required


● Deep expertise in commercial banking operations, treasury management services, and business banking implementation practices

● Advanced knowledge of commercial banking products, workflows, and operational processes including ACH, wires, reporting, limit management, and related banking services

● Strong ability to analyze complex customer operational models and translate business requirements into scalable implementation solutions

● Experience leading strategic customer engagements involving executive stakeholders, operational transformation, and enterprise implementation initiatives

● Ability to influence implementation strategy, product direction, and operational best practices across cross-functional teams

● Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills across technical, operational, and executive audiences

● Experience facilitating complex user acceptance testing, operational readiness activities, and customer advisory sessions

● Recognized subject matter expertise in commercial banking consulting, implementation delivery, and customer operations optimization


Preferred

● Knowledge of banking integrations, BAI2 processing, or treasury management operational workflows

● Experience influencing product roadmap discussions or operational enhancement initiatives

● Familiarity with enterprise implementation methodologies, customer onboarding operations, or change management practices

title: Senior Critical Operations Technician (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Critical Operations Technician is the senior on-shift technical role responsible for ensuring safe, stable and consistent operation of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems. The role provides elevated technical capability, supports first-response incident actions, verifies plant condition after maintenance or resets, and guides technicians in executing operational tasks with accuracy and discipline. This position supports STACK’s 100% uptime commitment through strong operational judgement, trend awareness, structured troubleshooting and the ability to stabilise plant conditions within authorised boundaries. The Senior Technician also enhances shift performance by coaching team members, refining documentation quality and maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

• Support STACK’s 100% uptime objective through disciplined operational control, proactive monitoring and accurate technical response.

• Maintain real-time awareness of plant condition through BMS/EPMS, alarms and inspections, taking timely actions within authorised limits.

• Provide senior technical support to shift technicians, assisting with prioritisation, procedural clarity and execution quality.

• Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems, including UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CRAC/CRAH, CDU/FWU, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant, strictly within approved procedures and authorisations.

• Perform structured diagnostics on abnormal conditions, apply permitted stabilisation actions and escalate with clear technical detail and recommended next steps.

• Support operational event response, including immediate containment actions, technical communication and accurate event documentation.

• Conduct enhanced rounds including thermal, capacity, vibration/noise, leak detection and set-point verification, ensuring findings are recorded and actioned.

• Identify trends, weak signals and reliability concerns using BMS/EPMS data and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.

• Manage on-shift work execution with strict adherence to permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO, vendor access and operational handbacks.

• Coordinate vendor activities during shift, ensuring safe execution, clear understanding of plant impacts and thorough return-to-service verification.

• Validate operational readiness following maintenance, resets or configuration changes, confirming alarms, redundancy, load paths and expected operating conditions.

• Review and improve the quality of shift logs, event notes, CMMS entries and handovers to ensure accuracy, clarity and traceability.

• Raise and escalate recurring defects, reliability risks and improvement opportunities through appropriate channels.

• Contribute to procedure reviews, readiness activities, drills and documentation improvements with practical, shift-based insights.

• This role does not perform licensed electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted activities are completed by appropriately qualified and licensed personnel. The Senior Technician focuses on operational system management, first-response stabilisation, verification and coordination.

People

• Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.

• Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.

• Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.

• Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.

• Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.

• Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and vendor personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.

• Demonstrate a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

• Strong operational discipline and sound judgement in a critical facility environment.

• High technical capability in electrical and/or mechanical systems within authorised boundaries.

• Effective structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.

• Ability to interpret alarms, telemetry, trends and technical documentation.

• Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational workflow tools.

• Strong written and verbal communication for shift documentation, incidents and customer updates.

• Contractor coordination skills with strong permit-to-work and LOTO awareness.

• Ability to coach others and improve team execution quality.

• Calm, methodical approach during alarms and operational events.

• Continuous improvement mindset with focus on reliability and operational quality.

Preferred Education and Experience

• Experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, defence or industrial facilities.

• Demonstrated capability operating and monitoring critical power and cooling systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, controls and fire systems.

• Hands-on experience conducting operational inspections and first-response stabilisation actions.

• Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools for monitoring, work management and operational documentation.

• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, technical drawings and OEM documentation.

• Familiarity with permit-to-work, isolations/LOTO and basic operational risk assessment.

• Strong written and verbal communication suitable for logs, handovers and customer-facing updates.

Work Environment / Conditions

• Role operates on a 24/7 rotating shift roster including nights, weekends and public holidays.

• Work occurs in data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required in accordance with site policy.

• Participation in emergency response activities and incident exercises is required.

Travel Required

• Minimal travel is expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

• Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.

• Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.

• Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.

• Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

• Legal entitlement to work in Australia.

• Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.

• Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.

• Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

title: Swedish Speaker - 3-Day Paid User Research Study

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

title: Software Engineer III, Workspace Foundations

Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

As a Software Engineer at Verily, you will play a pivotal role in developing and enhancing products that are focused on the promise of precision health. title: Short-Term Paid Research Study for German-Speaking Students - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native German speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in German actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native German speaker who grew up in Germany.
  • You use German in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
