title: Athletic Field Specialist (Soccer)
description:
Randall’s Island Park Alliance, Inc.
Job Opening Notice: 10/17/2026 - Until Filled
Job: Athletic Field Specialist (Soccer)
Department: Sports Field
Job Type: Full-Time, Year-Round; 40 hours per week; weekends and holidays required, overtime when required; Non-Exempt
Pay Range: $27.00-$32.00 / per hour
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package 60 days following date of hire (health insurance, paid time off, free parking on site etc.)
Work Location: Randall’s Island Park, New York, NY 10035
POSITION DESCRIPTION
The Athletic Field Specialist will report to the Director of Grounds and the Sports Field Manager and will work alongside members of the Sports Field crew to maintain high-quality athletic playing surfaces throughout Randall’s Island Park. The position will have a primary focus on maintaining and preparing the Kentucky bluegrass, sand-based regulation soccer pitch at Icahn Stadium at professional level standards while occasionally supporting the Park’s other 60+ playing fields, as needed. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in turf maintenance, a strong working knowledge of professional soccer field maintenance and the ability to work independently, with oversight from Management. This position offers a unique opportunity to help maintain fields of various playing surfaces and levels across a 330-acre park in New York City.
MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Implement and maintain an effective turf plan for the Icahn Stadium soccer field, under the direction of the Director of Grounds and Sports Field Manager.
• Perform day-to-day and specialized maintenance of the Icahn Stadium soccer pitch, with a focus on maintaining a safe, consistent and high-quality playing surface suitable for professional and semi-professional competition.
• Monitor and assess the condition of the pitch and identify maintenance needs related to turf health, soil conditions, moisture, drainage, irrigation and playability.
• Assist with implementation of a responsible integrated pest management program for the Icahn Stadium field.
• Provide gameday support during matches, including field inspections, preparation, lining, watering, and post-match maintenance.
• Work with the Randall’s Island Sports Field crew to assist with daily field maintenance including field layout, dimensions, lining, mowing, seeding, fertilizing, watering, leveling, laying sod, removing debris, and rolling.
• Perform and assist with specialized field projects, including field leveling, irrigation installation and repair, aeration, seeding, sod removal and installation and field renovation.
• Use specialized field assessment and maintenance tools such as compaction testers, soil moisture meters, shear test tools and other equipment.
• Operate hand tools such as various hoes, rakes, tampers, and shovels.
• Operate small equipment such as walk and riding lawnmowers, weed whackers, vibratory tamps, sod cutters, edgers and backpack leaf blowers.
• Operate large equipment such as motorized utility vehicles, tractors, and skid steers.
• Ensure equipment is secured and well-maintained, including washing, greasing, fueling, and arranging for service of equipment.
• Maintain timely communication regarding work-related matters, including regularly reviewing and responding to emails, participating in meetings with Management and Specialists and providing requested information.
• Regularly communicate with the Director of Grounds and Sports Field Manager regarding field conditions, turf health, maintenance needs, project status and issues requiring attention.
• Perform other general tasks as assigned.
This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that an employee in this position may be asked to perform from time to time.
QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:
• Minimum of two (2) years of professional experience in turf or athletic field maintenance, including stadiums, professional or collegiate sports facilities, golf courses, soccer fields, ballfields, or other high-quality playing surfaces.
• Working knowledge of and ability to assist with a variety of projects pertaining to the soccer fields which can include field renovations, sod removal, sod installation, irrigation install, repair/adjustments, aeration, seeding, and drainage.
• Ability to assess field conditions and troubleshoot issues related to turf health, soil conditions, moisture, compaction, drainage, irrigation, and playability.
• Working knowledge of soccer field dimensions, layouts, and playing formats with the ability to accurately line fields and use appropriate lining materials.
• Knowledge of natural and synthetic turf maintenance practices.
• Knowledge of field and soil amendments and their appropriate use and application.
• Ability to safely operate hand tools and specialized field assessment tools.
• Ability to safely operate small and large equipment used in turf and field maintenance.
• Strong attention to detail, organization skills and the ability to prioritize, and shift focus as needed.
• Sound judgement, able to troubleshoot problems and adapt to changing field conditions and maintenance needs.
• Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team, communicate effectively and develop positive working relationships with colleagues and management.
• Ability to work weekends, holidays, evenings and a fluctuating schedule.
• Ability to work outdoors in all different types of weather, under strenuous conditions.
• Ability to perform physical labor; must be able to lift 50lbs.
• Valid Driver License.
PREFERRED SKILLS/QUALIFICATIONS:
• Formal training, certificate or education in turf management, agronomy, sports field management, horticulture or a related field.
• Materials applications experience.
• Pesticide license.
• Fluency in Spanish.
To apply, please complete an application online at:
https:// randallsisland.org/about /employment-opportunities/

title: Cybersecurity Engineer - DoD RMF & Authorization
description:
Who we are:

Fuse builds innovative communications, networking, and computing solutions that improve the sharing of information, video, text, and voice among operators distributed throughout the airborne, maritime, and ground environments. We are a Technology firm creating in-house software, network and hardware solutions that support our noble cause of advancing warfighter capabilities with elegant, user-focused communications, networks, and software systems.

About this role:

Do you thrive in innovative, design-driven environments with a high level of both accountability and trust? Are you passionate about protecting computer and network systems from cyber attacks and vigilant about resolving vulnerabilities? If so – we want to hear from you! Fuse is currently developing, integrating, and testing secure communications networks for U.S. defense agencies that improve the sharing of information among warfighters distributed throughout airborne, maritime, and ground environments. Must have in-depth experience with Linux and virtualized systems.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the execution of the Department of Defense (DoD) Risk Management Framework (RMF) process for information systems throughout development, testing, authorization, and operational lifecycles.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage complete RMF authorization packages supporting Authorizations to Operate (ATOs), Interim Authorizations to Test (IATTs), and ongoing system authorization activities.
  • Prepare and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), security control implementation statements, Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), hardware and software inventories, system architecture documentation, and other required RMF artifacts.
  • Manage RMF authorization packages within Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS), ensuring security control documentation, assessment evidence, and supporting artifacts are accurate, complete, and maintained throughout the authorization lifecycle.
  • Analyze and document security control implementations in accordance with NIST SP 800-53, DoDI 8510.01, CNSSI 1253, applicable DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and DoD cybersecurity policies.
  • Coordinate with Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), Information System Security Officers (ISSOs), Security Control Assessors (SCAs), Authorizing Officials (AOs), and government representatives to support security assessments and authorization decisions.
  • Evaluate system architectures, configurations, and operational environments to determine security control applicability, implementation approaches, and compliance requirements.
  • Review and interpret vulnerability assessment results from ACAS, Nessus, SCAP, and STIG compliance assessments to identify security deficiencies, document associated risks, and develop remediation recommendations.
  • Develop, maintain, and track POA&Ms, coordinating with engineering teams to resolve identified vulnerabilities, document mitigating factors, and support risk acceptance decisions.
  • Support Security Control Assessment (SCA) activities by preparing assessment evidence, responding to findings, coordinating technical demonstrations, and resolving documentation deficiencies.
  • Develop and execute continuous monitoring activities to maintain the cybersecurity posture and authorization status of assigned information systems.
  • Assess proposed system modifications, software updates, and configuration changes to determine their impact on security controls, authorization boundaries, and existing ATO/IATT conditions.
  • Collaborate directly with systems, software, and network engineers to ensure cybersecurity requirements are incorporated into system design, development, integration, and testing activities.
  • Provide technical guidance on secure configurations, operating system hardening, network security, virtualization, and vulnerability remediation to support compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements.

Requirements

  • 6–8 years of professional experience in DoD cybersecurity, information assurance, systems administration, network engineering, or related technical disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting DoD RMF authorization activities, including development and maintenance of ATO and/or IATT packages.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining RMF documentation, including SSPs, security control implementation statements, POA&Ms, and supporting assessment artifacts.
  • Experience utilizing eMASS to document security controls, manage authorization artifacts, track assessment findings, and maintain RMF packages.
  • Strong working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, DoD RMF requirements, and security control implementation and assessment methodologies.
  • Experience interpreting DISA STIG requirements, vulnerability assessment results, and system security configurations to determine compliance and develop remediation recommendations.
  • Experience reviewing technical system configurations, network architectures, and security control implementations to support accurate RMF documentation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, including system administration, security hardening, access controls, and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with virtualized environments such as VMware, KVM, or Hyper-V and their associated cybersecurity considerations.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, subnets, firewalls, routing, network segmentation, and secure communications.
  • Ability to analyze cybersecurity findings, document technical risks, and communicate remediation requirements to engineering teams and government stakeholders.
  • Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated ability to produce clear, accurate, and technically defensible security documentation.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple RMF deliverables, coordinate across engineering disciplines, and meet program authorization milestones.
  • Ability to meet applicable DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements for the assigned work role.
  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Active Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience independently managing DoD RMF authorization packages from initial system categorization through authorization and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience supporting successful ATO/IATT submissions, security assessments, and authorization package reviews.
  • Familiarity with Navy, Marine Corps, or Air Force RMF authorization processes and service-specific requirements.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity accreditation of Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation (RDT&E) systems, developmental systems, or operational DoD capabilities.
  • Experience coordinating directly with SCAs, AOs, government ISSMs, and other authorization stakeholders.
  • Experience performing security control inheritance analysis, developing system authorization boundaries, and identifying applicable overlays and control tailoring requirements.
  • Experience using ACAS, Nessus, SCAP, STIG Viewer, and other vulnerability assessment or compliance tools.
  • Experience with technical implementation of DISA STIGs and security hardening of Linux, Windows, networking equipment, and virtualized environments.
  • Familiarity with DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-37, CNSSI 1253, and applicable DoD continuous monitoring guidance.
  • Knowledge of Navy Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (C4ISR) systems, military networks, or tactical data links.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity requirements within Agile software development or systems engineering environments.
  • Experience assessing cybersecurity risks associated with custom software, specialized hardware, or mission-specific system architectures.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a cybersecurity professional with substantial experience supporting DoD RMF authorization activities and a strong technical foundation in systems and network security.

This individual understands how to develop and maintain technically accurate RMF packages, interpret security control requirements, and coordinate authorization activities with engineering teams and government stakeholders.

Beyond documentation, the successful candidate will be able to examine system configurations, understand network architectures, interpret vulnerability assessment results, and determine whether security controls are appropriately implemented.

We are seeking someone who can independently drive RMF activities, identify potential authorization challenges, and work proactively with engineering teams to resolve technical and compliance issues.

Candidates should be comfortable operating in dynamic engineering environments where systems evolve throughout development, testing, and deployment.

We recognize that qualified candidates bring diverse technical backgrounds and experiences. If you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply and explain how your experience aligns with the position.

More about Fuse:

Founded in 2010, Fuse is a veteran-owned, rapidly growing small business. Our San Diego-based company has earned recognition as an emerging leader in airborne, maritime, and ground networking. Placing the warfighter at the center of every design process, Fuse delivers intuitive, agile, and resilient products that go beyond national security requirements—providing lasting utility and game-changing results. We take pride in our brilliant and talented team as well as our dynamic environment and collaborative, creative, environment. We build cutting-edge hardware and software products that solve complex national security challenges for our warfighters at the tactical edge.

Salary Range: $120,000 - $160,000

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
    • Employee coverage is fully funded; a portion of dependents' coverage is funded as well
  • 11 paid Federal Holidays
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
    • Date of hire through second year: 10 days/year (accrued)
    • After two years: unlimited
  • 40 hours of paid sick leave per year
  • 401k with employer matching
  • Annual bonuses
  • Cell phone reimbursement: $100/month

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role


At Megapixel, data plays a key role in how we understand our customers, measure performance and make business decisions.


We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our growing Business Intelligence team and help develop, maintain and improve our data platform.


You will work with both batch and real-time data, building reliable pipelines and making sure data is available, accurate and ready for analysis. You will also help improve the performance, reliability and scalability of our existing infrastructure.


This is a hands-on role where you will work with a modern cloud-based data stack and have the opportunity to shape how our data platform evolves.


Our Technology Stack


  • Data streaming: Apache Kafka
  • Data processing: Apache Spark on AWS EMR
  • Cloud storage: Amazon S3
  • Data warehouse: Snowflake
  • Data transformation: dbt
  • Workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop and maintain reliable batch and streaming data pipelines.
  • Maintain and improve our Spark-based data processing infrastructure.
  • Build and optimise data transformations and models in Snowflake using dbt.
  • Manage and improve data pipeline orchestration using Airflow.
  • Monitor data quality, pipeline reliability and system performance.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with internal and third-party data sources.
  • Investigate and resolve data pipeline and infrastructure issues.
  • Apply good engineering practices, including testing, version control and CI/CD.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation for data pipelines, systems and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with BI, product and engineering teams to understand data needs and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve our data platform.


Requirements


  • At least 3 years of professional experience in data engineering or a similar technical role.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with analytical databases or data warehouses.
  • Good programming skills in Python, Java or Scala.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow or a similar workflow orchestration tool.
  • Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in a cloud environment, preferably AWS.
  • Good understanding of data modelling and data warehouse concepts.
  • Familiarity with software engineering practices such as Git, testing and CI/CD.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with other teams.
  • Good written and spoken English.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with dbt and Snowflake.
  • Experience with Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Previous experience in the iGaming industry.


What the Company Offers


  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Fitness and wellness benefits.
  • Regular wellness initiatives.
  • Fresh fruit and snacks in the office.
  • Weekly team lunches and breakfasts.
  • Company and team events.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
  • Hybrid working arrangements: 4 days in the office and 1 day working remotely each week.


This role will be based on-site in our Gzira, Malta offices.

title: European Portuguese Speaker in NYC - Join a 3-Day Paid Phone Study - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Portuguese speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

description:

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense.

Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for skilled, hands-on engineers who're ready to bring these machines into the real world.

About the Role

As Senior Embedded Hardware Development Engineer, you’ll own the complete electrical design of our UAV compute, sensor and avionic systems. From architecture to component selection, from first schematic to flight test, you’ll be in charge of engineering the electronic and firmware backbone of our spatial intelligence systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and AI teams, but this is your domain, and you’ll be trusted to build it right.

What You’ll Work On

  • Architecture & Design: Translate top level goals into requirements, then schematics and detailed designs for sensors, compute and communication across our flying platforms

  • Program & Bringup: Bring your design to life by developing and deploying the foundation layers of code in forms of firmware, drivers and operating systems

  • Prototype & Iterate: Build, rework, and test hardware with speed and precision, both in simulation and in flight

  • Optimize & Troubleshoot: Analyze designs via simulation and real-world testing, including EMI/EMC, thermal, power and performance

  • Validate in the Loop: Support hardware-in-the-loop and environmental validation workflows to ensure rugged, reliable designs

  • Document with Purpose: Keep clear records of requirements, tradeoffs, test results, tuning procedures, and design rationale

  • Technologies we use: NXP ARM SoCs, Nvidia Jetson, various NPUs, MIPI-CSI, GMSL, Linux, ROS, Altium Designer and more

Your Profile

  • You hold a . in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in mixed hardware development and software integration, from component selection and PCB design to low-level programming

  • You’re fully proficient in PCB layout tools and eCAD like Altium designer, and have a practical eye for clean, testable and maintainable designs

  • You’re confident with lab equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) and use them to diagnose and debug with purpose

  • You’re experienced in PCB-bringup, debugging, and ensuring they survive real-world use

  • You write and debug embedded firmware in C and/or C++, including peripheral drivers and interfaces between hardware and software

  • You’re familiar with hardware-in-the-loop and environmental testing, and understand how designs fail in the wild

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfection. You iterate until it works. You love building things that last.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Deep understanding of design and verification of EMC / robustness against EMI

  • Thermal design and analysis for compact electronics

  • RF integration and noise suppression

  • MIL-STD, DO-254, CRA and RED qualification experience

  • Automation of test rigs for HIL testing

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Own product design and get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Greece and Spain

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other (conducted by Eugene, our Head of Talent)

  2. Technical Interview (45 min): (with Lukas, our Hardware Lead)

  3. Onsite Trial/Case (2 hrs): We’ll build or test something together, just like on the job (together with our Hardware Team)

  4. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

title: Principal, Document Standards & Quality
description:
Do you care deeply about the details that turn a document from merely readable into truly professional?

Would you like to define the standards that help AI-generated documents look, behave, and edit like the work of a domain professional?

About our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (http://www.relx.com), a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles (https://stories.relx.com/responsible-ai-principles/index.html).

About the Role

As Principal, you will own the Document Quality System that enables AI and engineering teams to produce professional, usable documents. You will translate expert judgment about document quality into clear standards, reference documents, rules, and measurable specifications that can be built and tested.

Responsibilities

  • Define "good." Write the canonical standards for typography, hierarchy, whitespace, tables, lists, headings, citations, pagination, headers and footers, exhibits, and numbering.
  • Build a document taxonomy. Define a distinct formatting grammar for each document family (legal briefs, contracts, client memos, research reports, and others). Each gets its own conventions, and you decide where they share a base and where they diverge.
  • Audit AI output. Review several hundred generated documents and build a failure taxonomy. Classify every formatting defect by type, severity, and root cause, and report the patterns.
  • Create gold-standard documents. Produce human-crafted reference documents for each document type, and version them as test fixtures for AI and engineering teams.
  • Turn judgment into rules. Write explicit, testable specifications, for example how Heading 2 behaves, what tables may never do, no orphaned headings, page-break behavior, and numbering that stays linked to styles rather than being typed by hand. Favor real document structure (styles, numbering, sections) over manual visual formatting.
  • Create the quality score. Develop a Document Quality Score covering structural integrity, visual hierarchy, consistency, readability, template compliance, and editability. Work with engineering to make it measurable, automatable where possible, and calibrated against human expert judgment.
  • Be the standards owner. Adjudicate disputes, review new templates, and represent document quality in product and model-evaluation decisions.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in professional document production, such as legal document production, publishing, technical or editorial design, knowledge management, or a similar field, with a track record of setting standards rather than just following them.
  • Expert command of Word-style structure: style-linked numbering, multilevel lists, sections, headers and footers, tables of contents and authorities, cross-references, and tracked changes. You know why a document that looks right can still be broken.
  • Strong typographic and information-design judgment, and the ability to explain why something is wrong, not just that it is.
  • Sound judgment across professional domains, including familiarity with legal and financial document conventions.
  • Experience in a large law firm, legal operations, or legal technology.
  • Experience with document automation, template systems, or design systems.
  • Familiarity with programmatic document generation (OOXML, PDF) and enough technical fluency to review output at the file level.
  • Prior work evaluating or improving AI-generated content

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer
description:
Company Overview
AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website

Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview

Job Role
We are looking for a hands-on Salesforce expert to help improve the quality and reliability of products built for complex Salesforce engineering environments.

The role combines platform engineering, technical investigation, scenario design, and product validation. You will recreate real-world development and release challenges, establish technically correct outcomes, identify edge cases, and work with Product and Engineering teams to improve product behaviour.

This role is suited to someone who understands how Salesforce behaves beyond the happy path.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design realistic Salesforce development, configuration, and release scenarios.
  • Establish expected outcomes and clear technical acceptance criteria.
  • Validate product behavior across metadata, code, security, integrations, and deployment workflows.
  • Investigate incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent results.
  • Reproduce complex failures across orgs, sandboxes, API versions, and release configurations.
  • Build reusable technical assets that improve product coverage and prevent regressions.
  • Analyze dependencies, deployment sequencing, environment drift, and configuration differences.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize platform gaps and improve reliability.
  • Track Salesforce platform releases and assess their impact on supported workflows.
  • Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls
Pride of Ownership
We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.

Experience & Desired Skills
Required Skills (Mandatory)
  • 5–8 years of hands-on Salesforce development or platform engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, validation rules, and asynchronous processing.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce metadata, dependencies, deployment behavior, and org configuration.
  • Strong knowledge of profiles, permission sets, sharing, roles, record types, and field-level security.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CLI, Metadata API, Tooling API, Apex testing, and deployment troubleshooting.
  • Strong Git skills, including branching, pull requests, merge-conflict resolution, and release promotion.
  • Experience working across multiple Salesforce orgs and sandbox strategies.
  • Ability to explain technical decisions through precise reasoning and evidence.
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail.
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms or Salesforce DevOps products.
  • Experience diagnosing complex metadata, packaging, or environment-specific failures.
  • Exposure to REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, Connected Apps, and Named Credentials.
  • Experience with managed packages, unlocked packages, namespaces, or enterprise release processes.
  • Experience defining technical test scenarios, review standards, or quality frameworks.
  • Experience with one or more Salesforce industry or specialized clouds.
  • Python or scripting experience is beneficial.
Salesforce Platform Exposure
Strong Salesforce Core Platform expertise is required.
Experience in one or more of the following is preferred:
  • Sales Cloud
  • Service Cloud
  • Experience Cloud
  • Revenue Cloud or CPQ
  • Field Service
  • Data Cloud
  • Financial Services Cloud
  • Health Cloud
  • Manufacturing Cloud
  • Salesforce Industries
  • Agentforce
Depth in every cloud is not expected. We value candidates who understand how platform capabilities affect metadata, security, integrations, and releases.

Certification
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, Application Architect, System Architect, or relevant DevOps certifications are preferred (not required)
  • What is required is true experience in Salesforce development & implementations across verticals.
What success looks like
  • Complex Salesforce scenarios are represented accurately and reproducibly.
  • Platform-specific gaps and failure modes are identified early.
  • Technical outcomes are supported by clear evidence.
  • Product coverage expands across meaningful Salesforce use cases.
  • Discovered issues become durable regression protection.
  • Product and Engineering teams can make faster decisions with greater confidence.
Who Will Thrive Here
You will thrive in this role if you:
  • Enjoy investigating why the same change behaves differently across environments.
  • Naturally look for dependencies, edge cases, and hidden assumptions.
  • Can distinguish a valid alternative from a technically incorrect result.
  • Turn difficult incidents into repeatable technical scenarios.
  • Prefer evidence over intuition.
  • Communicate complex Salesforce behavior clearly and precisely.
Why join AutoRABIT
Your Salesforce expertise will directly influence how our products behave. You will have the opportunity to turn domain knowledge into better customer workflows and help teams prevent failures before customers encounter them.

title: Ecological Horticulturist
description:
Randall’s Island Park Alliance, Inc.
Job Opening Notice Posting Dates: 10/17/2026 – Until filled
Title: Ecological Horticulturist
Job Type: Full-Time, Year-Round; Monday – Friday, plus overtime and weekends when needed, Non-Exempt
Pay Range: $24-$27/per hour
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package 60 days following date of hire (health insurance, paid time off, etc.)
Work Location: Randall’s Island Park, New York City 10035
POSITION DESCRIPTION:
Randall’s Island Park Alliance, Inc. (RIPA) is a 501(c) (3) non-profit organization that works with the City of New York and local communities to provide an innovative and exciting destination through a wide range of sports venues, public programs, cultural events, and environmental exploration. The Ecological Horticulturist will report to the Director of Grounds and the Horticulture Manager and work with members of the Horticulture crew to maintain Randall’s Island Parks’ gardens, meadows, and green streets with an emphasis on ecological landscape management, thoughtful landscape design, and creating attractive, welcoming spaces that enhance the visitor experience. Randall’s Island Park is a dynamic public park and horticulture practices must balance ecological stewardship with aesthetics, functionality, and maintenance needs. The Ecological Horticulturist will also assist with volunteer events, tours, and programming, as needed.
MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:
• General maintenance/oversight of all landscapes and gardens including wildflower meadows, woodlands, perennial gardens, and green streets. Tasks include, but are not limited to, plant propagation soil cultivation, digging, deadheading, thinning, mulching, watering, raking, weeding, edging, seed sowing, bed preparation, tree and shrub pruning, planting, and caring for existing gardens
• Apply knowledge of plants, their cultural requirements, and their botanical nomenclature, including protection and transplanting of existing plants, soil preparation, watering fertilization, irrigation, IPM etc.
• Apply an understanding of landscape design and aesthetics when maintaining and developing gardens, meadows, green streets and other areas with consideration to plant composition, color, texture, scale, sightlines and the overall visual experience of park patrons.
• Assist with training and developing seasonal staff members, giving occasional direction.
• Assist with the preparation of programming activities/festivals, as needed.
• Assist with volunteer groups in the meadows and gardens, as needed.
• Provide the Communications team with information for occasional social media posts.
• Support research and data collection projects, including pollinator monitoring, bloom phenology, and vegetation surveys, and work collaboratively with members of the Natural Areas and Park-as-Lab team.
• Maintain horticultural databases with accuracy.
• Hand water and monitor irrigation of plantings, especially during time of establishment and drought.
• Create and maintain containers for seasonal and holiday visual displays.
• Act as an ambassador for Randall’s Island, answering questions from visitors, including horticulture, park design, history, and general information.
• Operate hand tools and basic power machinery, including hedge trimmers, weed whackers, and leaf blowers and will report need for replacement or repairs to Management.
• Drive vehicles and operate other motorized equipment incidental to the performance of duties.
• General clean-up of garden beds and paths, including litter removal.
• Ensure all equipment is secure and well-maintained.
• Perform all other general tasks as assigned.
This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that an employee in this position may be asked to perform from time to time.
QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:
• B.A. in Public Horticulture or related fields OR equivalent horticulture certificate/coursework OR 3 years hands-on experience in horticulture/landscaping.
• Strong gardening skills and familiarity with gardening tools.
• Knowledge in management and maintenance techniques of native ecosystems.
• Strong native/non-native, perennial/annual, tree/shrub and weed identification skills.
• Integrated pest management skills and techniques.
• Demonstrated understanding of ecological practices.
• Ability to balance mindful ecological practices with design, aesthetics and visitor experience.
• Knowledge of invasive weeds and ecological techniques.
• Willing to work outdoors in all types of weather, under strenuous conditions.
• Ability to use light power equipment and tools.
• Ability to shift priorities and focus, when needed.
• Ability to collaborate and create positive working relationships.
• Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects.
• Ability to perform physical labor; must be able to lift up to 50 lbs.
• Motivated and punctual, able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Flexibility to work overtime and weekends, when needed.
• Valid Driver License.
PREFERRED SKILLS/QUALIFICATIONS:
• 3 years or more of hands-on gardening/landscaping experience.
• Experience working in public parks and knowledge of landscaping techniques.
• Experience with, and knowledge of plants native to the North-East area of the United States.
• Familiar with greenhouse techniques and plant propagation including annuals, perennials, natives, and non-natives.
• Knowledge of composting.
• Basic carpentry skills.
• Experience operating equipment (ie. Backhoe/loader, skidsteer, tractor, etc.).
• Experience working with volunteers and the public.
• Knowledge of sustainable landscape design.
• Familiarity with Integrated Pest Management (IPM) strategies.
• GIS knowledge.
• Certified Arborist.
To apply, please complete and application online at:
https://randallsisland.org/about/employment-opportunities/

description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

Your Role at Vantive

We are seeking a Senior IT Specialist, Supply Chain Planning Systems responsible for ensuring supply chain planning global applications meet business requirements and remain in a steady state throughout their lifecycle. This role requires hands-on experience with supply chain planning application such as Rapid Response.


As the Senior IT Specialist, Supply Chain Planning Systems, you will:

  • Own and manage supply chain planning and reporting applications, ensuring they are designed, operated, and maintained per business requirements.
  • Serve as the Technical specialist, gathering and analyzing business needs, defining requirements, and architecting solutions.
  • Lead system testing execution and change management in a regulated and non-regulated environment.
  • Oversee system maintenance, upgrades, defect tracking, and issue resolution in collaboration with IT and business teams.
  • Act as the primary liaison between IT, business process owners, and external vendors.

Open to applicants across the country, this is a remote position


What You’ll Be Doing


System Ownership & Governance

  • Implement solutions that align with business needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain system documentation, including functional requirements, technical design specifications, validation plans, and change control records.
  • Ensure systems remain in a validated state throughout their lifecycle.

Technical Solution Design

  • Gather, analyze, and document technical requirements, workflows, and process improvements.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical specifications.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to develop and deploy configurable solutions in Rapid Response.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned with Vantive’s Digital Transformation strategy.

Validation, Testing & Compliance

  • Develop and execute test scripts, UAT scenarios, and validation plans for new implementations and system changes.
  • Manage risk assessments, audits, and regulatory inspections related to system validation and compliance.

System Maintenance, Enhancements & Issue Resolution

  • Oversee system upgrades, patches, and maintenance, recommending enhancements as needed.
  • Manage issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution for system defects.
  • Work closely with business process owners to ensure applications align with operational needs.
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for system support and enhancements.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate should have a strong technical foundation with hands-on experience in enterprise application support, configuration, and deployment.


Key technical competencies include:

  • Kinaxis Configuration: Configure planning workbooks, worksheets, alerts, scenarios, schedule task, scorecards, automation chain and dashboards in Rapid response.
  • Data Integration: Support the integration of data from ERP systems such as JDE or Oracle into Kinaxis using available integration mechanisms and interfaces.
  • Data Modelling: Work with supply chain data, hierarchies, measures, calculations, attributes, and planning logic.
  • Technical Development: Build or maintain calculations, filters, queries, data transformations, and automation workflows supported by the Kinaxis environment.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Knowledge of AWS or Azure, including experience with deploying, configuring, and maintaining applications in a cloud environment.
  • Application Deployment & Support: Familiarity with system integrations, web services (APIs), and troubleshooting production issues. Investigate data discrepancies, integration failures, calculation errors, performance issues, and planning exceptions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning applications, business systems analysis, or enterprise systems
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Kinaxis Rapid Response/Maestro, including Demand Planning and Supply Planning modules
  • Strong knowledge of Kinaxis platform Data modeling concepts (table structures, linkages, configuration)
  • Ability to develop and execute test scripts, validation plans, and system documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic project management experience (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to address complex system issues.

Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

Director, Clinical Operations and Strategy

Lantern is looking for a Director of Clinical Operations and Strategy to join our fast-growing team. We are looking for a seasoned operations and strategy leader, who has a passion for complex clinical operations and optimization problems, to lead various clinical priorities from inception, ideation and discovery, through to road mapping, prioritization, experimentation, and implementation. This position requires an experienced operator who can efficiently lead cross-functional projects, stand-up new initiatives from 0->1 and lead a highly effective clinical operations organization. You will be successful in this role if you can straddle the balance of leading and doing. You should be a systems-thinker, prioritize well, and make high-quality, data-driven decisions, but also be willing to roll up your sleeves to help us continuously improve. This role will work closely with senior clinical leaders and collaborate across all parts of the organization. While this role is focused on ensuring smooth implementation and ongoing operation of clinical priorities, you will also be expected to provide support to the Chief Medical Officer in a Chief of Staff capacity as needed.

Location: Dallas, TX or New York, NY - Hybrid schedule (3x in office per week)

Responsibilities:

  • Drive execution of projects, including program management and change management
  • Lead the definition and implementation of new clinical workflows and processes
  • Design and conduct experiments to optimize existing clinical operations
  • Develop and manage KPIs/SLAs to measure the performance of clinical operations
  • Identify opportunities for process and efficiency improvement

title: Production Development Engineer - R&D
description:
Would you like to help drive the development of tomorrow’s sensor technology? We work on exciting development projects in advanced sensor technology, where new ideas must constantly be turned into real, measurable results.

INFICON Aaland is seeking a Production Development Engineer for our sensor development team. Please note that the workplace is in Mariehamn (Åland, Finland) and that the role requires good oral and written skills in both Swedish and English.

Your Role

This is not a role where you sit still behind a computer reading reports. You will be in the middle of things: coordinating the build of test sensors, making sure the test equipment never stands idle, and being the person who gathers and interprets the data that decides which way development goes next. The work is done in close collaboration with more experienced development engineers and offers unique opportunities to build a deep understanding of how sensors are constructed, how they are manufactured, and how they perform, through hands-on work close to production.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and drive the construction of test sensors and test units together with production, including planning material flow and test batches.
  • Ensure that calibration and test equipment is continuously supplied with samples.
  • Collect, structure and carry out basic analysis of process parameters and measurement data.
  • Identify and report deviations or variation in the build process and contribute to improvements.
  • Serve as the daily point of contact between the development department and production for prototype builds.
  • Document work processes, test results and lessons learned in a structured way that is accessible to the team.
  • Actively take part in team discussions about results and next steps in the development work.
  • Develop and contribute to the continuous improvement of the learning cycles (experiment planning, prototype build and test processes).
  • Actively use AI and statistical tools, for example in experiment planning and data analysis.

  • Engineer or engineering technician (Bachelor or Master)
  • Relatively newly graduated, and eager to put what you've learned into practice.
  • You like being close to production.
  • You are structured with data.
  • You thrive in the space between theory and practice.
  • You don't need to know everything on day one — but you want to learn quickly, take responsibility, and grow with the task.
  • If you bring knowledge in vacuum technology, mechanics or electronics from your studies, we see that as particularly valuable, since the role is at the intersection of these very areas — but it's not a requirement, and we place great emphasis on your curiosity and your practical mindset.

What We Offer

INFICON strives for long-term and sustainable business, and we care about our employees and our environment.

  • A company culture characterised by team spirit, accountability and a positive attitude towards both work and colleagues.
  • We offer flexible working hours to make everyday life easier for our employees.
  • Benefits that contribute to both well-being and community, such as free healthcare, a wellness allowance and regular staff activities.
  • A thorough introduction for all our new employees.
  • International cooperation within the INFICON Group.
  • Clean and modern premises with a pleasant working environment.

Are you an experienced Industrial Maintenance Technician, Industrial Electrician, Electro-Mechanical Technician, Controls Technician, PLC Technician, or Maintenance Supervisor looking for a career where you can make a difference?

Tec Centro – Capital Region is seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical / Industrial Maintenance Instructor to provide hands-on technical training to individuals preparing for careers in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, electrical, automation, and skilled trades.

You don't need to be a career educator to succeed in this role.

If you know how to troubleshoot industrial equipment, diagnose electrical and mechanical problems, work safely, and explain how systems work, we want to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to take the knowledge you've developed in the field and use it to prepare the next generation of skilled technical workers in Central Pennsylvania.

What You'll Teach

You'll provide a combination of classroom, laboratory, demonstration, and hands-on instruction covering core industrial maintenance and electro-mechanical skills.

Training topics may include:

  • Electrical fundamentals and electrical safety
  • AC/DC electrical systems
  • Industrial wiring and electrical components
  • Motors, motor controls, starters, relays, contactors, and transformers
  • Electrical troubleshooting and diagnostics
  • Industrial electrical systems
  • Mechanical systems and power transmission
  • Bearings, belts, chains, gears, couplings, and related components
  • Pneumatic and hydraulic systems
  • Industrial controls and automation
  • Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)
  • Sensors, switches, and control devices
  • Preventive and predictive maintenance
  • Industrial equipment troubleshooting
  • Reading electrical schematics and mechanical drawings
  • Electrical meters and diagnostic equipment
  • Hand and power tools
  • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
  • OSHA and workplace safety practices
  • Basic industrial maintenance principles
  • Workplace communication and professionalism
  • Job readiness and expectations for industrial environments

    • Training content may evolve based on employer needs, student skill levels, available equipment, and changing workforce requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in one or more of the following:
    • Industrial maintenance
    • Industrial electrical
    • Electrical maintenance
    • Electro-mechanical systems
    • Manufacturing maintenance
    • Automation and controls
    • PLCs
    • Mechanical maintenance
    • Industrial machinery
    • Mechatronics
    • Strong understanding of electrical and mechanical systems.
    • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot industrial equipment and systems.
    • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.
    • Strong commitment to workplace safety and proper work practices.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to individuals with varying levels of education and experience.
    • Ability and willingness to work in a hands-on training environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience teaching, training, mentoring, or supervising employees.
  • Experience working with apprentices, entry-level technicians, or individuals entering the skilled trades.
  • PLC programming or troubleshooting experience.
  • Industrial automation and controls experience.
  • Manufacturing or production equipment experience.
  • OSHA and/or NFPA 70E knowledge.
  • Lockout/Tagout experience.
  • Relevant industry certifications or licenses.
  • Associate degree, technical diploma, or formal training in electrical, electro-mechanical, industrial maintenance, automation, mechatronics, or a related field.

title: Japanese Speaker in NYC - Join a 3-Day Paid Phone Study - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Japanese speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Japanese actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.

Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Japanese speaker who grew up in Japan.
  • You use Japanese in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.


The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.


The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.

You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  • Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  • Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
  • Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  • Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
  • Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  • Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
  • Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.

What Success Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.

  • Hands-on engineering: You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
  • Customer empathy: You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
  • Collaboration and communication: You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Enterprise architecture: You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
  • Data expertise: You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
  • AI fluency and continuous learning: You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
  • Proactive problem solving: You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer science or a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms.
  • Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration.
  • Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Temporal, Step Functions, or similar.
  • Experience contributing to architecture decisions or technical strategy at the team or organizational level.
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products such as AEP, AJO, Marketo, CJA, or Target is helpful.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Financial Services, Healthcare, or Government is also helpful.

Why This Team

You’ll solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact and see your solutions reach production. You’ll combine architecture, engineering, strategy, and customer engagement while working with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams.

You’ll also help shape an engineering engagement model centered on rapid experimentation, customer feedback, and AI-assisted execution.


Come build the next generation of enterprise customer experiences with us!


Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
