title: Scientist, Proteomics
description:
Job Summary


Proteomics has emerged as a critical discipline driving contemporary drug discovery and clinical pharmacology. Once reserved as a support function to biochemistry organizations, proteomics is now an integral part of the drug discovery engine, working as a concerted discipline-team alongside pharmacology and molecular pathology within the Discovery & Translational Sciences (DTS) Division of Inotiv. We're looking for an early-career scientist who is excited by that mission and wants to grow their expertise where proteomic data makes a real difference.


The Scientist I, Proteomics is a Master's- or PhD-level scientist who conducts targeted and global proteomic bioanalytical studies supporting drug discovery, biomarker, and translational research programs. Working under the guidance of senior proteomics staff, this role performs hands-on sample preparation, LC-MS/MS analysis, and data processing, contributes to the development and qualification of proteomic assays, and supports communication of results to Study Directors and Sponsors. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career scientist to grow their technical and scientific expertise within a collaborative, cross-functional drug discovery environment.

Scientific Responsibilities


  • Contributes proteomics expertise to cross-functional project teams within DTS, collaborating with In Vivo Pharmacology, Molecular/Cellular Pharmacology, and Investigative & Molecular Pathology to support biomarker discovery, target validation, and translational research programs.
  • Supports the evaluation and implementation of new mass spectrometry-based technologies and workflows, including biomarker-based expression profiling efforts in partnership with Molecular Pathology.
  • Supports communication with Study Directors and Sponsors on targeted and global proteomics bioanalytical projects, and contributes to scientific posters, publications, and presentations that showcase Inotiv's proteomics capabilities.
  • Performs, and contributes to the design of, targeted and global/discovery proteomics studies under the direction of senior scientists, ensuring compliance with established best practices and SOPs.
  • Executes and assists with method development and validation (GxP and non-GxP) and sample-preparation workflows (protein digestion, immunoaffinity enrichment, high-abundance protein depletion, phospho-proteomics); operates and performs routine maintenance on LC-MS/MS instrumentation, chromatography, and automation systems.
  • Performs bioinformatic and statistical analysis of proteomic datasets (e.g., Skyline, FragPipe, Proteome Discoverer) to identify, quantify, and interpret protein and peptide biomarkers, and presents findings to the project team.
  • Drafts and revises SOPs for proteomic sample preparation, LC-MS/MS methods, and data analysis; stays current with scientific literature and emerging technologies.
  • Builds working knowledge of Inotiv's capabilities, particularly at the Nashville site; performs quality control checks of data, prepares data summaries and report sections, and troubleshoots method and assay issues, escalating to senior staff as appropriate.
  • Shares technical knowledge with colleagues and may assist in training team members on established proteomic and mass spectrometry techniques.
  • Follows GLP and SOP requirements, including timely reporting of deviations, accurate documentation, and archival of study data and samples.
  • Works with study management and operations teams to keep projects on track and support customer satisfaction from initiation through completion.
  • Upholds Inotiv Core Values, safety regulations, and confidentiality standards, and interacts professionally with clients, colleagues, and the community.

Teamwork & Professional Development


  • Works collaboratively within the proteomics team and with cross-functional partners to meet project timelines and deliverables.
  • Takes ownership of professional development, seeking out training and mentorship to deepen expertise in proteomics, mass spectrometry, and regulated bioanalysis.
  • Participates actively in team meetings, scientific discussions, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  • Contributes to an environment that supports the company’s commitment to equal employment opportunities and the value of a diverse workforce.

Minimum Requirements


  • Master's degree or PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a related field, with hands-on experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics.
  • 2–3 years of relevant industry experience (e.g., CRO, biotech, or pharmaceutical) or postdoctoral training in proteomics or a related field preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with targeted and/or global/discovery proteomic workflows, including operation of high-resolution LC-MS/MS instrumentation for peptide and protein analysis.
  • Working knowledge of protein/peptide separation, digestion, and enrichment techniques (e.g., immunoaffinity capture, fractionation, high-abundance protein depletion) and chromatographic systems used for proteomic analysis.
  • Experience with proteomic data analysis software (e.g., Skyline, FragPipe, Proteome Discoverer, DIA-NN) for protein and peptide identification and quantitation.
  • Understanding of bioanalytical processes, including sample preparation, calibration, quality control, instrument operation/troubleshooting, method development, data processing, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with analytical testing needs in drug discovery, biomarker verification, and/or clinical or translational proteomics.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn and apply new proteomic techniques to client and program needs.
  • Familiarity with GMP/GLP/GCP regulations and willingness to apply these practices in daily work; experience in a regulated laboratory is a plus.
  • Strong scientific writing skills for data summaries, reports, and manuscripts; peer-reviewed publications, posters, or presentations in proteomics/MS preferred.

Critical Success Factors

  • Results Driven. Drives efficiently and accurately toward results, setting high but achievable standards and continually seeking process improvements.
  • Efficient. Takes ownership of time and effectiveness, acting proactively, working through challenges, and knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Communication. Communicates complex information clearly and articulately, in oral and written form, tailored to audience and purpose.
  • Collaboration. Actively supports team success, shares information, and gets things done with others.
  • Critical Thinking and Problem Solving. Identifies key components of problems, interprets information from varied sources, and generates and evaluates creative solutions.
  • Organization and time Management. Plans and prioritizes work, manages time to meet deadlines, and follows through on commitments.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

  • Work is normally performed in a typical interior office work or laboratory environment
  • Work environment involves exposure to potentially dangerous materials and situations that require following extensive safety precautions and may include use of protective equipment
  • The noise level is usually moderate
  • This position will frequently be involved with radiant/electrical energy, solvents, grease, oil, irritants, acids, bases, and other hazardous chemicals, electro-mechanical hazards, flammable materials and bio-hazards.
  • Due to exposure to hazardous biological material (which may include HIV positive specimens), immunization to Hepatitis B and/or other diseases may be a requirement.
  • This position will require frequent walking, sitting and/or standing for extended periods of time, carrying, heavy lifting (max. 50 lbs), reaching while standing, gripping and twisting hand movements, finger control and other general repetitive motions (for more than four [4] hours per day)
  • Able to wear latex or nitrile gloves, dust mask or respirator, and safety glasses as required.
  • Manual dexterity to operate laboratory equipment and calculator/computer
  • Able to read and interpret test results and instrument specifications

Why Inotiv

  • Real science, real impact. Your data feeds directly into decisions on active drug discovery programs — the biomarker you help quantify this quarter could inform a clinical strategy next year.
  • Mentorship that builds expertise. You'll learn alongside senior proteomics scientists, with support for training in proteomics, mass spectrometry, and regulated bioanalysis.
  • Breadth of experience. Gain exposure to targeted and global proteomics, GxP and non-GxP work, and cross-functional programs spanning pharmacology and pathology.
  • A platform built to grow. Help evaluate new mass spectrometry technologies and workflows, and contribute to posters, publications, and presentations that showcase Inotiv's proteomics capabilities.

*This position could be offered at different levels for candidates who qualify with a combination of advanced levels of education and/or years of experience. The salary range will adjust along with the level of the role to match the person’s relevant experience and/or education level.


At Inotiv, our work helps advance the development of new medicines and therapies that can improve people's lives. As a leading global contract research organization (CRO), we partner with researchers to tackle complex scientific challenges, drive innovation, and help build a healthier, safer world. Bringing together scientists, researchers, technical experts, and business professionals, we provide the expertise and collaboration needed to move research forward. Our people make this work possible, and we value the knowledge, ideas, and contributions each person brings to the team. Whether you are starting your career or bringing years of experience, Inotiv offers opportunities to learn, grow, and play a meaningful role in advancing treatments for patients around the world.


Salary will be commensurate with experience and responsibilities. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401K, and more!


Inotiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide a fair and equal employment opportunity to all persons, regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits and training.

title: Systems Engineer - Requirements Management
description:
About the role

The Systems Engineer will serve within Aalo’s team, supporting the Aalo-X reactor. You will oversee safety-related reactor systems at Aalo-X—handling design, operations, performance tracking, and lifecycle support.


What you'll do

  • Lead and Develop Requirements Management Processes for the Design Team.
  • Upkeep Design Requirements to ensure completeness, correctness, verifiability, and traceability.
  • Oversee and recommend design improvements for advanced micro-reactor demonstrators.
  • Ensure all systems meet national consensus safety standards (codes/regulations).
  • Perform engineering calculations, specifications, system analyses, and testing.
  • Maintain change and configuration management and design documentation.
  • Collaborate across teams—program managers, lead engineers—ensuring nuclear safety compliance.
  • Support the authoring of system and equipment design documents such as process and instrument control drawings and system design descriptions


Qualifications

Required

  • Proficient in systems-engineering lifecycle practices (INCOSE/NASA/DoD frameworks), requirement management, SEMP development, and configuration management tools
  • Familiarity with systems-engineering toolchains, PLM/ALM platforms, relational databases, and version control systems. Experience with requirement management tools such as DOORS, DOORS Next Generation, or Jama Connect and model-based systems engineering practices are valuable.
  • Proven ability to assess and enhance engineering processes, implement continuous improvements
  • BS in System, Nuclear, Mechanical, Aerospace, Chemical Engineering, or related
  • 5–8 years relevant experience, or MS + 3–6 years
  • Experience with safety-related reactor systems in a nuclear power environment


Preferred

  • Familiarity with advanced micro-reactor technologies
  • Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills


Requirements

Must be based in the United States

Must be willing to work on-site at our headquarters in Austin, Texas

What It Takes to Succeed at Aalo

We're building technology that will help reshape the future of energy. The pace is fast, the problems are difficult, and the expectations are high. Successful team members consistently demonstrate:

Extreme Ownership — You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You proactively identify problems, drive solutions, and follow through.

A Passion for Solving Hard Problems — You are energized by challenges that others avoid and enjoy finding practical solutions to complex technical issues.

A Sense of Urgency — You move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and maintain momentum while balancing quality and execution.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary based on technical level
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Corporate Gym Membership


Candidates only. No recruiters or agencies, please.


Additional Information:

Aalo Atomics provides a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, intellectually challenging careers, and competitive compensation. Aalo Atomics is an equal opportunity employer and considers all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Applicants must be U.S. Citizens or U.S. Persons in compliance with 10 CFR Part 810 and may not hold non-compliant foreign citizenships.

Direct applicants only. No recruiters or staffing agencies, please.

title: Senior Service Desk Analyst
description:
Job Description:

The Senior Service Desk Analyst acts as a technical escalation point and team anchor within the IT Service Desk, handling incidents beyond first-line scope, and driving process and quality improvements. This role combines hands-on technical resolution, ensuring SLA adherence, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across the service desk function.

Key Responsibilities:


• Serve as a senior point of contact and technical escalation path for complex or high-priority IT incidents and service requests received via phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems.

• Review, re-prioritize, and reassign tickets in the ITSM tool to ensure accurate categorization and SLA compliance across the queue, not just individual tickets.

• Provide advanced troubleshooting for hardware, software, network, and application issues that junior analysts have been unable to resolve at first level.

• Own and resolve complex technical issues, including:

o Advanced account, identity, and access management issues (Okta)

o Microsoft 365 administration-level support / Google Workspace Administration (mailbox, licensing, and configuration issues)

o VPN, network connectivity, and remote access troubleshooting

o Endpoint, OS, and peripheral device issues requiring deeper diagnostics

o Email, collaboration tool, and application integration issues(Slack, Zoom)

• Act as the primary escalation contact between the service desk and Level 2/3 support teams, ensuring context is properly handed off and following up to closure.

• Monitor ticket queues and SLA dashboards proactively, intervening on at-risk tickets and backlog before breaches occur.

• Author, review, and maintain knowledge base articles and SOPs; audit team-submitted articles for accuracy and completeness.

• Provide on-the-job training to junior and mid-level Service Desk Analysts, including shadowing and quality reviews of their tickets/calls.

• Lead or actively participate in shift handovers, team huddles, and stakeholder meetings, representing the service desk's operational status.

• Take ownership of key service desk performance metrics like First Contact Resolution (FCR), SLA compliance, Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Resolution Time (ART), and lifecycle management.

• Drive continuous service improvement initiatives: identifying recurring issues, proposing automation/self-service opportunities, and contributing to process documentation.

• Support major incident management by coordinating communication and technical response until Level 2/3 teams take over.

• Assist with onboarding, training material development, and coverage planning for the shift roster.



Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3–5 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, or Technical Support role demonstrated experience handling escalations or guiding analysts

• Knowledge of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing systems.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills.

Shift Pattern: U.S. Business Hours / Rotational Shifts (Flexible based on business requirements)

Role is onsite and expected to work from office for 5 days

title: Vice President, Product Management (MDR)
description:
Vice President, Product Management (MDR)

Rapid7 is looking for a Vice President, Product Management to own the strategy, vision, and execution of our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) product portfolio. This is a rare opportunity to shape how thousands of organizations experience cybersecurity as a managed service, defining what great looks like at the intersection of human expertise and cutting-edge technology.


About the Team

Rapid7's MDR product team partners closely with our SOC, engineering, and go-to-market functions to shape the service experience, define platform capabilities, and continuously raise the bar on global managed security service delivery.


About the Role

As a Vice President, Product Management (MDR), your primary responsibility will be to set the product direction for Rapid7's managed security service while balancing customer needs, analyst capabilities, and strategic business goals. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Define and drive the MDR product strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with Rapid7's broader detection and response vision

title: Head of Infrastructure
description:
About the Company

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

Engineering at Valon

Our engineering team powers a modern software ecosystem designed to disrupt one of the most outdated and heavily regulated industries in finance: mortgage servicing. We have built the foundation of a scalable platform capable of managing billions in assets with precision and reliability. Now we are focused on scaling infrastructure, improving developer experience, and building high-leverage systems that support rapid product iteration and long-term business growth. We are a tight-knit, high-agency group of engineers from Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google, and we aim to do the best work of our lives—together.

Our headquarters are in New York City, with a satellite San Francisco office that opened last year. We also fully support remote work.

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to lead Valon's Cloud Infrastructure and Developer Infrastructure functions as one cohesive organization. This is a senior manager, or potential Director level role with responsibility for the systems that run ValonOS and the platform that enables engineers to build and operate it.

You will set the infrastructure strategy across Compute, Storage, data platforms, developer tooling, CI/CD, test infrastructure, observability, and engineering productivity. You will build and lead the organization that delivers this strategy—managing managers and senior technical leaders as the team grows, while staying close enough to the technology to make sound architectural and investment decisions.

The role requires balancing two complementary outcomes: a production platform that is secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-conscious; and a developer platform that makes it easy for engineers to deliver high-quality software quickly. You will partner with product, engineering, security, data, and operations leaders to turn those outcomes into a coherent roadmap and measurable results.

Valon handles more than 100 million background jobs per day and expects to scale more than 10x over the next two years. As ValonOS expands across major mortgage servicers, the infrastructure organization will be central to protecting reliability, accelerating innovation, and raising the bar for how regulated financial software is built.

Examples of work on the roadmap include:

  • Scaling compute and batch-processing systems to support rapid growth in production workloads.

  • Building a durable, well-operated storage and data platform, including migrations, replication, backup, recovery, and performance.

  • Creating production-equivalent environments for customer testing, demos, and internal development.

  • Making integration testing, schema compatibility, releases, and observability easier and more reliable for every engineering team.

  • Adopting AI-enabled developer tools with appropriate quality, security, and governance controls.

Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate a multi-year infrastructure strategy spanning Cloud Infrastructure and Developer Infrastructure.

  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing organization, including engineering managers, senior technical leaders, and individual contributors.

  • Own the portfolio roadmap and investment decisions across Compute, Storage, data platforms, developer experience, CI/CD, test infrastructure, and observability.

  • Set company-wide standards for reliability, security, service ownership, incident management, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

  • Partner with executive and functional leaders to align infrastructure priorities with customer commitments, product strategy, and business goals.

  • Build the planning, review, and operating mechanisms that make progress visible and tradeoffs explicit.

  • Stay hands-on enough to guide architecture, challenge assumptions, and engage in the most important technical decisions and incidents.

  • Recruit exceptional talent, develop leaders, and create a culture of high agency, high accountability, direct feedback, and collaboration.

  • Represent infrastructure clearly to the broader company and make the organization a trusted partner to every engineering team.

Ideal Background

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading multiple teams, engineering managers, or a substantial infrastructure organization.

  • Experience owning a broad infrastructure portfolio that includes cloud platforms, compute, storage, databases, SRE, developer infrastructure, or related domains.

  • Strong technical depth in distributed systems and a track record of operating critical production systems at scale.

  • Experience setting strategy across both production infrastructure and developer experience, or the ability to credibly lead leaders in both areas.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud providers such as AWS or GCP, container orchestration, data stores, CI/CD, and observability.

  • Excellent organizational judgment: you can sequence foundational investments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and connect technical work to business outcomes.

  • Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining strong teams through periods of rapid growth and change.

  • Clear, concise communication and the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, security, data, and operations.

Benefits

  • Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401(k) plan. The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of experience and interview performance.

  • Health & well-being: we’ll invest in your physical and mental well-being with comprehensive medical, dental, & vision benefits.

  • Free Food: daily lunch, and dinner provided through Forkable for in-office team members.

  • Commuter benefits: pre-tax deductions for public transit, rideshares, and parking to simplify your daily commute.

  • Grow together: company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning & development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360-degree feedback.

  • Play together: quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners.

  • Generous time off: flexible paid time off with no annual limit, sick days, and 11 company holidays.

  • Baby bonding time: 12 weeks of fully paid leave for both birthing and non-birthing parents, so you can spend uninterrupted time welcoming and caring for your newest family member.

Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.

Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE

Beacon is acquiring and operating a portfolio of vertical SaaS companies. Most private equity firms scale by adding people. We are building Beacon to scale by adding software. The thesis is simple: portfolio operations, value creation, and deal sourcing are bottlenecked by human attention, and an agentic operating system can lift that ceiling by an order of magnitude.

Beacon has raised $550M+ from investors including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, and the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Lead Software Engineers are Beacon engineers who work inside our portfolio companies. Each company we buy is a profitable, established business with a product its customers rely on. What it has not had is Beacon's engineering model, and you bring it. You join one company full time as its lead engineer and grow it. Some of our engineers stay with one company for years. Others move to a new one when the time is right.

We have several of these seats open. The stack depends on the company: .NET, Rails, Python, TypeScript, Oracle, PHP and others. You should be comfortable in any of them, or able to get there fast.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code every day, and you will coach the people around you to write better code than they did before you arrived.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Ship. You are hands-on from day one. Pick up the company's stack, get into the codebase and put working software in front of customers early and often.

  • Modernize the SDLC. CI, tests, staging, feature flags, a deploy anyone can run, coding agents in the loop. Do it while still shipping.

  • Coach the engineers already there. Most of our teams are small and have been heads-down for years. Make them better.

  • Set the roadmap. Work with the GM to decide what gets built and own the trade-offs.

  • Change what a week of work looks like. We work with coding agents every day. Work that took the team weeks should take days. You set that up and teach the team to run it.

  • Put AI in the product. Retrieval, tool use, evals, guardrails, in production.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including time as a tech lead, founding engineer, CTO of a small company, or the one engineer holding a product together.

  • Comfortable in any stack. You have shipped production code in at least three different ones and you pick up new ones quickly.

  • A fixer. You have taken over a messy codebase and a discouraged team before and can tell us what you did first.

  • AI-native. You use coding agents every day and can show us your setup.

  • Easy to work with. GMs, operators and customers will call you directly.

  • Good judgment on your own. Nobody will be checking your work daily.

BONUS POINTS

  • You have been the first engineering leader at a company that had none.

  • Vertical or B2B SaaS experience, especially where the buyer and the user are different people.

  • You have modernized a legacy codebase without a rewrite.


Our Values at Beacon Software

  • Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

  • Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen uuteen Keisarinnaan!
description:
Hei sinä hyvä lähihoitaja. Meillä olisi ehkä juuri sinulle paikka Keisarinnassa.

Keisarinna on uusi. Sinä voit olla mukana tekemässä siitä meidän näköisemme.

Lokakuussa on Piikkiöön avautunut uusi Keisarinna – koti ikääntyneille ja samalla kokonaan uusi työyhteisö.

Siksi emme etsi vain lähihoitajaa täyttämään työvuoroja. Etsimme työkaveria. Ihmistä. Persoonaa. Sellaista, joka osaa hoitaa, mutta ennen kaikkea osaa kohdata.

Millainen tyyppi viihtyy meillä?

Ehkä sinä olet se työkaveri, joka huomaa, kun joku tarvitsee apua ennen kuin sitä ehditään pyytää. Ehkä sinulle on tärkeää, että aamulla ei vain jaeta lääkkeitä ja tarkisteta vointeja, vaan pysähdytään hetkeksi juttelemaan.

Ehkä olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka – tai ehkä vahvuutesi on siinä, että saat ihmiset nauramaan myös kiireisen päivän keskellä.

Me tarvitsemme kaikkia näitä puolia.

Keisarinnassa haluamme tehdä hoitotyötä, jossa asukkaat saavat olla omia itsejään. Jos joku haluaa kuunnella musiikkia, jutella päivän uutisista, lähteä ulos tai vain istua kaikessa rauhassa kahvikupin kanssa, sille pitää olla aikaa ja tilaa.

Koska elämä ei lopu siihen, kun ihminen muuttaa hoivakotiin. Sen pitää jatkua. Ja tässä kohtaa sinä tulet mukaan.

Uudessa Keisarinnassa pääset rakentamaan asioita alusta alkaen. Ei tarvitse kuulla lausetta: "Näin meillä on aina tehty."

Sen sijaan haluamme kuulla: "Mitä jos kokeiltaisiin tätä?"

Meillä saat ehdottaa, kysyä, haastaa ja kehittää. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa työkaveria autetaan, huumorille on tilaa ja jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään.

Mitä lähihoitajan työ Keisarinnassa tarkoittaa? Tavallista hyvää hoitotyötä – mutta ihmisen kokoista.

Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

  • asukkaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoiva ja huolenpito

  • lääkehoito ja voinnin seuranta

  • toimintakyvyn tukeminen ja kuntouttava työote

  • päivittäisissä toiminnoissa avustaminen

  • yhdessäolo, ulkoilu ja viriketoiminta

  • yhteistyö läheisten ja muun henkilöstön kanssa

  • ennen kaikkea asukkaan kohtaaminen ja kuunteleminen.

Meillä hoitaja ei ole vain se, joka tekee asiat asukkaan puolesta.

Hyvä hoitaja auttaa ihmistä tekemään itse sen, minkä hän vielä pystyy tekemään.

Mitä me toivomme sinulta? Sinulla on lähihoitajan tutkinto ja halu tehdä työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä. Arvostamme ammattitaitoa, mutta emme etsi täydellistä ihmistä.

Etsimme ihmistä, joka:

  • pitää ihmisistä

  • ottaa vastuuta

  • uskaltaa kysyä

  • haluaa oppia

  • osaa tehdä yhteistyötä

  • kohtelee asukkaita ja työkavereita arvostavasti

  • pystyy heittäytymään mukaan uuden rakentamiseen.

Ja jos sinulla on joku erityinen taito tai intohimo – kerro siitä meille.

Osaatko soittaa kitaraa? Oletko intohimoinen ulkoilija? Rakastatko leipomista, musiikkia, liikuntaa, askartelua tai vanhojen tarinoiden kuuntelemista? Loistavaa!

Miksi kannattaa tulla juuri nyt? Koska myöhemmin voit sanoa: "Minä olin mukana, kun Keisarinna syntyi."

Saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa uutta yksikköä ja uutta työyhteisöä yhdessä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Ja ehkä kaikkein tärkeintä: Saat tehdä työtä, jossa yksi hymy, yksi hyvä kohtaaminen ja yksi pieni teko voivat tehdä jonkun päivästä paremman. Jos tämä kuulostaa enemmän sinulta kuin perinteinen työpaikkailmoitus, lähetä meille hakemuksesi.

Kerro meille kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea: Miksi juuri sinä olisit hyvä tyyppi Keisarinnaan?

Me haluamme tavata sinut.

Tehdään tästä yhdessä paikka, jossa on hyvä asua – ja vielä parempi tehdä töitä.

Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti: sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua.

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

title: Product Manager
description:
About On Me

Humans have given each other gifts since the dawn of time. For gratitude, for friendship, and for love. In today’s society, gifting has become harder and much more wasteful, as it’s become nearly impossible to know exactly what someone wants, when you just want to show that you care.

On Me is revolutionizing gifting by rebuilding it for the mobile and Instagram era. Traditional gift cards are impersonal and rigid, usually sold by an old and wealthy megacorp. We make it easy to send a personalized, media-rich gift that’s spendable across brands, fits someone’s hobbies, and drops straight into their mobile wallet for tap‑to‑pay. Check out our live experience at .

We’re a small startup from Google and Apple moving fast on a massive category and have raised $8M from top‑tier investors like NFX, Lerer Hippeau, Focal VC, and Mastercard. Since launching in November 2024, On Me has been featured in Tech Crunch, Fortune, and The Wall Street Journal. In 2025, we sustained over 40% growth month over month throughout the year, and the trend shows no sign of stopping.

In 2026, we’re doubling down on making every gift feel magical end‑to‑end and building an amazing consumer product. As our first product manager, you’ll set the bar for how we ship — turning fuzzy ideas into crisp flows, driving execution across the team, and shaping the product surfaces that millions of gifters will touch.

Who you are

You operate with the autonomy and judgment of a senior PM, regardless of years on paper. You can walk into a vague problem and walk out with a plan. You move things across the finish line, sweat the details, and have a real point of view on what good looks like. You build conviction from talking to users and watching how they actually behave, and you partner closely with designers on the look, feel, and polish of what you ship. You’re happy juggling many threads at once, comfortable cutting work that doesn’t matter, and energized by working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, designers, and the founding team in a fast-moving startup.

What you’ll do

As On Me’s first product manager, you’ll work directly with our CEO Darragh and the founding team to own the roadmap and execution across our consumer gifting app, growth surfaces, and our emerging business gifting product. You’ll translate fuzzy goals into concrete flows, drive projects across product, design, and engineering, and own the metrics that determine whether what we ship actually moves the needle. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of critical product areas, drive both product and engineering decisions, and have meaningful influence on the company’s direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own product strategy and execution across core consumer gifting, growth, and business gifting surfaces.

  • Turn vague problems into PRDs, flows, and milestones

  • Work hand-in-hand with design and engineering to take fuzzy goals to concrete features.

  • Define, instrument, and watch the metrics that tell you whether what we shipped actually worked.

  • Keep work moving: align stakeholders, remove blockers, and chase down loose ends.

  • Talk to users regularly — run interviews, usability sessions, and quick research loops to keep us close to real behavior.

  • Partner with design on craft, join design crits, and hold the bar on polish across every surface.

  • Own launches end-to-end: work with marketing, ops, and partnerships to take features from ship to real traction.

  • Use AI tooling to prototype, sharpen decisions, and raise the team’s output.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of PM experience shipping user-facing products.

  • Experience taking ambiguous, loosely scoped problems through to shipped features.

  • Experience managing multiple workstreams in parallel.

  • Hands-on experience running user interviews, usability sessions, or other product research.

  • Examples of shipped work with measurable impact on user or business outcomes.

  • Experience partnering closely with designers on product quality and polish.

  • Comfort reading SQL and writing basic queries.

  • Daily use of AI tooling for prototyping and to accelerate your work.

  • Fluency with product metrics and analytics, including instrumentation.

  • Clear, direct communication with engineering, design, and business partners.

Bonus points

  • Consumer product experience, especially in a startup context.

  • Strong design sensibility and an eye for craft.

  • Technical degree (CS or engineering).

  • Experience with payments, fintech, or other high-value transactional products.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful early employee equity in a fast-growing consumer startup.

  • A dynamic, collaborative, balanced, and inclusive work culture.

  • The opportunity to deeply shape our product roadmap, processes, and Product Management culture as our first PM.

  • Hybrid office in SF (preferred), with NYC hybrid also possible.

  • Unlimited paid time off.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • 401k

Who You’ll Work With

At On Me, you’ll join a small, elite team of builders from Google and Apple who move fast and care deeply about product quality. You’ll report to and work daily with:

  • Darragh Meaney, CEO — Formerly at Google Ads and YouTube

  • Sitar Harel, CTO — Formerly at Google Maps and Google Photos

  • Daniel Li, Founding Engineer — ex-Apple, WWDC session speaker and Cornell AppDev alum

  • Neil Shankar, Founding Designer — previously Senior Designer at Google and Block (formerly Square)

And a team of amazing engineers and designers!

We combine big-tech craft with startup speed—and we’re just getting started.

Join Us

Become a part of On Me’s story, and play an integral role in our journey to strengthen relationships through magical gifting experiences. If you’re ready to own product end-to-end at a team that values ambition, collaboration, and the joy of tackling exciting challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Mechanical Technician I
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft and precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, such as solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration and in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, a constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world-class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN I

Based out of Rocket Lab’s site in Toronto, Ontario, the Mechanical Technician I will be responsible for the integration of spacecraft precision attitude determination and control products, which are comprised of mechanical, electrical, and optical subassemblies. The successful candidate will assemble, inspect, and perform other duties associated with building products from Rocket Lab’s star tracker and reaction wheel product lines. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space!

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Perform mechanical integration of space hardware in a clean environment
  • Integrate electrical subassemblies into mechanical housings
  • Assemble and focus opto-mechanical subassemblies
  • Conduct functional and performance testing of reaction wheel and star tracker subassemblies and units
  • Perform final inspections (mass and photography) of parts, subassemblies, and integrated units
  • Install bearings into reaction wheel assemblies
  • Apply lubricant/grease to rotary components with precision
  • Shim reaction wheels to achieve clearances and bearing preloads with precision
  • Perform bulk cleaning of components using an ultrasonic cleaner and manual cleaning with isopropanol
  • Occasionally rework or modify fixtures and production components
  • Apply staking compounds (epoxy and/or Loctite) to threaded fasteners in a controlled manner
  • Document all activities and collected data accurately

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS AS A MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN I:

  • Experience with precision mechanical integration
  • Excellent fine motor skills, including the ability to manipulate small components with fine tweezers
  • Excellent vision at close range (with or without corrective lenses)

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience working with high-reliability aerospace or spacecraft components
  • Experience with machined aluminum components, bearings, and optics
  • Ability to use digital or analog calipers, micrometers, and dial gauges to measure critical dimensions
  • Proficiency with a drill press, hand drill, and other basic metalworking tools
  • Ability to use a torque wrench
  • Experience using an optical microscope (4-20x magnification range)
  • Ability to interpret and follow technical instructions supplemented by verbal instruction
  • Familiarity with cleanroom/cleanbench best practices
  • Familiarity with best practices for working with ESD-sensitive hardware
  • Highly organized and able to work independently with strong attention to detail

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to stand and walk for an entire shift (8+ hours) on various work surfaces
  • Ability to climb ladders and work at elevated heights, in small spaces, awkward positions, and tight areas as needed
  • Perform repetitive motions, including bending, twisting, reaching, grasping, pushing, pulling, and stooping
  • Use hands with precision to handle, control, and operate tools, instruments, and equipment
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment up to 25 lbs.
  • Work in varied environments, including production floors, equipment areas, and field locations, with exposure to noise, temperature variations, and moving machinery
  • Flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, and varied shifts as operational needs require

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. Responsibilities include equipment maintenance, calibration, movement, installation, troubleshooting, and repair as well as facility evaluation in preparation of new equipment, in addition to building, implementing, and maintaining site EHS and environmental management system (EMS) programs. The overlying function for this position is support and optimization for production and R&D activities related to facilities equipment, while ensuring the site operates in compliance with applicable OSHA, RCRA, and environmental regulations. title: Analyst, Global Equities (London)
description:
About Galvanize

Galvanize is a global asset manager investing at the intersection of energy innovation, resilience, and intelligence. The firm deploys capital across seed, venture, growth, public equities, credit, and real estate, combining investment expertise with deep in-house capabilities in technology, policy, and markets. Galvanize is structured to rapidly identify and execute on investment opportunities created by the energy transition, across all sectors of the economy

Role

GGE leverages its deep understanding of the Energy Transition to invest in ~30 companies we believe are servicing the path to Net Zero to generate compelling financial returns. The breadth of this opportunity allows us to be purposeful in building a long-only portfolio diversified across risk factors and geographies where we aim to hold companies for 3-5yrs.

We segment the universe into:

  • FRANCHISES - typically scaled, market-leaders offering sustainably high returns on capital, strong alignment to the Transition in capital allocation, and accelerating top line growth in these Transition-related activities.
  • IMPROVERS - typically companies with an important role to play in the Transition that are early in their journey of adoption, where business models are ‘improved’ either by specific revenue opportunities or an advantaged cost position versus peers through a focus on the profit pools create by the Transition.
  • ENABLERS - typically companies delivering and enabling the Transition by allocating their capital towards services/products specifically intended to deliver the Transition.

The Analyst will report to one of the Portfolio Managers, who also leads engagement and will work closely with other members of the Global Equities team and Galvanize’s broader investment, science, technology, and impact teams. This role is based in London and follows Galvanize’s hybrid working mode where the team is in office Monday – Thursday and remote on Fridays.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct fundamental, bottom-up research on publicly listed companies and related entities using investment screening, financial modelling, primary research, and industry analysis.
  • Build and maintain detailed financial models, valuation frameworks, and scenario analyses to assess company performance, risk, and potential returns.
  • Evaluate company strategy, competitive positioning, management quality, capital allocation, industry dynamics, and relevant technological, regulatory, and macroeconomic developments.
  • Conduct primary research through engagement with company management teams, industry participants, customers, suppliers, competitors, and other relevant sources.
  • Develop, present, and defend investment recommendations based on rigorous research and differentiated insights.
  • Support the ongoing monitoring of portfolio companies, including financial performance, investment catalysts, valuation, and emerging risks.
  • Prepare investment memoranda, company updates, and other materials for internal investment discussions and portfolio reviews.
  • Help produce investor materials, market commentary, and ad hoc external reports as required.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Galvanize to incorporate relevant technology, policy, market, and sustainability insights into the investment process.
  • Uphold Galvanize’s fiduciary obligations, compliance standards, and reputation.
  • Handle confidential and material non-public information in accordance with applicable laws and Galvanize policies.
  • Travel, as necessary, to other Galvanize offices, research conferences, industry events, and company headquarters.
  • Promote a culture of inclusion, collaboration, and respect across the firm.
  • Research and evaluate the corporate governance practices and material environmental and social considerations of companies in which Galvanize invests.
  • Perform other responsibilities consistent with the role as business and investment needs evolve.
  • Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and experience integrating AI tools into professional workflows to improve efficiency and decision-making is preferred

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in corporate finance, private equity, public equity research on the buy side or sell side, investment banking, or strategy consulting.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, corporate finance, and public equity valuation methodologies.
  • Ability to develop, articulate, and defend differentiated investment theses.
  • Strong investment judgment, attention to detail, and ability to identify key business and valuation drivers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex analysis clearly and influence effectively.
  • High intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and openness to feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity.
  • Highly motivated, results-oriented, and accountable, with a track record of strong performance.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work effectively under pressure, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced investment environment.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively within a team-oriented, intellectually rigorous environment.
  • Experience with financial data and research platforms such as Bloomberg,is preferred.
  • Authorization to work in the United Kingdom.

Compensation and Benefits

  • 25 days annual leave
  • Private health & dental coverage
  • Employer pension contribution of 5%
  • Wellness benefit
  • Life Assurance, Income Protection and Critical Illness coverage
  • Annual stipend for employer-sponsored professional development opportunities

title: Infrastructure Engineer, Agentic DevSecOps
description:
About Distyl AI

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.

We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.

Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.

What We Are Looking For

We're hiring a Infrastructure Engineer to own how Distyl engineers build, test, secure, and release software. Our independently versioned services span multiple repositories and deploy into customer environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with different security, connectivity, and upgrade constraints.

This is a hands-on role with scope matched to your experience, from owning complex delivery systems to setting technical direction across teams. You'll build shared delivery systems and coding-agent workflows that make releases reliable, failures actionable, and engineers more productive. Your systems will shape how every Distyl engineer ships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical ownership. Set direction and priorities for build, test, release, and coding-agent infrastructure. Choose tools and standards with engineering partners, and own implementation, adoption, and operation across teams

  • Build systems and repository standards. Standardize repository conventions and reusable build/test workflows. Make builds reproducible and efficient through explicit dependencies, consistent tooling, and effective caching

  • Release engineering. Build once and promote versioned bundles of immutable artifacts through release stages, with source traceability and test and security gates. Partner with Platform, Runtime, and Customer Delivery on integration and compatibility testing, configuration and schema changes, and recovery. Support customer-registry distribution and offline packaging where required

  • Agent-enabled engineering. Equip engineers with reusable coding-agent tools to diagnose failures, propose fixes, and handle routine work. Include tests, scoped permissions, failure handling, and independent output validation; measure quality and time saved

  • Software supply-chain security. Implement artifact signing and provenance, software bills of materials (SBOMs), isolated build runners, scoped CI credentials, and vulnerability gates. Integrate dependency and container remediation into engineering workflows

  • Developer experience. Understand engineers' workflows and remove friction with self-service tools, documentation, and diagnostics that distinguish code failures from tooling issues. Use developer feedback to guide incremental migrations, earn adoption, and reduce manual work

  • Engineering productivity and alerting. Track build/test latency, pipeline reliability, flaky-test rates, release lead time, and tooling adoption. Use these signals and developer feedback to reduce flaky tests and bottlenecks. Set service-level objectives and route actionable alerts to owners

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, developer productivity, SRE, or related infrastructure engineering roles

  • Experience enabling engineers to use coding agents through reusable tools, workflows, and guidance, with independent validation and scoped access

  • Experience owning production build, test, and release infrastructure across services and teams, including versioned release bundles and compatibility testing

  • Hands-on experience with build systems, dependency management, reproducibility, performance diagnosis, and caching

  • Strong Python skills for building and debugging backend services and maintainable automation. Comfortable navigating unfamiliar code, including JavaScript frontends

  • Strong Linux fundamentals and experience building and maintaining secure container images. Working knowledge of Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and cloud deployment

  • Hands-on experience implementing software supply-chain controls. Demonstrated security judgment across permissions, credentials, dependencies, artifacts, and remediation

  • Experience building developer platforms, automated remediation, or reusable agent tooling adopted by other engineers

  • A record of improving build/test performance, release reliability, and tooling adoption using metrics and developer feedback

  • Experience independently leading complex projects and migrations. A record of setting technical direction and driving adoption across teams is especially valued. You defend technical choices with evidence and adapt to changing constraints

  • Preferred: Building and operating testing infrastructure in a microservices environment

  • Preferred: Distributing release artifacts to customer registries or restricted environments, including offline packaging

What We Offer

  • The base salary range for this role is $200,000-$250,000, depending on experience, location, and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package

  • 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible time off

  • Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources

  • Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well-being, and fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot

  • Complimentary in-office lunches and snacks provided

  • Access to state-of-the-art AI models, generous usage of modern AI tools, and real-world business problems

  • Ownership of high-impact projects across top enterprises

  • A mission-driven, fast-moving culture that values curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence

Distyl has offices in San Francisco and New York. This role follows a hybrid collaboration model with 3+ days per week (Tuesday–Thursday) in‑office.

title: Network Operations Expert
description:
Job ID: 3425

In Nordea, we’re harnessing the power of technology to reinvent the future of banking. A tech revolution is underway – and you can make an impact. Though we’re a Nordic bank, we’re also one of the largest IT employers in Łódź, Tricity and Warsaw. Working with international teams in an inspiring working environment, you’ll have lots of opportunities to expand your skills and advance your career.

We are looking for a full-time Network Operations Expert with strong expertise in Cisco Catalyst Center, ISE, ASA, VPN, SD-WAN, and SDA.

At Nordea, we know our customers’ needs are changing – and we’re deeply committed to meeting them with the financial solutions of tomorrow. We’re creating an agile environment where we’re harnessing the power of technology – one where you can make an impact. So bring your skills, ideas and unique background. With us, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to grow and make your mark on something bigger.

About this opportunity

Welcome to Network Operations Oversight team. Would you like to be part of a journey where we create value by ensuring the security, stability, resilience, and continuous improvement of our network services? We are responsible for the operational health of critical network services, maintaining technology standards, managing service-related risks, and supporting strategic decision-making across the network domain.

As a Network Operations Expert, you will play a key role in advancing operational excellence across a complex enterprise environment. You will collaborate closely with suppliers, vendors, service providers, engineering teams and key stakeholders to ensure high-quality, reliable, and secure network services. You will contribute to service performance reviews, operational readiness, incident learnings, and improvement initiatives that strengthen our overall network landscape.

Working together with colleagues across the Nordic countries and Poland, you will contribute directly to our success by enhancing service quality, promoting best practices, and supporting the delivery of a stable, secure, and future-ready network environment.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead in-depth technical investigations into complex network issues, service degradation, infrastructure dependencies, and remediation options, gaining broad exposure to world-class modern infrastructure and a diverse range of enterprise network technologies
  • Take technical ownership of business-critical incidents, working side by side with highly experienced engineering teams, technology vendors, and suppliers to exchange knowledge, accelerate troubleshooting, define effective recovery actions, and restore services with confidence
  • Turn service reports, monitoring data, trends, and recurring issues into actionable insights, while continuously developing best-in-class monitoring capabilities and operational dashboards that reveal service health, performance, risks, and emerging issues
  • Act as the technical lead for Root Cause Analysis within the Problem Management process, expanding your expertise as you uncover underlying causes, shape preventive actions, and support the Problem Manager in driving them through to implementation
  • Plan and deliver business-critical network changes across complex, interconnected technologies and solutions, combining technical validation, risk assessment, implementation coordination, and rollback readiness to achieve safe and predictable outcomes
  • Strengthen the security and resilience of large-scale network services by overseeing vulnerability management and security baseline compliance, assessing exposure and business risk, identifying control gaps, prioritising remediation, and following mitigation actions through to closure
  • Bring your technical judgement to operational and supplier reviews, collaborating with recognised specialists across countries and technology domains while evaluating evidence, constructively challenging delivery quality and corrective measures, and ensuring agreed actions, owners, deadlines, and dependencies remain on track
  • Help shape reliable, supportable services and the future of our network landscape by validating the operational readiness of new and changed solutions, broadening your experience across acceptance criteria, support procedures, escalation paths, recovery instructions, service dependencies, and ownership across engineering and operations
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, sharing knowledge with experienced colleagues and ensuring that operational procedures, configuration records, and recovery instructions remain accurate, current, and practical to use across teams
  • Drive transparency and continuous improvement by maintaining prioritised action, risk, issue, and improvement backlogs, and by translating complex topics into concise status updates, management summaries, and clear recommendations that influence decisions in governance forums

You’ll join a newly established and ambitious team with a real opportunity to influence the future shape of Nordea’s network. The role is based in any of our offices in Poland (Łódź, Gdynia, Gdańsk or Warsaw).

Who you are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

  • Have a structured and analytical mindset, with the ability to work across strategic, tactical, and operational priorities
  • Take ownership and act proactively, including in situations with unclear boundaries, dependencies, or requirements

title: Maskinmesteraspirant til Bioenergy - Asnæsværket
description:
Forestil dig en fremtid, hvor du lærer at drive og vedligeholde et kraftværk og deltager i nye innovative projekter, som understøtter den grønne omstilling

Nogle af vores fordele:

Dokumenteret høj medarbejdertilfredshed og motivation

Løbende muligheder for læring og udvikling

Konkurrencedygtig løn og attraktiv pensions- og ferieordning

Fokus på sundhed, herunder sundhedsforsikring, sund og lækker mad og fitness på flere lokationer.

I denne rolle som maskinmesteraspirant vil du være tilknyttet Asnæsværket under hele dit 4½-årige studieforløb. Her vil du få praktisk erfaring med at drive og vedligeholde værkets anlæg, der hver dag sikrer energi til den lokale industri og tusindvis af danske hjem. Du vil også blive del af bæredygtige projekter, der er med til at forme fremtidens grønne energiforsyning, og få mulighed for at præge dine opgaver efter interesser og kompetencer.

**Velkommen til Asnæsværket
**Du bliver del af Asset Operation, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger bliver en del af kraftværkets organisation og vil arbejde med og lære af nogle af landets dygtigste folk inden for kraftværker, fjernvarme og grøn energi. Vi tilbyder et aspirantforløb, som giver dig mulighed for at kombinere din teori fra skolen med praktisk erfaring. Samtidig er du sikret en fast praktikplads under hele dit studieforløb, hvor du får tildelt en buddy, som vil støtte dig i din faglige og personlige udvikling. Du vil være lønnet under hele dit uddannelsesforløb.

I vores team vil du bl.a. være en del af et hold af aspiranter og maskinmesterstuderende på forskellige uddannelsestrin, hvilket giver dig en unik mulighed for sparring.

I jobbet vil du:

  • dygtiggøre dig inden for termiske procesanlæg med fokus på energiproduktion
  • deltage i bæredygtige projekter med fokus på den grønne omstilling og biodiversitet
  • oparbejde forståelse for de menneskelige processer, som er forbundet med at drive et kraftværk på et organisatorisk plan
  • deltage i vurderinger af anlægsstatus for væsentlige procesområder
  • udføre vedligeholdelsesopgaver og lære de faglige discipliner.

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • er påbegyndt M1 på maskinmesteruddannelsen med studiestart umiddelbart efter sommerferien 2026
  • har masser af gåpåmod og lyst til at lære af dine kolleger
  • har lyst til at bidrage til den grønne omstilling
  • trives både med at arbejde selvstændigt og tæt sammen i teams
  • vil indgå i et internt netværk for studerende på tværs af landet.

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

**Form fremtiden med os
**Send din ansøgning og dit CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

**Lønramme:
**For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau fastsat i henhold til gældende overenskomst for områdetfor lokationen i jobannoncen. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opfyldelse af rollen inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Denne jobannonce henvender sig primært til kandidater, der er tidligt i deres karriere eller fortsat opbygger erfaring inden for området. Lønniveauet vil derfor typisk ligge i den lavere del af det samlede interval for stillingen. Vi byder dog også ansøgninger fra alle kvalificerede kandidater velkommen, uanset erfaringsniveau. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

**Vores fordelspakke:
**I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage/feriefridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, og internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

**Baggrundstjek før ansættelse:
**Denne stilling kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen, og jobtilbuddet er afhængigt af resultatet af dette tjek. Du vil modtage yderligere information i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjekket udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

title: Project Manager/Leader - Senior
description:
Position Overview

Justice Technology Services is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager/Leader to plan, coordinate, and deliver complex audio-visual, videoconferencing, telecommunications, and Information Technology (I&IT) projects.

The successful candidate will lead concurrent medium-to-large-scale projects involving enterprise technology implementations, network architecture, Voice over IP (VoIP), video, audio-visual systems, and building telecommunications infrastructure. The role requires strong project governance, vendor management, procurement, risk management, financial oversight, stakeholder engagement, and organizational change management capabilities.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, technical specialists, external service providers, contractors, and senior executives to ensure projects are delivered within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and security requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning and Delivery

  • Plan, lead, coordinate, and control all phases of concurrent I&IT and audio-visual projects.

  • Develop project charters, master project plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, and resource plans.

  • Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Lead project kick-off meetings and establish communication, risk assessment, procurement, and mobilization plans.

  • Monitor project progress and ensure delivery within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

Audio-Visual and Technical Implementation

  • Lead projects involving audio-visual systems, videoconferencing, telecommunications, VoIP, voice, data, video, and radio technologies.

  • Coordinate facility scope validation, construction completion, equipment procurement, receipt, and validation.

  • Oversee GUI design, review and approval, functional design drawings, and onsite system installation.

  • Coordinate use-case-based test plans, quality assurance, system testing, and functionality testing.

  • Manage commissioning, client handover, final acceptance, and sign-off.

  • Ensure vendors provide complete as-built documentation, inventories, photographs, programs, manuals, and close-out packages.

Risk, Issue, and Change Management

  • Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate project risks and issues.

  • Escalate significant issues and proposed changes to project sponsors for decisions and approvals.

  • Assess change impacts and update project plans, schedules, resources, and budgets accordingly.

  • Apply change management principles to support business process improvements and user adoption.

  • Recommend appropriate solutions to address technical, operational, and organizational challenges.

Stakeholder and Team Leadership

  • Manage relationships with clients, business areas, I&IT specialists, project sponsors, and external partners.

  • Provide leadership, direction, and guidance to project teams, vendors, contractors, and local trades.

  • Build collaborative teams and establish clear accountability for project deliverables.

  • Communicate project status, risks, issues, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Conduct service review meetings and lessons-learned sessions.

Financial Management and Procurement

  • Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial controls.

  • Coordinate I&IT procurement planning for software, hardware, IP circuits, bandwidth, and related services.

  • Negotiate the acquisition of goods and services and administer contractual agreements.

  • Prepare business cases, proposals, tenders, and submissions for senior-level decision-making.

  • Support Treasury Board and Management Board of Cabinet submissions as required.

Documentation and Project Closure

  • Maintain project plans, schedules, risk registers, communication plans, and delivery documentation.

  • Validate completion of facility, construction, equipment, and technical implementation activities.

  • Ensure final client acceptance and vendor documentation are completed.

  • Prepare internal close-out packages, including financial reports, site profiles, and project journals.

  • Document lessons learned and support continuous improvement.




Requirements

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • At least 10 years of project management experience.

  • At least 5 years of audio-visual and videoconferencing technology experience.

  • Demonstrated experience managing concurrent, technically complex I&IT projects across multiple enterprise technologies.

  • Experience delivering medium-to-large-scale technology implementation projects on time and within budget.

  • Knowledge of audio-visual, communications, videoconferencing, and IT deployment best practices.

  • Experience with project planning, resource allocation, risk management, change control, and financial management.

  • Experience managing vendors, contractors, technical teams, procurement activities, and contractual agreements.

  • Strong understanding of organizational change management and business/user adoption planning.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Microsoft Project.

Technical Knowledge and Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate knowledge of the following:

  • Audio-visual systems and videoconferencing technologies, including hardware and software.

  • Telecommunications infrastructure, network architecture, IP circuits, bandwidth, voice, data, video, and VoIP.

  • Enterprise I&IT infrastructure, software development platforms, and technical architecture.

  • Multi-tier software architecture, cloud technologies, and infrastructure requirements.

  • IT security requirements and implementation of high-availability solutions for sensitive and confidential environments.

  • Technical standards, architecture principles, and best practices for validating vendor recommendations.

  • Operations management, resource management, financial controls, and procurement processes.

  • Project governance, risk assessment, issue resolution, quality assurance, and commissioning.

Required Project Deliverables

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating and delivering the following project artifacts and activities:

  1. Project charter and project kick-off.

  2. Master project plan and work breakdown schedule.

  3. Procurement and mobilization plans.

  4. Risk assessment and communication plans.

  5. Business and user adoption plans, including training materials, user manuals, and GUI requirements.

  6. Validated facility scope of work and construction completion.

  7. Use-case-based test plans.

  8. Equipment procurement, receipt, and validation.

  9. GUI design approvals and finalized functional design drawings.

  10. Onsite system installation and implementation.

  11. Quality assurance, system, and functionality testing.

  12. Commissioning, client handover, and formal sign-off.

  13. Vendor as-built documentation and close-out packages.

  14. Lessons-learned sessions and service review meetings.

  15. Internal project closure documentation, including financial reports, site profiles, and journals.

Project Management Skills

  • Extensive experience managing all phases of concurrent, complex I&IT projects.

  • Knowledge of enterprise I&IT, audio-visual, videoconferencing, and converged communications solutions.

  • Strong risk and issue management, including engagement with senior executives.

  • Demonstrated change management capabilities.

  • Effective prioritization and resource allocation.

  • Experience managing technical teams, vendors, and local trades to deliver projects on time, within scope, and on budget.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced knowledge of audio-visual and videoconferencing hardware and software.

  • Experience managing project budgets, cost estimates, forecasting, and financial controls.

  • Procurement experience, including negotiation, acquisition of goods and services, and contract administration.

Communication Skills

  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, consultation, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to build effective client relationships and high-performing project teams.

  • Experience preparing and delivering presentations, proposals, and business cases.

  • Ability to influence stakeholders, secure buy-in, resolve conflicts, and support strategic decisions.

Public Sector Experience

- Five years of public sector experience.

8. Mandatory Requirements and Preferred Experience

Must-have requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of audio-visual and videoconferencing technology experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of project management experience, as stated in the supplier comments.

  • Knowledge of best practices for audio-visual, communications, and IT deployment.

  • Ability to work onsite at the Toronto office five days per week.

Preferred / Asset

  • Previous Ontario Public Service (OPS) experience.

  • Previous Justice Sector experience.

The formal experience requirements also specify at least 10 years of project management experience. Candidates should meet the 10-year requirement to align with the main job description.
