title: Principal Strategic Researcher
description:
About the team

Zillow Customer Research is a modern, multi-disciplinary team of research operations professionals, technologists, behavioral scientists, researchers, and research specialists. Our goal is to build the customer understanding, judgement, and conviction that Zillow’s experiences are built upon. We deliver this through building research capabilities and platforms that enable the company to build a shared understanding of what we know, execute self-service research, prototype with customer context, and conduct strategic research on select high-risk bets.

About the role

Zillow focuses its strategic researchers on high-risk opportunities that are ambiguous, moldable, and ripe for de-risking. As Principal Strategic Researcher, you'll bring structure, creativity, and foresight to these areas through deep partnership with product, design, engineering, and business leaders. You'll go where the business needs this capability most, and that focus will shift as Zillow's priorities evolve.


You’ll get to:

  • Identify the customer-focused questions that matter the most in ambiguous spaces.
  • Design and execute mixed-methods research approaches to answer those questions, choosing the rigor and speed needed to influence decision-making.
  • Shape product strategy through close partnership with senior product, design, engineering, and business leaders.
  • Build and refresh Zillow's foundational customer understanding by turning your strategic research into durable, reusable knowledge.
  • Raise the bar for research craft and customer judgment alongside your Zillow Customer Research colleagues.
  • Use AI tools to amplify your strengths and flex your creativity in how you land your learnings and influence partners.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $182,100.00 - $290,900.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $173,000.00 - $276,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You're drawn to untangling complex business and customer challenges through research. You have a demonstrated track record of translating learnings into conviction that business leaders act on.


Specifically, you:

  • Have extensive experience (10+ years) executing research in a product-focused environment.
  • Have developed a comprehensive mixed-methods research toolkit and consistently choose the right approach for the problem, the risk, and the decision at hand.
  • Have led strategic research that shaped product or business direction, and can point to decisions your work has changed.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and executives through clear storytelling, strong points of view, and trusted relationships built over time.
  • Thrive in ambiguity and can define a path forward when the problem, the audience, and the approach are still taking shape.
  • Created frameworks and models to codify, communicate, and land findings with partners.
  • Have an ownership mindset; you act as a strategic operator, not just a researcher.
  • Hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools in your research workflow and curiosity to push what’s possible

Nice to Have

  • Experience drawing on behavioral science, psychology, or decision science frameworks to explain customer behavior or frame problems.
  • Partnered with data science or product teams to design or interpret experiments, and combined attitudinal and behavioral evidence.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Software Engineer -- Applied AI (All Level)
description:
Why Plot

Plot is building the next generation of social intelligence — an AI-native platform that helps some of the world's most influential brands understand culture, find emerging trends, and activate their communities at scale. We're a high-growth, venture-backed startup supported by the co-founders of Reddit and Plaid, with customers like Tory Burch, Lululemon, La Roche-Posay, and other household names.

We operate at the frontier of applied AI and agentic systems, ingesting and reasoning over millions of short-form videos to uncover consumer insights no one else can see. Our work impacts real product decisions, global marketing campaigns, and how brands engage their fans.

You'll join a small experienced team where engineers ship product — not tickets. You'll work hand-in-hand with our product designer from day one, shaping features before specs exist and turning rough ideas into shipped experiences. You'll work directly with founders, hop on customer calls, and own company-defining features end-to-end. If you want real responsibility, fast learning loops, and the ability to shape both product and company, Plot is the place. It's also a perfect fit if you aspire to build your own startup one day — we operate with a deep founder's mindset.

What You'll Work On

  • Build agentic, reasoning-driven systems on top of cutting-edge LLMs to power consumer intelligence, marketing automation, and influencer activation.

  • Collaborate deeply with product design to prototype, iterate, and ship AI features from 0→1. You'll be in Figma reviews, whiteboarding sessions, and user interviews — not just implementing handed-down specs.

  • Design & execute LLM/ML evaluation frameworks — from offline benchmarks to live A/B tests — to measure quality, reliability, and business impact.

  • Own full-stack AI product features: prompt design, orchestration, tooling, monitoring, and the UX that brings it all together.

  • Collaborate closely with founders, design, marketing, and customers to ensure our AI deliver real customer value

  • Stay at the front of the curve: research, prototype, and integrate emerging methods in agentic reasoning, context engineering, and LLM-driven automation.

  • Note: This role is not focused on training foundation models — it's about building high-leverage systems on top of them (think "Claude-Code over Claude-Model").

What We're Looking For

  • Proven track record shipping customer-facing products. You've built features users love and can move quickly across the entire stack — frontend, backend, infrastructure.

title: Software Engineer - Observability
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


About the team and the role:


The Observability Platform team builds and operates the infrastructure that helps eBay teams monitor, fix, and improve the reliability of large-scale distributed systems. This platform supports the telemetry and reliability needs of thousands of microservices across eBay and operates at hyperscale, processing billions of time series and petabytes of log data using modern open-source technologies including Prometheus, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, and related tools.


As a Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build scalable distributed systems with Golang / Python that power metrics, logs, traces, and related observability workflows across the stack—from ingestion and storage to query and visualization. You will partner closely with SREs, platform engineers, and service owners to solve complex reliability challenges, improve operational excellence, and help shape the future of observability at eBay.


This role offers the opportunity to work on critical systems, contribute to open-source technologies, and grow through direct exposure to some of eBay’s most complex infrastructure challenges. This role also includes participation in the team’s on-call rotation in support of production reliability.


What you will accomplish:


  • Design and deliver scalable, fault-tolerant observability infrastructure that improves reliability while reducing operational overhead for platform and engineering teams
  • Build and optimize high-throughput services for ingesting, transforming, storing, and querying telemetry data across logs, metrics, and traces
  • Strengthen the resilience of Kubernetes-based production systems through self-healing, autoscaling, and robust operational design
  • Partner with SREs, platform teams, and service owners to translate observability needs into tools and platform capabilities that improve incident response and operational excellence
  • Contribute to architecture reviews, production readiness discussions, and post-incident findings to drive continuous improvement across the platform
  • Expand your technical breadth by working across distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and optionally user-facing observability experiences.


What you will bring:


  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong programming skills in Golang or Python, with experience building reliable backend or infrastructure services
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts such as fault tolerance, scalability, and system reliability
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating containerized services in Kubernetes or similar cloud-native environments
  • Solid understanding of observability domains including metrics, logs, and traces
  • Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse, or similar technologies; familiarity with time-series systems, high-throughput data pipelines, open-source infrastructure, or React/JavaScript is a plus


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

C$142,400 - C$190,100

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including RRSP eligibility, various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

title: Polish Speaker in NYC - Join a 3-Day Paid Phone Study - $100/hr

  • A native Polish speaker who grew up in Poland.
  • You use Polish in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. KLA physics modeling group at Ann-Arbor, Michigan, is looking for talented research scientists and engineers to join the plasma and gas-thermal modeling team. Relevant experience should include experience in some of these areas and a good intuition about the physical processes being modeled. Especially important is the ability to work with the other R&D and engineering teams to define modeling plans that explore the potential design space for implementation in future.

title: Platform Engineer
company: CM060 Cyan Blue Odds USA LLC
description:
Platform Engineer

Department: Technology / Engineering

Reporting to: Platform Engineering Tech Lead / Manager


Location: Hybrid - Office travel on average once per month, London Waterloo

Also participate in an on-call rota, covering one week every six weeks


Why this role exists


FairPlay Sports Media is building a tech-led, AI and data-powered sports media network that serves both owned brands (e.g., oddschecker, WhoScored.com, SuperScommesse, and others) and partners with BetTech products spanning data, display, and predictive capabilities. At FairPlay scale - real-time data, high-frequency updates, and partner integrations - the Platform team provides the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and observability that let multiple engineering teams ship and operate reliable, compliant, high-throughput products.


Our busiest moments - major sporting events, new market launches, and B2B partner go-lives - are when the platform matters most, and the Platform team makes sure the foundations hold.


What you’ll do


We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic Platform Engineer (DevOps / Infrastructure) to own and deliver components within our Google Cloud Platform estate - across CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and Kubernetes-based workloads.


You’ll take part in the on-call rotation, automate away operational toil, apply secure-by-default practices to everything you build, and support product development squads with the environments, pipelines, and tooling they need to move quickly and safely. You’ll work with limited oversight on 2–3 month pieces of work and contribute to larger initiatives led by Senior engineers.


Pillar 1: Platform Engineering & Delivery


Building dependable automation so developers can ship confidently:

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Design, build, and operate GCP infrastructure (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, VPC networking) as Terraform, following and contributing to the team’s shared modules and standards.
  • Kubernetes Workloads: Deploy and run services on GKE - workloads, networking, storage, autoscaling, and Helm-based configuration - and help product development squads containerise and operate their applications well.
  • CI/CD: Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines: artifact management, environment promotion, and safe deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rollback), with policy and security checks baked in.
  • Developer Experience & Automation: Identify toil and remove it with Python, Go, or Bash tooling; improve self-service for product development squads (environments, access, deployments).
  • AI-assisted Engineering: Use Claude Code and adjacent tooling deliberately as part of day-to-day work - managing context, using sub-agents for investigation and adversarial review, and writing reusable skills (prompt-driven automations) for repeat tasks.

Pillar 2: Reliability & Operations


Keeping the platform healthy and the team ready for peak events:

  • Observability: Build and maintain metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting (Google Cloud Operations Suite, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry or equivalents) for the components you own; define and track SLIs/SLOs.
  • On-Call & Incident Response: Take part in a week-long 24hr on-call rotation: respond to escalations from product teams and to platform-owned alerts; triage, mitigate, and escalate following our incident process. On-call duties and escalations are additionally compensated via callout pay.
  • Runbooks & Post-Incident Reviews: Write and maintain accurate runbooks; contribute to blameless post-incident reviews and see durable follow-up actions through to completion.
  • Production Readiness: Factor upcoming critical business events - peak sporting fixtures, market launches, B2B go-lives - into your work, and support load testing, capacity, and failover checks led by Senior engineers.

Pillar 3: Security & Compliance


Building security in from the start:

  • Identity & Access: Implement least-privilege IAM, Workload Identity, and service account hygiene in the components you build; escalate design decisions with wider security or compliance implications.
  • Secrets & Configuration: Use Google Secret Manager and Cloud KMS for secrets and encryption; keep configuration safe and auditable; ensure credentials never end up in code or pipelines.
  • Guardrails in Delivery: Contribute to policy-as-code across Terraform and security scanning (SCA/SAST, container image scanning) in GitLab pipelines, working alongside our Security function.
  • Security Reviews: Consider security during design, raise implications explicitly, and contribute to security reviews of your own and others’ components.

Working with others


  • Product Development Squads: Understand their needs, unblock delivery, and communicate progress, risks, and operational status clearly.
  • Platform Team: Deliver alongside Senior engineers; contribute to shared modules, patterns, and standards; write clear documentation for what you own.
  • Coaching: Pair with and review the work of Junior engineers, explaining your decisions so they can learn from them.

What we’re looking for


Technical Skills & Experience

Must have

  • Experience: 3–5 years in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering within a modern cloud environment, delivering production infrastructure with limited oversight.
  • GCP & Containers: Solid hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Compute, IAM, VPC, GKE, Cloud Storage, managed data services) and containerisation with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Proficient with Terraform - modules, state management, and reviewing changes safely.
  • CI/CD: Proficient at building and debugging pipelines (GitLab CI or similar), including artifact handling and deployment strategies.
  • Observability: Proficient with metrics, logs, and traces; has built dashboards and actionable alerting and understands SLIs/SLOs.
  • Linux & Networking: Proficient with Linux systems (processes, filesystems, systemd, shell) and a working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, and VPC networking.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficient in at least one of Python, Go, or Bash, and able to read the others.
  • Operations: Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation and handling common incidents calmly and methodically.
  • Security Fundamentals: Working knowledge of secure-by-default practices in cloud infrastructure: least privilege, secrets management, safe configuration.

Highly Desirable


  • Experience with high-traffic or real-time systems (sports, betting, finance, media streaming).
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) with an understanding of context management, sub-agents, MCP, and hooks.
  • Experience with GitOps-style workflows (e.g. Argo CD or Flux) for managing Kubernetes and infrastructure changes.
  • Exposure to policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest, Sentinel, or similar) and security scanning in pipelines.
  • Exposure to security or compliance practices in regulated environments (e.g. gambling regulation, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  • Cost and efficiency awareness in cloud environments (rightsizing, committed use, FinOps practices).
  • Relevant certifications (GCP Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, CKA).

Soft Skills


  • Ownership & Pragmatism: You take initiative, pursue problems to resolution, and balance speed with care - and know when to raise a trade-off rather than decide alone.
  • Calm under Pressure: You stay methodical during incidents, ask for help early, and follow through on the actions that stop it happening again.
  • Communication & Collaboration: You explain technical decisions clearly to developers and teammates, write documentation people actually use, and give and receive constructive review feedback.
  • Curiosity & Growth: You’re keen to learn across the full breadth of the platform and to help those around you learn too.

description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This role owns product strategy and execution for payment optimization across PayPal's branded and unbranded (PPCP) stacks, with direct accountability for authentication and authorization rate performance. The role also drives Global Platform Unification across our PSP businesses, concentrating on optimization capabilities and value-added services (VAS) that can be delivered consistently across regions and business lines. This is an individual contributor role.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
  • Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
  • Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Own product strategy and lifecycle performance: Manage, track, and report product performance across its full lifecycle, including strategy, planning, and issue prioritization, spanning wallet, issuer, platform decline, and risk decline optimization.
  • Drive the roadmap and statement of direction: Drive product development and improvements, including roadmap and statement of direction work, and manage the full product lifecycle from concept and design through testing, production deployment, and commercialization.
  • Drive wallet optimization: Own approval rate and acceptance for digital wallets such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, including tokenized and pass through wallet flows, wallet provisioning and updates, and the authentication and routing specific to each wallet.
  • Drive issuer optimization: Raise approval rates at the issuer level using the data issuers prefer, such as network tokens, merchant advice and decline codes, and enriched transaction metadata, along with issuer engagement and retry and routing strategies built for each issuer.
  • Drive platform decline optimization: Steadily reduce the declines that come from PayPal's own platform and gateway, such as technical and soft declines, validation errors, timeouts, formatting issues, and routing failures, working with engineering to measure, diagnose, and fix them.
  • Drive risk decline optimization: Work with Risk and Fraud to cut false declines from risk decisioning, tuning rules and models to approve more legitimate transactions while keeping fraud and chargeback exposure in check.
  • Own playbooks for each market: Own the playbooks that cover wallet mix, issuer preferences, 3DS exemptions, network token adoption, routing rules, and retry windows, and keep tuning them across all markets Paypal operates in.
  • Run experiments with data: Design and lead A/B and multivariate tests for method selection, routing, and retries, measure the impact on authorization rate and on each decline category, and iterate toward a measurable lift in approvals.
  • Prioritize by ROI and set OKRs: Prioritize features by quantified ROI, set OKRs tied to conversion lift and approval rate, and build business cases to support new product recommendations.
  • Write PRDs and technical specs: Author PRDs and sequence diagrams for gateway, processor, network, and wallet integrations, with clear requirements and strong acceptance criteria that lead to high quality launches.
  • Lead across teams and own reliability: Lead peers and dotted line relationships through the project lifecycle, serve as the main negotiator between internal teams and clients to resolve problems and use cases, and own incident runbooks, root cause analysis, and reliability KPIs alongside on call partners..

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Test Lead Coordinator IV is responsible for assuring that all Business functional testing activities are completed within a particular Business work stream and delivered with high quality while ensuring no KPI's are negatively affected – all in service of making our members’ health journeys easier.

Do you have strong organization and time management skills? Do you have a passion for serving others and learning new things? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

What You Bring to Cambia:

Qualifications:

· The UAT Quality Analyst IV would have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Administration or related field, 8+ years of business, health insurance or general health industry and 7 years of experience in defining and analyzing business requirements, process modeling, and acceptance testing with 2 years of experience leading and delivering quality UAT in support of multiple complex corporate projects and lead continuous improvement initiatives for UAT. Extensive experience effectively writing and running queries to support UAT activities; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Skills and Attributes:

· Knowledge of the healthcare insurance domain and Facets, plus experience in a supported functional area (e.g., claims, membership, customer service) and recognition as an expert in one or more business areas or Agile teams.

· Ability to turn business requirements into test cases and scripts that provide full functional coverage, prioritize them using a risk-based approach, and confirm systems meet business objectives.

· Broad knowledge of testing techniques and industry-standard practices to prevent and detect defects throughout the software development lifecycle, including accurate defect recording and communication.

· Ability to create UAT strategies, manage UAT activities across multiple Agile teams, business areas, and concurrent projects, and develop new UAT methods, tools, and standards.

· Ability to validate test data preparation, align teams on functional, regression, and end-to-end testing needs, analyze production defect leakage, and measure results against defined KPIs.

· Ability to identify process changes and their impact on end-user procedures, perform complex workflow analysis, and recommend quality improvements.

· Knowledge of software development and project methodologies (including Agile and company-approved project management practices), plus experience with programming languages, software tools, desktop applications, and AI tools (highly desired).

· Strong cross-functional communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills; ability to lead team members, work independently or in a team, adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment, and report UAT status, metrics, issues, and risks to all levels of management.

· Select, schedule, train, coach, and mentor the Business Test Team and UAT Quality Analysts, providing access to systems and tools and supporting the ongoing growth and success of the team.

· Serve as a business area expert in one or multiple functional areas and an information resource for Quality Assurance and other UAT Analysts, advising Product Owners on KPIs, using metrics to assess process effectiveness and quality, and initiating and driving process, practice, and tool improvements that increase efficiency and meet changing customer expectations.

title: Product Manager, Supplier Growth
description:
Taivo

At Taivo, we’re bringing together the industry’s leading technology solutions to power the businesses behind branded merchandise. Our trusted products—including OrderMyGear, OneSource, Printavo, GraphicsFlow, and Clarity—help distributors, decorators, printers, sign shops, suppliers, and team dealers manage and grow their businesses. By connecting these solutions in one ecosystem, we’re building a better way for the industry to work, grow, and deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.


Product Management @ Taivo

You will own how supplier products get found, chosen, and promoted across Taivo. That starts with search and ranking inside OneSource and the supplier-facing promotion tools that sit on top of it. This is a product manager role inside an established product. The strategy and the first initiative are set. You will turn that initiative into a roadmap of well-framed problems, lead a cross-functional squad to ship them, and prove with data that they worked.


You will report to the Director of Product for our Supplier domain and partner closely with other product managers, design, engineering, and our go-to-market teams.


The OneSource Solution

OneSource is our supplier product platform. Suppliers publish their catalogs once. That data then powers product search across our tools for presentations, online stores, and quotes, along with the industry-standard APIs that other systems pull from. Today our ecosystem sees millions of product searches a month, and suppliers already pay for visibility in it.


A Day in the Life

  • Own the roadmap for supplier search and promotion. Translate the initiative into a prioritized set of epics, each with a clear problem, a target user, and a success metric defined before anything gets built. Explain the "why" of every epic to your squad and stakeholders.
  • Build a new promotion experience, end to end. Design how suppliers buy, target, and manage promotion; how placements appear to the clients searching for products; and how results get reported back. Prototype early, test with real users, and ship in slices that teach you something.
  • Protect search quality while you monetize it. Set the bar for how much promotion a surface can carry and what "relevant" means for a paid result. When short-term revenue and buyer trust pull against each other, bring a recommendation grounded in data and make the call at the squad level, escalating when needed.
  • Prove the return. Define the measurement model for promotion (what counts as an impression, a click, an attributed order) and get it instrumented. Lead updates with the metric and its movement, not the feature you shipped. Be relentless about getting the data a decision needs rather than settling for "I didn't have access."
  • Run continuous discovery. Keep a standing cadence of conversations with suppliers who advertise and with the distributors and store owners whose search experience you protect. Interview for actual past behavior, not opinions about features, and turn what you learn into decisions the team can act on.
  • Lead the squad. Own the "what" for a cross-functional team of engineers and designers; partner with them on the "how" and "when." Manage the backlog for predictability, balance roadmap work against bugs and unplanned requests, and say no to good ideas that do not serve the goal.
  • Ship AI where it earns its place. Apply generative AI and machine learning as appropriate to the use cases. You will shape how models and heuristics are used in the product, define how we evaluate quality, and decide where a human stays in the loop.
  • Launch well. Partner with marketing, sales, and support on release plans, supplier-facing messaging, and feedback loops. Keep executives and stakeholders informed on progress, changes, and risks, and escalate early when something is not working.


Must-Haves

  • A builder who has shipped. You have taken a new capability from problem to production inside an existing product, more than once. You prototype yourself (we use tools like Claude Code and v0) and test with users to validate problems and assumptions; you would rather put a rough version in front of a user this week than a polished spec next month; and you read API documentation and test endpoints.
  • Shipped AI into production. You have delivered at least one feature where an AI model (ranking, relevance, recommendations, classification, or generation) was part of the product. You know how to define quality for it, how to evaluate it before and after launch, determine where it fails, and iterate.
  • Experience with search or promotion products. You have worked on how one group finds, chooses, or pays to reach another: search and relevance, sponsored products or retail media, listings and placements, recommendations, or promotions. You understand the trust tension in pay-for-placement products and have managed it.
  • Continuous discovery as a habit. You maintain a regular cadence with customers rather than running research as a phase. You can describe a decision that changed because of something you heard, or data analysis that you conducted.
  • Measurement you can defend. You define the success metric before you build and instrument the work to be measurable. You can tell when a number proves something and when it only looks good. You understand basic statistics and use that when looking at data and dashboards.
  • Technical and data fluency. You are comfortable in the details with engineers: how data connects across systems, how an action gets attributed to a result, how APIs and integrations work. You do not need to be an engineer, but you have strong data capabilities that allow you to pull and analyze data (SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, product analytics, and BI tools).
  • Market fluency, quickly. You build a working map of a new industry fast: how money flows, who the alternatives are, where our products sit, what customers do today when our product is not in the picture.
  • Collaborative by default, with a backbone. You build trust with a new team and with peers whose scope borders yours. You hold strong opinions loosely, and you can push back on engineering, design, go-to-market, or leadership with evidence rather than volume.


The Right Person Will Have...

  • 4+ years in product management, with at least 2 years on a product where you owned a roadmap and led a squad. We will consider candidates with 3 years in product management.
  • Experience in B2B, B2C, or B2B2C software. Catalog, e-commerce, marketplace-adjacent, or vertical SaaS backgrounds translate well. Branded merchandise experience is not expected, but would be a big plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or a quantitative field preferred; equivalent experience welcome.
  • Comfortable working in a remote team and in the US time zones we operate in.


A Few of the Perks

  • Competitive benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote work available for U.S.-based candidates
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid parental leave
  • In-office benefits for those local to Dallas, TX:
    • Catered lunches
    • Casual office atmosphere & located in the Design District
    • Fully stocked kitchen


Candidates must be physically located and legally authorized to work in one of the following states: AZ, AR, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, ME, MI, MN, MO, MT, NV, NH, NC, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, and WI. We are currently unable to consider applicants outside of these states.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Why Plot

Plot is building the next generation of social intelligence — an AI-native platform that helps some of the world's most influential brands understand culture, find emerging trends, and activate their communities at scale. We're a high-growth, venture-backed startup supported by the co-founders of Reddit and Plaid, with customers like Tory Burch, Lululemon, La Roche-Posay, and other household names.

We operate at the intersection of applied AI and large-scale data systems, turning millions of short-form videos every day into structured representations of culture and consumer behavior. Plot makes unstructured social media legible at scale, enabling brands to build a deep, systematic understanding of trends, audiences, and influence.

You'll join a small but mighty team where engineers own systems end-to-end — not tickets. You'll work directly with founders, shape foundational architecture, and make decisions that define how Plot scales for years to come. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, deep systems thinking, and building infrastructure that unlocks entire product surfaces, Plot is the place. It’s also a great fit if you aspire to be a technical founder one day — we operate with a strong founder’s mindset.

What You'll Work On

  • Own the core data systems that power Plot. You’ll take responsibility for how millions of enriched videos flow from ingestion → storage → analytics → product surfaces.

  • Stabilize and harden high-throughput write paths. Our pipelines ingest and enrich data continuously; you’ll diagnose failure modes, reduce error rates, and make ingestion reliable, observable, and predictable.

  • Design data access patterns that stay fast under pressure. You’ll ensure dashboards and analytical queries remain responsive even while large volumes of data are being written concurrently.

  • Separate transactional and analytical concerns. You’ll lead decisions around which workloads belong where, and design the systems and contracts that keep them from stepping on each other.

  • Build read-optimized models for insight, not just storage. This includes partitioning strategies, rollups, and schemas that reflect how data is actually queried — by humans and by AI.

  • Enable AI-native analytics. You’ll shape how our internal tools and AI agents query and reason over data, making it possible to answer complex analytical questions without brute-force scans.

  • Make architectural calls that matter. You’ll evaluate tradeoffs, write RFCs, and guide the evolution of Plot’s data platform as scale, product needs, and AI capabilities grow.

  • Raise the bar for reliability and performance across the team. You’ll define best practices, unblock other engineers, and become a go-to resource for data-related decisions.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience operating Postgres in production under real-world read/write concurrency. You understand partitioning, locking, autovacuum, connection pooling, and why systems fail in subtle ways.

  • Strong systems intuition. You think in bottlenecks, failure modes, and tradeoffs — not just indexes or tooling.

  • Experience designing or owning analytical data architectures, including read-optimized schemas, aggregations, or large-scale querying patterns.

  • Comfort leading ambiguous, high-impact work. You can take a messy system, form a clear mental model, and chart a pragmatic path forward.

  • High ownership mindset. You like digging into logs, metrics, and real data — and you care deeply about correctness, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and a desire to build foundational systems that other engineers and AI systems depend on. No degree requirements.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Company Overview
AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website

Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview

Job Role
Own the technical direction and delivery outcomes of a major product area or substantial cross-team initiative. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining deep engineering ability with customer understanding and product judgment. You will shape solutions with Product and Engineering, implement critical components and remain accountable for how they perform after release.

Key Responsibilities
  • Product and technical direction. Understand customer workflows, adoption barriers and relevant market alternatives with Product and customer-facing teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations on what to improve, simplify or avoid building. Translate agreed priorities into architecture, delivery increments and measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on delivery. Lead design, coding, review, testing and rollout of complex Java services and platform capabilities. Build critical components and reference implementations. Make trade-offs explicit and help teams deliver secure, maintainable software rather than leaving execution at the design stage.
  • Production AI judgment. Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they offer meaningful customer value. Define evaluation cases, security boundaries, human approvals where needed, failure handling and acceptable cost and latency. Select conventional engineering approaches when they solve the problem more reliably.
  • Reliability and modernisation. Improve performance, scalability, observability, security and tenant isolation within the assigned scope. Address technical debt through staged investments linked to customer or delivery impact. Resolve systemic causes of production problems and improve prevention.
  • Cross-team influence. Align interfaces, dependencies and engineering practices across participating teams. Mentor senior engineers and explain decisions clearly. Partner with Product on priorities, Engineering Managers on delivery capacity and the Distinguished Engineer or CTO on company-wide architecture. title: Software Development Manager, FME Engine
description:
As a Software Development Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects within your team. You’ll collaborate with Product, UX, and other stakeholders to prioritize work, guide technical direction, and ensure smooth delivery.

You’ll also support the growth and well-being of team members through coaching, feedback, and development opportunities. Your leadership will help the team navigate challenges, align with product goals, and continuously improve their practices and performance.

This is a people-first leadership role for someone who is passionate about developing talent, supporting delivery, and fostering collaboration. You’ll also serve as a bridge between your team and the broader organization, helping align business needs with technical implementation.

This is a hybrid role based out of Safe Software's Surrey, BC headquarters. We have an immediate opening and are excited to find the right candidate to join our team.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Even if you don’t meet every requirement listed, we value your unique experiences and perspectives.

About The Team

The FME Engine team builds and maintains the core of Safe Software’s FME platform, the technology that powers data integration for organizations around the world. As SDM, you’ll lead two Engine teams, which build many of the transformers at the heart of FME. It’s computational, algorithm-rich work written primarily in C++ within the FME codebase. Both teams are strong and highly collaborative, with a habit of tackling problems together rather than working in silos, and they’re looking for a leader who will nurture that culture.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Software Development Manager, FME Engine, you will:

  • Lead a team of developers through coaching, feedback, and professional development.

  • Collaborate with Product, UX, and technical stakeholders to define and prioritize work.

  • Act as product owner for your teams, partnering with Product Managers to manage the backlog, prioritize features and internal improvements, and bring planned work to your teams.

  • Oversee technical delivery, helping manage project flow and addressing risks early.

  • Support architecture and design discussions to ensure alignment and inclusion of team voices.

  • Build a positive, inclusive team culture centred on collaboration and shared ownership.

  • Guide hiring, onboarding, and team growth with a focus on skill development and values alignment.

  • Champion continuous improvement and openness to change in tools, practices, and communication, including AI-assisted ways of working.

  • Act as a liaison between your team and other parts of the organization, advocating for both team and business needs.

Qualifications, Skills, and Competencies

At Safe Software, we welcome diverse backgrounds and experiences. While not all candidates will have everything listed, the most successful candidates will bring many of the following:

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years in software development, including 3+ years leading software teams as a people manager, team lead, or similar role. Direct people management experience strongly preferred.

  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices and software system design.

  • Strong working knowledge of C++, enough to understand the scope and design of your teams’ work. Hands-on coding is welcome but not expected.

  • Product owner experience in an Agile environment, including backlog management and feature prioritization.

  • Demonstrated interest and practical experience in adopting AI tools within a development team.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a focus on empathy and clarity.

  • Demonstrated ability to support team health and build inclusive, high-performing teams.

  • Ability to balance technical direction with team and business priorities.

Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Python, particularly for test frameworks.

  • Familiarity with Safe Software’s platform or similar technical domains.

  • Involvement in mentoring, DEI, or culture-building initiatives.

  • Knowledge of hiring practices, onboarding, and team-building techniques.

  • Experience with AI Coding Agents (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).

What You Can Expect

When you choose a career with Safe Software, you’re also choosing…

  • Meaningful Work: Make a profound impact across our business, workplace and data integration product.

  • A Supportive Environment: Feel empowered to share your ideas and implement them with high autonomy and team support.

  • Social Responsibility: Become part of a team that finds meaningful ways to give back. Take paid time off to volunteer for one of our Safe-organized opportunities that align with our core community initiatives.

  • Learning & Career Development: We believe in your continuous learning and growth. Take advantage of an annual learning budget and training programs paid for by Safe.

  • Flexible Working Hours: Flexible and remote-friendly work arrangements to fit your lifestyle. Work when you want, and how you want to.

  • Work-Life Balance: There's no place for burnout at Safe. Maintain a healthy balance of your personal and work life without splitting yourself in two. Enjoy 3 weeks of vacation to recharge, plus an additional paid 6 seasonal days off per year.

  • Health & Wellness: Extended health, dental, health or lifestyle spending, and counseling benefits from day 1. That’s right, no waiting period.

  • Family is important: We are dedicated to supporting our employees through parenthood and offer a Parental Leave Top-Up Program for new parents through childbirth or adoption.

  • Shared Success: Share in Safe’s success with our bi-annual profit sharing and RRSP/TFSA matching program.

  • An Accessible Commute: Regardless of your commute method, we’re located close to public transit, and provide complimentary parking and bike storage for our team!

About Safe Software

Safe Software transforms organizations with FME, the only All-Data Any-AI Enterprise Integration Platform connecting all your data, anywhere, at any velocity.

With over 30 years of expertise and 25,000+ enterprise customers across 125+ countries, we simplify your data journey, wherever it leads.

Founded in 1993, Safe is headquartered in Surrey, BC with over 300 team members and counting. We’re always looking for talented individuals with diverse backgrounds who are determined to learn and grow. Are you ready to join the team?


Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Safe Software is an equal opportunity employer and we truly believe that innovation and strength begin with diversity and inclusion.

We welcome all candidates regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, ability, disability, national or ethnic origin, political belief, religion, or family status.

Should you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact hr_dept@safe.com.

Notice Regarding Use of Automated Tools in Hiring

These tools may assist in screening resumes and summarizing interview content based on the information you provide. This helps our team review applications efficiently while ensuring every candidate is considered based on the requirements of the role.

Please be assured that the final hiring decision is always made by a member of our team. For more information on how we protect your privacy, please see our policy. If you have questions about this process, please contact us at hr_dept@safe.com.

description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

Fanatics Collectibles is looking for a QC Associate to support quality-control operations for our Autograph Operations team. This role reports into our Quality Control department and is responsible for ensuring that the autographs that make it into our product are of the highest caliber, inventoried & documented properly, and delivered on-time for production. Candidates with a passion for sports, culture, & entertainment will find themselves a strong cultural fit.

Responsibilities:

  • Conducts quality control for sticker and on-card autographs, with an emphasis on high value sets and white glove athletes
  • Conducts analysis on autographs to determine "good" vs. "bad" on-card or sticker autographs
  • Operate automated defect detection machine and perform due diligence and quality checks on automated QC process
  • Conducts analysis on AI-based outputs to properly compile data on QC Sheets and address any discrepancies from automated QC
  • Conducts product pack outs and product check-ins with vendors to ensure Autograph Operations delivers all active cards per the subject list on time
  • Responsible for receipt of sticker and on-card autographs daily, to include unboxing and staging of products, data entry into Autograph Operations databases, and secure transportation of products in cages from receipt area to quality control
  • Supports the secure storage and organization of high value autographs in inventory room, to include properly shelving on-card autographs in alphabetically order by product
  • Mentors and trains less experienced QC Associates; provide guidance and training as questions or discrepancies arise

The Ideal Candidate:

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 1-2 years of experience in manufacturing or production environments, preferred
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to lift 10-15 lbs. at once, preferred
  • Proficient experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel), required

title: Senior Software Engineer - Commercial - #4978
description:
Our mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. We are working to change the trajectory of cancer mortality and bring stakeholders together to adopt innovative, safe, and effective technologies that can transform cancer care.
We are a healthcare company, pioneering new technologies to advance early cancer detection. We have built a multi-disciplinary organization of scientists, engineers, and physicians and we are using the power of next-generation sequencing (NGS), population-scale clinical studies, and state-of-the-art computer science and data science to overcome one of medicine’s greatest challenges.
GRAIL is headquartered in the Bay Area of California, with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom. It is supported by leading global investors and pharmaceutical, technology, and healthcare companies.
For more information, please visit

GRAIL is seeking a Senior Software Engineer for the Commercial engineering team within our Technology organization. Our team builds and operates the patient- and provider-facing software behind the Galleri® test, including my.grail.com and provider.grail.com, along with the systems that collect and deliver the clinical data the test depends on. The software we write sits directly in the path between a patient ordering a test and a physician acting on the result, so correctness, reliability, and clarity matter as much as velocity.

This is a backend-leaning full-stack role for an engineer who wants meaningful ownership. You will design and build cloud-native services in Go on AWS and Kubernetes, and you will follow your work through to the React interfaces that patients and clinicians actually use. You will own systems end to end — design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production operation — and you will help raise the bar for the engineers around you. If you want your work to have a direct line to earlier cancer detection, this is a rare place to do it.

This role is based in Sunnyvale, California. It offers a flexible work arrangement, with the ability to work from GRAIL's office or from home. Our current flexible work arrangement policy requires that a minimum of 60%, or 24 hours, of your total work week be on-site. Your specific schedule, determined in collaboration with your manager, will align with team and business needs and could exceed the 60% requirement for the site. At our Sunnyvale campus, Tuesdays and Thursdays are the key days where we encourage on-site presence to engage in events and on-site activities.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate backend services and distributed systems that power GRAIL's commercial offerings for the Galleri® test, including my.grail.com and provider.grail.com.

  • Own features and services end to end, from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  • Contribute across the stack, building and maintaining React interfaces used by patients, clinicians, and internal clinical operations teams.

  • Lead the technical design of projects of diverse scope, working independently and bringing designs forward for review at critical decision points.

  • Devise solutions where precedent is limited, adapting existing approaches and exercising judgment to select the right course of action.

  • Partner with product managers, clinical operations, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical plans, advising senior stakeholders who may not share your technical background and adapting how you communicate to the audience.

  • Write and maintain automated tests and test protocols appropriate for software operating in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Improve the reliability and observability of the systems you own, participating in on-call rotation, incident response, and follow-up remediation.

  • Raise engineering quality on the team through code review, pairing, and mentorship of less experienced engineers.

  • Identify and drive improvements to our tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and development practices.

    • These responsibilities summarize the role's primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company's discretion.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a similar technical field with 5+ years of related experience, or a Master's degree with 2+ years of related experience, or a PhD, or equivalent experience.

  • Professional experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining production backend or full-stack applications.

  • Professional experience building and operating services on a major cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Java, Python, or C++.

  • Strong professional written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing production Go, and experience with gRPC-based service communication.

  • Experience building and maintaining production React applications.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS specifically, including infrastructure as code using Terraform.

  • Experience operating containerized workloads with Kubernetes and Docker in production.

  • Experience designing and scaling microservice architectures, including service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility.

  • Strong working knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design and query performance, and of caching layers such as Redis.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and agile development practices.

  • Experience building software in healthcare or another regulated domain, including familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, or software quality and validation requirements.

  • Experience with observability and reliability tooling, and a track record of improving system uptime.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading small project teams.

  • A demonstrated passion for designing and building practical, high-quality software, and a desire to add value to the team.

title: SUMS Architect

The SUMS architecture will be responsible for end-to-end design, implementation, validation, and regulatory compliance of Over-The-Air (OTA) software updates. Document OTA processes (creation, transfer, receipt), vehicle manifests, version control, failure recovery, authorization, key management, audit trails

  • Regulatory compliance

Prepare and submit evidence for type approval submissions (VTA) for UNECE R156, R155, MVMA notices on OTA, recalls, vehicle admission

Interface with regulatory authorities in Korea, EU, and other markets to ensure national-level compliance per local standards

  • Engineering & integration

Collaborate with embedded software teams to integrate OTA infrastructure with ECUs (e.g., AUTOSAR), power management, OBD interfaces, fallback mechanisms

Implement safety-critical lifecycle processes: verification, validation, risk/cybersecurity management across vehicle/infrastructure

Establish and enforce CI/CD, secure update packaging, manifest/version retrieval, vehicle-brick mitigation, rollback procedures

  • Project management

Lead international feature delivery across OEM/Tier-1 teams, streamline coordination across engineering, product, cybersecurity, compliance, and support; work in cross-functional environments

Conduct audits, enforce quality processes per ISO 24089 & ISO 21434 (governance, info sharing, tailoring, risk tracking)

  • Training & certification

Train teams on OTA, versioning, SUMS, recall processes, support preparation for certifications and regulatory audits

  • undefined

  • undefined
  • Continuous improvement of SUMS processes and tools based on audit findings and industry benchmarking.

  • Regulatory expertise

Strong understanding of ISO 24089, ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156

  • Technical/engineering skills

title: Intern Researcher- Audio, Speech & Acoustic AI
description:
Huawei Canada has an immediate 12-month internship opening for a Researcher

About the Role

Huawei Canada CBG team is seeking a highly motivated Audio, Speech, & Acoustics Research Intern to join our AI & Signal Processing Research team. In this role, you will work closely with senior researchers and engineers to explore, design, and implement cutting-edge algorithms at the intersection of acoustic signal processing, deep learning, and speech processing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Algorithm Research & Development: Design, prototype, and evaluate novel audio signal processing algorithms and deep learning models for speech and acoustic processing.

  • Data Pipelines & Dataset Curation: Build robust data pipelines for synthetic and real-world acoustic data augmentation, simulation, and feature extraction (e.g., room impulse response generation, spectrograms, neural representations).

  • Proof-of-Concept Implementation: Develop efficient clean Python / C++ implementations to test research hypotheses and validate models on benchmark datasets.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams to help translate successful research prototypes into scalable product features.

  • Publication & Documentation: Clear technical documentation of methodologies and results, with the potential to publish findings at top-tier conferences (e.g., ICASSP, INTERSPEECH, NeurIPS).

The total targeted annual compensation (based on 2,080 hours per year) ranges from $58,000 to $104,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Requirements

About the Ideal Candidate:

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Audio/Acoustic Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong foundations in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) (e.g., STFT, filter design, array processing, room acoustics) and/or Deep Learning for Audio.

  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Strong proficiency in Python (including NumPy, SciPy, Librosa, PyTorch-Audio, or Torchaudio).

  • Strong analytical skills, curiosity, and passion for solving open research problems in audio.

  • Track record of research publication in domain conferences (e.g., ICASSP, INTERSPEECH, WASPAA, IEEE TASLP).

  • Speech AI: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Voice Conversion, or Speaker Diarization.

  • Acoustic Signal Processing: Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC), Active Noise Control (ANC), Beamforming, Sound Source Localization, or Dereverberation.

  • Audio Generation & Enhancement: Neural audio codecs, generative audio models (Diffusion/LLMs for audio), or audio source separation.

  • Spatial Audio: Ambisonics, HRTF modeling, or binaural rendering.

Huawei Canada is committed to a fair, inclusive, and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodation during any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. All applications for this position are reviewed directly by our hiring team, we do not use artificial intelligence tools to screen or select candidates.

Blizzard Video is the video production arm of the Story & Franchise Development team. We exist to engage, inform, and activate the global Blizzard community through the creation of epic video content.


Blizzard Video is looking for a talented Senior Motion Graphics Department Producer who is highly organized with outstanding communication and project management skills. Communications skills are essential as you’ll be interfacing with other departments company-wide, coordinating with them to fulfill requests and gather assets. Position Overview
Provides quality rehabilitation care to residents under the direct supervision of a licensed Occupational Therapist as outlined in the plan of care in accordance with laws, regulations and Facility guidelines.

Basic Qualifications

Graduate of an accredited occupational therapy program (AS-Occupational Therapy).

sensitive situations related to the emotional well-being of the residents with patience, dignity and respect; must be able to lift 40 lbs floor to waist; lift 10 lbs waist to shoulder; lift and carry 40 lbs; and push/pull 40 lbs.

Experience:
Licensed COTA within the state of practice; one year experience in long-term care environment preferred.

Working Conditions
Works specifically in the rehabilitation department, resident rooms, etc.; bends, lifts, sits, stands and moves frequently throughout the shift; deals with frequent interruptions and possibly upset residents and family members; works regularly scheduled shifts with possible weekends, holidays and other hours based on resident needs; primary responsibility is careof residents but also deals with visitors, government personnel, etc.; participates in required continuing education
programs; subject to odors, falls, burns and exposure to infectious diseases, waste, etc., including AIDS and Hepatitis B viruses.

Professionalism: Reports to work on time and as scheduled; keeps open communication with direct supervisors to ensure quality care of the residents; promotes teamwork, takes part in problem solving and displays a positive, caring attitude; consistently attends staff meetings, required in-services and other committees as assigned by the facility.

Resident Rights: Promptly reports resident grievances to the rehabilitation supervisors; treats all resident care information with confidentiality; continuously monitors assigned areas to ensure residents are treated fairly and with dignity and respect at all times; conducts rehabilitation care in privacy, including knocking on the door prior to entering a resident's room; honors resident refusal of treatments and reports to rehabilitation supervisors.

Safety Awareness: Follows safety program guidelines; immediately reports accidents and incidents to supervisors; identifies unsafe working areas and promptly reports to supervisors; promotes safety by working as safely and efficiently as possible; monitors resident rooms to ensure it is clean and neat at all times; consistently follows infection control and universal precautions and other guidelines; identifies and corrects or reports hazardous conditions to supervisors;
understands facility emergency and evacuation protocols.

Organizational and Communication Skills: Handles multiple residents simultaneously; completes assignments in an organized fashion by the end of scheduled shifts; operates with flexibility and shows attention to detail when recording information in resident charts; possesses effective verbal and nonverbal communication skills and is an attentive listener.

Customer Service: Treats all residents, families, co-workers and supervisors with dignity and respect and takes initiative to exceed customer expectations; professional represents the facility, self and position to visitors and residents; demonstrates a positive attitude and willingness to help to all visitors and residents; remains sensitive to all needs through listening, observing and responding appropriately for the position held.

2. Follows resident care plan and provides occupational therapy treatments under the direction of a licensed OT.

title: Backend Software Engineer, Trust & Safety (Anti-Fraud)
description:
Almaty, Kazakhstan · Trust & Safety Engineering

Why this role exists

Our ML and analytics teams already work on fraud detection and risk analysis. This role owns the backend that turns their signals into reliable protections across accounts, credits, payments, and generation. You'll integrate risk checks into product flows, build enforcement services and operator tools, and make sure controls work correctly in production. We're looking for an engineer we can trust to take a backend problem from an unclear starting point to a working solution.

What you'll actually do

  • Risk integrations: connect existing ML scores and risk signals to account creation, credit usage, payments, and generation flows, with clear timeouts and fallback behavior.

  • Enforcement services: implement configurable rules, rate limits, account restrictions, and credit or payment controls with consistent behavior across services.

  • Operator tooling: build APIs and workflows for reviewing cases, inspecting decision history, and safely applying or reversing restrictions.

  • Production reliability: handle retries, duplicate events, concurrent requests, and safe rollouts; add monitoring and audit trails so failures can be traced and fixed.

  • Work in other teams’ codebases to add signals or interventions without hurting their stability or architecture.

  • Ownership: clarify the control with ML, analytics, and operations → scope the smallest useful implementation → ship → verify production behavior and review impact with the team. Our release cycle is days, not quarters, so your first shipped protection happens fast.

Must-haves

  1. You've taken a difficult problem from an unclear starting point to a working system used in production, and can explain your own decisions, contribution, and results.

  2. You can build reliable backend services: APIs, data models, queues, transactions, idempotency, and concurrency. You can integrate external services and debug failures across the request and event lifecycle.

  3. You choose the next steps, remove blockers, and ask for help when needed. You cut scope to test an idea, adapt from evidence, and keep working through difficult problems.

  4. You work with ML, analytics, and operations to turn risk requirements into clear backend behavior. You use operator feedback and customer cases to improve controls and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

  5. You take feedback, change your mind when the evidence changes, and do the work the team needs. You share knowledge and responsibility so others can operate and extend what you build.

Who this is not for

  • You prefer problems where requirements stay stable after launch.

  • You prefer work centered on training models or producing analysis rather than building and operating backend services.

Nice to have

  • Fraud prevention, payments risk, or platform abuse experience.

  • Integrating risk-scoring services or building rules engines and rate limiters.

  • Case management, appeals, and risk operations tooling.

  • Familiarity with Stripe.

  • Experience building real-time scoring, graph-based account linkage systems.

  • Python/Go experience.

Interview process

  1. Recruiter screen: role expectations, logistics, and fit.

  2. Technical interview: a difficult system you shipped, what you personally decided and built, and how your work made the team more capable without leaving it dependent on you.

  3. Additional technical interview, if needed: a deeper discussion of technical skills and open questions.

  4. Product fit interview: take an existing risk signal and an operator need, scope a backend protection, and work through failure cases and effects on legitimate customers.

  5. Offer.

What we offer

Competitive base in USD, equity, relocation support, and ownership of protections that preserve both company revenue and customer trust.

title: Polish Speaker - 3-Day Paid User Research Study, $100/hr
description:
