Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Polish actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.

Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Polish speaker who grew up in Poland.
  • You use Polish in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Almaty, Kazakhstan

Build the shared infrastructure that helps Higgsfield’s product teams ship quickly and run reliable services. You’ll own problems from finding the bottleneck to shipping a solution and supporting it in production.

What you’ll do

  • Build shared services for queues, job scheduling, caching, configuration, and service communication.

  • Improve concurrency limits, resource allocation, and recovery for long-running media workloads.

  • Make database access, migrations, and connection management safer and faster.

  • Simplify service setup, testing, deployment, and production debugging.

  • Improve observability, investigate incidents, and reduce infrastructure cost per completed job.

  • Work directly with product engineers, ship focused improvements, and measure the results. Our release cycle is days, not quarters.

Required

  • Experience running production systems on Kubernetes (K8s) and AWS, including deployments, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong software engineering skills: you build shared services, tools, and automation that other engineers use.

  • Experience with databases, queues, and distributed systems, including performance debugging, safe rollouts, and recovery.

  • A difficult production problem you owned from an unclear starting point to a working solution.

  • Ability to set priorities, make practical tradeoffs, remove blockers, and ask for help when needed.

  • Clear communication, openness to feedback, and knowledge sharing so others can operate and extend your work.

Nice to have

  • Cloudflare.

  • Infrastructure as code.

  • PostgreSQL, Redis, or event-streaming systems.

  • High-throughput media pipelines or AI workload orchestration.

Interview process

  1. Recruiter screen: expectations, logistics, and fit.

  2. Technical interview: a difficult system you shipped, your decisions, and the results.

  3. Additional technical interview, if needed.

  4. Product fit interview: investigate a team’s bottleneck and plan a practical improvement, adoption, and safe rollout.

  5. Offer.

What we offer

Competitive base pay in USD, equity, relocation support, and ownership of infrastructure used across our engineering teams.

title: Graduate Engineer
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

STACK Infrastructure is seeking motivated graduates in Engineering and Construction to join our Singapore team and support the development and delivery of data centre projects in Malaysia and across APAC.

This is a full-time opportunity for graduates who want to build a career in the data centre industry. You will gain practical exposure to the design, development, construction, commissioning and handover of mission-critical data centres, supported by experienced colleagues and a structured development approach.

During the selection process, we will assess your interests, strengths and technical background and place successful candidates into the area most suited to them.

Engineering pathway

Engineering graduates may be assigned to teams supporting:

  • Design management and coordination

  • Engineering solutions and technical reviews

  • Commissioning, testing and operational readiness

  • Project coordination, quality assurance and issue resolution

You will work with internal teams, consultants, contractors and vendors to help ensure that systems are designed, tested and ready for safe, reliable operation.

Construction pathway

Construction graduates may be assigned to the Delivery team, supporting the planning and execution of data centre construction projects.

You will gain hands-on exposure to site coordination, programme tracking, contractor management, safety, quality, risk management and project handover.

What you will do

  • Support project teams with technical coordination, documentation and reporting.

  • Participate in site inspections, meetings, testing activities and project walk-downs.

  • Assist with reviewing drawings, technical submissions, work packs, test plans and project records.

  • Help identify, track and resolve technical issues, defects and outstanding works.

  • Work closely with project managers, engineers, consultants, contractors and vendors.

  • Support safety, quality and operational-readiness requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Take on increasing responsibility as your experience, skills and confidence develop.

What we are looking for

  • A recent graduate, or final-year student graduating soon, with a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Built Environment or a related discipline.

  • For the Engineering pathway, a background in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Controls, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline is preferred.

  • Strong interest in data centres, critical infrastructure, engineering, construction or project delivery.

  • Practical aptitude, intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn quickly.

  • Good analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, site-based environment.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with Bluebeam, Microsoft Project or similar tools is advantageous.

  • Willingness to work primarily on project sites and travel within Singapore and occasionally across APAC where required.

STACK is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only activities to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related responsibilities requested by their manager.

title: Mobile Software Engineer
description:
About On Me

Humans have given each other gifts since the dawn of time. For gratitude, for friendship, and for love. In today’s society, gifting has become harder and much more wasteful, as it’s become nearly impossible to know exactly what someone wants, when you just want to show that you care.

On Me is revolutionizing gifting by rebuilding it for the mobile and Instagram era. Traditional gift cards are impersonal and rigid, usually sold by an old and wealthy megacorp. We make it easy to send a personalized, media-rich gift that’s spendable across brands, fits someone’s hobbies, and drops straight into their mobile wallet for tap‑to‑pay. Check out our live experience at .

We’re a small startup from Google, Apple, and Stripe moving fast on a massive category and have raised $8M from top‑tier investors like NFX, Lerer Hippeau, Focal VC, and Mastercard. Since launching in November 2024, On Me has been featured in Tech Crunch, Fortune, and The Wall Street Journal. In 2025, we sustained over 40% growth month over month throughout the year, and the trend shows no sign of stopping.

In 2026, we're doubling down on making every gift feel magical end‑to‑end and building an amazing consumer product. You'll help us build world-class iOS and Android apps that people love. If you want meaningful ownership, clear consumer product impact, and the chance to set engineering standards early, this is it.

Who you are

You're perfect for this role if you're a mobile engineering expert who wants to own the native app experience end to end. You love crafting polished, performant iOS and/or Android apps that delight real users. You care deeply about the quality and craft of what you build, and why you build it.

What you’ll do

As a mobile software engineer, you'll be the fourth engineer at a tiny startup, working closely with the whole team to design and build the native mobile experiences that power our gifting platform. You'll own our iOS and/or Android apps from architecture to pixel‑perfect UI, building polished, performant experiences backed by clean API integrations. Your work will include thinking through user journeys, edge cases, loading and error states, and optimizing for performance across devices. You'll have end-to-end ownership of critical mobile surfaces, driving both product and engineering decisions that shape the future of digital gifting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and ship native iOS and/or Android features using Swift and Kotlin.

  • Build high-quality, fluid mobile UIs with attention to polish, animation, responsiveness, loading, and error states.

  • Architect and evolve our mobile codebases for maintainability, testability, and performance.

  • Integrate with backend APIs and collaborate on API design to support mobile use cases.

  • Collaborate with product, design, and the rest of the team to translate fuzzy goals into concrete flows and shipped features.

  • Drive mobile architectural decisions to support scaling to hundreds of thousands of users.

  • Set up and evolve crash reporting, performance monitoring, and release tooling for our mobile apps.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping native mobile apps.

  • Proficiency in Swift (iOS) and/or Kotlin (Android), with strong experience in at least one and working knowledge of the other.

  • Strong product and UX mindset: you think from the user's point of view and care about end‑to‑end flows, not just screens.

  • Deep understanding of mobile platform conventions, lifecycle management, and performance optimization.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD, automated testing, and release management (TestFlight, Play Console).

  • Solid understanding of API integration, data modeling, and how systems fail in practice.

  • Ability to take ownership of projects from vague problem → design → implementation → launch and iteration.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a fast-paced startup environment.

Bonus points

  • Some experience with modern web stacks (React, Next.js, TypeScript) — enough to contribute to web features when needed.

  • Experience with frontend development for consumer products.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery).

  • Experience working with payments, financial transactions, or other high‑value data systems.

  • Experience with mobile wallet integrations (Apple Wallet, Google Wallet).

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary and meaningful early employee equity.

  • A dynamic, collaborative, balanced, and inclusive work culture.

  • The opportunity to deeply shape the company’s tech stack and engineering culture.

  • Hybrid office in SF with a fully stocked gym, or hybrid office in NYC.

  • Unlimited paid time off.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • 401k

Who You’ll Work With

At On Me, you’ll join a small, elite team of builders from Google and Apple who move fast and care deeply about product quality. You’ll collaborate daily with:

  • Darragh Meaney, CEO — Formerly at Google Ads and YouTube

  • Sitar Harel, CTO — Formerly at Google Maps and Google Photos

  • Daniel Li, Founding Engineer — ex-Apple, WWDC session speaker and Cornell AppDev alum

  • Neil Shankar, Founding Designer — previously Senior Designer at Google and Block (formerly Square)

We combine big-tech craft with startup speed—and we’re just getting started.

Join Us

Become a part of On Me’s story, and play an integral role in our journey to strengthen relationships through magical gifting experiences. If you're ready to contribute to a team that values ambition, collaboration, and the joy of tackling exciting challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Executive Director/Vice President Global Media Relations, Executive Communications & Comm Ops
description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.

Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

This is a global role. Demonstrated international communications experience is required — candidates must have led media and corporate communications outside the United States, across multiple markets and regulatory regimes. Experience confined to the U.S. market will not meet the bar for this position.

We are seeking a seasoned, globally experienced communications leader to run our communications function and own how our story reaches the world. As VP, Global Media Relations & Corporate Communications, you will serve as our principal media strategist and spokesperson partner — setting one coherent corporate narrative and adapting it across every market in which we operate. You should bring established, durable relationships with the journalists who cover our science and our sector on both sides of the Atlantic and beyond, and preparing our executives to represent the company with clarity and credibility anywhere in the world.

This role sits at the intersection of media, markets, and science. You will lead media communications around clinical data readouts, regulatory milestones, earnings, and business development announcements — U.S. and international alike — working shoulder-to-shoulder with Investor Relations, Commercial, Legal, Government & Medical Affairs, and Regulatory. You will be equally comfortable driving proactive storytelling during moments of momentum or scrutiny.

You will develop a dynamic and growing team, supported by US and Global Communications leads.

Responsibilities

Within the brand & comms team you will:

Lead Global Communications

  • Global strategy: Oversee the us and ex-us communications strategy end to end — setting one global narrative and directing how it is adapted for each market's media environment, regulatory regime, language, and cultural context.
  • Tier One media relationships: Personally build and maintain senior relationships with journalists and editors, across tier 1 press (ex. WSJ, FT, etc), TV (CNBC, BBC, etc), and digital.
  • Cross-border execution: Oversee time-zone-spanning announcement execution, embargo coordination, and simultaneous multi-market releases so that news lands cleanly and consistently everywhere at once.
  • Global issues readiness: Ensure crisis and issues frameworks account for jurisdictional differences in disclosure, product safety communication, and media norms.

Build BridgeBio’s corporate and executive visibility

  • Media strategy: oversee and partner with leads to develop proactive and reactive media strategy aligned to corporate, pipeline, and reputational objectives, and direct your team and agencies in executing it across markets.
  • Own corporate presence Define how we show up at major industry, policy and business-of-health forums (e.g., J.P. Morgan Healthcare, BIO International, BIO-Europe, Milken Global Conference and Future of Health, STAT Summit, Fortune Brainstorm Health, Aspen Ideas: Health), securing speaking slots, media briefings and executive positioning
  • Press relationships: Serve as the senior corporate media contact and personally cultivate high-trust relationships with priority U.S. and international journalists across national, business, financial, healthcare, science, and trade outlets.
  • Story placement: Identify and land the high-stakes media opportunities that require senior-level access and judgment — exclusives, profiles, and complex scientific stories.
  • Milestone calendar: Own the forward-looking global catalyst and announcement calendar, sequencing news flow in coordination with Investor Relations, Clinical Development, and Regulatory.
  • Measurement: Define KPIs for earned media, share of voice, sentiment, and message pull-through by region; report insights and recommendations to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

Serve as Strategic Counsel to Executives and Spokespeople

  • Executive counsel: Act as trusted advisor to the CEO, CFO, CSO, and other senior leaders on media engagement opportunities, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Spokesperson readiness: Experience with end-to-end broadcast readiness; design and deliver media training; personally prepare executives and scientific subject matter experts for interviews, panels, earnings calls, and high-stakes engagements in U.S. and international settings.
  • Thought leadership: Set the executive visibility strategy across bylined commentary, speaking engagements, podcasts, international conference participation, and owned channels.

Corporate Reputation & International Operations

  • Corporate narrative: Develop and steward the enterprise narrative, uniting our science, clinical progress, business strategy, and culture into a coherent and differentiated story that travels across borders.
  • Issues and crisis: Oversee an international team and network of agencies to anticipate reputational risks and lead issues management and rapid response related to data outcomes, regulatory actions, product safety, patient access, litigation, and organizational change — across all markets in which we operate.
  • Internal alignment: Partner with Human Resources and leadership to ensure employees globally are informed and prepared ahead of major external announcements.
  • Talent Development: Manage and develop the evolving team, set priorities, delegate clearly, give direct feedback, and grow individuals and roles as the company scales.
  • Global agency network: Oversee & direct public relations, digital, and creative agency relationships in the U.S. and internationally, from RFP through engagement lifecycle; own associated budgets and hold partners accountable for quality and ROI.
  • Operating rigor: Establish the processes, review workflows, and approval pathways that let a distributed team move quickly without sacrificing accuracy or compliance.

Where You'll Work

Based in Palo Alto, but a global role. Regular international travel is required for media engagements, scientific congresses, investor conferences, and time with regional teams and agency partners. Flexibility to work across time zones is expected.

Who You Are

Required experience:

  • Experience leading media relations via corporate communications inside & outside the United States, relationships with non-U.S. journalists, and adapted messaging across multiple markets, regulatory regimes, languages, and cultural contexts.
  • Experience managing a communication-related function, with direct ownership of strategy, budget, and staffing, and responsibility for managing or building a team — rather than executing within a function led by someone else.

Additional qualifications:

  • 12+ years of communications experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare — in-house, at a public relations agency, or a combination of both — including significant experience supporting a publicly traded company.
  • Demonstrated track record of building senior relationships with top-tier reporters, U.S. and international, and securing high-impact placements for complex scientific and corporate stories.
  • Direct experience leading communications through material events: FDA & ex-U.S. drug approvals, clinical data readouts, regulatory milestones, earnings announcements, financings, or transactions.
  • Working knowledge of SEC disclosure requirements, Regulation FD, and the regulatory environment governing biopharmaceutical communications in the U.S. and abroad, as well as demonstrated experience navigating the approval process.
  • Fluency with the practical mechanics of multi-market communications: embargoes across time zones, translation and localization workflows, and in-country review requirements.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment, with the ability to set messaging direction, raise the quality of others' writing, and convey complex ideas across formats, channels, and audiences.
  • Proven success as a spokesperson and as a media trainer and counselor to senior executives.
  • A track record of delegating effectively and developing direct reports, while retaining accountability for what the function produces.
  • Cultural fluency and the judgment to know when a message needs to change for a market and when it must not.
  • Sound judgment and composure under pressure, with the discretion required to handle confidential and market-sensitive information.
  • Ability to influence without authority and to lead effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed, highly regulated environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, public relations, life sciences, or a related field.

Preferred Background

International and global experience:

  • Lived or worked outside the United States — based in a non-U.S. market for a meaningful portion of your career or having led a function from the U.S. with genuine day-to-day international accountability.
  • Deep experience with media and media training including being an active spokesperson & executive coach
  • Experience managing communications staff or agencies across multiple regions, including building or restructuring an international agency network.
  • Direct experience with ex-U.S. regulatory and market milestones — EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA, or Asia-Pacific approvals, HTA and reimbursement decisions, or EU and UK disclosure and promotional requirements.
  • Communications leadership at international scientific congresses and experience coordinating with U.S. congress activity.
  • Experience supporting ex-U.S. partnerships, licensing deals, or regional joint ventures, including partner-coordinated announcements.
  • Experience standing up communications in a new geography — market entry, affiliate launch, or first-time international listing or investor base.

Other preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in communications, business, public health, or a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience building or scaling a communications function from an early stage, including first hires, agency transitions, and bringing capabilities in-house.
  • Experience supporting a company's transition from clinical-stage to commercial-stage operations, including product launch communications.
  • Therapeutic area depth relevant to our pipeline, and fluency with the scientific publication landscape.
  • Experience partnering with Investor Relations on capital markets transactions and investor-facing communications.
  • Familiarity with patient advocacy engagement and the communications considerations unique to patient communities across geographies.
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools and modern measurement platforms in a communications workflow.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Applied Research
description:
About Us

Chakra Labs' mission is to encode human taste into intelligence. We build high-fidelity environments, evals, and datasets for frontier AI research, working with several of the top labs.

Our work sits at the frontier of post-training, agent environments, data quality, and research infrastructure. We care about building systems that make models better in ways that are measurable, useful, and hard to fake.

What You’d Work On

  • Post-training loops. You’d help design and run model improvement workflows across supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning approaches like GRPO. The work is not just launching training jobs; it’s figuring out what signal matters, how to collect it, and whether the model actually improved.

  • Environment and task design. We build environments that feel real and scenarios that push agents past static benchmark behavior. You’d design tasks, tools, validators, reward signals, and evaluation harnesses that test meaningful capabilities instead of whatever is easiest to measure.

  • High-fidelity trajectories. You’d create, inspect, and improve the data that teaches models how to behave. That means caring about taste, correctness, edge cases, and whether a trajectory would actually help a frontier model learn.

  • Reward and evaluation systems. You’d work on reward functions, rubrics, validators, and analysis tools that turn messy model behavior into useful training signal. You should be interested in where evals lie, where rewards get hacked, and how to make measurements more robust.

  • Training and research infrastructure. You’d run experiments across distributed GPU clusters, work with PyTorch and FSDP, and build the infrastructure needed to support model training, evaluation, and data generation at scale.

  • Customer research problems. You’d work with frontier AI labs to translate ambiguous research goals into concrete environments, datasets, experiments, and deliverables.

About You

  • Machine learning fundamentals. You have Masters / PhD-level knowledge of machine learning fundamentals. You understand linear algebra, optimization, stochastic gradient descent, and can reason from first principles when a model or training run behaves unexpectedly.

  • Hands-on post-training experience. You have worked with or deeply understand LLM fine-tuning, preference data, reward modeling, or reinforcement learning for language models. You know the difference between reproducing a recipe and understanding why it works.

  • Environment-building instinct. You are excited by agent environments, multi-turn tool use, sandboxed tasks, eval harnesses, and the question of how to test capabilities that do not fit neatly into a benchmark.

  • Python and PyTorch fluency. You are strong in Python and comfortable building with PyTorch, FastAPI, and modern ML infrastructure. You can work at a high level, but you are also comfortable dropping into lower-level primitives when the abstraction leaks.

  • Strong engineering judgment. You can move between research ambiguity and production constraints. You know when to iterate quickly, when to be rigorous, and when a result is too fragile to trust.

  • Experience. No hard rule. Roughly 3-5 years is what we imagine, but more or less experience works if the expectations above resonate with you.

What Makes This Different

  • The work is concrete. You are not just “touching the latest AI stack.” You are building the environments, trajectories, evals, rewards, and training loops that frontier labs use to improve models.

  • It is research-facing, but production-minded. Our customers are AI researchers and labs pushing the edge of what agents can do. The systems you build need to support real experiments, real users, and real deadlines.

  • Ownership, not theater. You own whole problems, not isolated tickets. One week you might be designing a new environment; the next you might be debugging a training run, improving a reward function, or scaling an eval pipeline.

  • Ambiguity is part of the job. There is no fixed playbook for this work. Data, post-training, and agent evaluation are changing quickly. If you need every problem to be fully specified before you begin, this role will be challenging.

  • The team. Our team is ex-Stripe, Snap, AWS, Microsoft, Airtable — you'll work with a small team who has years of shipping high-impact products over the last decade.

title: Hydrologist (Contract)
description:
About Blumen

Blumen is building the regulatory intelligence layer for American infrastructure. Our platform combines regulatory information with more than 2,500 geospatial datasets to help energy companies and environmental consultants understand the permits, constraints, and risks facing a project in hours instead of weeks.
We are a small, fast-moving team tackling a huge market at the moment AI is beginning to reshape professional services. Someone joining now will help define both Blumen and the future of environmental work in infrastructure development.

  • Keep on top of industry best practices and standards that benefit our engineering organization, and hold teams accountable to them.

What you'll bring:

  • Technical depth in production software development and distributed systems, with the judgment to guide architecture and implementation decisions.

  • Experience delivering reliable products with cross-functional partners in a complex or regulated environment.

  • A practical understanding of modern backend and frontend systems, relational databases (SQL), event-driven architectures, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Effectiveness at communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A strong commitment to inclusive leadership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement — including improving team documentation and making meaningful improvements to the codebase.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails, React or React Native, GraphQL, Kafka, Temporal, Kubernetes, AWS, Datadog, or Sentry.

  • Experience with Java, Kotlin, Python, or mobile development.

  • Experience in fintech, banking, brokerage, or other systems that handle sensitive financial data.

What success looks like

In your first six months, you'll have built strong relationships with your team and partners, established clear goals and development plans, understood the health of the team's systems and operations, and helped shape a roadmap that improves reliability, delivery, and the client or operational experience.

Why Wealthsimple?

title: Electrical Assembler
description:

Job Title: Electrical Assembler

Location: Amesbury, MA

Company: Munters

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 6:000 AM-4:30 PM

Salary: $22.06/hr. - $27.90/hr.


About Us:

Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission‑critical processes. We deliver innovative, energy‑efficient, and sustainable solutions to customers across industries where controlling humidity, temperature, and air quality is essential. Sustainability, continuous improvement, and people development are core to our success, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where employees can grow and thrive.


Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Electrical Assembler to join our manufacturing team. The Electrical Assembler will be responsible for assembling, wiring, and testing electrical components and systems according to blueprints, schematics, and engineering instructions. This position requires a high level of attention to detail, manual dexterity, and a solid understanding of electrical systems and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Assemble electrical components, wiring harnesses, control panels, and electrical equipment according to specifications.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, blueprints, and assembly instructions.
  • Install, route, connect, and secure wires, cables, terminals, connectors, switches, and other electrical components.
  • Use hand tools, power tools, crimping tools, soldering equipment, and measuring instruments as required.
  • Perform visual inspections and basic electrical tests to verify proper assembly and functionality.
  • Identify assembly defects, wiring errors, and damaged components, and report issues to the supervisor.
  • Follow standard operating procedures, engineering specifications, and quality control requirements.
  • Maintain accurate assembly records and complete production documentation.
  • Keep the work area clean, organized, and compliant with safety standards.
  • Work with engineering, quality, and production teams to meet daily production targets.
  • Follow all applicable electrical safety procedures and company policies.

Required Qualifications:

  • H.S. diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Skilled and experienced with operating hand, power and pneumatic operated tools common to the trade.
  • Skilled and experienced with reading circuit diagrams and schematics, ladder logic diagrams and layout drawings
  • Skilled and experienced to read and interpret written instructions, bill of materials, production schedules and blueprints
  • Ability to learn how to properly handle overhead cranes and forklift
  • Ability to troubleshoot circuits and devices and recommend changes or improvements
  • Working knowledge of ERP systems
  • 3-5 years related experience
  • Experience or exposure to lean concepts
  • Familiarity with current NEC code requirements and interpretation.
  • Preferred experience with electrical theory and practice as applied to the operation of such components as electric motors, motor starters, contactors, control relays, time delay relays, circuit breakers, fusing, PLC’s, fluid flow and temperature sensors, and other related electrical, pneumatic and mechanical components.

Physical Requirements:


  • Frequently stand, walk, bend, crouch, kneel, climb, maneuver, stoop, squat, grasp, reach and carry, or otherwise move objects exerting up to 75 pounds force
  • Daily walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing for sustained periods of time, walking, pushing, pulling, and lifting.
  • Required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; expansive reading; visual inspection involving small defects, small parts and/or operation of machines; using measurement devices; and/or assembly of fabrication of parts at distances close to the eyes.

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous vacation and paid time off.
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer matching.
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement and conference attendance.
  • Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities.
  • State-of-the-art equipment and tools to support your work.

title: HR Operations & Process Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

Scaling our mission takes more than great people, it takes reliable processes, clear structures, and a People function that keeps everything running smoothly. As our HR Operations & Process Specialist, you’ll play a hands-on role in building and maintaining the foundations that support our team. From employee support and HR administration to payroll coordination and process improvement, you’ll help ensure that our People operations are accurate, efficient, and reliable.

This is a role for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving problems, and wants to make a tangible impact. You’ll work across different areas of HR, help improve how we operate, and grow into broader responsibilities as our company scales.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Employee support & documentation: Be the first point of contact for employee inquiries and provide timely, helpful support throughout the employee lifecycle. Prepare and manage HR-related documentation, including employment contracts, amendments, Arbeitsbescheinigungen, EZB, employment references, and other employee documents, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.

  • Payroll coordination: Support payroll preparation and related processes, ensuring that employee data is accurate, complete, and submitted on time for smooth payroll execution.

  • Employee data & records: Maintain accurate and up-to-date personnel master data and employee documentation, handling sensitive information with the highest levels of precision, confidentiality, and care.

  • HR processes & continuous improvement: Take ownership of operational topics, identify opportunities to improve existing processes, and help make our HR operations more efficient as we scale. You enjoy figuring things out, tackling new challenges, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across the company to coordinate HR-related topics, resolve questions, and ensure that processes run smoothly from start to finish.

  • Learn & grow: Build experience across HR Operations and the employee lifecycle, expand your skill set, and take on increasing responsibility as our People function evolves.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years in HR operations, personnel administration or a similar role.

  • Ownership & initiative: You take responsibility, follow things through and solve problems proactively rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Fast learner & hands-on mindset: You pick up new topics quickly, enjoy figuring things out and are happy to jump into different areas.

  • Reliable & detail-oriented: You’re highly organised and precise, especially when handling employee data, contracts, payroll and other sensitive information.

  • Strong communication skills: You’re approachable, responsive and comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment.

  • Languages: Fluent German and strong English, written and spoken.

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Sr. Scientist, Mass Spectrometry & Biologics Characterization
description:
Who We Are:

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)



About the Role:

Our dynamic team is seeking a motivated, collaborative, and experienced Senior Scientist to support biologics characterization for analytical development team. The qualified individual will work closely with team members to design, develop, and execute assays to deliver robust and high-quality data to drive decision-making. The position requires a dedicated mass spectrometry expertise supporting modality-agnostic characterization, developability assessment, and advanced method development from preclinical research through early development. Along with that, the position requires excellent scientific, technical and laboratory skills, strong organizational and communications skills, and enthusiasm for contributing to a fast-paced organization focused on discoveries of novel and differentiated therapeutic candidates.

_

Your Contributions (include, but are not limited to):

  • Develop and implement advanced mass spectrometry methods applicable across modalities and development stages, with particular emphasis on native MS, top-down MS, and advanced structural characterization
  • Lead, develop, and perform large molecule analytical and characterization assays, including identity testing by intact mass and/or subunit analysis, glycan profiling, primary structure and PTM analysis by peptide mapping, and other mass spectrometric techniques necessary to provide critical data for decision-making processes
  • Provide fit-for-purpose characterizations for various discovery-stage programs such as pre-engineering and active engineering efforts
  • Support Lead Optimization production activities through high-throughput intact mass analysis of stable pools and clones, providing molecular identity and early semi-quantitative N-glycan profiling as additional data for cell-line selection.
  • Perform manual and automated sample injections acquire LC-MS data, analyze data, draft report and document experiment in ELN, support stakeholders including discovery biology, protein engineering and lead optimization
  • Perform routine maintenance of HPLC and MS systems, prepare mobile phases, execute calibration and cleaning procedures, coordinate regular preventative maintenance troubleshooting under the supervision of team leaders
  • Execute sample preparation workflows, such as buffer exchange, immunoprecipitation, reduction and alkylation, enzymatic digestion
  • Manage sample receiving, testing and storage, maintain and track consumables including columns, buffer solutions, enzymes and chemicals
  • Track and document assay performance
  • Provides recommendations to improve process efficiency and research quality
  • Present key research findings to cross-functional team members to guide project strategy
  • Leverage literature, ICH/Regulatory guidance, and practical experience to perform this work and collaborate on CMC analytical development strategies
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • BS/BA degree in chemistry or closely related field and 12+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience, focusing on separation method development OR
  • MS/MA degree in chemistry or closely related field preferred and 10+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience noted above OR
  • PhD in chemistry or closely related field and 4+ years of applicable experience
  • Expert knowledge and understanding in protein analytical method development for identification and quantitation, including physicochemical and MS-based methods
  • Expert knowledge and understanding in native MS, top-down MS, and other MS-based methods including but not limited to intact and subunit MS, glycan profiling, and bottom-up MS
  • Good knowledge and demonstrated ability working with large molecule separation methods including reversed-phased HPLC, analytical SEC, and CE-SDS
  • Solid understanding of mass spectrometry operating principles, including ionization, ion transfer, gas-phase fragmentation, and mass analyzers
  • Hands-on experience on high-resolution TOF and/or orbitrap mass analyzers, including routine maintenance and troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of protein chemistry, amino acid composition, primary structure, post-translational modifications, higher-order structure and protein-protein interactions
  • Knowledge of cross-functional understanding related to drug development
  • Excellent laboratory and productivity skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with strong oral and written communication abilities
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills
  • Collaborative and highly motivated
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Good project management skills

description:

You will focus on automation, reliability, scalability, and operability — ensuring our multi-tenant cloud platform consistently meets both functional and non-functional requirements. You will work closely with product development teams to influence system design, improve resilience, and ensure production readiness, while building the tools and frameworks that enable efficient, global, follow-the-sun operations.

Drive Reliability, Automation & Scale:

  • Design, build, and operate highly reliable, scalable infrastructure for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.

  • Automate deployment, provisioning, and operational workflows across cloud infrastructure and applications.

  • Develop internal tools, services, and frameworks to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Improve Platform & Infrastructure:

  • Partner with development teams to ensure systems meet availability, performance, and scalability requirements.

  • Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and failure modes, and implement solutions before they impact customers.

Security & Identity:

  • Ensure platform services meet security and compliance standards.

Enablement & Collaboration:

  • Mentor engineers and promote best practices in reliability engineering and automation.

  • Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Helm, CNI, and Ingress networking.

DevOps & Delivery:

Mindset & Collaboration:

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a proactive, systems-thinking mindset.

  • A collaborative team player who can influence, mentor, and lead through technical expertise.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and data-driven insights to improve productivity and outcomes.

  • AWS or Kubernetes certifications

Why Guidewire?

title: Pharmacy Intern Grad
description:
Job Objectives

Provides pharmacy consulting services to customers regarding the effective usage of medications, awareness with drug interactions and offering preventive healthcare services such as immunizations. Responsible for ensuring the proper compounding, dispensation, review and verification of prescribed medications within regulatory guidelines, company policies and procedures.

Supports the efficient workflow of the pharmacy and assists the pharmacy manager in identifying ways to optimize pharmacy financials, inventory management and enhance customer experience

Job Responsibilities/Tasks
Customer Experience
  • Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues in a timely manner and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
  • Develops strong relationships with most valuable customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services. Supports efforts on enhancing customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services (e.g. patient consultation, medication management, drug therapy reviews, and perform retail, clinical, or wellness services such as immunizations, flu shots, and diabetes awareness) thereby promoting the shift of the pharmacy role from transactional to interpersonal.
Operations
  • Counsels patients and answers their questions regarding usage of medicine, side effects, interactions, contraindications, patient information privacy, generics, less expensive medicines, over-the-counter products, and refers to medical provider as needed to ensure medication is taken correctly, health needs addressed, and satisfaction with service.

  • Ensures the pharmacy operates in accordance to regulations, company policies and standards. Assists pharmacy manager with establishing procedures that promotes the efficient workflow of the pharmacy including assigning roles, coordinating activities and soliciting employee suggestions. Responsible for the opening and closing of the pharmacy and shift change duties.
  • Ensures the use of all elements of the Good Faith Dispensing policy in conjunction with state and federal controlled substance laws when filling prescriptions. The Product Review/Retail Fill Process Pharmacist has the ultimate responsibility for ensuring that the elements of Good Faith are present.
  • Maintains current knowledge of information technology associated with pharmacy systems such as Intercom Plus, registers, automation, StoreNET to provide support to customers as well as pharmacy staff. Proposes and implements enhancements to pharmacy systems to further promote productivity.
  • Ensures the accurate processing of insurance claims to resolve customer issues and prevent payment rejections. Follows-up with insurance companies as well as medical providers and participates in 3rd party audit.
  • Follows-up with medical providers’ offices to clarify prescribed medications, dosages, refills, interactions and allergies to suggest alternative medications, and answer medical provider questions
  • Performs retail, clinical, and wellness services such as immunizations, flu shots, diabetes awareness and other preventive healthcare services.
  • Assists and supports the pharmacy manager in analyzing performance data including pharmacy financial, customer service, and implementation of procedures for pharmacy asset protection and inventory management. Reviews KPI’s with Pharmacy Manager, Store Manager, and Healthcare Supervisor.
  • Develops and maintains good relationships with local medical community including physicians, nurses, and other health care providers. Participates in community outreach activities to promote the pharmacy business and further enhance growth opportunities.
  • Partners with Central Pharmacy Operations for customer registration, 3rd party reviews, and assists with resolving customer issues to support the Well Experience locations. In virtual environments, conducts virtual product review by following specific company procedures and guidelines (e.g. using specific photographs taken by the technicians sent electronically during the F4 process and reduce transactional tasks).
People & Performance Management
  • Assists the Pharmacy Manager with staff hiring and training. Reinforces the direction of Pharmacy Manager in staff performance by coaching, and providing constructive feedback, monitoring customer service, and fostering employee development.

Training & Personal Development
  • Maintains current knowledge and skills related to pharmacy and healthcare by reading pharmacy related journals, company publications, and communications. Maintains awareness of developments in retail and management and pursues best practices that would enhance performance
  • Obtains necessary certifications, education credits and training such as People Plus Learning modules as required by the Company
  • Seeks professional development by monitoring one’s performance, solicits for constructive feedback, and leverages pharmacy manager and store manager as mentor and coach

Communications
  • Supports the Pharmacy Manager and Store Manager by communicating relevant corporate health and wellness services or strategy information to pharmacy staff.

  • Willingness to obtain a Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm D) degree from an accredited educational institution prior to the start date in position.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About On Me

Humans have given each other gifts since the dawn of time. For gratitude, for friendship, and for love. In today’s society, gifting has become harder and much more wasteful, as it’s become nearly impossible to know exactly what someone wants, when you just want to show that you care.

On Me is revolutionizing gifting by rebuilding it for the mobile and Instagram era. Traditional gift cards are impersonal and rigid, usually sold by an old and wealthy megacorp. We make it easy to send a personalized, media-rich gift that’s spendable across brands, fits someone’s hobbies, and drops straight into their mobile wallet for tap‑to‑pay. Check out our live experience at .

We’re a small startup from Google and Apple moving fast on a massive category and have raised $8M from top‑tier investors like NFX, Lerer Hippeau, Focal VC, and Mastercard. Since launching in November 2024, On Me has been featured in Tech Crunch, Fortune, and The Wall Street Journal. In 2025, we sustained over 40% growth month over month throughout the year, and the trend shows no sign of stopping.

In 2026, we’re doubling down on making every gift feel magical end‑to‑end and building an amazing consumer product. You’ll help us build a world-class web platform and mobile apps that people love. If you want meaningful ownership, clear consumer product impact, and the chance to set engineering standards early, this is it.

Who you are

You’re perfect for this role if you want to own your work end to end and make company-wide decisions across product, frontend, and backend. You love working on features that touch real users, from the pixels and flows they see to the systems and data powering everything underneath. You care about the quality and craft of what you do, and why you do it.

What you’ll do

As a full stack software engineer, you’ll be the fourth engineer at a tiny startup, working closely with the whole team to design and build the end‑to‑end product experiences that power our gifting platform. You’ll own projects that span our web app, iOS and Android Apps, and the backend services behind them. You’ll be responsible for building polished, performant UIs; designing clean APIs; and wiring everything up to resilient systems that can safely handle millions of dollars in transactions. Your work will include thinking through user journeys, edge cases, loading and error states, while also architecting systems for availability, performance, and security. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of critical product surfaces, driving both product and engineering decisions that shape the future of digital gifting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and ship full stack product features on web, iOS, and Android

  • Build high-quality, interactive UIs with attention to polish, responsiveness, loading, and error states.

  • Design and maintain clean, pragmatic APIs that connect our frontend experiences to backend systems.

  • Collaborate with product, design, and the rest of the team to translate fuzzy goals into concrete flows and shipped features.

  • Drive architectural and product decisions to support scaling to hundreds of thousands of users and transactions.

  • Set up and evolve monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain system health and performance.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack engineer building user-facing products.

  • Strong product and UX mindset: you think from the user’s point of view and care about end‑to‑end flows, not just endpoints.

  • Strong foundations in modern web stacks (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js / Express).

  • Experience with native iOS development in Swift or native Android development in Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping high-quality, interactive web UIs to production.

  • Solid understanding of API design, data modeling, and how systems fail in practice.

  • Experience designing and building APIs.

  • Knowledge of scalability, caching, and fault-tolerance patterns.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability tools.

  • Ability to take ownership of projects from vague problem → design → implementation → launch and iteration.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a fast-paced startup environment

Bonus points

  • Experience with frontend development for consumer products.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery).

  • Experience working with payments, financial transactions, or other high‑value data systems.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary and meaningful early employee equity.

  • A dynamic, collaborative, balanced, and inclusive work culture.

  • The opportunity to deeply shape the company’s tech stack and engineering culture.

  • Hybrid office in SF with a fully stocked gym, or hybrid office in NYC.

  • Unlimited paid time off.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • 401k

Who You’ll Work With

At On Me, you’ll join a small, elite team of builders from Google and Apple who move fast and care deeply about product quality. You’ll collaborate daily with:

  • Darragh Meaney, CEO — Formerly at Google Ads and YouTube

  • Sitar Harel, CTO — Formerly at Google Maps and Google Photos

  • Daniel Li, Founding Engineer — ex-Apple, WWDC session speaker and Cornell AppDev alum

  • Neil Shankar, Founding Designer — previously Senior Designer at Google and Block (formerly Square)

We combine big-tech craft with startup speed—and we’re just getting started.

Join Us

Become a part of On Me’s story, and play an integral role in our journey to strengthen relationships through magical gifting experiences. If you're ready to contribute to a team that values ambition, collaboration, and the joy of tackling exciting challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Product Manager, Venmo Credit Card and Lending
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

Venmo is looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the Venmo Credit Card and lead the development of our first lending offerings. This role combines ownership of a scaled consumer credit product with 0-to-1 product development, identifying and validating new ways Venmo can help customers access and manage credit. You will partner across Engineering, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Growth, Marketing, and external bank and lending partners to deliver customer-centered products that achieve business objectives while operating within regulatory and risk requirements.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
  • Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
  • Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
  • Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
  • Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
  • Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
  • Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Additional Responsibilities

  • Own the Venmo Credit Card roadmap across acquisition, activation, engagement, rewards, servicing, and account management.
  • Establish business goals with Finance across new accounts, spend, balances, revenue, credit performance, and unit economics, and connect roadmap priorities to those outcomes.
  • Lead 0-to-1 lending initiatives, developing and testing product hypotheses based on customer needs, market opportunities, and Venmo's ecosystem.
  • Define MVPs, success metrics, experiments, and phased launch plans to validate customer demand and economics before scaling.

  • Partner with Growth and Marketing on go-to-market strategy and with Customer Support and Operations on scalable servicing experiences.
  • Contribute to the broader Venmo Cards strategy in partnership with Debit Card and other product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Product management experience in fintech, payments, consumer financial services, or another regulated consumer product.
  • Direct experience with credit cards, consumer lending, installment lending, or buy-now-pay-later products.
  • Experience taking a new product or business line from concept through launch.
  • Understanding of consumer credit economics, including interchange, interest income, credit losses, customer acquisition cost, and lifetime value.

  • Experience partnering with a bank, issuer, lender, or other regulated third party.

title: Senior Critical Operations Technician (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Critical Operations Technician is the senior on-shift technical role responsible for ensuring safe, stable and consistent operation of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems. The role provides elevated technical capability, supports first-response incident actions, verifies plant condition after maintenance or resets and guides technicians in executing operational tasks with accuracy and discipline.

The role applies strong operational judgement, trend awareness and structured troubleshooting to stabilise plant conditions within authorised boundaries. The Senior Critical Operations Technician also enhances shift performance by coaching team members and refining documentation quality.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

• Support STACK’s 100% uptime objective through disciplined operational control, proactive monitoring and accurate technical response.

• Maintain real-time awareness of plant condition through BMS/EPMS, alarms and inspections, taking timely actions within authorised limits.

• Provide senior technical support to shift technicians, assisting with prioritisation, procedural clarity and execution quality.

• Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems, including UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CRAC/CRAH, CDU/FWU, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant, strictly within approved procedures and authorisations.

• Perform structured diagnostics on abnormal conditions, apply permitted stabilisation actions and escalate with clear technical detail and recommended next steps.

• Support operational event response, including immediate containment actions, technical communication and accurate event documentation.

• Conduct enhanced rounds, including thermal, capacity, vibration/noise, leak-detection and set-point verification, ensuring findings are recorded and actioned.

• Identify trends, weak signals and reliability concerns using BMS/EPMS data and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.

• Manage on-shift work execution with strict adherence to permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO, vendor access and operational handbacks.

• Coordinate vendor activities during shift, ensuring safe execution, clear understanding of plant impacts and thorough return-to-service verification.

• Validate operational readiness following maintenance, resets or configuration changes, confirming alarms, redundancy, load paths and expected operating conditions.

• Review and improve the quality of shift logs, event notes, CMMS entries and handovers to ensure accuracy, clarity and traceability.

• Raise and escalate recurring defects, reliability risks and improvement opportunities through appropriate channels.

• Contribute to procedure reviews, readiness activities, drills and documentation improvements with practical, shift-based insights.

• This role does not perform licensed electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted activities are completed by appropriately qualified and licensed personnel. The Senior Critical Operations Technician focuses on operational system management, first-response stabilisation, verification and coordination.

People

• Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.

• Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.

• Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.

• Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.

• Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.

• Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and vendor personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.

• Demonstrate a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

• Strong operational discipline and sound judgement in a critical facility environment.

• High technical capability in electrical and/or mechanical systems within authorised boundaries.

• Effective structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.

• Ability to interpret alarms, telemetry, trends and technical documentation.

• Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational workflow tools.

• Strong written and verbal communication for shift documentation, incidents and customer updates.

• Contractor coordination skills with strong permit-to-work and LOTO awareness.

• Ability to coach others and improve team execution quality.

• Calm, methodical approach during alarms and operational events.

• Continuous improvement mindset focused on reliability and operational quality.

Work Environment / Conditions

• The role operates on a 24/7 rotating shift roster, including nights, weekends and public holidays.

• Work occurs in data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required under site policy.

• Participation in emergency response activities and incident exercises is required.

Travel Required

• Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

• Experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, Defence or industrial facilities.

• Demonstrated capability operating and monitoring critical power and cooling systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, controls and fire systems.

• Hands-on experience conducting operational inspections and first-response stabilisation actions.

• Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools for monitoring, work management and operational documentation.

• Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, technical drawings and OEM documentation.

• Familiarity with permit-to-work, isolations/LOTO and basic operational risk assessment.

• Strong written and verbal communication suitable for logs, handovers and customer-facing updates.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

• Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.

• Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.

• Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.

• Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

• Legal entitlement to work in Australia.

• Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.

• Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.

• Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Short-Term Paid Research Study for Hebrew-Speaking Students - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Hebrew speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Hebrew actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Hebrew speaker who grew up in Israel.
  • You use Hebrew in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

HR Coordination & Employee Support

Essential Experience

  • Experience with Workday, Dayforce, or other HR systems.
