  • Capture and organize customer feedback, routing it to the appropriate TAM or product team member.

About You

  • 2-3 years of experience in account management, customer success, operations, or a related analytical role (logistics industry exposure a plus, but not required).

  • You're a strong communicator who can synthesize data into clear, digestible takeaways for both TAMs and customers.
  • You're eager to learn the fundamentals of data fusion and machine learning, and can grow into communicating product value to technical and commercial audiences.

title: Account Representative, Small and Medium Business
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

title: Senior Project Manager – HV Infrastructure (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Project Manager – HV Infrastructure is a key role within STACK’s Power & Energy function, responsible for the successful delivery of major high-voltage infrastructure supporting STACK’s data centre developments across Australia.


The role provides end-to-end project leadership for HV infrastructure from early design and procurement through construction, testing, commissioning and energisation. This may include transmission and distribution connections, HV substations, transformers, switchgear, transmission lines/cables, contestable works, BESS and associated electrical infrastructure.

The Senior Project Manager will act as STACK’s primary delivery interface with HV EPC contractors and work closely with the Principal Engineer – HV Infrastructure, Grid Connection Manager, Engineering, Delivery, network service providers and other project stakeholders.

The role is accountable for ensuring HV infrastructure is delivered safely, to programme, within approved budget and in accordance with STACK’s technical and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

HV Infrastructure Project Delivery

  • Lead delivery of major HV infrastructure projects from early development and ECI through EPC execution, commissioning and energisation.

  • Develop and maintain integrated project programmes covering engineering, procurement, long-lead equipment, construction, testing, network interfaces and energisation.

  • Manage project scope, programme, cost, risk, quality and change control.

  • Coordinate delivery of substations, contestable works, HV cables/lines, transformers, switchgear, BESS and associated infrastructure as applicable.

  • Ensure HV delivery milestones remain aligned with the overall data centre development programme.

EPC & Contractor Management

  • Lead procurement, engagement and management of HV EPC contractors and specialist delivery partners.

  • Support development of ECI/EPC scopes, tender documentation, commercial evaluations and contract award recommendations.

  • Establish clear contractor deliverables, interfaces, programme requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Monitor EPC performance against programme, cost, quality and contractual obligations.

  • Manage contractor reporting, variations, claims, risks and corrective actions in conjunction with Commercial and Legal teams.

  • Maintain clear single-point accountability for delivery of the upstream HV package.

Engineering & Project Interfaces

  • Work closely with the Principal Engineer – HV Infrastructure to ensure technical requirements are incorporated into EPC design and delivery.

  • Coordinate with the Grid Connection Manager to ensure connection requirements, CPS, GPS, NSP requirements and grid studies are reflected in project execution.

  • Manage interfaces with Engineering and Delivery at the agreed campus electrical interface.

  • Coordinate project dependencies with NSPs, contestable works providers, OEMs and other external stakeholders.

  • Ensure design changes, construction issues and programme decisions are communicated and resolved across relevant teams.

Commissioning & Energisation

  • Own the integrated delivery programme for testing, commissioning and energisation of HV infrastructure.

  • Coordinate EPC contractors, NSPs, OEMs, Grid Connection Manager, engineering teams and Delivery through energisation readiness.

  • Establish commissioning milestones, hold points, prerequisites and completion requirements.

  • Ensure required documentation, test records, defects and technical approvals are completed prior to handover.

  • Manage transition of completed HV assets into Operations, including documentation, training, spares and operational readiness.

Governance, Safety & Risk

  • Promote a strong safety culture across all HV project activities.

  • Ensure contractors comply with STACK standards, applicable legislation, network requirements and project safety systems.

  • Maintain project risk, issue, change and decision registers.

  • Provide clear reporting on programme, cost, risk and delivery status to senior leadership.

  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to standardisation of future STACK HV infrastructure projects.

Competencies

  • Strong project leadership and major infrastructure delivery capability.

  • Strong knowledge of HV electrical infrastructure and substation delivery.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage major EPC contracts and contractors.

  • Strong programme, commercial, risk and change-management capability.

  • Ability to manage complex interfaces between engineering, construction, utilities and data centre delivery.

  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and communication skills.

  • Strong understanding of testing, commissioning and energisation of HV infrastructure.

  • Ability to communicate complex delivery issues clearly to senior leadership.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 10+ years’ experience delivering major electrical, transmission, renewable-energy, utility or infrastructure projects.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering HV substations and associated electrical infrastructure.

  • Experience managing EPC contractors and major construction packages.

  • Experience managing projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and energisation.

  • Strong understanding of project controls, programme, cost, risk and contract management.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience delivering 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage infrastructure.

  • Experience with Australian TNSPs/DNSPs and contestable HV infrastructure.

  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or other large industrial loads.

  • Experience with BESS and renewable-energy infrastructure.

  • Experience with ECI-to-EPC delivery models.

  • PMP, AIPM or equivalent project-management accreditation.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Ability to work flexibly around major construction, testing and energisation activities.

  • Comfortable operating in complex, high-pressure project environments with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Principal, Product Manager
description:
Job Description:

The Role

Are you looking to join a highly collaborative, fast‑paced organization where you can help shape the future of portfolio management technology and drive transformative business solutions? Equity remains one of the most critical and innovative segments of global financial markets, and our Portfolio Management & Research Technology team is building the next generation of portfolio management capabilities that support multiple teams across the Equity business. We are seeking a Principal, Product Manager who is energized by the complexities of portfolio management technology, and motivated by the opportunity to influence a platform used by portfolio managers, analysts, and traders.

As Principal, Product Manager, you will blend your passion for product leadership to deliver meaningful value for our stakeholders and cross‑company partners. In this role, you serve as the end‑to‑end owner of your delivery teams’ culture and execution. Operating within an agile structure, you will collaborate with other teams in your product area and across the domain, partner with business stakeholders to shape the product roadmap, and align resources to the highest‑value opportunities. You will define and refine quarterly goals, and lead a focused, empowered team to deliver capabilities that help our users with their investment decision making. Through continuous planning, prioritization, and stewardship of the product backlog, you will ensure shared clarity on the why and the what that shape when work is executed. You will enable your delivery teams to work iteratively, innovate through testing and experimentation, and learn quickly from feedback loops — all while maintaining a disciplined approach to quality, stability, and performance.

The Value You Deliver

  • Project Vision: Define the project’s objectives and capabilities to advance the Portfolio Management product vision while effectively addressing the needs of business partners.
  • Requirements Gathering: Partner with stakeholders to elicit, analyze, prioritize, and document business, functional, and system requirements.
  • Technical Translation: Transform business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable successful delivery by development teams.
  • Process Analysis: Analyze current-state workflows, identify inefficiencies, and recommend opportunities for process optimization and automation.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Facilitate meetings, workshops, demonstrations, and ongoing collaboration to ensure alignment between business and technology teams. Develop a deep understanding of partner needs, proactively anticipate challenges, and serve as the voice of the customer throughout execution.
  • Solution Validation: Support testing, quality assurance, and user acceptance activities to ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements and expected outcomes.
  • Data Analysis: Leverage data and insights to support decision-making, validate assumptions, measure outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain comprehensive documentation, standards, and artifacts related to requirements, business processes, system changes, and operating procedures.
  • Continuous Improvement: Drive enhancements to existing systems and processes by incorporating performance metrics, user feedback, and evolving business needs.
  • Prioritization & Trade-Off Management: Make informed prioritization and trade-off decisions that balance strategic objectives, tactical needs, resource constraints, and business value.
  • Team Development & Delivery Excellence: Foster a high-performing, empowered team that leverages proven frameworks, best practices, and standard processes while maintaining a focus on quality and delivery excellence.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Provide candid feedback and employ a solutions-oriented mindset to proactively identify, assess, and address organizational, product, and delivery risks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering leaders, program and project managers, and delivery teams to build organizational capabilities, enhance capacity, and support continuous learning and professional development.

The Skills and Expertise You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree (or above) in technology related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in business/systems analysis, product owner, and/or product management.
  • Committed to developing a balance of business domain knowledge and technology skills to fully appreciate the broad needs of our customers and products.
  • Take a data-focused approach and regularly seek out the expertise of colleagues to understand customer requirements, propose solutions, and measure results.
  • Experience in writing user/system stories and maintaining accurate technical documentation.
  • Derive epics and end-to-end workflows that can be broken down into stories with well-defined business value and acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with all levels of an organization.
  • Effective problem solver with proven ability to address root causes to high-impact problems.
  • Established proficiency in conveying ideas and recommendations to impact a wide range of team members.
  • Excellent presentation and facilitation skills.
  • Capable of leading, influencing, and motivating colleagues on solutions, best practices, and tools without formal authority, and being a day-to-day mentor/coach for the analyst team members.
  • Innovative, intellectually curious, and a team player who can continuously improve our culture, process, and tools, and encourage an agile way of working.
  • Thorough knowledge of software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience in systems integration and testing to ensure requirements have been fulfilled.
  • Prior experience in the financial services industry preferred; exposure to investment management and/or wealth management is a plus.
  • Preferred Technical skills with: AWS and cloud-based solutions, APIs & Web Services, SQL and relational databases (e.g. Oracle).

The Team

Asset Management Technology (AM Tech) is the organization responsible for delivering innovative, scalable, and industry leading investment technology that enables Fidelity’s Investment and Asset Management business to achieve a global competitive advantage. AM Tech plays a critical role in shaping Asset Management’s technology direction and shares accountability for the achievement of business goals.

AM Tech is a global organization, with technologists located across the United States, London, India, and Ireland. The team supports a broad range of functions within the Investment Management and Advisory domain, including Portfolio Management, Research, and Trading, by providing reliable, high impact technology solutions.

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description:

Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.

As a company, we’re passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. Why you will love this opportunity as Senior PMO analyst at Civica

If you’re looking for a role where your PMO expertise will be valued, your ideas welcomed, and your impact clearly seen—Civica is the place for you.

Benefits

Why you'll love working with us

We know that when our people are happy, they will work better and have greater work satisfaction. Here's what you can expect:

We're all different - and we love this about us.

Apply for this job - Become part of something special Do you see yourself in this role? If so, then we would love to hear from you.

title: Vice President, People
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The Role

Location: London or Geneva. In-office, with flexibility for 1–2 days per week from home.

Reporting to the CEO and managing a team of 3 in People, you'll be Sparta's most senior People leader. Working directly with the CEO and leadership team, you'll define and execute the people strategy required to scale the organisation, ensuring we have the leadership, capability, culture and organisational structure necessary to achieve our long-term growth ambitions.

We're looking for someone with the strategic ability to grow into a CPO role as Sparta scales.

You'll be shaping and scaling the People organisation, building the structure, capability and leadership needed to support Sparta's next phase of growth: compensation and levelling, performance, leadership development, hiring and organisation design, while ensuring the overall People strategy remains aligned to business objectives. Much of what this role owns needs to be improved, perfected or redesigned, so you'll be hands-on from day one, building frameworks and running processes personally before you're managing others through them. You'll be central to building a consistent, high-performance culture across our distributed teams globally.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Develop and execute Sparta's global people strategy, ensuring organisational structure, capability, culture and talent are aligned to support the company's growth from Series B through its next stage of scale, whilst balancing local employment, cultural and regulatory considerations

  • Act as a strategic advisor to the CEO, Executive Team and Board on organisational design, leadership capability, succession planning, workforce risks and culture

  • Build our compensation architecture: salary bands, a levelling framework, and a consistent, transparent approach to pay across geographies.

  • Introduce a structured performance process and individual scorecards, so everyone knows what success looks like for them.

  • Build our leadership pipeline through talent reviews, succession planning and management development. Give managers the confidence and authority to make more decisions themselves and address people problems early.

  • Lead organisation design, ensuring Sparta's operating model, spans and layers, leadership structure and workforce planning evolve appropriately as the business scales internationally. Partner with Finance and functional leaders to develop workforce planning and capability strategies that support Sparta's growth objectives

  • Own talent acquisition strategy and delivery. Work with Marketing and the TA team to grow our employer brand so more great people come to us.

  • Own Learning & Development: coaching, training, and levelling up managers and individual contributors

  • Provide executive oversight of workplace and employee experience across all locations. Partner closely with the Executive Team and other leaders to align hiring philosophy, location strategy, and expectations across Sparta's distributed teams

  • Represent People at the leadership table. Raise risks early and make sure stakeholders always know where things stand

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

  • Executive Team aligned around a clear people strategy

  • Leadership effectiveness and manager capability measurably improved

  • Workforce plan linked to business objectives

  • Salary bands and a levelling framework live

  • Individual scorecards in place, so everyone knows what success looks like for them

  • A structured performance review running company-wide, with buy-in from key stakeholders

  • A middle-management empowerment programme in place, with managers visibly making more decisions without escalating to the exec team

  • Succession plans in place for key roles

  • Hiring on track against plan, with quality and retention holding up

About You

  • You've been the most senior People leader in a scaling organisation, or held a Director or VP People role with significant strategic accountability

  • You've worked in a Series B–D SaaS or tech scaleup and know the people challenges of that stage first-hand

  • You've personally built compensation, levelling and performance frameworks, and you can point to what you built and the impact it had

  • You can influence founders, boards and senior executives, and challenge constructively when it's needed

  • You're commercially minded. You find workable compromises and build frameworks that fix problems for good

  • You've led organisational change across distributed, multi-country teams, not just rolled out HR programmes. Sparta has people across London, Geneva, Spain, Singapore, Houston, and Dubai - familiarity with local laws, regulations and cultures in these locations is a distinct advantage

  • You take ownership, move with urgency and are comfortable being hands-on

  • You communicate clearly and proactively

  • You want to grow this role into a CPO seat

  • Experience scaling a tech business from around 100 to 300+ people is a big plus

We care more about what you've achieved, and how relevant it is to our stage, than about a specific number of years' experience.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Lead QA Engineer
company: QLYS_IN Qualys Security TechServices Private Ltd.
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Qualys is looking for a Lead QA Engineer to own quality for products in the Cybersecurity and Compliance domain used by thousands of enterprise customers.

You will act as a senior individual contributor and technical mentor for QA and automation engineers. You will define the test strategy across UI, backend, and data pipelines, and drive the move toward AI-assisted, self-healing automation. This is a hands-on technical role: you set quality direction, influence release decisions, and actively write and review framework code. Candidates who have built or meaningfully enhanced AI-based self-healing automation tools will stand out.

Responsibilities

QA Mentorship & Strategy

  • Mentor and guide QA and automation engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for legacy components by improving automation coverage, while ensuring all new components are fully automated from the start.
  • Act as the quality voice in sprint planning, design reviews, and release readiness; make data-backed go/no-go recommendations.
  • Establish scalable QA processes: defect triage, severity/priority standards, regression tiers, test case management, and root-cause analysis for escaped defects.
  • Track and report quality metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky-test rate, mean time to detect, release cycle time) to engineering and product leadership.
  • Partner closely with Development, Product, Support, and Sustenance teams to shift quality left and reduce customer-reported issues.

Test Automation (Hands-On)

- Architect and evolve automation frameworks across React/TypeScript front ends, Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, and Kafka-based pipelines.

- Own API and contract testing (REST Assured, Pact, Postman/Newman) covering OAuth2, JWT, token, and Basic auth flows, pagination, throttling, and vendor error handling.

- Own CI/CD quality gates in Jenkins or GitHub Actions with fast PR-level feedback and tiered regression runs.

AI-Driven & Self-Healing Automation

- Lead the design and rollout of self-healing automation: automatic locator recovery, DOM-similarity scoring, element fingerprinting, and confidence-based fallback that keeps suites green through UI changes.

- Apply LLMs across the QA lifecycle — generating test cases from requirements and API specs, converting manual tests to automated scripts, summarizing failures, and suggesting root causes from logs.

- Build intelligent flaky-test detection, failure classification, and auto-quarantine to separate real regressions from environmental noise.

- Set guardrails for AI use in QA — validating AI-generated tests, measuring healing accuracy, and preventing false passes.

Qualifications

Experience

- 8-10+ years in QA / test engineering, with at least 2 years leading or mentoring a QA team.

- Proven track record of building automation frameworks from scratch and owning release quality for a SaaS product.

- Hands-on experience building, extending, or productionizing an AI-based or self-healing automation solution, with the ability to explain how you measured its impact.

Skills

Automation & Testing

- Robot, Playwright and/or Selenium 4; TestNG or JUnit 5; Cypress, Jest, or Vitest

- API automation: REST Assured, Postman/Newman, schema validation

- Contract testing (Pact), service virtualization, and mocking (WireMock or similar)

- Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or Gatling

- Visual regression and accessibility testing

Programming & Backend

- Python, Java(17+) and JavaScript/TypeScript

- SQL and data validation on Oracle or similar

- Familiarity with microservices, Spring Boot, and Kafka (or other event streaming systems)

AI in QA

- Self-healing locator strategies and intelligent element matching

- LLM integration: prompt design, structured outputs, and embedding model calls into test tooling

- AI-assisted test generation, failure clustering, and log/trace summarization

- Familiarity with RAG or vector search over test artifacts is a plus

- Working knowledge of AI testing platforms (Healenium, Applitools, mabl, Testim)

DevOps & Tooling

- CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions

- Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals

- Test management (Jira/Xray, TestRail, or Zephyr)

- Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) for test and pipeline diagnostics

Technical Mentorship

  • Strong ability to mentor engineers through technical guidance and code reviews
  • Clear communication with engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
  • Data-driven decision-making on quality and release readiness

Preferred

- Background in cybersecurity — vulnerability management, Policy Compliance

- Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS at large data volumes.

- Open-source contributions to testing or automation projects.

title: Austrian German Speaker - 3-Day Paid User Research Study, $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native German speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in German actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.

Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native German speaker who grew up in Austria.
  • You use German in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Program Manager, CM Manufacturing Launch

Required

Preferred

  • Experience with manufacturing processes related to chip-on-carrier assembly, including assembly, bonding, inspection, or test processes.
  • Experience with manufacturing equipment installation, process qualification, and production ramp.
  • Experience working with Contract Manufacturers.
  • Familiarity with structured NPI / product development gate processes.
  • Experience with Microsoft Project or similar project management tools.

Key Success Factors

The successful candidate will:

  • Identify schedule and readiness gaps before they impact production.

title: Intermediate Full-Stack Developer
description:
Opportunity

Our Development team is growing, and we're looking for a .NET Full-Stack Developer who's excited to build high-quality, customer-facing features and solve real business problems. You'll work across our stack - C#/.NET, React, and our in-house Storybook component library - on a platform backed by AWS, serverless (Lambda), and a messaging-based architecture. We're AI-first but human-accountable: you'll use AI to move fast, and your judgment to make sure what ship is right.


Admin Team:
The Admin team owns the core administrative and security capabilities of Method CRM, including authentication, user management, access control, account configuration and multi-tenancy. We are a balanced full-stack team building both frontend and backend experiences that enable customers to securely manage their organizations at scale. Our work underpins platform trust, compliance, and long-term customer growth.


About Method

Method is on a mission to transform how small businesses operate by giving them real control over their customer workflows. Our flagship product, Method CRM is purpose-built for small businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and generic tools. With deep QuickBooks integration and a powerful no-code customization engine, Method enables users to design workflows that truly fit their unique needs. As a scaling growth company, we’re now taking that mission further, leveraging AI to develop intelligent agents that assist users in rapidly building and customizing no-code apps. This innovation is at the heart of our next chapter, and we’re looking for people who are excited to build the future of work!


The Role

As a .NET Full-Stack Developer, you will be part of a driven and supportive team that’s always striving to deliver value to our customers by shipping new features and helping our platform scale.

  • Design, develop, maintain, and deploy well-tested services and features, with a focus on solving the underlying customer problems.

  • Refine project requirements prior to development, ensuring that ambiguity is resolved early and that delivery remains within the appropriate scope.

  • Provide in-depth analysis and resolutions to complex problems reported by our users, targeting the root cause of every issue.

  • Effectively contribute suggestions and new ideas to enhance the performance and usability of our platform for all users.

  • Participate in team story and task breakdowns, code reviews, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement.

  • Communicate early with leadership when technical work impacts core architecture, security, or deviates from established objectives.

What You Bring

Before you read this next section, we want you to know that we know the “ideal candidate” doesn’t exist — everybody has a unique background and skill set. Even if you don’t check every box below, we’d love for you to apply - we are building for the future and growth potential is a priority for us!

  • 2+ years building web apps across both front-end and back-end.

  • Strong C#, .NET Core, .NET 6/7/8, Web API, MVC, REST, design patterns, SPA, monolith vs. microservices, and Git.

  • JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, and a front-end SPA library (Angular / React).

  • Persistence storage and ORMs (SQL / NoSQL).

  • Unit and integration testing; Agile (Sprint / Kanban) experience.

  • Works AI-first with disciplined verification — uses AI to accelerate analysis, code, and tests; neither avoids it nor trusts it blindly.

  • Self-motivated and goal-driven, prioritizes well, and enjoys problem solving in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

  • Passionate for building engaging user experiences.

  • A team player with a positive attitude and a willingness to contribute to the overall team’s success in a fast paced environment.

  • Education in Computer Science, Computer/Software Engineering, or equivalent experience preferred


Bonus points if you have any of the following:

  • Infra and front-end tooling: Linux, Docker, Redux, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, MassTransit, CI/CD pipelines, Playwright, Python, SQS.

  • Microsoft or AWS certifications.


What We Offer

🌐 Flexible hybrid work model – designed to support work-life balance while maintaining strong team collaboration; employees work from our downtown Toronto office 2–3 days per week

🎉 Collaborative and social team culture – work in a supportive environment with regular team events and company-wide celebrations that keep things fun and connected

🚀 Growth-stage company experience – working at a scaling growth company like Method gives you deep insight into how a software company operates. You'll be involved in a wide range of discussions and initiatives, gaining experience that's hard to find in more siloed environments.

📚 Training – You will receive initial and ongoing training on Method’s products, policies and procedures as well as a quarterly professional development budget.

📍Great downtown location – Method is located right in the heart of Toronto’s young and vibrant ‘King West’ technology hub at the corner of Adelaide and Spadina Ave.

🩺 Comprehensive health benefits – inclusive of healthcare, vision, and dental coverage to support your overall well-being

🥗 Weekly lunch credit – enjoy a meal on us every week as a small way to say thanks


What to Expect in Your First 90 Days:

  • Onboard and acclimate with the Development team, including tailored 1on1s.

  • Complete Method’s Bootcamp.

  • Understand Method’s values, tools and best practices and how our teams collaborate to drive results.

  • Learn how various parts of the system are integrated together, and navigate the codebase so that you can troubleshoot minor bugs.

  • Start making small improvements based on the product backlog or refactoring code to improve readability, testability, and maintainability.

  • Contribute to the Development team's culture, processes, and best practices.

  • Become more confident with code ownership and deploying to production.

  • Assisting the team with daily releases and monitoring changes.

  • Start assuming more autonomy and finding small ways to practice ownership across the platform.

  • Work closely with your manager to explore goals for the rest of the year.

  • Help other developers with code design and decision making.


Compensation: $70,000 - $90,000 per annum


Job type: Full-time permanent.

This is an active role we are currently hiring for, and we thank all applicants for their interest. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. We kindly request that recruiting agencies do not contact us regarding this position.

AI in Recruitment

At Method, we use artificial intelligence (AI) to help support and enhance our recruitment process. These tools may assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription, and occasionally sourcing candidates.

AI is never used to make final hiring decisions. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Our use of AI is intended to support administrative and repetitive tasks, helping us streamline our workflows while maintaining a thoughtful and human-centered hiring experience.

We are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI in our recruitment practices. Our standardized hiring processes are designed to reduce bias and promote fairness, and we regularly review and refine our practices to align with evolving industry standards and legal guidelines.

Method is an equal opportunity employer for all — regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status or able-bodiedness. As part of our commitment to be an inclusive and accessible workplace, we’re happy to provide accommodations for candidates taking part in the selection process.

description:

While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. As a Member of People Experience, you're the anchor behind every employee's journey at Anchorage Digital, from the moment they accept their offer to their next chapter after Anchorage. Your work is often someone's first and lasting impression of what it's like to work here.
You'll run onboarding, offboarding, and internal mobility day to day, resolve employee casework and route what belongs elsewhere, and manage immigration case logistics.
You'll also partner closely with our Infrastructure, Analytics, & AI team, bringing operational context to help identify and test automation that removes manual work from People Experience workflows, so the team can spend more time on the people in front of them.
We have created the Factors of Growth & Impact to help Villagers better measure impact and articulate coaching, feedback, and the rich and rewarding learning that happens while exploring, developing, and mastering the capabilities and contributions within and outside of the Employee Experience role:

Technical Skills:

  • Execute onboarding, offboarding, and internal mobility workflows day to day, managing handoffs across HRIS, payroll, and benefits accurately and on time.
  • Bring a deep understanding of employee lifecycle operations, plus working knowledge of related areas including immigration, total rewards, and data privacy considerations relevant to a regulated environment.

  • Deploy and track completion of People, Legal and Compliance training within our HRIS.
  • Partner with the Infrastructure, Analytics, & AI team to flag repetitive workflows worth automating, and help test new tools before rollout.

Complexity and Impact of Work:

  • Define priorities and apply problem-solving skills to moderately complex casework and projects.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of employee casework and immigration cases, from intake through resolution, coordinating with outside counsel as needed.
  • Work through diverse challenges across the employee lifecycle that require thoughtful analysis and sound judgment.
  • Spot patterns across casework and feedback that point to friction in the employee experience, and know when to escalate them.
  • Contribute to process improvements that reduce manual work and strengthen data accuracy across the employee lifecycle.

Organizational Knowledge:

  • Understand how People Experience workflows connect to HRIS, Total Rewards, Accounting, and People Analytics, and apply that understanding to day-to-day planning.
  • Stay aware of engagement and survey findings the Analytics team surfaces, and factor them into day-to-day execution.
  • Stay current with evolving HR systems, tools, and best practices relevant to the role.
  • Contribute to hiring efforts through referrals, interviews, and recruiting participation.

Communication and Influence:

  • Communicate clearly across the full range of employee casework, from routine policy questions to process guidance.
  • Build strong working relationships with People Business Partners, Total Rewards, Accounting, and Infrastructure, Analytics, & AI so handoffs happen smoothly.
  • Communicate feedback themes and their implications clearly, so the right people can act on them.
  • Adapt communication style to the audience, whether that's an employee, a People Business Partner, or a technical partner.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of HR or People Generalist experience, preferably with at least some in a startup or high-growth environment.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (Dayforce, Workday, or similar).
  • Experience partnering with technical or data teams on process automation or workflow tooling.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workflows concurrently.
  • Clear communication skills with a strong sense of ownership and a process-minded approach.

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

  • You have experience supporting a global workforce.
  • You have experience coordinating company-wide training programs.
  • You were emotionally moved by the soundtrack to Hamilton, which chronicles the founding of a new financial system. :)
About Anchorage Digital: Who we are
The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.

title: Manager Data Science
description:
Are you excited to lead the development of next-generation AI-powered legal solutions that help professionals draft, reason, and work more effectively with complex legal information?


Do you thrive at the intersection of people leadership, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and product innovation, turning emerging AI capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes?


About our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (http://www.relx.com), a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles.


About LexisNexis Data Sciences:

At LexisNexis, we're redefining legal intelligence through advanced AI. Our teams harness the power of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic systems to build tools that analyze, draft, and reason with legal text. Join us in building AI systems that help legal professionals move faster, think deeper, and operate with confidence.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a Manager of Data Science to lead a high-impact team focused on building intelligent systems powered by LLMs and RAG architectures. This role will focus on improving LLM-powered drafting and retrieval solutions through advanced search, embeddings, reranking, evaluation, and production-grade ML components.

You’ll drive the strategy, technical execution, and team growth necessary to build next-generation legal assistants, capable of contextual document drafting, and interaction with structured and unstructured data sources.

Key Responsibilities:

Vision & Strategy:

  • Define the roadmap for applying LLMs and agentic AI to real-world legal drafting.
  • Evangelize and embed AI-driven change across legal product platforms.
  • Translate evolving generative AI capabilities into tangible customer value within the legal domain.

Technical & Product Leadership:

  • Architect systems that combine foundation models with RAG pipelines to draft contracts, memos, and pleadings grounded in enterprise knowledge.
  • Guide the development of AI agents that perform multi-step reasoning, cite evidence, retrieve domain-specific content, and produce compliant outputs.

Team & Operational Excellence:

  • Mentor and grow a multidisciplinary team of LLM-focused Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with Legal SMEs, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and Design.
  • Establish best practices for evaluation, observability, and responsible use of generative AI.

Core Qualifications:

Experience

  • Previous people management experience (3+ years) of teams building LLM-based applications, especially in domains requiring rigor and traceability like legal, finance, or compliance.
  • Hands-on experience delivering systems using LangChain, LLM agent frameworks, vector databases, and prompt orchestration pipelines.
  • Strong background in deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for grounded and auditable responses.
  • Demonstrated success in taking LLM-powered applications from prototype to production.

Technical Proficiency

  • Proficient with Python and LLM tooling: LangChain, HuggingFace Transformers, OpenAI APIs, and prompt tuning techniques.
  • Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., Solr, Elasticsearch, Qdrant, Weaviate), knowledge graphs, and hybrid retrieval architectures.
  • Working knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and model serving tools (TorchServe, Triton, Ray Serve).
  • Cloud infrastructure experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Background

  • Graduate degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or equivalent experience.
  • 6 years of post-degree experience, with 3+ years in a data science or applied AI leadership role, with a focus on NLP/LLM systems.
  • Prior experience in legal tech, legal AI, or document-intensive domains is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with ethical/legal considerations in deploying generative AI in professional settings.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.


Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This role is a technical leader for the API Management platform. You will coordinate the work of other engineers, set technical direction, improve existing structures and processes, and make design decisions that affect the internal and external teams building on PayPal’s APIs.

Role Impact:
Serve as a senior engineer and subject matter expert for the API Management platform.

Own the design, implementation, and operational health of core APIM components, including governance, lifecycle, security, and observability capabilities.

Contribute to the technical roadmap by assessing implementation alternatives, trade-offs, and recommendations.

Mentor engineers at all levels and advise senior leaders on platform systems, challenges, and strategy.

Own availability and performance of the platform and participate in on-call and incident response.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system
  • Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow
  • Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives
  • Proactively improves existing structures & processes
  • Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems
  • Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions
  • Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor
  • Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

title: Senior UX Researcher, Synthetic Audiences
description:
Let’s talk about the team

Experience Insights (EXI) is a multidisciplinary research function spanning UX research, Customer Experience and Behavioral Science. EXI helps CX, Product and the broader Resmed organization understand user and provider needs, journey friction, behavior drivers and experience outcomes so teams can make more confident, customer-centered decisions.

As EXI evolves into a more AI-powered enablement function, the team is expanding how insights are created, connected, accessed and applied across the organization. This includes strengthening the knowledge layer, improving application of research and VOC intelligence, developing AI-enabled insight agents, applying synthetic audience capabilities responsibly and ensuring human judgment remains central to high-quality decision-making.

This role will own the creation, maintenance, evaluation and responsible application of AI insight agents and synthetic audience capabilities within EXI. It is an individual contributor role at the intersection of AI-enabled insight systems, UX/CX research, synthetic research methods, responsible AI and customer experience enablement.

Let’s talk about the role

As a Senior UX Researcher, you will:

  • Develop and maintain synthetic audience capabilities that help teams explore early hypotheses, pressure-test concepts, identify research questions and accelerate discovery without replacing human research.
  • Define clear guardrails for synthetic audience use, including when synthetic audiences are appropriate, when human research is required and how outputs should be interpreted.
  • Evaluate synthetic audience outputs for quality, usefulness, source grounding, completeness, bias, overclaiming, hallucination risk and alignment to EXI evidence standards.
  • Create test questions, evaluation routines, feedback loops and improvement backlogs to ensure synthetic audiences remain useful, trustworthy, and fit for purpose over time.
  • Partner with UX researchers to ensure agent experiences reflect real customer and provider evidence.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science/AI, Product and platform teams to shape technical requirements, integration needs, deployment approaches and ongoing support models for AI-enabled insight tools.
  • Create guidance, training, and onboarding materials that help Product and non-Product stakeholders understand how to use synthetic audiences responsibly and effectively.
  • Provide ongoing support for synthetic audience users by answering questions, gathering feedback, identifying usability issues, and improving how people access and apply AI-enabled intelligence.
  • Help define standards for what should be answered by AI agents, what should be escalated to human research and what should remain outside AI-enabled workflows.

Let’s talk about you

  • You are highly autonomous, technically minded, self-directed and comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor in a new domain.
  • You are a strong UX researcher who brings deep research judgment, methodological rigor, and customer empathy to AI-enabled work. You can evaluate whether an AI-generated output reflects real evidence, overgeneralizes from weak sources, misses important context or creates false confidence.
  • You are also a hands-on AI agent builder. You have used AI to create agents, automations, simulations, or research tools that improve how work gets done and you can translate real research workflows into useful, trustworthy, source-grounded agent experiences.
  • You are comfortable partnering with UX researchers, VOC, BeSci, Product, Engineering, Data Science/AI and platform teams to translate research and CX needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions.
  • You are an effective educator and partner. You can help others understand when to use synthetic audiences, when to rely on existing evidence, and when to engage human research.
  • You take ownership of what you create and continuously improve it based on user feedback, performance, observed behavior, research validation and evolving EXI and CX priorities.

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

title: Global Director of Data & AI Governance and Foundations
description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role

Data is at the heart of how Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) serves customers, supports partners and drives business decisions. As we continue to evolve our data and AI capabilities, we’re looking for a Global Director of Data Foundations & Governance to shape how data is governed, trusted and used responsibly across our global organisation.

Reporting directly to the VP Data & Analytics, you’ll lead our enterprise-wide data and AI governance strategy, data product standards and data strategy and change portfolio. Working closely with Technology, Product, Legal, InfoSec and business leaders, you’ll define the frameworks and standards that enable teams to innovate with confidence, while ensuring our data and AI practices remain secure, high-quality and compliant.

This is a critical leadership role where you’ll set the direction for data governance across JET’s markets and domains, partnering with our Platform team to translate standards into scalable solutions. We’re looking for someone who can live our behaviours of Lead, Deliver and Care, challenge the status quo and bring people together to create lasting business impact.

These are some of the key components to the position:

  • Set the direction – Define and evolve JET’s enterprise data and AI governance strategy, establishing clear frameworks, standards and controls that enable trusted, responsible innovation across the business.
  • Lead through collaboration – Partner with Technology, Product, Legal, InfoSec and business leaders to embed governance into platforms, products and operational processes, building shared accountability across teams and markets.
  • Champion responsible AI – Establish AI governance frameworks covering model risk, training data quality, bias, explainability, lineage and Generative AI, ensuring AI is used safely, ethically and responsibly.
  • Raise the bar on data quality – Define enterprise-wide data quality standards, stewardship practices and monitoring requirements so that data used for business decisions and AI systems is accurate, complete and trusted.
  • Build for reuse – Establish clear standards for data products, ownership, lifecycle management and data contracts, enabling teams to share trusted, consistent data while reducing duplication across domains.
  • Shape our data strategy – Work with senior leadership to prioritise data initiatives based on business value, evolve our operating model and measure the return on our data investments.
  • Turn standards into action – Define the requirements for governance tooling, metadata management, data lineage and automated controls, partnering with the Platform team to determine what good looks like and enable scalable implementation.
  • Drive adoption and change – Lead initiatives that embed data-driven behaviours across JET, building a strong data community and developing data literacy and capabilities across different teams and markets.
  • Protect our data ecosystem – Establish policies and standards that support regulatory compliance, including GDPR, CCPA and the EU AI Act, while defining governance expectations for third-party data providers and AI vendors.
  • Lead and develop your team – Build a high-performing team with a culture of trust, accountability, transparency and continuous improvement, developing the capabilities needed to keep JET ahead of emerging data and AI challenges.

What will you bring to the team?

  • Extensive experience across data governance, data management, data product management and enterprise data strategy, with a strong understanding of how to scale these capabilities in complex organisations.
  • Demonstrable experience in AI governance, responsible AI or machine learning governance, including the ability to establish frameworks for model risk, data provenance and Generative AI.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance frameworks, data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship and data contracts, including their application across modern data and AI environments.
  • A solid understanding of data privacy and AI regulation, including GDPR, CCPA and the EU AI Act, with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical governance standards.
  • Experience shaping enterprise data strategies and federated governance models across multiple markets, business domains and technology environments.
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders across Technology, Product, Legal and business functions, bringing people together around a shared vision and clear priorities.
  • Experience defining requirements for governance tooling, data catalogues, data quality platforms and AI-assisted automation, with an understanding of modern data architectures and cloud environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to prioritise initiatives based on business value, measure outcomes and demonstrate the impact of data investments.
  • Experience establishing governance standards for third-party data partnerships and AI/ML vendors, balancing innovation, security, privacy and regulatory risk.
  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with a track record of developing high-performing teams, embracing change and translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes. You take ownership, welcome challenges and help others succeed.

At JET, this is how we play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.


At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else are we delivering?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.



Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

title: Game Developer (Unity, C#, OOP)
description:

The Job

  • Phối hợp Designer/Art tích hợp tài nguyên 2D/3D, animation, VFX, âm thanh vào game.

  • Xây dựng và bảo trì công cụ nội bộ (Unity Editor) phục vụ thiết kế level và phân tích dữ liệu.
  • Tích hợp SDK (quảng cáo, analytics, IAP); build và phát hành lên App Store / Google Play.
  • Sửa lỗi, cải thiện tính năng, viết code maintainable & reusable; nghiên cứu game cùng loại để cải tiến.

Your Skills and Experience

K – Kiến thức

  • 2–4 năm kinh nghiệm Unity & C#; đã release ít nhất một game mobile (ưu tiên puzzle/casual).
  • Tốt nghiệp loại Khá trở lên ngành Công nghệ thông tin hoặc liên quan (ưu tiên HUST, UET, PTIT, ..).
  • Vững OOP, Design Patterns, cấu trúc dữ liệu & giải thuật; tư duy logic và giải quyết vấn đề tốt.
  • Nắm vững tư duy Composition (composition over inheritance) và Reflection trong C#
  • Hiểu sâu vòng đời Unity: prefab, scene management, coroutine, event system, ScriptableObject, state machine.
  • Đọc hiểu tốt tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh.

S – Kỹ năng

  • Tự chủ implement gameplay end-to-end: bóc tách thiết kế, dựng kiến trúc tính năng, hoàn thiện đạt chất lượng release.
  • Thành thạo Unity: Canvas, Animation, Effects & Particles, Physics (DOTween là lợi thế).
  • Tối ưu performance & tài nguyên: Profiler / Memory Profiler / Frame Debugger, draw call, batching, texture, memory, Addressables.
  • Kiến trúc data-driven cho phép Designer chỉnh dữ liệu/level mà không cần đụng code.
  • Viết công cụ nội bộ trên Unity Editor (EditorWindow, custom inspector) cho level design & phân tích dữ liệu.
  • Tích hợp ad/analytics/IAP/mediation SDK; thành thạo Git, review code và đề xuất cải tiến kiến trúc.
  • Ưu tiên: build automation / CI-CD, remote config & A/B test, giám sát ổn định bản live (Crashlytics, ANR).
  • Lợi thế: Shader / Shader Graph, VFX / VFX Graph.

A – Thái độ

  • Feel: quan tâm chất lượng kỹ thuật và cảm giác sản phẩm — code không chỉ chạy đúng mà tính năng phải mượt và “đã tay”; đặt mình vào vị trí người chơi.
  • Fuel: theo vấn đề kỹ thuật đến cùng debug tới gốc rễ, hoàn thiện tính năng tới mức release, không nửa vời.
  • Chủ động, tỉ mỉ, ownership cao, đam mê làm game; tiếp nhận feedback và cải tiến nhanh.
  • Tinh thần học hỏi, cởi mở với công nghệ mới; chủ động ứng dụng AI vào lập trình để tăng tốc và nâng chất lượng.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Lương up to 25.000.000 VNĐ (thoả thuận theo năng lực) + thưởng theo project.
  • Lộ trình phát triển cá nhân hóa, định hướng lên Functional Leader; tham gia trực tiếp các sản phẩm hướng tới global.
  • Văn hoá “Feel and Fuel”; team trẻ, nhỏ, nhanh, ít tầng nấc — bạn thực sự sở hữu mảng của mình.
  • Team giai đoạn đầu, phúc lợi đang được xây dựng — bạn vừa hưởng vừa góp phần định hình; đảm bảo chế độ cơ bản theo luật.
  • Giờ làm linh hoạt 9:00 – 18:00 (nghỉ trưa 1h30); đề cao kết quả công việc.

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

Responsible for planning, analyzing, administering, and coordinating the Quality Assurance functions of Quality Control, as well as supervising and programming CMM’s, and inspecting parts as needed to maintain the production schedule and on-time deliveries.

  • Plan and administer the Quality Control function of the department.
  • Create and execute inspection methods and techniques that will assure quality is achieved and maintained.

  • Supervise inspectors to accomplish first piece/first article inspections, in-process inspection, final inspections, Certificate of Conformance (CoC) and outside process receiving inspection tasks as required.
  • Manage all assigned labor (time and attendance) and fixed cost for the inspection department.
  • Maintain a calibration system which includes employee-owned measuring tools as well as company owned measuring equipment.
  • Assure current print revisions and current process instructions are readily available for inspection of assigned parts. Inspection records shall be maintained which show pertinent information for each production run of assigned parts.
  • Measure and analyze key quality performance data. Make recommendations to management on specific opportunities to improve quality.
  • Develop training and procedures to support and audit operator in-process inspections and required documentation.
  • Develop and implement quality plans on an ongoing basis. The quality plan should specify the requirements for people, equipment and systems to be used for continuous improvement of quality.
  • Recommend changes to documentation which supports quality improvement, (i.e., Engineering Change Requests, process instructions, raw material requirements).
  • Leads and applies the principles of “Total Quality” to the workplace, to include 5S and safety standards.
  • Participate and maintain assigned responsibility for ISO 9001:2008 documented quality systems.
  • Be responsible for ensuring that inspectors know and comply with all ISO 9001:2008 requirements within their area of responsibility.
  • Provide quality inspection support of a value stream in a back-up support role as needed.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • High school graduate or equivalent. Degree in Business Administration, Quality Management, Logistics, Supply Chain Management.
  • 3 to 5 years' experience of quality control and machining in manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in supervising and leading a manufacturing team. This position will supervise 6-10 hourly inspectors.
  • Experience and knowledge reading drawings (prints) is required.
  • Experience and knowledge working with GD&T
  • Experience supervising and working on shop floor environment
  • Inspection lab and processing experience
  • Experience in semi-conductor, medical device, automotive, aerospace or precision machining manufacturing
