title: Loads Engineer
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Load Analysis & Definition: Calculate and establish static and dynamic design load cases for all flight and ground phases, including transportation, launchpad operations, engine ignition, atmospheric ascent (aerodynamic loads), staging, re-entry, and landing.

  • Coupled Loads Analysis (CLA): Build and execute complex mathematical simulation models by coupling launch vehicle and payload models to predict critical flight environments and transient events.

  • Modeling & Simulation: Develop and optimize finite element models (FEM) and perform structural dynamics analyses, including transient, sinusoidal, random vibration (PSD), gusts, and acoustic response analyses.

  • Testing & Validation: Design, oversee, and analyze data from physical tests (e.g., modal surveys, vibration, and shock testing) and correlate simulation models with actual flight telemetry data.

Who you are

  • Education: University degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a strong focus on structural dynamics or continuum mechanics.

  • Experience: Proven experience in structural loads definition, structural dynamics, or aeroelasticity, ideally within the development of launch vehicles, satellites, or missiles.

Technical Skills:

  • Deep understanding of structural dynamics, vibe/shock environments, and acoustic phenomena.

  • Proficiency with commercial FEA solvers (Optistruct) and pre-/post-processors (HyperMesh).

What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.
At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Job Description:

The Medical Science Liaison is a field-based Medical Affairs professional responsible for non-promotional, peer-to-peer scientific exchange with external healthcare stakeholders. The role advances scientific understanding, identifies unmet medical needs and actionable insights, and contributes to Medical Strategy and improved patient care within the assigned therapeutic areas and products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identifies and engages external scientific experts and other relevant healthcare stakeholders, building and maintaining credible peer-to-peer scientific relationships. Provides accurate, balanced, and high-quality medical and scientific exchange through appropriate activities such as advisory boards, scientific meetings, educational programmes, presentations, and literature discussions.
  • Develops and executes territory- and account-level Medical Engagement Plans aligned with the Medical Strategy, based on stakeholder needs, patient journeys, healthcare-system dynamics, and identified medical priorities.
  • Develops an in-depth understanding of the local healthcare ecosystem, including clinical and referral pathways, multidisciplinary care, institutional priorities, and barriers affecting patients’ access to appropriate care.
  • Captures, validates, analyses, and communicates high-quality, actionable field medical insights. Identifies patterns, evidence gaps, patient-journey barriers, and emerging trends, and assesses their potential implications for Medical Strategy and evidence generation.
  • Responds to unsolicited investigator-initiated study (IIS) proposals and provides scientific input and support to Phase IV studies and other evidence-generation activities, in accordance with applicable governance and local requirements. Ensures that proposals are scientifically relevant and aligned with local and global Medical Strategy.
  • Contributes to Medical activities across the product lifecycle, including launch readiness and post-launch evidence and education needs.
  • Coordinates with cross-functional partners, including Market Access, to ensure appropriate awareness of the Medical Plan, and provides role-appropriate medical and scientific input. Throughout, preserves Medical independence and a clear separation between non-promotional scientific exchange and promotional activities.
  • Serves as a scientific resource to Medical and appropriate cross-functional colleagues, and provides accurate, balanced, and role-appropriate scientific training using approved materials and in line with applicable governance.
  • Maintains a high level of scientific and technical expertise in the assigned therapeutic areas and products. Monitors treatment guidelines, clinical practice, emerging evidence, congress data, and competitor developments, and critically evaluates and communicates relevant findings to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Responds to unsolicited medical and scientific enquiries in an accurate, balanced, timely, and non-promotional manner.
  • Documents scientific interactions, insights, follow-up actions, and Medical activities accurately and in a timely manner using approved systems and tools, supporting knowledge continuity, Medical planning, and compliance.
  • Provides scientific input to publications, abstracts, congress activities, and medical education initiatives in line with the publication plan.
  • Evaluates the quality, relevance, and impact of Medical engagements and activities using appropriate qualitative and quantitative measures, and applies learnings to continuously improve field medical execution.
  • Conducts all activities in accordance with applicable laws, industry codes, ethical standards, and company policies and procedures. Reports adverse events, product complaints, and other safety information within required timelines.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in pharmacy, medicine, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, preferably in Medical Affairs, field medical, or clinical research.
  • Strong scientific background, with the ability to critically appraise clinical data and communicate complex scientific information clearly.
  • Solid understanding of the Korean healthcare environment and applicable regulations and industry codes

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (PharmD, MD, PhD, or MSc)
  • Field medical/MSL experience in a relevant therapeutic area (e.g., reproductive medicine).

Other Requirements

  • Willingness to travel domestically as required; approximately 80-90% of working time is expected to be field-based / external stakeholder-facing.
  • Occasional international travel for congresses and regional meetings.

  • Participation in the Safety and Health Committee.

  • Preparation and control of mandatory documentation related to Occupational Health and Safety.
  • Collaborate with EHS Manager in expense control within the area.
  • Participation in onboarding for new hires.
  • Record required information according to procedures and ensure its traceability.
  • Basic support in environmental management.
  • Compliance with prevention, quality, and environmental regulations.
  • Be aware of and comply with all regulations, procedures, and instructions related to your work, especially those concerning prevention and protection measures.

What We Will Love About You


To contribute to a safe and healthy working environment through effective risk prevention, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.


And also …


  • Higher education in Occupational Risk Prevention specializations.
  • Desirable: Master's degree covering all three specializations in Occupational Risk Prevention.

title: Guidewire Data Engineer - Hybrid
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Our client is an organization operating within the BPO Industry, focused on providing tech solutions. The company servesNorth American, European, and APAC regionsand is committed to delivering quality solutions, operational excellence, and sustainable business growth. Additional information about the organization will be shared with selected candidates at the appropriate stage of the recruitment process.

Location: BGC

Work Setup: Hybrid, 3 Days WFH and 2 Days Onsite

Compensation Flexibility: Open to negotiation for highly qualified candidates.


JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a skilled Guidewire Data Engineer to develop, test, and support data migration, integration, and reporting solutions for Guidewire implementations and modernization programs. The ideal candidate will have experience in Guidewire data models, ETL development, SQL, cloud data platforms, and Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance processes.

The role involves collaborating with Data Leads, Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Guidewire functional teams to deliver data migration and integration workstreams across PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, and Guidewire Cloud environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyze legacy insurance systems and source data structures to support data migration and conversion activities.

  • Develop source-to-target data mappings and ETL processes for Policy, Claims, Billing, Customer, and Producer data.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, transformation logic, data quality checks, and reusable migration frameworks.

  • Develop SQL scripts and stored procedures, optimize database performance, and support large-volume data processing.

  • Participate in mock conversions, trial runs, production cutovers, and post-migration validation.

  • Perform data profiling, validation, and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity between source and target systems.

  • Develop and support integrations between Guidewire applications and external systems through APIs, batch interfaces, and other data exchange mechanisms.

  • Support implementations involving Guidewire DataHub, InfoCenter, and Guidewire Cloud Data Platform.

  • Execute and support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production validation activities.

  • Investigate and resolve data defects, migration issues, and data quality concerns.

  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, subject matter experts, and Guidewire configuration and integration teams to clarify requirements and mapping specifications.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

  • Provide post-production support during deployment and stabilization phases.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4–8 years of experience in Data Engineering, ETL Development, Data Migration, or related projects.

  • Hands-on experience with data mapping, ETL processes, SQL development, data validation, and reconciliation.

  • Knowledge of relational databases, data transformation techniques, and data quality management.

  • Experience with data integration, batch processing, and large-volume data handling.

  • Understanding of Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance processes and data structures.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience working on Guidewire implementation projects.

  • Experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, DataHub, or InfoCenter.

  • Exposure to Guidewire Cloud implementations and the Guidewire Cloud Data Platform.

  • Experience with Python, Java, or MuleSoft.

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms and services such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks.

  • Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or SSIS.

  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment processes.

REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Guidewire Platforms: PolicyCenter, ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, DataHub, InfoCenter, and Guidewire Cloud Data Platform.

  • Data Engineering: Data migration, ETL development, source-to-target mapping, data profiling, data transformation, validation, reconciliation, and data quality management.

  • Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.

  • Programming & Query Languages: SQL, PL/SQL, and shell scripting; Python and Java are advantageous.

  • ETL & Integration Tools: Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, SSIS, and MuleSoft.

  • Cloud & Data Platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks.

  • DevOps & Version Control: Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Insurance Domain: Personal and Commercial Lines, policy administration, claims processing, billing and collections, underwriting, and customer data management.

  • Testing & Support: SIT, UAT, data reconciliation, defect resolution, production validation, and post-deployment support.

  • Collaboration: Requirements analysis, stakeholder coordination, Agile delivery, and cross-functional teamwork.

description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

The Senior Director, Media & Growth is a newly created, highly strategic marketing role. This new leader will manage our global paid media strategy and drive measurable growth across our consumer and merchant businesses. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of performance marketing, brand media, and data-driven customer acquisition — responsible for translating business objectives into integrated media plans that accelerate GNA, MAA, and TPV outcomes at scale.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing Operations, this leader will oversee a high-performing team and manage relationships with our agency partners, platform partners, and internal stakeholders across Marketing, Technology, and Finance.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy for the marketing function
  • Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert in marketing
  • Inspire and lead the marketing team to achieve long-term success
  • Align marketing strategies with PayPal-wide strategy and operations
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in marketing practices
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure the marketing function supports overall business goals

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Specific responsibilities include:


Media Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and own the global paid media strategy across all channels — paid search, paid social, display, video, streaming, out-of-home, and emerging platforms
  • Build integrated media plans that connect brand awareness to performance outcomes, ensuring every dollar of investment is tied to a measurable business result
  • Lead the annual and quarterly media planning process in close partnership with Finance and Marketing leadership
  • Define channel investment priorities, audience strategies, and creative rotation frameworks across all markets

Growth & Performance Marketing

  • Own GNA (Gross New Accounts) and MAA (Monthly Active Accounts) growth targets driven by paid media investment
  • Develop and scale a full-funnel performance marketing approach — from upper-funnel demand generation to lower-funnel conversion and activation
  • Lead customer segmentation strategy to ensure media investment is targeted against the highest-value acquisition and re-engagement opportunities
  • Partner with CRM and Lifecycle teams to connect paid and owned channel strategies into a seamless customer journey

Data, Measurement & Optimization

  • Leverage a best-in-class measurement framework — including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), multi-touch attribution, and incrementality testing — to accurately assess media ROI and guide investment decisions
  • Drive paid media instrumentation from current levels to industry-standard 60–80% enablement across partner platforms
  • Build and maintain executive-level reporting on media performance, MROI, and contribution to business KPIs
  • Champion a test-and-learn culture across the media organization, using data to continuously optimize channel mix and creative performance

Agency & Partner Management

  • Serve as the primary executive point of contact for our media agency of record and key platform partners (Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, etc.)
  • Hold agency partners accountable to performance, innovation, and ways of working standards
  • Lead media contract negotiations, upfront commitments, and partnership agreements in collaboration with Procurement and Legal

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of media and growth marketing professionals across the US and international markets
  • Build a culture of accountability, analytical rigor, and creative ambition within the media organization
  • Partner across Marketing, Product, Analytics, MarTech, and Finance to ensure the media function operates as a connected, integrated part of the broader business
  • Serve as a cultural carrier and positive energy force within the organization, building a team that is ambitious, collaborative, creatively bold, and enthusiastic about the opportunity ahead

title: Sr. Director, Energy Strategy & Development, New Markets
description:
At Rowan Digital Infrastructure, we are transforming data center delivery for speed and scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility. Our data center solutions are tailored to our customers’ needs and delivered by our exceptional end-to-end team. Rowan is assembling a strategic portfolio of data center sites in Tier 1 markets across the United States at various stages of development, and we’re looking for incredible and passionate people to help us advance our company and our commitment to building a more sustainable future.

Rowan is backed by Quinbrook, a leading investor in the energy transition, and Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager.

Ready to join us in transforming the future of data centers and sustainability? Apply now to explore exciting career opportunities at Rowan Digital Infrastructure and be a part of our mission to revolutionize data center delivery.

Role Summary:

Rowan Digital Infrastructure is seeking a Senior Director of Energy Strategy & Development, New Markets to define and lead the energy strategy for Rowan’s expanding data center portfolio. This role is responsible for setting and executing multi‑year, function‑wide strategies that enable the delivery of reliable, scalable, and sustainable power infrastructure aligned with Rowan’s customer commitments and long‑term growth objectives for firm, clean, cost-effective capacity.

As a senior leader, you will own Rowan’s new market energy strategy end‑to‑end—spanning market entry, site selection, grid and alternative energy solutions, regulatory engagement, and commercial execution. You will partner closely with utilities, transmission system operators (TSOs), regulators, governments, customers, and internal teams to unlock capacity, mitigate risk, and accelerate development timelines across diverse regional power markets.

This role requires deep technical and commercial expertise in power infrastructure, strong regulatory fluency across utility jurisdictions, and the ability to lead complex, cross‑functional initiatives with material company‑wide impact. You will coordinate across a high‑performing team of energy professionals and act as a trusted advisor to Rowan’s executive leadership and Board of Directors.

Travel: Ability to travel up to 70% for stakeholder, utility and/or project related activities

Location: Must be US based, Denver, CO or Seattle, WA in-office strongly preferred

Compensation: $220K - $275K (Offers Bonus)

Key Responsibilities:

Define and Own Energy Strategy, New Market

  • Define, own, and deliver Rowan’s multi‑year new market energy strategy, ensuring alignment with company growth plans, customer requirements, and sustainability commitments.

  • Set function‑wide priorities and guide market entry and expansion decisions across power markets

  • Influence company‑level strategy by integrating energy availability, grid constraints, alternative power solutions, and regulatory considerations into siting and investment decisions.

Lead Energy Development & Execution

  • Originate, structure, and execute complex energy solutions to support large‑scale data center campuses, including grid interconnections, transmission upgrades, on‑site generation, storage, and renewable procurement.

  • Lead negotiations with utilities, TSOs, regulators, and energy partners for interconnection, electrical service, and long‑term energy agreements.

  • Develop creative, market‑specific solutions that accelerate timelines and mitigate constraints in capacity‑limited or highly regulated environments.

Cross‑Functional & External Leadership

  • Act as Rowan’s senior energy representative with utility executives, regulators, government agencies, and major customers

  • Build deep partnerships across Development, Real Estate, Finance, Legal, Sustainability, and Business Development teams to ensure integrated decision‑making and execution.

Governance, Risk, and Business Case Ownership

  • Build and own investment cases for energy infrastructure and commercial agreements; align executive leadership and the Board on risk, return, and execution strategy.

  • Anticipate regulatory, market, and grid‑related risks; develop mitigation strategies for factors outside Rowan’s direct control.

Education, Skills, and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (engineering, business, economics, construction management, real estate, or related discipline).

  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience developing power infrastructure for large, energy‑intensive assets (e.g., data centers, industrial facilities, infrastructure projects),

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating interconnection, transmission, and long‑term power agreements with utilities, TSOs, or renewable developers.

  • Proven track record leading multi‑team, multi‑year initiatives with material business impact.

  • Deep technical expertise in transmission and distribution infrastructure, with strong working knowledge of power market structures and regulatory frameworks.

  • Experience working with hyperscale or large enterprise data center customers strongly preferred.

  • Exceptional executive communication skills, including the ability to present complex topics clearly to senior leadership and Boards.

  • Strong strategic judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to operate effectively in fast‑moving, highly cross‑functional environments.

Fueled by Excellence & Collaboration

At Rowan, we are a distributed team united by a common mission to transform data center delivery. Across our two offices, we offer a hybrid work environment supported by teamwork, technology, and in-office gathering time to help you be successful. We are headquartered in downtown Denver, Colorado and have an office in Seattle, Washington. Our team of talented and passionate individuals is spread out across the U.S.

Here to support you

At Rowan, we want to make sure you can do great work. We offer competitive benefits focused on helping you be and achieve your best.

  • Hybrid working environment

  • Generous benefits package including robust health benefits and a 401(k)-company contribution

title: Head of Security, IT & AI Governance
description:
Head of Security, IT & AI Governance

Obligo is looking for a Head of Security, IT & AI Governance to own security and IT end to end. You will set the strategy, lead the team, and also roll up your sleeves to deploy, configure and investigate yourself. You will secure a fintech that handles open-banking and sensitive financial data, and an AI-powered product and workforce, from day one.

What you will do

  • Own security and IT strategy. Define and execute the multi-year security and IT roadmap, budget and scorecards, and communicate risk clearly to leadership, customers and auditors.
  • Secure our AI footprint. Improve our AI security and governance program covering AI tools used by employees (approved-tool lists, shadow-AI discovery, data-leakage controls) and AI built into our product (prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure, excessive agency of AI agents, MCP/tool and model supply-chain risk, vector/RAG data exposure). Align with OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
  • Strengthen security monitoring and Zero Trust controls. Continuously improve detection, response and access security across AWS, Google Workspace, endpoints and SaaS. Work hands-on with SIEM and SASE / Zero Trust technologies to refine logging, detection rules, alert triage and incident response, and strengthen access and data protection through SSO/MFA, device posture, ZTNA, SWG, CASB and DLP.
  • Lead SOC 2 and compliance. Own SOC 2 readiness, audits and continuous monitoring (using Drata). Be the face of security in customer due diligence and questionnaires.
  • Run cloud and application security. Harden AWS and Google Workspace, manage vulnerability management, annual penetration tests, secure code review, secrets and IAM hygiene, and work with R&D to embed security in the SDLC.
  • Run IT operations. Own employee onboarding/offboarding, device management and hardening, software procurement, and the IT ticketing function with clear SLAs.
  • Manage vendor and third-party risk. Run security reviews of vendors and third parties, including AI vendors, and keep the vendor inventory current.
  • Improve security awareness. Run an ongoing security awareness program for all employees, including phishing simulations and training.
  • Be hands-on. Investigate alerts, write detections and automation, configure tooling and respond to incidents yourself, while leading and growing the team (today a SecOps engineer, and external IT company) and managing vendors.
  • Co-lead risk. Serve as the primary technology-risk voice on the Obligo Risk Committee, working closely with R&D, Legal and Operations leadership.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in security and IT, including 2+ years in a leadership role at a cloud-native, fast-growing company (fintech or SaaS an advantage).
  • Proven, hands-on experience working and implementing tools such as a SIEM (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic, Wazuh, Panther, Sumo Logic) and a SASE or modern Zero Trust stack, including ZTNA/SWG (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Cloudflare, Palo Alto Prisma).
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI security risks and controls, for both employee use of AI and AI-powered products, including agentic AI and LLM-specific threats.
  • Direct experience leading SOC 2 (Type II) readiness and audits end to end, ideally with a compliance automation platform. ISO 27001, PCI or similar is a plus.
  • Strong AWS and Google Workspace security background: IAM, network, logging, endpoint management (MDM/EDR) and SSO/MFA.
  • Real management skills: Led technical people, and you are equally comfortable running the keyboard yourself.
  • Excellent communication in English; able to translate risk into business language for executives, auditors and customers.
  • Calm under pressure, structured, ownership-driven, and comfortable with ambiguity in a startup environment.

Nice to have: relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP, AWS Security Specialty, AI security certifications), experience with security automation and scripting, and experience in a regulated financial environment.

Why join us

  • Real ownership, with the mandate and budget to build the program properly.
  • Greenfield work on modern problems: SIEM, SASE/Zero Trust and AI security, instead of maintaining legacy systems.
  • A collaborative, high-energy team in our Tel Aviv office.

About Obligo

Obligo is the simplest way to establish trust between renters and landlords. Harnessing open banking, big data and AI, Obligo acts as a trusted third party that frees landlords and renters from the burden of security deposits. Our R&D center is based in Tel Aviv, and we are backed by leading VCs including 83North, 10D and Entrée Capital. [Update with latest company facts, size and funding.]

title: Civil Enforcement Officer
description:
Job Summary:

 Act as a visible and approachable presence in the community, patrolling designated
areas to provide guidance to the public while enforcing road traffic regulations,
including the issuance of Penalty Charge Notices when appropriate.
 Support the reduction of traffic congestion and improvement of air quality by
managing kerbside activity and ensuring compliance with parking restrictions, using a
moped, bicycle, or on foot in all weather conditions.
 Deliver excellent customer service by engaging respectfully with the public at all times
and help to uphold a safe, orderly, and customer-focused environment.

Job Description:

1. Monitor on-street and off-street parking areas using a moped, bicycle, or on foot, ensuring vehicles are parked

in accordance with relevant regulations, and issue Penalty Charge Notices (PCNs) where non-compliance is

identified, in line with local traffic orders.


2. Act as a visible and reassuring presence to encourage compliance, promoting responsible parking through

positive public engagement and providing accurate, helpful advice on parking rules and facilities to residents

and visitors.


3. Collect and record comprehensive evidence to support the issuance of PCNs, including writing clear and

accurate reports, capturing photographic evidence, and maintaining simultaneously notes in official records.


4. Identify and authorise the immobilisation or removal of vehicles in line with regulatory guidelines, where

necessary to support enforcement operations or ensure public safety.


5. Regularly inspect pay and display machines, signage, and car park equipment, reporting faults, vandalism, or

maintenance issues promptly to ensure continuous service and public accessibility.


6. Observe and report damaged or missing street furniture, unclear road markings, or suspicious vehicles,

contributing to the upkeep and safety of the public realm.


7. Attend court hearings or tribunal proceedings where required, providing factual witness statements and

supporting documentation when a PCN is formally challenged.


8. Collaborate with community safety partners such as Police Community Support Officers and local law

enforcement, sharing relevant observations to address anti-social behaviour and support wider community

safety initiatives.


9. Stay informed about changes in legislation, policies, and systems affecting parking enforcement, attending

training sessions and continually developing professional knowledge relevant to the role.


10. Support the development of colleagues by providing guidance and informal mentoring, sharing knowledge and

promoting a culture of continuous improvement and teamwork.


11. Carry out any additional duties commensurate with the role and grading, supporting the flexible delivery of

service priorities across the team.


12. Operate in line with the company’s core values and professional standards, demonstrating integrity,

accountability, and respect in all interactions with the public and colleagues, and contributing positively to the

reputation of the service.

title: Critical Operations Supervisor - MECHANICAL (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Critical Operations Supervisor - Mechanical provides day-to-day operational leadership and technical governance to ensure the safe, compliant and reliable performance of all mechanical and cooling infrastructure across the site. This Monday-Friday role is accountable for coordinating mechanical operations, overseeing major works and maintaining regulatory and contractual compliance.

The position participates in a rotating on-call roster to provide after-hours escalation, ensuring timely response to mechanical, thermal or cooling-related incidents. The Supervisor leads the Mechanical workstream across all shift teams, providing expert escalation on complex issues and coordinating critical activities such as planned shutdowns, cooling plant maintenance, thermal risk mitigation, troubleshooting and return-to-service (RTS) validation.

This role is also responsible for ensuring mechanical training, competency and authorisation requirements are met. The Supervisor partners closely with site stakeholders to uplift procedures, enhance plant performance, strengthen operational readiness and continuously improve the mechanical reliability of the facility.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

• Uphold STACK’s 100% uptime objective by providing disciplined operational leadership and oversight of site mechanical and cooling systems.

• Ensure safe and compliant operation of all mechanical systems, including chilled water systems, CRAC/CRAH units, cooling towers, pumps, valves, filtration equipment and associated controls.

• Maintain real-time situational awareness of mechanical system condition, thermal stability, redundancy state and risk indicators through BMS/EPMS and field verification.

• Act as the primary mechanical escalation point for shift teams, providing real-time guidance, diagnostic support and risk evaluation.

• Lead the development, review and implementation of operational and maintenance procedures, including MOPs and SOPs for mechanical systems.

• Coordinate major mechanical activities, including planned shutdowns, incident response, corrective maintenance, onsite troubleshooting and programmed maintenance.

• Provide technical direction during planned maintenance, resets, cooling plant adjustments, valve alignments and energisations to ensure safe execution aligned to site procedures.

• Review and provide input into risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO and return-to-service documentation.

• Verify operational readiness following maintenance, resets, parameter changes or commissioning activities by confirming alarms, redundancy status, thermal performance and control sequences.

• Ensure all operational activities are carried out with due regard to health and safety, business risk and STACK’s 100% uptime objective.

• Act as incident manager for mechanical incidents when required, including during on-call periods.

• Coordinate vendor activities affecting mechanical systems, ensuring safe execution, alignment to site requirements and correct post-work configuration.

• Identify systemic risks, recurring thermal issues, capacity constraints and mechanical design limitations, and escalate as required.

• Improve operational documentation, including SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, shift logs, CMMS data quality, handover standards and alarm-handling procedures within the mechanical workstream.

People

• Model outstanding safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct.

• Provide coaching, uplift and technical mentoring to Senior Data Centre Specialists, Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians to strengthen team capability and execution consistency.

• Reinforce high-quality shift communication, including clear escalation structures, accurate technical context and structured handovers.

• Ensure clear and accurate transfer of information between rotating shifts, maintaining continuity of operations and supporting consistent decision-making across the team.

• Support onboarding and technical familiarisation for new team members, clarifying operating boundaries, site safety and shift expectations.

• Collaborate effectively with Security, Projects, Operations and vendors to support safe and coordinated campus operations.

• Represent Critical Operations during customer visits, tours, audits and technical discussions, maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach at all times.

• Contribute practical insights and recommendations during toolbox talks, performance reviews, drills and operational meetings.

Competencies

• Advanced operational judgement in a mission-critical environment.

• Strong technical capability in mechanical and cooling systems, including chilled water, HVAC and airflow management.

• Expert interpretation of plant telemetry, thermal behaviour, automation sequences and redundancy models.

• Structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.

• Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational data platforms.

• Skilled in coaching, guiding and uplifting technical capability in others.

• Strong written and verbal communication suitable for incidents and customer interactions.

• Calm, authoritative presence during alarms, escalations and operational events.

• Strong coordination and oversight skills for work control, vendor interaction and RTS verification.

• Continuous improvement mindset focused on safety, reliability and operational excellence.

Work Environment / Conditions

• This is a Monday-Friday position with rotating on-call requirements to support after-hours incidents and escalations.

• Work occurs across data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required under site policy.

• Participation in emergency response, readiness exercises and incident management activities is required.

Travel Required

• Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

• Mechanical trade qualification, such as Certificate III/IV in Mechanical, HVAC or Refrigeration, or a mechanical engineering qualification with suitable Australian recognition or registration.

• Extensive experience in data centres or other mission-critical facilities, including utilities, hospitals, Defence or industrial environments.

• Demonstrated expertise operating and monitoring critical cooling and mechanical systems, including CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, cooling towers, airflow and filtration systems.

• Strong background in inspecting, triaging and stabilising mechanical plant under abnormal conditions.

• Experience reviewing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, risk assessments and commissioning documentation.

• Ability to interpret mechanical schematics, chilled water diagrams, airflow layouts, control logic and OEM manuals.

• Knowledge of permit-to-work processes, isolations/LOTO and operational risk frameworks.

• Strong written and verbal communication for technical reporting, incident updates and customer briefings.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

• Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.

• Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.

• Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.

• Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

• Legal entitlement to work in Australia.

• Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.

• Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.

• Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Paid Research Participant - Austrian German Speakers
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native German speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in German actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.

Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native German speaker who grew up in Austria.
  • You use German in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

title: Senior Director, Media & Growth
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

The Senior Director, Media & Growth is a newly created, highly strategic marketing role. This new leader will manage our global paid media strategy and drive measurable growth across our consumer and merchant businesses. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of performance marketing, brand media, and data-driven customer acquisition — responsible for translating business objectives into integrated media plans that accelerate GNA, MAA, and TPV outcomes at scale.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing Operations, this leader will oversee a high-performing team and manage relationships with our agency partners, platform partners, and internal stakeholders across Marketing, Technology, and Finance.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy for the marketing function
  • Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert in marketing
  • Inspire and lead the marketing team to achieve long-term success
  • Align marketing strategies with PayPal-wide strategy and operations
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in marketing practices
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure the marketing function supports overall business goals

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Specific responsibilities include:


Media Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and own the global paid media strategy across all channels — paid search, paid social, display, video, streaming, out-of-home, and emerging platforms
  • Build integrated media plans that connect brand awareness to performance outcomes, ensuring every dollar of investment is tied to a measurable business result
  • Lead the annual and quarterly media planning process in close partnership with Finance and Marketing leadership
  • Define channel investment priorities, audience strategies, and creative rotation frameworks across all markets

Growth & Performance Marketing

  • Own GNA (Gross New Accounts) and MAA (Monthly Active Accounts) growth targets driven by paid media investment
  • Develop and scale a full-funnel performance marketing approach — from upper-funnel demand generation to lower-funnel conversion and activation
  • Lead customer segmentation strategy to ensure media investment is targeted against the highest-value acquisition and re-engagement opportunities
  • Partner with CRM and Lifecycle teams to connect paid and owned channel strategies into a seamless customer journey

Data, Measurement & Optimization

  • Leverage a best-in-class measurement framework — including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), multi-touch attribution, and incrementality testing — to accurately assess media ROI and guide investment decisions
  • Drive paid media instrumentation from current levels to industry-standard 60–80% enablement across partner platforms
  • Build and maintain executive-level reporting on media performance, MROI, and contribution to business KPIs
  • Champion a test-and-learn culture across the media organization, using data to continuously optimize channel mix and creative performance

Agency & Partner Management

  • Serve as the primary executive point of contact for our media agency of record and key platform partners (Meta, Google, TikTok, Amazon, etc.)
  • Hold agency partners accountable to performance, innovation, and ways of working standards
  • Lead media contract negotiations, upfront commitments, and partnership agreements in collaboration with Procurement and Legal

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of media and growth marketing professionals across the US and international markets
  • Build a culture of accountability, analytical rigor, and creative ambition within the media organization
  • Partner across Marketing, Product, Analytics, MarTech, and Finance to ensure the media function operates as a connected, integrated part of the broader business
  • Serve as a cultural carrier and positive energy force within the organization, building a team that is ambitious, collaborative, creatively bold, and enthusiastic about the opportunity ahead

title: GIS Analyst
description:
GIS Analyst
Location: Ft Drum, NY
Job Summary
SYNCADD is actively recruiting a GIS Analyst to support a GIS and Real Property reconciliation effort at Fort Drum in NY State. The GIS analyst will work on-site at Ft Drum in a team environment supporting the Directorate of Public Works (DPW) to maintain and/or develop specific GIS data layers, maps and reports to address Army Real Property compliance requirements.
Candidates must have knowledge of geospatial principles, practices, and standards as well as experience with Microsoft office software; familiarity with creating and maintaining GIS features that comply with the Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment (SDSFIE); and possess exceptional planning, critical thinking, analytical, and effective communication skills. Responsibilities include collecting, updating, and maintain GIS data in accordance with DPW and Army standards; performing data quality control and editing to meet SDSFIE 4.0 GIS data standards; performing analysis and updates to existing and new GIS data to ensure Real Property compliance; filed data collection through GPS, field sensors, and field work or other means; map-mapping and cartographic production; GIS analysis and modeling; and reporting.

  • Conducting data quality control checks, reporting, and standardization to SDSFIE.
  • Ensuring attribute and metadata development meet Army and Ft Drum standards.
  • Fulfilling requests for organizational geospatial data requests.
  • Performing enterprise GIS data maintenance.
  • Conducting Real Property and GIS data reconciliation.
  • Performing field data collection

title: Service Desk Lead
description:
Job Description:

The Service Desk Lead is responsible for the day-to-day operational leadership of the IT Service Desk team, ensuring SLA targets are met, escalations are managed effectively, and analysts are supported, coached, and held accountable to performance standards. This role acts as the bridge between the Service Desk team and IT management, owning team-level metrics, scheduling, quality, and process governance while remaining hands-on for critical incidents.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the Service Desk team, including task allocation, shift/roster scheduling, coverage planning, attendance/leave management, and shift swaps.
  • Conduct coaching, identify skill gaps, coordinate training and onboarding plans, and handle first-line people issues.
  • Own overall team performance against SLAs (FCR, ART, CSAT, backlog, response/abandonment rates), monitoring queues in real time and reallocating resources during volume spikes or shortages.
  • Act as incident commander for major incidents (P1/P2), driving communication, coordinating with Level 2/3 and vendors, and ensuring post-incident reviews are completed.
  • Own escalation paths between Service Desk and Level 2/3 teams, and manage the ITSM tool's queues, routing rules, and SLA configuration.
  • Review and approve knowledge base articles, SOPs, and runbooks for accuracy and consistency.
  • Drive continuous improvement, analysing incident trends for root-cause/problem elimination, identifying automation and self-service opportunities, and leading quality audits (ticket/call/chat reviews) with structured analyst feedback.
  • Own Service Desk SOPs, escalation matrices, and onboarding documentation;
  • Serve as the primary stakeholder contact for Service Desk performance and major incidents; prepare and present performance reports to IT leadership.
  • Represent the Service Desk in cross-functional forums (Change Advisory Board, Problem Management reviews, rollout planning) and lead shift handovers and team huddles.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 5–8 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Help Desk, or Technical Support role guiding analysts including at least 2 years in a team lead, supervisory, or shift lead capacity

• Strong knowledge on ITIL process and hands on of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing systems.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills.

Shift Pattern: U.S. Business Hours / Rotational Shifts (Flexible based on business requirements)

Role is onsite and expected to work from office for 5 days

title: Product Development Intern - Electron Beam Instrumentation
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


Job Description/Responsibilities


We are seeking a highly motivated Product Development Intern to join our team, focusing on the design, development, and testing of advanced electron beam instrumentation for the semiconductor industry. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge technology and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced R&D environment.


In particular, the intern would work in the following areas:

  • Develop methods and test plans for characterization of electron beam based subsystems such as detectors and electron beam sources.
  • Work with vacuum chambers, pumps, valves, gages and related equipment.
  • Design, set up and execute multi-disciplinary experiments.
  • Analyze data and prepare summary reports.
  • Work with simulations based on physical models and build correlations with experimental data.
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers across the company.

Qualifications:

  • Experience with laboratory equipment and data acquisition systems.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong analytical mindset.

Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.


About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Why Plot

Plot is building the next generation of social intelligence — an AI-native platform that helps some of the world's most influential brands understand culture, find emerging trends, and activate their communities at scale. We're a high-growth, venture-backed startup supported by the co-founders of Reddit and Plaid, with customers like Tory Burch, Lululemon, La Roche-Posay, and other household names.

We operate at the intersection of applied AI and large-scale data systems, turning millions of short-form videos every day into structured representations of culture and consumer behavior. Plot makes unstructured social media legible at scale, enabling brands to build a deep, systematic understanding of trends, audiences, and influence.

You'll join a small but mighty team where engineers own systems end-to-end — not tickets. You'll work directly with founders, shape foundational architecture, and make decisions that define how Plot scales for years to come. If you enjoy ambiguous problems, deep systems thinking, and building infrastructure that unlocks entire product surfaces, Plot is the place. It’s also a great fit if you aspire to be a technical founder one day — we operate with a strong founder’s mindset.

What You'll Work On

  • Own the core data systems that power Plot. You’ll take responsibility for how millions of enriched videos flow from ingestion → storage → analytics → product surfaces.

  • Stabilize and harden high-throughput write paths. Our pipelines ingest and enrich data continuously; you’ll diagnose failure modes, reduce error rates, and make ingestion reliable, observable, and predictable.

  • Design data access patterns that stay fast under pressure. You’ll ensure dashboards and analytical queries remain responsive even while large volumes of data are being written concurrently.

  • Separate transactional and analytical concerns. You’ll lead decisions around which workloads belong where, and design the systems and contracts that keep them from stepping on each other.

  • Build read-optimized models for insight, not just storage. This includes partitioning strategies, rollups, and schemas that reflect how data is actually queried — by humans and by AI.

  • Enable AI-native analytics. You’ll shape how our internal tools and AI agents query and reason over data, making it possible to answer complex analytical questions without brute-force scans.

  • Make architectural calls that matter. You’ll evaluate tradeoffs, write RFCs, and guide the evolution of Plot’s data platform as scale, product needs, and AI capabilities grow.

  • Raise the bar for reliability and performance across the team. You’ll define best practices, unblock other engineers, and become a go-to resource for data-related decisions.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience operating Postgres in production under real-world read/write concurrency. You understand partitioning, locking, autovacuum, connection pooling, and why systems fail in subtle ways.

  • Strong systems intuition. You think in bottlenecks, failure modes, and tradeoffs — not just indexes or tooling.

  • Experience designing or owning analytical data architectures, including read-optimized schemas, aggregations, or large-scale querying patterns.

  • Comfort leading ambiguous, high-impact work. You can take a messy system, form a clear mental model, and chart a pragmatic path forward.

  • High ownership mindset. You like digging into logs, metrics, and real data — and you care deeply about correctness, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and a desire to build foundational systems that other engineers and AI systems depend on. No degree requirements.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience

title: Tech II, Field Service

This position manages an assigned territory and travels to perform installation, repair, preventative maintenance, training, and other services on a variety of electromechanical medical devices. title: Students: Earn $100/hr - 3-Day Study for Italian Speakers
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Italian speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Italian actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Italian speaker who grew up in Italy.
  • You use Italian in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

No minimum educational requirements

title: Precision Motion Control Intern
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


The Mechatronics team in KLA's RAPID Division is looking for an intern to develop a model-based control framework for a precision motion stage.
In this project, the intern will build a high-fidelity dynamic model from measured stage performance. The intern will then use modern model-based control methods to design a robust controller, deploy it to the stage hardware, and measure its performance.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Pursuing an MS or PhD with a focus on control systems, mechatronics or precision motion control.
  • Experience with frequency-domain loop shaping and robust control synthesis (e.g., H∞; μ-synthesis).
  • Experience with system identification and fitting models to measured FRF data.
  • Familiarity with multivariable (MIMO) systems, modal analysis and cross-axis coupling.
  • Knowledge of practical controller implementation, including feedforward design, notch and loop-shaping filters, discretization and real-time embedded control.
  • Experience with FRF measurement tools, such as dynamic signal analyzers or swept-sine and noise-based excitation.
  • Experience with Python for data analysis.
  • Experience designing structured test plans and comparing controller performance against a baseline.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in an MS or PhD program in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Coursework or project experience in feedback control systems, including frequency-domain analysis (Bode and Nyquist plots, stability margins).
  • Understanding of dynamic system modeling, transfer functions and state-space representations.
    Skill in MATLAB and/or Simulink for modeling, analysis and control design.
  • Hands-on lab experience running experiments and analyzing measured data.
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills, including documenting and presenting technical results.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Supervisor, Reprogramming (iPSC)
description:
California, US residents click here.

The job details are as follows:

Who We Are


We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.

United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

Who You Are

Lead from the bench and help advance the next generation of cell-based manufacturing. As Supervisor, Reprogramming (iPSC), you will guide a team of Manufacturing Associates while working alongside them to reprogram and scale induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) in a phase-appropriate GMP environment. You will set the pace for safe, compliant, and efficient day-to-day operations, ensuring work is executed in accordance with GMP principles, established procedures, and safety protocols. This is an opportunity for a hands-on leader to combine technical expertise with people leadership and make a meaningful impact on the development of robust, scalable iPSC manufacturing processes.

  • Lead and participate in day-to-day activities of Manufacturing Associates and ensure adequate resources are available to meet production targets. Ensure operations follow phase-appropriate GMP principles, established procedures, and applicable OSHA and Unither safety policies, and promote a strong culture of safety. Manage safety incidents, deviations, and non-conformances, including documenting and investigating events in accordance with established procedures.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point and key decision-maker for production floor operations, ensuring continuity, product quality, and efficiency. Exercise independent judgment on critical operational matters, including adjusting production schedules, responding to unexpected disruptions, and determining whether to proceed under non-ideal conditions in line with GMP principles and established procedures.
  • Perform hands-on manufacturing operations alongside Manufacturing Associates in a phase-appropriate GMP environment, including equipment setup and operation, iPSC reprogramming, culture, expansion, scale-up, and cell banking, material preparation, and in-process testing, while maintaining aseptic technique and good documentation practices
  • Review and approve manufacturing documentation, including batch records, deviations, investigations, and corrective actions
  • Create, review, and revise SOPs and manufacturing procedures to reflect current practices and regulatory expectations
  • Monitor, respond to, and lead resolution of all area equipment alarms and alerts on a 24/7 basis; determine appropriate actions as needed for unexpected system interruptions. Lead troubleshooting efforts for equipment, systems, and processes; and evaluate product status to determine next steps during process disruptions.
  • Initiate and support investigations into process deviations, equipment issues, and operational events; ensure timely resolution and escalation to management as appropriate
  • Proactively plan and adjust schedules to maintain production targets. Participate in short-term and long-term planning, including process scale-up, production ramp-up, tech transfer activities, and operational readiness initiatives.
  • Collaborate with the procurement team to monitor raw material usage rates, maintain accurate inventory levels, and ensure compliance with the operating budget
  • Support implementation, qualification, and validation of new equipment and/or upgrades; assist w/equipment troubleshooting & optimization; contribute to vendor evaluations and outsourcing strategies, providing input on operational feasibility and process impact
  • Conduct performance evaluations, set objectives, and support career development through coaching, mentoring, and development plans; deliver and document on-the-job training for new and current staff on production processes, equipment, and safety procedures; foster a collaborative and accountable team environment
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by leadership


Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a directly related life science specialty field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cell culture and expansion in 2D and 3D systems (including T-flasks, multi-well plates, and bioreactors)
  • Hands-on experience operating cell manufacturing equipment, including automated and closed-system processing platforms, cell separation and culture systems, and standard aseptic processing equipment (e.g., biosafety cabinets, centrifuges, tube welders and sealers)
  • Experience with aseptic technique (open vessel/closed systems), cleanroom practices, and contamination control
  • Understanding of basic cell therapy techniques, including cell isolation, transduction, expansion (2D and 3D format)
  • Ability to work in a regulated cleanroom environment, including extended periods in full gowning
  • Applied knowledge of pharmaceutical GMPs, FDA guidelines, and industry standards. Ability to apply GMP to company specific processes and products.
  • Identify and perform advanced trouble-shooting and assist with technical issues
  • Excellent professional documentation and verbal communication skills. Ability to objectively, accurately, and thoroughly convey complex issues in writing. Ability to produce a large volume of written materials independently.
  • Ability to interact with other departments effectively. Ability to review work performed by other personnel, communicate problems and deficiencies, elicit corrections, and enforce departmental and Company policy and procedures as they relate to manufacturing requirements.
  • Ability to work a rotating schedule that includes weekends and holidays to support routine cell culture activities (e.g., feeding and monitoring), as well as flexible hours and off-shift support to respond to unplanned manufacturing needs
  • Ability to effectively manage a diverse group of skilled manufacturing associates

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of GMP experience
  • 1+ years of direct supervisory experience
  • Hands-on experience with iPSC reprogramming, culture, characterization, banking, and scale-up to 3D/bioreactor systems
  • Basic understanding of quality control, in process checks (e.g., viability, flow cytometry, qPCR, endotoxin)

Job Location

United Therapeutics requires this role to be 100% onsite in our Silver Spring, MD office.

The salary range for this position is $37.98 - $50.48/hour and reflects our good-faith estimate of the compensation for this role at the time of posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on factors such as education, qualifications, experience, skills, geographic location, and business needs, as well as other factors permitted by law at the time of posting. This range may be modified in the future based on company and market factors.

At United Therapeutics, our mission and vision are one. We use our enthusiasm, creativity, and persistence to innovate for the unmet medical needs of our patients and to benefit our other stakeholders. We are bold and unconventional. We have fun, we do good.

Eligible employees may participate in the Company’s comprehensive benefits suite of programs, including medical / dental / vision / prescription coverage, employee wellness resources, savings plans (401k and ESPP), paid time off & paid parental leave benefits, disability benefits, and more. Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Arabic actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Arabic speaker who grew up in Saudi Arabia.
  • You use Arabic in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
