title: Videographer & Video Editor AI Factory Kuwait
description:
CODED is the first tech and AI academy in the Arab world, and the region's go-to place for technology and AI education. We build real technical capability — software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, and emerging technologies — across individuals, youth, and enterprises.

What we are building is talent density. Not headcount. Not volume. A concentrated pool of genuinely exceptional people, inside CODED and across the market we serve.

We only aspire to work with people who are excellent at what they do, and who raise the standard of everyone around them.

About the Role

Videographer & Video Editor

CODED — The First Tech & AI Academy in the Arab World

The Role: Videographer & Video Editor

Department: CODED's AI Factory · Location: Kuwait City, on-site · Type: Full-time preferred, part-time considered for the right profile

The Videographer & Video Editor turns an approved script into a finished video that is ready to publish.

This role owns CODED's video content end to end: pre-production, the shoot, the edit, sound, graphics, captions, and delivery. It is one role, not two. The person in it runs the camera, the audio, and the lights on set, then takes the same footage through to a published master.

Our content has a clear standard: premium, current, and unmistakably on-brand. The craft of this role is making video that performs on social without looking like template content, and knowing what would sink a video before the camera is switched on.

Four domains: 1. Shooting & On-Set Production 2. Editing & Post-Production 3. Brand Quality & Publishing Workflow 4. Archive, Assets & Trends

I. Shooting & On-Set Production (Core Domain)

  • Take an approved script and shoot brief and run pre-production: shot list, location, wardrobe, and permissions
  • Operate mirrorless and DSLR cameras with full manual control: exposure, lens choice, focus, and framing by intent
  • Record and monitor audio live on set. Levels are checked while filming, not discovered in post
  • Light classroom, office, and mixed or natural-light interiors with portable LED kits
  • Direct presenters, trainees, and staff on camera so they look and sound natural
  • Protect the brand on set: clean environments, correct dress, and awareness of cultural red flags before anything is recorded

Objective: every shoot comes back with footage and audio that is usable as captured.

  • Edit in Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve: rough cut, picture lock, multicam, colour correction, and grading
  • Select music that supports speech instead of burying it; layer SFX, cut to beat, duck under dialogue, and deliver at correct platform loudness
  • Apply social-level VFX cleanly: masking, tracking, speed ramps, transitions, and object removal
  • Deliver vertical-first: 9:16, safe zones respected, burned-in Arabic and English captions
  • Export to the correct spec for each platform

Objective: every cut is purposeful. No template edits, no meme overload, no excessive zooms.

III. Brand Quality & Publishing Workflow

  • Get brand review before the shoot and Brand + Marketing sign-off before anything is published
  • Make sure every piece lands the structure: a hook in the first 3 seconds, one clear CTA, 9:16, captioned
  • Work closely with Marketing (briefs and calendar), Brand (review and sign-off), Programs and Academy (access to classes, trainees, and events), and Partnerships (client-facing shoots)

Objective: nothing goes out that the brand would not sign its name to.

  • Keep strict file discipline: naming, backup, and archive on every project
  • Build and maintain a b-roll and asset library the whole team can actually find and use
  • Track what is working on Reels and short-form this month, and adapt trends to a premium brand without turning them into meme content
  • Use AI tools where they genuinely help production: b-roll generation, upscaling, and voice-over cleanup

Objective: the team has the footage it needs, and our output stays current.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 2 years full-time in social-first video, ideally 3 to 5. Agency, in-house brand team, content house, or a self-run creator business with a public body of work all count
  • Real experience both shooting and editing
  • Strong on-set audio and lighting habits, not just camera skills
  • Expert ear for music and sound: you know how to make a mix serve the message
  • Current, hands-on knowledge of short-form platforms and what is performing now
  • Fluent in Arabic and English
  • A clear understanding of, and respect for, Kuwaiti culture, and the judgment to apply it on set
  • Organised, disciplined, and reliable with files and deadlines

Nice to have

  • Motion graphics (2D animation, kinetic Arabic and English typography, lower thirds, logo stings, animated stats)
  • Your own equipment

title: Software Engineer (High Performance/Distributed Computing)
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.



Group/Division

With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.



Come join a highly motivated Software team building Semiconductor Inspection/Review tools by solving high-end Physics problems using software expertise. You will drive innovation of the next generation of CPUs, GPUs, and DL engines like Bionic Chips.


Here is a quick overview of our product from our website (eSL10 e-Beam Defect Inspection | Chip Manufacturing | KLA (kla-tencor.com)


Responsibilities:

  • Writing elegant, clean, code with automated tests to cover it
  • Designing distributed applications
  • Taking full advantage of system resources to deliver high performance computing (HPC) solutions.
  • Defining data classes for efficient processing.

Qualifications:

  • Proficiency with C++ programming is crucial
  • Working on Linux OS
  • Used Object-Oriented principles for software design
  • HPC experience or coursework
  • Understanding of network stacks

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to workload management software
  • Containers and Docker to package software services
  • Passion for Physics

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.



Total Rewards

At the core of the product is AI as a personal companion that supports users on their journey of self-discovery. The product’s key value is helping people gain clarity about who they are, what they want, and why they make certain decisions. Its mission is to help people live happier lives by changing the way they understand themselves and perceive the world.

As a Head of User Acquisition, you will:

  • Own the entire UA function, reporting directly to the CEO — CAC, ROAS, and the ad-to-subscriber path.
  • Build the acquisition system from zero — tracking, attribution, and creative-testing pipeline.
  • Run structured tests on Meta Ads, expanding to other channels once unit economics work.
  • Own budget scaling — validation budget → $100K/month → $1M+/month.
  • Source creatives through in-house, freelance, and UGC channels, and later build and lead the UA team.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has full-funnel paid UA experience — Meta Ads as the primary channel, with working knowledge of TikTok, ASO, and influencer/UGC.
  • Has experience building structured, hypothesis-driven creative testing systems.
  • Has a strong understanding of unit economics — CAC, LTV, payback, ROAS/ROMI.
  • Has a proven track record of scaling budgets from a small test budget to six-figure+ monthly spend without breaking CPA.
  • Has experience with attribution & analytics — Amplitude/GA4-style tools, MMP basics, and A/B testing.
  • Has experience with vendor & creator management — sourcing UGC, agencies, and freelancers through Fiverr/Billo/Modash-style platforms.
  • Has English at Upper-Intermediate (B2)+ level: the product and ads target the English-speaking Tier-1.

Here’s what our hiring flow looks like:

  • Step 2. Interview with the CEO.
  • Step 3. Bar-Raising Interview.

  • Step 5. Job Offer.

Growth & self-realization

  • Build your function from scratch — from processes and approaches to the team.

Flexible working conditions

  • Choose your work format: fully remote or our Kyiv office, with coworking spaces in Lviv and Warsaw.

Care & support

title: PT-C.N.A H (701900-3466)
description:
Position Overview
Responsible for providing routine daily nursing services to assigned residents in a manner that is caring, compassionate and customer-oriented and in accordance with laws, regulations and facility guidelines.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Certification:
High school diploma or equivalent; successfully completed a state-approved Certified Nursing Assistance program; must possess a current certification in good standing, or be able to obtain certification within four months of employment, if allowable by the state; must have CPR certification.

Skills & Requirements: Must possess the ability to read, write and speak the English language, communicate resident condition to others and make independent decisions as needed; must have common working knowledge of all rules, laws and regulations as defined by the state as it relates to skilled nursing; must be patient, friendly, courteous and respectful to residents in any situation, including difficult ones; must be able to move frequently throughout the workday, answer resident call lights, assist with baths, showers, toileting, feeding and personal grooming of the residents; must be able to handle sensitive situations related to the emotional well-being of the residents with patience, dignity and respect; must be able to lift 40 lbs floor to waist; lift 10 lbs waist to shoulder; lift and carry 40 lbs; and push/pull 40 lbs.

Experience: Minimum of six months experience in a long-term care or other geriatric care environment is preferred.

Working Conditions
Works specifically in the nursing department, resident rooms, shower rooms, etc.; bends, lifts, sits, stands and moves frequently throughout the shift; deals with frequent interruptions and possibly upset residents and family members; works regularly scheduled shifts with possible weekends, holidays and other hours based on resident needs; primary responsibility is care of residents but also deals with visitors, government personnel, etc.; participates in required continuing education programs; subject to odors, falls, burns and exposure to infectious diseases, waste, etc., including AIDS and Hepatitis B viruses.

Competencies of Position
Professionalism: Reports to work on time and as scheduled; keeps open communication with direct supervisors to ensure quality care of the residents; promotes teamwork, takes part in problem solving and displays a positive, caring attitude; consistently attends staff meetings, required in-services and other committees as assigned by the facility.

Resident Rights: Promptly reports resident grievances to the nursing supervisors; treats all resident care information with confidentiality; continuously monitors assigned areas to ensure residents are treated fairly and with dignity and respect at all times; conducts nursing care in privacy, including knocking on the door prior to entering a resident's room.

Safety Awareness: Follows safety program guidelines; immediately reports accidents and incidents to supervisors; identifies unsafe working areas and promptly reports to supervisors; promotes safety by working as safely and efficiently as possible; monitors resident rooms to ensure it is clean and neat at all times; consistently follows infection control and universal precautions and other guidelines; identifies and corrects or reports hazardous conditions to supervisors; understands facility emergency and evacuation protocols.

Organizational Skills: Completes assignments in an organized fashion by the end of scheduled shifts; operates with flexibility and shows attention to detail when recording information in resident charts.

Customer Service: Treats all residents, families, co-workers and supervisors with dignity and respect and takes initiative to exceed customer expectations; professional represents the facility, self and position to visitors and residents; demonstrates a positive attitude and willingness to help to all visitors and residents; remains sensitive to all needs through listening, observing and responding appropriately for the position held.

Essential Job Duties

1. Provides quality nursing care to residents and communicates to each resident and family member to build positive relations.
2. Routinely makes rounds and responsively provides proper resident care and service.
3. Assesses residents for condition changes and reports to nurse supervisor.
4. Answers resident call lights promptly and courteously.
5. Delivers meals and performs feeding assistance to residents and provides hydration.
6. Performs vital sign monitoring/charting and observes residents for changes in condition or behavior and reports to nursing supervisors.
7. Provides assistance to residents for showers or baths.
8. Provides assistance with lifting, turning, moving, transporting or transferring residents.
9. Monitors incontinent residents to ensure bed linens and clothing are clean and dry.
10. Assists residents with toileting and bed pans and collects urine, stool and sputum samples as directed.
11. Ensures good hygiene through oral care, hair care, shaving, etc.
12. Changes bed linens and makes beds.
13. Provides proper skin care and promptly reports observations of skin breakdown and pressure areas.
14. Communicates changes and follows plan of care effectively by recording changes in charts.

Other Job Duties

1. Adheres to facility admission, discharge and transfer policies and prepares resident rooms for arrival.
2. Labels, organizes and stores resident's personal belongings, clothing, etc.
3. Provides support and assistance for dying residents and post-mortem care.
4. Receives report from off-going shift or supervisor to better understand resident needs and changes.
5. Promotes interdepartmental teamwork to meet resident needs.
6. Promotes an environment of positive public relations by displaying a calm, caring, warm and friendly atmosphere in department and on each shift.
7. Keeps residents' water pitchers clean and filled with fresh was and within reach of the resident. 8. Provides training to new CNAs, upon request.
9. Ensures cleanliness of water pitchers and provides refills of fresh water as needed.
10. Transfer residents to and from dining room, activities, therapy, etc.
11. Works well with supervision, team members and other departments to properly care for each resident.
12. Rotates residents on a two-hour schedule.
13. Monitors dressings, bandages, etc. and changes, as directed.
14. Arrives to work as scheduled and makes rounds with previous shift.
15. As instructed and appropriate, collects specimens (urine, stools, etc.).

title: Founding Drone & Avionics Technician
description:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as Founding Drone & Avionics Technician

Help us get our autonomous systems airborne. You’ll own electrical integration from prototype to flight. Early team, deep tech, high impact.

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense.

Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for a hands-on operator who’s ready to bring these machines into the real world.

About the Role

As our Founding Drone & Avionics Technician, you’ll play a key role in getting our fleet of autonomous drones ready for flight. Working closely with our engineering team, you’ll establish our professional-grade avionics shop, build harnesses and integration workflows, and ensure every system is measured, tested, and flight-proven. You won’t just follow instructions, you’ll improve the way we work on your initiative and directly with our engineering team.

What You’ll Work On

  • Wire & Build: Assemble and test prototype avionics units, including harnesses and electrical subsystems for UAVs

  • Integrate & Checkout: Install, measure, and verify electronics inside flight vehicles, ensuring robust, repeatable, and high-quality integration

  • Own the Shop: Set up, organize, and maintain our avionics workspace by selecting quality tools and building out a scalable integration process

  • Improve & Suggest: Spot design flaws, propose improvements, and help us move faster and build better

  • Test & Feedback: Support qualification and development testing, from vibration to thermal tests, and loop feedback back to engineering

Your Profile

  • You’ve completed a technical apprenticeship or training in a relevant field, e.g., Fluggeräteelektroniker, Elektroniker, or you’re EASA-certified

  • You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience assembling wiring harnesses and electronics, ideally in aerospace or high-reliability systems

  • You’re proficient in soldering wires, connectors, and PCBs, and you know your way around aerospace crimping and wire tools

  • You’re comfortable using electronic diagnostic tools and have a solid grasp of troubleshooting workflows

  • You care about precision, build quality, and structure. You know that great systems start with clean, reliable integration

  • You bring a proactive, organized approach and a deep sense of ownership. You don't just build, you improve

  • Conversational English is a must; German is a strong plus

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience with sensors, signal chains, and testing setups

  • Operating or tuning drones (and the scars to prove it)

  • Familiarity with CAD, PLM, or MES systems

  • Experience running environmental tests like vibration or thermal

Perks & Benefits

  • Get Certified: We'll train you to become a certified drone pilot

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other (conducted by Michael, our Chief of Staff)

  2. Technical Interview (45 min): (with Lukas, our Hardware Lead)

  3. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5 hrs): We’ll build or test something together, just like on the job (together with our Hardware Team)

  4. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

title: Energy Portfolio Analyst (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Energy Analyst – Markets & Sustainability is a key role within STACK’s Power & Energy team, responsible for energy accounting, consumption forecasting, utility cost validation and administration of STACK’s electricity supply and renewable energy arrangements across its Australian portfolio.

The role will establish and maintain accurate visibility of energy consumption, cost and forecast demand across STACK’s data centres, providing the data and analysis required to support energy procurement, budgeting, sustainability reporting and business decision-making.

The Energy Analyst will also manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs, administer energy contracts and renewable energy certificate requirements, and support the implementation and ongoing management of STACK’s energy accounting systems.

This role will work closely with Power & Energy, Finance, Operations and other relevant stakeholders to ensure energy data, costs and forecasts are accurate, transparent and effectively managed.

Energy Accounting, Forecasting & Analytics

  • Manage energy forecasting across STACK’s Australian data centre portfolio, including validation of electricity invoices against metering data, contracted rates, network tariffs and applicable charges.

  • Investigate billing and consumption discrepancies and coordinate resolution with retailers, Metering Service Providers, DNSPs and internal stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain short-, medium- and long-term electricity consumption forecasts, incorporating actual and forecast data centre load growth.

  • Track actual energy consumption and cost against forecast, identify material variances and provide supporting analysis.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards covering energy consumption, cost, forecasts and other relevant energy metrics.

  • Support Finance with energy accruals, budgeting, reconciliations and energy-related financial reporting.

Energy Markets, Contracts & Stakeholder Administration

  • Support administration of electricity retail contracts, PPAs, metering arrangements and other energy-related agreements.

  • Maintain a central register of energy contracts, key dates, pricing arrangements, obligations and renewal requirements.

  • Manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs relating to billing, metering, consumption data and account administration.

  • Coordinate LGC and other renewable energy certificate surrender requirements, including tracking, reconciliation and supporting evidence.

  • Support electricity procurement activities, retailer engagements, contract renewals and commercial evaluations.

  • Analyse consumption profiles, tariffs and energy costs to support procurement and portfolio decisions.

Energy Systems, Sustainability Reporting & Business Support

  • Support selection, implementation and ongoing administration of STACK’s energy accounting and energy management software, including integration of retailer, metering and internal energy data.

  • Maintain appropriate data-quality, validation and reconciliation processes across energy systems and reporting.

  • Provide accurate energy consumption, renewable energy and supporting data inputs into NABERS, NGER, renewable energy indices and other applicable sustainability and regulatory reporting.

  • Support establishment of energy accounting, metering and reporting processes for new and expanding data centre sites.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and improve energy data collection, invoice validation, forecasting and reporting.

  • Provide ad hoc energy analysis and administrative support as STACK’s energy procurement, sustainability and portfolio requirements continue to evolve.

Competencies

  • Strong numerical, analytical and data-management capability.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify billing and data discrepancies.

  • Understanding of electricity billing, metering, network tariffs and retail electricity arrangements.

  • Strong Excel/ Power BI and data-analysis capability.

  • Ability to develop clear forecasts, dashboards and management reporting.

  • Strong organisational and contract-administration skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple external service providers and internal stakeholders.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and establish processes within a developing function.

  • Commercial mindset and interest in Australian electricity markets and renewable energy.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Energy or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 3–5 years’ relevant experience in energy, utilities, energy accounting, commercial analysis, finance or a related field.

title: Paid Research Participant - French Speakers
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native French speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in French actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.



Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native French speaker who grew up in France.
  • You use French in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Director ERP Program Delivery******Directeur du programme PRE
description:
Version anglaise ci-dessous | English version below


IPEX est l’un des principaux fournisseurs nord-américains de systèmes de canalisations en plastique de pointe. Notre mission est de façonner un avenir meilleur en reliant les collectivités à l’eau et à l’énergie.


Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un Directeur du programme PRE pour se joindre à notre équipe. Ce poste est basé à Oakville (Ontario) ou Montréal (Québec) et relève du vice-président, TI.


Ne manquez pas l’occasion de vous joindre à une équipe diversifiée de professionnels centrés sur l’humain, de leaders d’opinion, d’esprits novateurs et d’entrepreneurs qui remettent en question le statu quo.



Sommaire du poste

À titre de Directeur du programme PRE, vous serez responsable de la gouvernance et de l’exécution de bout en bout de l’écosystème ERP d’IPEX, avec une responsabilité particulière à l’égard du programme de transformation SAP S/4HANA. En étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants des secteurs d’affaires et des technologies de l’information, vous assurerez la réalisation d’une initiative stratégique d’envergure visant à soutenir les objectifs opérationnels et la croissance à long terme de l’entreprise.


Cette fonction représente une occasion unique de jouer un rôle de premier plan au sein de l’un des plus importants programmes de transformation technologique et organisationnelle d’IPEX. À la croisée des technologies, des opérations et de la gouvernance d’entreprise, vous veillerez à l’alignement des priorités d’affaires avec l’exécution du programme à l’échelle de notre réseau manufacturier nord-américain. La personne retenue possède une expertise approfondie de SAP, une solide expérience en gouvernance de programmes et la capacité de piloter des initiatives complexes dans un environnement en constante évolution.



Responsabilités principales

  • Assurer le succès du programme grâce à un partenariat tripartite structuré entre les TI, les unités d’affaires et l’intégrateur de systèmes, en définissant clairement les rôles, les droits décisionnels et les responsabilités à tous les niveaux de gouvernance.
  • Être responsable de l’atteinte des résultats d’affaires ciblés, de la réalisation des bénéfices attendus ainsi que de la stabilisation opérationnelle suivant les principales phases de déploiement et les mises en production.
  • Établir et appliquer les cadres de gouvernance du programme, incluant les points de contrôle, les comités de pilotage, les registres de risques et les mécanismes d’escalade.
  • Gérer les calendriers intégrés du programme, les plans de ressources, les risques, les interdépendances et les budgets excédant 10 M$.
  • Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires composées de plus de 50 employés internes et consultants externes.
  • Assurer la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction et au conseil d’administration, notamment les tableaux de bord de performance, les prévisions financières et le suivi des jalons stratégiques.
  • Établir et maintenir des relations de confiance avec les intégrateurs de systèmes et les fournisseurs stratégiques, tout en assurant le respect rigoureux des engagements contractuels, des échéanciers et des normes de performance.
  • Piloter les stratégies de préparation organisationnelle, de gestion du changement et de communication en partenariat avec les équipes responsables de la transformation et des affaires chez IPEX.
  • Promouvoir la standardisation des processus, la gouvernance des données et la gestion des données maîtres à l’échelle de l’entreprise.



Qualifications et expérience

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience progressive en leadership dans le domaine des technologies de l’information, dont un minimum de 5 ans dans des fonctions de direction associées à la livraison de programmes ERP.
  • Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, en informatique, en génie ou en administration des affaires (obligatoire); MBA fortement souhaité.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite d’implantations complètes de SAP S/4HANA (greenfield ou brownfield) au sein d’environnements manufacturiers ou industriels.
  • Expérience de gestion de programmes ERP pluriannuels comportant des budgets supérieurs à 10 M$ et des équipes de plus de 50 personnes réparties sur plusieurs sites et plusieurs pays.
  • Excellente connaissance des modules SAP S/4HANA; familiarité avec SAP BTP ainsi qu’avec la gestion des versions et des environnements SAP.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication exécutive et capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes auprès de la haute direction et du conseil d’administration.
  • Solides aptitudes en négociation, en gestion de fournisseurs et en influence au sein d’environnements matriciels.
  • Capacité démontrée à évoluer dans l’ambiguïté, à prendre des décisions sous pression et à instaurer un climat de confiance auprès d’équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Aptitude à diriger des transformations organisationnelles d’envergure en favorisant l’adhésion, l’alignement et l’engagement des parties prenantes.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l’atteinte des résultats convenus, la réalisation des bénéfices escomptés, l’amélioration de la performance opérationnelle et l’atteinte des objectifs du programme.
  • Capacité à identifier, évaluer et atténuer les risques de façon proactive tout en assurant l’efficacité des mécanismes de gouvernance et d’escalade.
  • Engagement envers l’innovation, l’optimisation des processus et l’excellence opérationnelle afin de maximiser la valeur d’affaires et les capacités de la plateforme ERP.

Mobilité :
Une mobilité est requise selon les besoins de l'entreprise et les étapes clés du programme, incluant des visites dans les installations d'IPEX, sur les sites de projets et auprès de partenaires, au besoin.


IPEX s’engage à offrir des mesures d’adaptation aux personnes en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement. Sur demande, nous collaborerons avec les candidats qualifiés afin de fournir des accommodements adaptés à leurs besoins en matière d’accessibilité. Les demandes d’adaptation sont les bienvenues à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection. Pour obtenir une mesure d’adaptation, veuillez communiquer avec les Ressources humaines à l’adresse askhr@ipexna.com.

______________________________________________________________


IPEX is one of the North American leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.


We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Director, ERP Delivery. This role is based in our Oakville, ON or Montreal, QC location and reports to the VP, IT.


Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!


Job Summary

As Director, ERP Delivery, you will be accountable for the end-to-end governance and delivery of IPEX's ERP landscape, with a primary focus on our SAP S/4HANA transformation program. Working in partnership with business and IT leaders, you will help drive the successful execution of a complex, multi-year transformation initiative that supports IPEX's strategic and operational objectives.

This is an opportunity to play a key leadership role in one of IPEX's most significant technology and business transformation programs. You will operate at the intersection of technology, operations, and executive leadership, helping to align business priorities with program delivery while supporting our North American manufacturing footprint. The ideal candidate brings deep SAP expertise, strong program governance capabilities, and the ability to lead large-scale initiatives in a complex and evolving environment.



Principal Responsibilities

  • Drive program success through a deliberate three-way partnership among IT, the Business, and the System Integrator, with clearly defined roles, decision rights, and accountability across all levels of governance.
  • Accountable for delivery of targeted business outcomes, value realization, and operational stabilization following key deployment milestones and go-live events.
  • Establish and enforce program governance frameworks including stage gates, steering cadences, risk registers, and escalation protocols.
  • Manage integrated program schedules, resource plans, risks, dependencies, and budgets exceeding $10M.
  • Lead cross-functional teams of 50+ internal staff and external consultants.
  • Drive executive and board-level reporting including program health dashboards, financial forecasts, and milestone tracking.
  • Build and sustain high-trust partnerships with system integrators and third-party vendors while maintaining rigorous accountability to contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and performance standards.
  • Lead organizational readiness, change management, and communications strategies in partnership with the IPEX Change Management and Business Leads.
  • Champion process standardization, data governance, and master data management across the enterprise.



Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive IT leadership and a minimum of 5 years in senior ERP program delivery roles.
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or Business (required); MBA strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record leading full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations (greenfield or brownfield) in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Experience managing multi-year ERP programs with budgets exceeding $10M and teams of 50+ across multi-plant, multi-country environments.
  • Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA modules; familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP release and environment management.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business language for C-suite and board audiences.
  • Strong negotiation, vendor management, and influencing skills in a matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, drive decisions under pressure, and build trust across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to effectively lead large-scale organizational change, driving alignment, adoption, and commitment across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated accountability for delivering agreed outcomes, benefits realization, operational improvements, and program objectives.
  • Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks while ensuring effective governance and escalation processes.
  • Champions innovation, process optimization, and operational excellence to maximize business value and ERP platform capabilities.



Travel: Travel required based on business needs and key program milestones, including visits to IPEX locations, project sites, and partner locations as necessary.


IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at askhr@ipexna.com.

title: PRN-C.N.A H (701900-4860)
description:
Position Overview
Responsible for providing routine daily nursing services to assigned residents in a manner that is caring, compassionate and customer-oriented and in accordance with laws, regulations and facility guidelines.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Certification:
High school diploma or equivalent; successfully completed a state-approved Certified Nursing Assistance program; must possess a current certification in good standing, or be able to obtain certification within four months of employment, if allowable by the state; must have CPR certification.

Skills & Requirements: Must possess the ability to read, write and speak the English language, communicate resident condition to others and make independent decisions as needed; must have common working knowledge of all rules, laws and regulations as defined by the state as it relates to skilled nursing; must be patient, friendly, courteous and respectful to residents in any situation, including difficult ones; must be able to move frequently throughout the workday, answer resident call lights, assist with baths, showers, toileting, feeding and personal grooming of the residents; must be able to handle sensitive situations related to the emotional well-being of the residents with patience, dignity and respect; must be able to lift 40 lbs floor to waist; lift 10 lbs waist to shoulder; lift and carry 40 lbs; and push/pull 40 lbs.

Experience: Minimum of six months experience in a long-term care or other geriatric care environment is preferred.

Working Conditions
Works specifically in the nursing department, resident rooms, shower rooms, etc.; bends, lifts, sits, stands and moves frequently throughout the shift; deals with frequent interruptions and possibly upset residents and family members; works regularly scheduled shifts with possible weekends, holidays and other hours based on resident needs; primary responsibility is care of residents but also deals with visitors, government personnel, etc.; participates in required continuing education programs; subject to odors, falls, burns and exposure to infectious diseases, waste, etc., including AIDS and Hepatitis B viruses.

Competencies of Position
Professionalism: Reports to work on time and as scheduled; keeps open communication with direct supervisors to ensure quality care of the residents; promotes teamwork, takes part in problem solving and displays a positive, caring attitude; consistently attends staff meetings, required in-services and other committees as assigned by the facility.

Resident Rights: Promptly reports resident grievances to the nursing supervisors; treats all resident care information with confidentiality; continuously monitors assigned areas to ensure residents are treated fairly and with dignity and respect at all times; conducts nursing care in privacy, including knocking on the door prior to entering a resident's room.

Safety Awareness: Follows safety program guidelines; immediately reports accidents and incidents to supervisors; identifies unsafe working areas and promptly reports to supervisors; promotes safety by working as safely and efficiently as possible; monitors resident rooms to ensure it is clean and neat at all times; consistently follows infection control and universal precautions and other guidelines; identifies and corrects or reports hazardous conditions to supervisors; understands facility emergency and evacuation protocols.

Organizational Skills: Completes assignments in an organized fashion by the end of scheduled shifts; operates with flexibility and shows attention to detail when recording information in resident charts.

Customer Service: Treats all residents, families, co-workers and supervisors with dignity and respect and takes initiative to exceed customer expectations; professional represents the facility, self and position to visitors and residents; demonstrates a positive attitude and willingness to help to all visitors and residents; remains sensitive to all needs through listening, observing and responding appropriately for the position held.

Essential Job Duties

1. Provides quality nursing care to residents and communicates to each resident and family member to build positive relations.
2. Routinely makes rounds and responsively provides proper resident care and service.
3. Assesses residents for condition changes and reports to nurse supervisor.
4. Answers resident call lights promptly and courteously.
5. Delivers meals and performs feeding assistance to residents and provides hydration.
6. Performs vital sign monitoring/charting and observes residents for changes in condition or behavior and reports to nursing supervisors.
7. Provides assistance to residents for showers or baths.
8. Provides assistance with lifting, turning, moving, transporting or transferring residents.
9. Monitors incontinent residents to ensure bed linens and clothing are clean and dry.
10. Assists residents with toileting and bed pans and collects urine, stool and sputum samples as directed.
11. Ensures good hygiene through oral care, hair care, shaving, etc.
12. Changes bed linens and makes beds.
13. Provides proper skin care and promptly reports observations of skin breakdown and pressure areas.
14. Communicates changes and follows plan of care effectively by recording changes in charts.

Other Job Duties

1. Adheres to facility admission, discharge and transfer policies and prepares resident rooms for arrival.
2. Labels, organizes and stores resident's personal belongings, clothing, etc.
3. Provides support and assistance for dying residents and post-mortem care.
4. Receives report from off-going shift or supervisor to better understand resident needs and changes.
5. Promotes interdepartmental teamwork to meet resident needs.
6. Promotes an environment of positive public relations by displaying a calm, caring, warm and friendly atmosphere in department and on each shift.
7. Keeps residents' water pitchers clean and filled with fresh was and within reach of the resident. 8. Provides training to new CNAs, upon request.
9. Ensures cleanliness of water pitchers and provides refills of fresh water as needed.
10. Transfer residents to and from dining room, activities, therapy, etc.
11. Works well with supervision, team members and other departments to properly care for each resident.

title: Talent Pool (Future Opportunities)
description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Talent Pool - Future Opportunities

If we don't currently have an open role that interests you then you can still let us know you'd like to be a Spartan! We're always eager to hear from talented, ambitious people who want to be part of our mission to build the future of commodity trading!

By joining our Talent Pool, you can let us know you're interested in future opportunities at Sparta and you're giving us permission to reach out to you when a role opens up that we feel could match your experience or interests.

When you apply we will review your application against anything we're hiring for right now. We'll keep your details in our system and if we feel there's a potential match now or in the near future we'll reach out to you.

If at any time you change your mind and want us to delete your data, please get in touch and let us know!

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

The Security Systems Engineer will be responsible for the integration of security systems and relevant data into a larger technology platform that will improve the visibility and efficiency of the DC properties in the region, with focus on Japan.

A good knowledge and hands-on experience of physical security application software and hardware in the data centre domain is a must. The candidates must be able to understand security concepts, risk management, and operations.

Responsibility

  • Work with Operational Technology team on the deployment of security systems for projects on new and existing buildings.

  • Carry out planning and solutioning of security systems for new projects.

  • Work with Security Consultant/other Consultants to review security systems design. When necessary, create high-level design principles, markups/ sketches, and reports as design direction to the consultants/ contractors.

  • Assist in research and develop security engineering standards, guidelines, and Basis of Design (BOD).

  • Work with internal key stakeholders to make continuous improvement on Security Systems platforms.

  • Assist in evaluating security tender for security vendors and manage their progress.

  • Perform periodic inspections and tracking of progress of security installation, programming, and testing during construction stage as required.

  • Create hardware inventory/matrix of security devices and assist in developing test scripts for Commissioning.

  • Liaise and coordinate with Delivery team during construction period on security systems.

  • Work with key technology partners to support the various internal teams in the delivery and commissioning of new projects.

  • Work with security vendors on managing and reviewing security systems programming on new and existing buildings. This includes but not limited to: Network and systems settings; Add/modify/remove/ relocate security devices; Setup video recording profiles and parameters; Setup access control parameters, timing, interlocks, etc; Setup GUI, dashboards, and virtual maps; Setup integration between Video Surveillance System, Electronic Access Control Systems, Intrusion Detection System, and others; Setup alarms, alerts, notifications; Perform regular backups and maintenance work on software applications where required; Perform any other configurations & settings as required by Operational Technology and local Security Operations team.

  • Work with local Security Operations Team and Critical Operations Team to provide inputs on system reliability, maintenance, and improvement works.

  • Be a point of escalation in Operational Technology team and provide advice to the local operation teams during security systems incidents/events affecting site operation.

  • Provide technical assistance/advice to the local Security Operations Team and maintenance vendors to troubleshoot and identify security systems issues, including but not limited to the security application software and end-devices.

  • Provide technical assistance/advice to the local Security Operations Team and maintenance vendors to ensure the system maintenance, planned restarts, firmware & software upgrades, and any planned activities are delivered exceeding standards including managing effective reports of the activities.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Engineering field.

  • Must have at least six (6) to eight (8) years of experience in the management, deployment, or maintenance of physical security, monitoring, and alarm systems for Data Centres or other related mission critical facilities.

  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in administering and managing facility preventative maintenance programs is preferred.

  • Candidates with training experience in various security products (Genetec, Axis Communications, Hanwha Vision, Mercury, HID, Gallagher) are strongly preferred. Any other certifications with other security Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) will are preferred.

  • Must have operational knowledge of physical security systems, such as: Integrated Security Management System (ISMS); Video Surveillance System (VSS)/CCTV; Electrical Access Control System (EACS); Perimeter Intrusion Detection System (IDS); Video Intercom System (VIS); Electronic Key Management System (EKMS); Physical security barriers (anti-tailgating barriers, vehicle gates/barriers).

  • Ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal staff.

  • Ability to coordinate, supervise, and communicate with contractors who perform maintenance in the data center.

title: Landscaping & Irrigation Lead – Hands-On Working Lead
description:
Who We Are

Aro Homes is a thriving, purpose-driven company on a mission to redefine residential construction. Aro Homes was founded to create well designed, precision engineered homes that are beautiful, livable, and durable, while being built multiple times faster and having a positive impact on the environment.

We are a diverse and experienced group of passionate and curious designers, builders, engineers, product developers, and businesspeople who are passionate about and committed to delivering on our mission. We've demonstrated there is a massive opportunity to reduce waste and improve sustainability while building homes in a fraction of the time it takes traditionally. We utilize a repeatable, multi-disciplinary, and product-driven approach which is unique in the industry. We are funded by world-class investors who care about transforming industries for the better, including Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors. If you share the desire to leave a lasting positive impact on the world and to join a strong culture of intelligent, passionate people, then let's start a conversation.

What You Will Be Responsible For

We are looking for a Fencing Lead to perform and oversee fencing and gate installations, repairs, and warranty work across our residential construction projects in the South Bay.

This is a hands-on working lead position for someone who enjoys building and repairing fences, solving problems in the field, and guiding small crews of temporary workers to deliver high-quality results.

Your primary focus will be installing, maintaining, and repairing residential fences and gates, including addressing warranty-related issues. You'll also support other construction activities as needed, such as retaining wall construction and basic landscaping tasks. Secondary focus will be to support Quality and Warranty related tasks.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your daily work, lead by example, and contribute to building high-quality homes while maintaining a safe, collaborative, and productive work environment.

What You'll Do

Fencing & Gate Installation and Repairs

  • Perform daily hands-on installation on new building sites, coordinating timeing of installation with the Asst, Superintendent of Warranty and the Site Supt., maintenance, and repair of residential fences and gates, including measuring, cutting, assembling, and ensuring proper alignment and functionality.

  • Diagnose and resolve warranty-related issues involving fences, gates, hardware, and posts, ensuring repairs and installations meet quality standards and project specifications.

  • Dig and set fence posts, including mixing, pouring, and finishing concrete for posts, footings, and other small construction applications.

Crew Leadership & Field Coordination

  • Lead and work alongside small crews of temporary construction workers, assigning daily tasks, demonstrating proper techniques, and ensuring safe, productive, high-quality work.

  • Coordinate daily work priorities with field supervisors and other construction teams to support project schedules.

  • Promote safe work practices and ensure team members follow established safety procedures, including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).

  • Communicate project progress, material needs, and potential challenges to field management.

General Construction & Site Support

  • Assist with building and repairing retaining walls, including material preparation and installation.

  • Manually move, carry, and position iron brackets, metal components, and other construction materials when needed, using safe material-handling practices.

  • Support landscaping activities as needed, including laying and connecting basic irrigation piping.

  • Assist with site preparation, digging, grading, cleanup, and other general construction activities.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing residential fences and gates OR 2+ years experience with general home construction with the ability to complete work independently.

  • Experience using construction hand tools, power tools, and measuring equipment safely and effectively.

  • Ability to take accurate measurements, follow construction instructions, and deliver quality workmanship.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality and workplace safety.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with team members while managing assigned tasks independently.

  • Reliable transportation and the ability to travel between multiple residential construction sites throughout the South Bay during the workday.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience constructing or repairing retaining walls, including related concrete work and/or general home construction

  • Knowledge of concrete mixing, pouring, and setting fence posts a plus

  • Experience leading, coordinating, or guiding construction workers, including temporary labor crews a plus

  • Experience working with various fencing materials, including wood, metal, and composite materials.

  • Familiarity with residential new construction and post-construction warranty repairs.

  • Basic landscaping experience, including installing irrigation piping.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to perform physically demanding construction work, including prolonged standing, walking, bending, kneeling, squatting, digging, and working on uneven surfaces.

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs independently, with heavier materials handled using team assistance or appropriate lifting equipment.

  • Ability to safely handle and move fencing materials, lumber, metal brackets, concrete, and other construction supplies.

  • Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions and at active residential construction sites.

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join an outstanding start-up team and grow a purpose-driven company from the ground up.

  • Competitive salary package.

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits.

  • Equity in the company.

At Aro Homes, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you have a disability or special need that requires an accommodation to complete an application, please do not hesitate to let us know at people@aro.homes. If you're excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Sales Engineer, Logistics
description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As we scale our logistics business, we are hiring a Senior Sales Engineer to be the technical lead on Altana’s work with logistics service providers and customs brokers. Following our acquisition of Cervo, our product surface now spans transaction screening, shared product catalog, duty calculation, post-entry audit, and agentic entry writing, and the deals that win are the ones where someone can map a broker’s actual entry-writing workflow today, show them what it looks like on Altana, and prove the integration path is real. You’ll own that work: demos, solution design, architecture conversations, and the technical narrative that carries a deal from first call to signed order form.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation, and act as the voice of the customer back to our product and engineering teams. This is a high-leverage hire on a fast-moving vertical.

You Will

  • Achieve mastery of the full Altana product surface area and run demos that hold up with brokerage operations staff, IT leadership, and executive buyers alike, whether it’s an impromptu whiteboard session or a prepared narrative demo
  • Design solutions for complex customer environments, mapping current-state operational workflows to a credible future state on Altana, and documenting the gap between them in terms a customer recognizes as their own business
  • Speak fluently to the technical architecture of the platform: data models, APIs, EDI and file-based integration patterns, and how Altana lands inside the systems logistics providers already run
  • Serve as the bridge between the commercial and product organizations, translating field reality into product input and product direction into field-ready positioning
  • Support the sales process with new and existing customers in the customs and trade space, identifying use cases that address stakeholder needs before they’ve been articulated
  • Contribute to the Altana product development process in collaboration with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and customer-facing stakeholders

About You

  • 5+ years in pre-sales engineering, solutions consulting, or solution architecture, selling technical software into trade, customs, logistics, or enterprise supply chain
  • Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and executive audiences
  • A track record of current-state to future-state workflow design on genuinely complex, multi-stakeholder operational processes
  • Working fluency in systems architecture and integration: APIs, EDI, file-based transfer, and data modeling, with enough depth to hold your own with a customer’s IT team
  • The ability to correlate a customer’s specific business problems with Altana’s solutions
  • Customs brokerage or freight forwarding operations experience is a strong plus, including familiarity with ABI, CargoWise, NetCHB, or HTS classification workflows
  • You possess a passion for tackling complex challenges within global trade
  • Nice to Haves:
    • You prototype. You can stand up a rough working artifact using modern AI tooling, notebooks, or low-code and put it in front of a prospect to shorten the feature feedback loop
    • Experience capturing voice of customer in a structured way and translating it into product input, primarily from prospects and secondarily from live accounts
    • Exposure to agentic or AI-assisted automation in a live operational setting

This role is based in New York or Washington, DC with hybrid work flexibility.

Salary Ranges and Benefits

New York City: $155,000 - $185,000 USD
Washington, DC: $150,000 - $175,000 USD

The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position. The base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Altana's total compensation package. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  • Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Oﬀ (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.
  • Parental Leave: We oﬀer industry leading Paid Parental Leave (PPL), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.
  • Health Benefits: We have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. Our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA). There is also a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option.
  • Supplemental Benefits: Altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and AD&D insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.
  • 401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Fidelity 401(k) retirement savings program.
  • Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!
  • Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.
  • Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support.
  • Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre-tax funds for childcare expenses

The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Our Values

Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana’s culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

  • Trust: Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
  • Resilience: In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It’s how we respond when things don’t go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
  • Stewardship: We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
  • Courage: Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. It’s the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. We know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. Courage fuels our growth mindset. It means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it’s demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

At Altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. Our employment opportunities and decisions are based on business needs and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family care or medical leave status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations in the areas in which we operate. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, in any situation.

Offers related to employment at Altana will come from an Altana.ai email address. We will never ask for payment as part of the interview or onboarding process.

title: Tool Technician
description:
Azenta UK, Ltd.

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity

Job Title

Tool Technician

Job Description

Tool Technician

Based in Wotton, Surrey (Own transport is required due to Rural location)

Monday - Friday / 8am - 4.30pm


The Tool technician is tasked with supporting the production department daily, based in the tool room. Working with other team members cleaning and servicing of Injection moulding tools with timely turnaround to maintain production schedules. The cleaning and servicing of the injection moulding tools requires good attention to detail and quality of workmanship that are vital to this role.


What You'll Be Doing


The Tooling technician will be servicing and cleaning injection mould tools, stripping them down for cleaning, inspecting for issues and reporting any found, reassembling the tools after servicing, and returning the tools to the production department. On occasion other responsibilities for the repair, maintenance, and calibration of tools, jigs, fixtures, and instruments may be required..

  • Daily servicing & cleaning of mould tools in the tool room or in the factory.
  • Carrying out the repairs, modifications and servicing of injection moulding tools and other associated tooling.
  • Document service & repair work by completing electronic records, including photographs of issues documented.
  • At times support production by completing cleans or repairs in the clean room factory.
  • To carry out, cleaning and servicing on other toolroom and production equipment as required from time to time.
  • Assist in equipment repairs and breakdown if required.
  • Maintaining a clean and safe working environment.

What You'll Bring

  • You will hold a C&G's, NVQ or Apprenticeship trained
  • Solid experience in mechanical assembly & disassembly and basic wiring.
  • Experience of Manual and CNC machine tools to include all or some of the following: Surface Grinder, CNC, VMC, Milling and Centre Lathe
  • Mechanical Engineering / toolmaker apprenticeship, with experience in injection molding tools although not essential.
  • High precision injection tooling, polishing, and finishing experience is desirable. Hot runner experience and multi-cavity high is also advantageous
  • Be able to read and understand 2D component Drawings, experience with wiring drawings also advantageous
  • Core Computer skills using email, excel and word documents.
  • Work in a small team with good communication & co-operation
