title: Temporary Research Participant (Arabic Language) - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Arabic speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Arabic actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Arabic speaker who grew up in the UAE.
  • You use Arabic in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Sr. Specialist IT Tech lead planning
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

Your Role at Vantive

We are seeking a Senior Specialist, IT Tech Lead planning to serve as a Technical Lead, responsible for ensuring supply chain planning global application meet business requirements and remain in a steady state throughout it’s lifecycle. This role requires hands-on experience with supply chain planning application such as Rapid Response.

As the Sr Specialist, IT Tech Lead planning you will:

  • Support regional US/Canada Demand and supply planning team to develop a business process design that leverages Rapid Response capabilities; Providing high levels of customer service.
  • Help ensure that supply chain data, planning models, integrations, and workflows operate accurately and efficiently in Kinaxis global application. Identify opportunities to improve planning accuracy, system performance, automation, and user experience for better adoption of the tool.
  • Lead system testing execution and change management in a regulated and non-regulated environment.
  • Oversee system maintenance, upgrades, defect tracking, and issue resolution in collaboration with IT and business teams.

Open to applicants across the country, this is a remote position

What You’ll Be Doing

System Ownership & Governance

  • Implement solutions that align with business needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain system documentation, including functional requirements, technical design specifications, validation plans, and change control records.
  • Ensure systems remain in a validated state throughout their lifecycle.

Technical Solution Design

  • Gather, analyze, and document technical requirements, workflows, and process improvements.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical specifications.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to develop and deploy configurable solutions in Rapid Response.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned with Vantive’s Digital Transformation strategy.

Validation, Testing & Compliance

  • Develop and execute test scripts, UAT scenarios, and validation plans for new implementations and system changes.
  • Manage risk assessments, audits, and regulatory inspections related to system validation and compliance.

System Maintenance, Enhancements & Issue Resolution

  • Oversee system upgrades, patches, and maintenance, recommending enhancements as needed.
  • Manage issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution for system defects.
  • Work closely with business process owners to ensure applications align with operational needs.
  • Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for system support and enhancements.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate should have a strong technical foundation with hands-on experience in enterprise application support, configuration, and deployment.

Key technical competencies include:

  • Kinaxis Configuration: Configure planning workbooks, worksheets, alerts, scenarios, schedule task, scorecards, automation chain and dashboards in Rapid response.
  • Data Integration: Support the integration of data from ERP systems such as JDE or Oracle into Kinaxis using available integration mechanisms and interfaces.
  • Data Modelling: Work with supply chain data, hierarchies, measures, calculations, attributes, and planning logic.
  • Technical Development: Build or maintain calculations, filters, queries, data transformations, and automation workflows supported by the Kinaxis environment.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Knowledge of AWS or Azure, including experience with deploying, configuring, and maintaining applications in a cloud environment.
  • Application Deployment & Support: Familiarity with system integrations, web services (APIs), and troubleshooting production issues. Investigate data discrepancies, integration failures, calculation errors, performance issues, and planning exceptions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Planning applications, business systems analysis, or enterprise systems
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Kinaxis Rapid Response/Maestro, including Demand Planning and Supply Planning modules
  • Strong knowledge of Kinaxis platform Data modeling concepts (table structures, linkages, configuration)
  • Ability to develop and execute test scripts, validation plans, and system documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certification in Kinaxis Author Level 1, Administrator Level 1 and Integration Level 1
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or cloud-based environments.
  • Basic project management experience (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to address complex system issues.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good Team player

Reasonable Accommodation

title: LVN Intake - WellMed Central Brownsville
description:
$1,000 Sign on Bonus for External Candidates

Explore opportunities with WellMed, part of the Optum family of businesses. We believe all patients are entitled to the highest level of medical care. Here, you will be part of a team who shares your passion for helping people achieve improved health outcomes. Explore rewarding opportunities for physicians, clinical staff and non-patient-facing roles. Join us and discover the meaning behind Caring. Connecting. Growing together.


Under the direction of providers (defined as an MD, DO, DPM, NP or PA) or RNs, the LVN/LPN provides clinical support functions and professional nursing care to patients using established standards of clinical nursing care and procedures approved by WellMed and applicable state board of nursing. Is an active member of the health care team to assess patients' needs, provide input into the plan of care and implement prescribed interventions.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Performs all nursing duties within the scope of a Licensed Vocational/Practical Nurse (procedures, injections, medication administration, EKGs, phlebotomy) as determined by the applicable State Board of Nursing
  • Participates in implementing established education plans for patients and their families with common health problems and well defined health learning needs
  • Coordinates patient care as directed by providers, RNs, and policies, including referrals, transition visits, medications, procedures and follow up
  • Documents chief complaint and rooms patients according to policy and procedures, prepares patient for examination
  • Telephonically obtains information on chief complaint and symptoms and accurately relays information to provider
  • Collects data and performs 'focused' nursing assessment of patients; assists in the evaluation of a patient's response to treatment and identifies patient's needs; communicates findings to the provider
  • Records patient assessment and care in the medical record in an accurate and timely manner
  • Reviews the patient record, chart, reports (including laboratory and x-ray), and other pertinent information for patients prior to being seen by the provider and reports relevant information to the provider and/or RN
  • Provides a safe environment (OSHA standards) for patients and staff in the clinic
  • Ensures patient confidentiality (HIPAA) at all times and treats patients with courtesy and respect
  • Organizes exam and treatment rooms, stocks and cleans rooms and sterilizes instruments
  • Practices standard infection control precautions
  • Ensures medication management follows policies and procedures; appropriately documents medications & immunizations in patient records
  • Follows laboratory management polices & procedures and CLIA standards; collects lab samples and ensures proper labeling
  • Fulfills medication refill requests following approved protocols
  • If certified in IV therapy; starts peripheral lines, monitors and adjusts flow rates, prime IV lines, changes dressing on IV sites (if needed) and discontinues venous lines
  • Performs all other related duties as assigned

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Current and unrestricted State Vocational/Practical Nursing license
  • Current BLS certification
  • Knowledge of medical terminology and medical office procedures
  • Proficient computer skills to work efficiently with electronic medical records
  • Effective listening and communication skills; proper use of grammar and spelling
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations
  • Ability to perform medical procedures, give injections and perform phlebotomy
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationship with providers/staff, patients, and the community
  • Good communication and customer service skills
  • If required by clinic, IV certification must be obtained
  • This position requires Tuberculosis screening as well as proof of immunity to Measles, Mumps, Rubella, Varicella, Tetanus, Diphtheria, and Pertussis through lab confirmation of immunity, documented evidence of vaccination, or a doctor's diagnosis of disease


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in a medical setting
  • IV certification
  • Knowledge of ICD-10 and CPT coding
  • Bilingual in Spanish

title: Produktionstekniker
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact – on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we’re pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.


As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

Om jobbet

Som vores nye Produktionstekniker bliver dit primære ansvar at understøtte og implementere tekniske løsninger i vores Manufacturing Center. Du vil spille en central rolle i at optimere vores produktionsprocesser, løse tekniske udfordringer, og bidrage til løbende forbedringer på tværs af organisationen.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil omfatte:

  • TPM, 5S, SOP og VSM.

Som person er du proaktiv, og tager selv initiativ til at identificere muligheder og skabe forbedringer. title: Aftersales Digitalization Business Partner
description:
About the role:

As an Aftersales Digitalization Business Partner, you will act as the digitalization partner for the local aftersales organization, connecting local business teams and dealer operations with BYD’s European Aftersales Business Digitalization team.

This is not a traditional IT support or system coordination role. You will work closely with business teams, dealers, Digital Product Owners and end users to understand business problems, identify digitalization opportunities, shape practical solutions, and drive them into effective digital capabilities.

You will contribute across the full delivery lifecycle – from business requirement understanding and solution definition to validation, testing, rollout, adoption, operation and continuous improvement.

We expect you to actively leverage data, AI, automation and modern digital tools to improve problem-solving efficiency and business outcomes, while ensuring that regional and global digital capabilities work effectively in the local market.

Working location: Uxbridge, London

Main responsibilities:

  • Business Understanding & Digitalization Partnership: Work directly with local aftersales teams and dealers to understand business processes, operational pain points and priorities. Identify the real business problem behind requests and translate business needs into practical digitalization initiatives.

  • Market Digital Product Ownership: Represent local business requirements in regional and global digital product development. Work with Digital Product Owners to define requirements, user journeys, priorities and acceptance criteria, and validate solutions against real business and dealer scenarios.

  • Digital Solution Delivery: Coordinate requirements, solution validation, UAT, pilots, business acceptance and rollout. Take ownership of local delivery and ensure digital solutions are implemented successfully and create real business value.

  • Dealer Digitalization & System Integration: Work with dealers, DMS providers and technology partners to improve digital connectivity between dealer systems and company platforms. Coordinate business requirements, interface validation, testing and rollout with relevant technical teams.

  • Platform Rollout & Adoption: Drive local implementation and adoption of regional and global aftersales digital platforms. Coordinate market readiness, dealer onboarding, training, communication and rollout, and continuously monitor adoption and user feedback after go-live.

  • Data, Automation & AI Enablement: Use data to identify operational issues and improvement opportunities. Actively use AI, automation and modern digital tools to improve analysis, requirements, documentation and problem solving, and support adoption of relevant data and AI capabilities.

  • Operation & Problem Solving: Take ownership of digital issues raised by local business users and dealers. Distinguish user and process issues from product defects, integration failures and data problems, perform root-cause analysis and turn recurring issues into product or process improvements.

  • Continuous Improvement: Use operational data, user feedback and support cases to identify systematic improvement opportunities. Look beyond individual issues and help convert repeated market needs into scalable digital capabilities.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with local business teams, dealers, European Digital Product Owners, Business Platform Engineers, BYD HQ development teams and external technology partners. Ensure clear ownership, communication and effective coordination across business and technology teams.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive, Supply Chain or another relevant field.

  • 3+ years of experience in business digitalization, digital product delivery, enterprise IT, business analysis, automotive aftersales or a related area.

  • Strong ability to understand business processes, identify root causes and translate ambiguous business problems into practical digital solutions.

  • Good understanding of enterprise digital systems and integration concepts such as DMS, CRM, ERP, APIs, system integration, data flows, cloud platforms and BI.

  • Experience driving or contributing to digital initiatives across requirement analysis, solution definition, testing, rollout, adoption and continuous improvement.

  • Practical experience using data, AI, automation or modern digital tools to improve business processes or personal productivity is highly valued.

  • Ability and willingness to understand business processes and operational problems rather than simply forwarding predefined requirements.

  • Strong problem-solving capability and ownership mindset, with the ability to independently move ambiguous problems toward practical working solutions.

  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with business users, dealers, Product Owners, technical teams and external vendors in an international environment.

  • Fluent English is required. Local language requirements may be defined based on the hiring market. Mandarin Chinese is a plus due to collaboration with BYD HQ and development teams.

  • Experience in automotive aftersales, dealer operations, DMS or enterprise digitalization is highly desirable, but not mandatory.

  • Experience working with dealer networks, multi-market organizations or cross-functional business and technology teams is an advantage.

We offer:

  • Performance and experience-based competitive remuneration

  • Scottish Widows workplace pension

  • Commuting Allowance

  • Car Salary Sacrifice Scheme

  • 25 days paid holidays + public holidays

  • Private Health care

  • Department & company-wide team building events.

Our Purpose is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature and a World of clean air. We are looking for talent that connects with this mission and want to create positive impact by joining a diverse and dynamic team 🌏

title: Computer Vision/Machine Learning Intern
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.


KLA is seeking applications for an Computer Vision/Machine Learning intern in Ebeam division to research and prototype cutting edge image processing and machine learning algorithms for our next-gen products. We are one of the pioneering companies in the Semi-Conductor industry to use Deep Learning algorithms for defect detection and classification. In addition, we are actively exploring using Generative/Diffusion models for SEM image simulation and image quality enhancement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working experience in one of the following: Image Processing, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Deep Learning.
  • Working knowledge in one of the following SW: Tensorflow, Pytorch, Python, MATLAB.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Students working towards a Master's or PhD Level Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field.

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - US Government
description:
A World-Changing Company
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) understand our customers’ greatest pain points and design end-to-end solutions to address them. FDSEs solicit constant feedback on their work from both customers and colleagues, improving our products over time with rapid iteration cycles.

FDSEs deploy ground breaking technical solutions to solve our customers’ hardest problems. Projects often start with a nebulous question like “Why are we losing customers?” or “How can we more effectively identify instances of money laundering?” FDSEs lead the way in developing a solution, from high-level system design and prototyping to application development and data integration. As an FDSE, you leverage everything around you: Palantir products, open source technologies, and anything you and your team can build to drive real impact.

You work with customers around the globe, where you gain rare insight into the world’s most important industries and institutions. We help our customers detect insider trading, improve disaster relief, fight healthcare fraud, and more. Each mission presents different challenges, from the regulatory environment to the nature of the data to the user population. You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Technologies We Use

  • Core Palantir products provide the foundations for our deployments.
  • Custom applications built on top of core Palantir platforms.
  • Postgres, Cassandra, Hadoop, and Spark for distributed data storage and parallel computing.
  • Java and Groovy for our back-end applications and data integration tools.
  • Typescript, React, Leaflet, and d3 for our web technologies.
  • Python for data processing and analysis.
  • Palantir cloud infrastructure based on AWS EC2 and S3.

Our Principles

  • Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
  • Dedication: We see projects through from beginning to end in spite of obstacles we may encounter.
  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems.
  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities—we don't micromanage. We want to give people the space to think for themselves.
  • Growth: We push ourselves and our peers to improve themselves and the world around them.
  • Learning: We often face entirely novel problems, where we need to pick up a lot of new information and learn how to use it to make progress.

What We Value

  • Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics.
  • Experience with logistics, materiel, sustainment, aviation, or readiness analysis is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
  • Understanding of how technical decisions impact the user of what you’re building.
  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Skill and comfort working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Demonstrated ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Willingness and interest to travel as needed.

What We Require

  • Active US Security Clearance at or above the Top Secret level.
Salary
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000- $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Benefits

Life at Palantir

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and evolving our order management and commerce platform with Fluent Commerce at its core. You will design and build workflows, integrations, and platform extensions that reliably power the journey of millions of customer orders. Working across Fluent Commerce, Java-based services, APIs, and our wider e-commerce ecosystem, you will take ownership of complex features end-to-end, from specification and architecture through to delivery, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Collaborating with Product and Engineering teams, you will combine strong technical judgment with a deep understanding of order management and distributed systems to build solutions that are scalable, resilient, and easy to evolve. Your curiosity for emerging technologies and AI-assisted development will help the team work smarter, ship faster, and continuously improve how we build and operate our commerce platform. This position is permanent and based in Munich.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, build, and maintain solutions on the Fluent Commerce platform, taking end-to-end ownership from architecture to production release and maintenance
  • Design and evolve Fluent Commerce workflows, rules, events, and orchestration logic supporting order management, fulfilment, and inventory processes
  • Develop custom Fluent Commerce rules using the Rules SDK and Java, keeping business logic modular, testable, and maintainable
  • Build and extend integrations between Fluent Commerce and our wider e-commerce landscape using GraphQL, REST APIs, webhooks, events, and other integration patterns
  • Own the reliability and performance of order-management flows, handling failure scenarios, retries, idempotency, and observability
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical designs, build AI-powered capabilities, and champion engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, and documentation

YOU COME WITH

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and extending Fluent Commerce, with solid knowledge of its Order Management platform, Workflow Framework, events, rules, and orchestration concepts
  • Practical experience with the Fluent Commerce Rules SDK and Java development (Maven), with experience in Spring Boot and the Fluent Connect SDK being a strong plus
  • Strong background in software architecture and integration design, connecting enterprise and e-commerce systems using GraphQL, REST APIs, webhooks, and asynchronous or event-driven integration patterns
  • Good understanding of core order management concepts including sourcing, fulfilment, inventory, cancellations, returns, and order life cycles
  • Proven fluency with Agentic AI, directing coding agents on well-scoped work to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability
  • Fluency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills; German is a plus

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.
At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

• A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
• An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
• In-Office Culture: 4 office days per week (Mon-Thu) dedicated to fast decision-making, high-impact collaboration, and strong team connections
• Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
• 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
• A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
• Exclusive discounts: 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), and 20% Family & Friends discount on Westwing Collection, plus special-occasion vouchers
• Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
• Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
• Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
• One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
• Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest

ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Web & iOS
description:
Company Overview
AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website

Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview

Job Role
AutoRABIT is hiring Senior Full Stack Engineers with demonstrated experience building both enterprise web applications and native iOS mobile applications.

You will help develop a new product that automates the software delivery lifecycle for Salesforce teams. The platform connects customer Salesforce organizations, source control systems, and issue trackers to plan, build, validate, and deploy changes through a governed pipeline. AI agents perform delivery tasks within controls designed to ensure secure and reliable software releases.

Our technology stack includes Java and Spring Boot backend services, an Angular and TypeScript web application, Python services supporting automation and AI agents, and native iOS mobile development.

This is a true full stack engineering role requiring hands on experience across backend services, web applications, and iOS mobile development. Candidates must be comfortable working across multiple technologies, writing production code, and using AI coding tools as part of their daily development workflow.

Key Responsibilities
Full Stack & Backend Development
  • Design, build, test, and deploy features across backend services, web applications, and mobile experiences.
  • Develop secure, scalable, multi tenant backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.
  • Build responsive, accessible web applications using Angular and TypeScript.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs that support web and mobile applications.
  • Extend Python services supporting delivery automation and AI powered workflows.
  • Design and evolve APIs using OpenAPI specifications and generated client integrations.
  • Ensure security, performance, reliability, and tenant data isolation across the platform.
iOS Mobile Development
  • Design, develop, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift and modern iOS development frameworks.
  • Build intuitive, responsive, and reliable mobile experiences that integrate with AutoRABIT's backend services.
  • Develop mobile interfaces using SwiftUI and established iOS architecture patterns.
  • Integrate iOS applications with REST APIs, authentication services, and enterprise systems.
  • Implement secure mobile authentication, session management, and data handling.
  • Troubleshoot mobile application performance, compatibility, and reliability issues.
  • Participate in mobile testing, debugging, deployment, and App Store release processes.
  • Ensure consistency and functionality across web and mobile user experiences.
AI & Automation
  • Contribute to AI powered automation supporting software development and delivery workflows.
  • Work with Python services and AI agent integrations that automate development tasks.
  • Use AI assisted coding tools to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality.
  • Evaluate AI generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to identify AI enabled product opportunities.
Engineering Quality & Collaboration
  • Build integrations with Salesforce, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jira, Slack, and other enterprise platforms.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, encryption, and credential management.
  • Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and end to end tests.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker based builds, and AWS deployments.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across backend, web, and mobile applications.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain engineering standards.
  • Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and DevOps teams.
  • Follow established security, compliance, and software development practices
Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.

Pride of Ownership
We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.

Experience & Desired Skills
Required Skills (Mandatory)
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications.
  • Demonstrated professional experience developing and releasing native iOS mobile applications.
  • Strong hands on experience with Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, and the iOS development lifecycle.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services.
  • Strong Java development experience using Spring Boot, Spring Security, REST APIs, and modern enterprise development practices.
  • Strong Angular and TypeScript experience building modern web applications.
  • Working proficiency in Python, including maintaining and extending existing Python services.
  • Experience with Python testing and API frameworks such as pytest, FastAPI, and Pydantic.
  • Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, database design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs using OpenAPI specifications.
  • Understanding of secure application development, authentication, authorization, and data protection.
  • Experience with automated testing across backend, web, and mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with Docker, AWS cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency with Git, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Hands on experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor as part of regular software development.
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.
  • Strong problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
  • Experience developing software within the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Experience building enterprise mobile applications or mobile experiences for SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with UIKit alongside SwiftUI.
  • Familiarity with mobile CI/CD, automated iOS testing, and App Store Connect.
  • Experience with push notifications, secure local storage, or mobile offline capabilities.
  • Experience with AI and LLM engineering, including agent frameworks, API integrations, tool use, Model Context Protocol, or prompt engineering.
  • Experience developing applications in highly regulated or security sensitive environments.
Why join AutoRABIT
This is an opportunity to help build an innovative enterprise software platform that combines modern web technologies, native mobile development, and AI powered automation.

You'll work across the full technology stack, contribute to meaningful product decisions, and help deliver secure, scalable applications that improve how enterprise Salesforce teams develop and release software.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, embrace AI as a practical development tool, and are excited to build exceptional software across web and mobile platforms.

title: Software Development Manager, FME Form
description:
As a Software Development Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects within your team. You’ll collaborate with Product, UX, and other stakeholders to prioritize work, help shape technical priorities, and ensure smooth delivery.

You’ll also support the growth and well-being of team members through coaching, feedback, and development opportunities. Your leadership will help the team navigate challenges, align with product goals, and continuously improve their practices and performance.

This is a people-first leadership role for someone who is passionate about developing talent, supporting delivery, and fostering collaboration. You’ll also serve as a bridge between your team and the broader organization, helping align business needs with technical implementation.

This is a hybrid role based out of Safe Software's Surrey, BC headquarters. We have an immediate opening and are excited to find the right candidate to join our team.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Even if you don’t meet every requirement listed, we value your unique experiences and perspectives.

About The Team

As part of the FME Form product group, you’ll join a group of collaborative development teams composed of tech leaders, developers, quality analysts, and student interns who work together as a team and alongside product managers and user experience designers, on complex technical projects that provide direct value to our users. In this role, you’ll report to our Director, Software Development and work closely with them to support the team and its priorities.

As a part of this close-knit and diverse team, you will work together with internal stakeholders to maintain and extend our flagship FME Form products that delight customers and empower them to author dataflows that can be shared, reused, and integrated with the FME Platform.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Software Development Manager, FME Form, you will:

  • Lead a team of developers through coaching, feedback, and professional development, in close collaboration with your Director.

  • Manage people responsibilities for your direct reports, including performance conversations, calibration, and other HR processes.

  • Collaborate with Product, UX, and technical stakeholders to define and prioritize work.

  • Act as product owner and project manager for your team, partnering with Product Managers, designers, your Director, and tech leaders to manage the backlog, prioritize features and internal improvements, and see planned work through from kickoff to delivery.

  • Oversee technical delivery, helping manage project flow and addressing risks early.

  • Support architecture, product, and design discussions with QA, Customer Support, and other relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment and inclusion of team voices.

  • Build a positive, inclusive team culture centred on collaboration and shared ownership.

  • Guide hiring, onboarding, and team growth with a focus on skill development and values alignment.

  • Champion continuous improvement and openness to change in tools, development processes, practices, and communication, including AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Act as a liaison between your team and other parts of the organization, advocating for both team and business needs.

Qualifications, Skills, and Competencies

At Safe Software, we welcome diverse backgrounds and experiences. While not all candidates will have everything listed, the most successful candidates will bring many of the following:

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years in software development, including 3+ years leading software teams as a people manager, team lead, or similar role. Direct people management experience strongly preferred.

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile development practices.

  • Working knowledge of software development in any language (e.g., C++, Python, Java), enough to understand the scope and design of your team’s work. Hands-on coding is not expected.

  • Product owner, scrum master, or project management experience, including backlog management and feature prioritization using Jira or equivalent project management software.

  • Openness to and support for adopting AI tools within a development team.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a focus on empathy, honesty, and clarity.

  • Demonstrated ability to support team health and build inclusive, high-performing teams.

  • Ability to balance technical direction with team and business priorities.

  • An open, adaptable mindset toward change, with a willingness to listen to multiple perspectives.

  • Confidence to establish credibility with experienced senior engineers, setting clear boundaries while remaining collaborative.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with C++ software development.

  • Familiarity with Safe Software’s platform or similar technical domains.

  • Involvement in mentoring, DEI, or culture-building initiatives.

  • Knowledge of hiring practices, onboarding, and team-building techniques.

  • Experience with AI Coding Agents (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).

What You Can Expect

When you choose a career with Safe Software, you’re also choosing…

  • Meaningful Work: Make a profound impact across our business, workplace and data integration product.

  • A Supportive Environment: Feel empowered to share your ideas and implement them with high autonomy and team support.

  • Social Responsibility: Become part of a team that finds meaningful ways to give back. Take paid time off to volunteer for one of our Safe-organized opportunities that align with our core community initiatives.

  • Learning & Career Development: We believe in your continuous learning and growth. Take advantage of an annual learning budget and training programs paid for by Safe.

  • Flexible Working Hours: Flexible and remote-friendly work arrangements to fit your lifestyle. Work when you want, and how you want to.

  • Work-Life Balance: There's no place for burnout at Safe. Maintain a healthy balance of your personal and work life without splitting yourself in two. Enjoy 3 weeks of vacation to recharge, plus an additional paid 6 seasonal days off per year.

  • Health & Wellness: Extended health, dental, health or lifestyle spending, and counseling benefits from day 1. That’s right, no waiting period.

  • Family is important: We are dedicated to supporting our employees through parenthood and offer a Parental Leave Top-Up Program for new parents through childbirth or adoption.

  • Shared Success: Share in Safe’s success with our bi-annual profit sharing and RRSP/TFSA matching program.

  • An Accessible Commute: Regardless of your commute method, we’re located close to public transit, and provide complimentary parking and bike storage for our team!

About Safe Software

Safe Software transforms organizations with FME, the only All-Data Any-AI Enterprise Integration Platform connecting all your data, anywhere, at any velocity.

With over 30 years of expertise and 25,000+ enterprise customers across 125+ countries, we simplify your data journey, wherever it leads.

Founded in 1993, Safe is headquartered in Surrey, BC with over 300 team members and counting. We’re always looking for talented individuals with diverse backgrounds who are determined to learn and grow. Are you ready to join the team?


Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Safe Software is an equal opportunity employer and we truly believe that innovation and strength begin with diversity and inclusion.

We welcome all candidates regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, ability, disability, national or ethnic origin, political belief, religion, or family status.

Should you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact hr_dept@safe.com.

At Safe Software, we use automated tools to help us process applications and identify qualified candidates. These tools may assist in screening resumes and summarizing interview content based on the information you provide. This helps our team review applications efficiently while ensuring every candidate is considered based on the requirements of the role.

Please be assured that the final hiring decision is always made by a member of our team. For more information on how we protect your privacy, please see our policy. If you have questions about this process, please contact us at hr_dept@safe.com.

At Clutch, we are reinventing the way Canadians buy and own cars. Recently named one of the Fastest Growing Canadian Companies by the Globe & Mail and one of the Top Canadian Startups by LinkedIn, we’re looking to add to our great team of people who embrace hard things, think like owners, and love to help their teammates.

We pride ourselves on our high-quality certified vehicles, great prices, and customer experience. By visiting clutch.ca, customers can browse a large selection of high-quality vehicles, buy a car that's right for them, and enjoy seamless delivery—all from the comfort of their homes.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Toronto, Clutch services Alberta, British Columbia, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, and Saskatchewan. We are backed by world-class investors including D1 Capital Partners, Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, Upper90, FJ Labs, Global Founders Capital, and Azure Capital Partners.

About the Role

As the Lead, Lot Attendent you will be the ground-floor coordinator of vehicle movement across our Halifax operations. You will oversee high-volume vehicle flow between our Halifax and OPENLANE storage locations, ensuring incoming units, service vehicles, and outbound deliveries are staged, parked, and moved efficiently without gridlock or delays.

You will lead a team of attendants in an active, outdoor, fast-moving environment where precision, speed, and spatial awareness are essential. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in organized chaos, has strong logistical instincts, and can maintain control in high-pressure, high-volume conditions.

  • Oversee end-to-end vehicle movement across intake, staging, service, and delivery zones

  • Coordinate vehicle flow between the Halifax and OPENLANE storage locations

  • Ensure smooth coordination between incoming transport, shop workflow, and outbound deliveries

  • Maintain operational flow across a high-volume environment

  • Lead attendants in real time to ensure consistent execution of parking and movement standards

High-Density Flow Coordination

  • Act as the lead coordinator for vehicle arrivals and departures across both storage locations

  • Break down vehicle movement into clear staging zones to avoid confusion or congestion

  • Continuously monitor entry and exit points to prevent bottlenecks

  • Reassign attendants dynamically based on volume spikes and priority areas

  • Optimize parking layouts to maximize space while maintaining emergency access and “first-out” readiness

  • Coordinate vehicle movement between Halifax and OPENLANE based on operational needs

Hands-On Floor Leadership

  • Stay physically present on the lot to direct real-time vehicle movement

  • Demonstrate correct parking and movement techniques for attendants to follow

  • Give immediate feedback to improve speed, accuracy, and safety compliance

  • Reinforce safety standards including speed control, pedestrian awareness, and visibility rules

  • Step in directly during complex or high-risk repositioning situations

Inventory Integrity & Audit

  • Perform regular zone counts to ensure physical inventory matches system records

  • Identify stalled, misplaced, or underutilized vehicles in the workflow

  • Maintain organized, clearly structured lot sections for efficient navigation

  • Support accurate tracking of vehicle locations and statuses in real time

  • Ensure lot layouts support operational speed and clarity across both locations

Problem Solving & Agility

  • Respond quickly to unexpected issues such as early transport arrivals or inoperable vehicles

  • Remove operational blockers in real time to keep vehicle flow moving

  • Coordinate closely with production, shop leads, and delivery teams on timing and priorities

  • Resolve most issues directly on the floor before escalation is needed

  • Maintain steady flow during high-pressure and high-volume periods

  • Adjust priorities and resources between the Halifax and OPENLANE locations as operational needs change

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in high-volume vehicle flow environments (valet, rental fleets, logistics yards, auction lots, or similar)

  • Strong spatial awareness and ability to organize dense parking layouts efficiently

  • Comfortable working outdoors in fast-paced, physically demanding conditions

  • Clear, confident communication for directing teams in loud environments

  • Strong decision-making ability under pressure with minimal supervision

  • Comfortable working between multiple storage locations based on business needs

Why You’ll Love It at Clutch

  • Autonomy & Ownership: You directly impact how efficiently vehicles move through the operation

  • Fast-Paced Environment: Every day is active, dynamic, and different

  • Leadership Opportunity: You lead real-time operations and guide a frontline team

  • Career Growth: Exposure to automotive logistics, production, and operations leadership paths

  • Team Culture: Work with a group focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement

Employment Type

  • Permanent Full-Time

Compensation & Benefits

  • Hourly wage: $22.50 per hour

  • Overtime opportunities based on operational demand

  • Health & dental benefits package

  • Stable full-time employment

  • Exposure to a fast-growing automotive operations environment

Location & Working Conditions

  • Location: Halifax, Nova Scotia, with regular work between our Halifax and OPENLANE storage locations

  • 100% On-Site: Outdoor, physically active role in all weather conditions

  • High Mobility: Continuous walking, standing, and vehicle movement throughout the shift

  • Must be comfortable travelling between the two storage locations as operational needs require

title: Director, Global Value & Access Strategy (Cell-Therapy Autoimmune)
description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.

Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.


Job Description

We are seeking a Director, Global Value & Access Strategy (GVAS), Cell-therapy Autoimmune. This role reports to the Senior Director, GVA Lead, Lymphoma, Autoimmune and Solid Tumors/Pipeline.


This role will be office-based/hybrid (3 days onsite) in El Segundo or Thousand Oaks or Foster City, CA.


In this position, you will be a critical Global Value & Access partner for Kite's growing autoimmune cell therapy portfolio. You will lead the development and execution of global market access strategies to support early and late-stage development programs, while preparing for future launches of transformative cell therapies across autoimmune diseases.


You will work closely with Global Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, HEOR/RWE, Commercial, Regulatory Affairs and regional Access teams to ensure payer perspectives are incorporated into development decisions and launch planning. You will play a key role in shaping evidence generation strategies that support differentiated value propositions, reimbursement, and patient access across major global markets.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Market Access Leadership

  • Serve as the Global Market Access representative for assigned autoimmune programs and contribute to cross-functional conversations.
  • In the Value Access Sub-Team, you will be leading and partnering with the Global and Regional functions of Value Access, HEOR/RWE and commercial to ensure efficient integration of Access input into the Portfolio Strategy.
  • Lead the development of global value and access strategies across the product lifecycle, from early development through launch and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure payer, HTA, and health system perspectives are reflected in development, evidence generation, pricing, and commercialization strategies.
  • Partner with regional and country access teams to develop integrated global-to-local reimbursement strategies.

Asset Development and Evidence Generation

  • Analyze market access trends, evolving reimbursement requirements, competitive dynamics, and health system considerations across major markets including the US, EU5, Canada, Australia, and Japan.
  • Provide market access input into target product profiles, clinical development plans, endpoint selection, comparator strategy, study design, and evidence generation plans.
  • Advise development teams on evidence requirements needed to support future reimbursement, pricing, and formulary access decisions.
  • Ensure access-relevant considerations are incorporated into development milestones and governance decisions.

Value Demonstration and HEOR Partnership

  • Partner with Clinical, HEOR, RWE and Medical Affairs to develop and execute early payer engagement and HTA scientific advice strategies across multiple autoimmune indications, ensuring payer perspectives are incorporated into evidence generation and development plans.
  • Provide strategic leadership on US market access dynamics across autoimmune indications, including payer formulary management, utilization management (e.g., step edits and prior authorization), and rebate contracting strategies, ensuring these considerations are proactively incorporated into development, evidence generation, pricing, and launch planning.
  • Lead cross-functional assessment of payer, HTA, and health system evidence requirements across key global markets, translating insights into actionable recommendations for clinical development programs.
  • Assess the access implications of development opportunities across autoimmune indications and advise governance teams on the likelihood of achieving favorable pricing, reimbursement, and patient access outcomes.
  • Partner with HEOR, RWE, Medical Affairs, and Commercial teams to develop compelling value propositions and evidence packages.
  • Advise on the development of economic models, burden-of-illness studies, indirect treatment comparisons, and other payer-focused evidence.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the market access lead within cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment across Development, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Regulatory Affairs, Pricing, and HEOR.
  • Influence strategic decisions through robust assessment of payer expectations, reimbursement risks, and value opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years with a PhD/ PharmD

OR

10+ years with MS/MA, MBA, PharmD, PhD or equivalent advanced degree

OR

12+ years with BS/BA


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of direct experience supporting autoimmune disease programs, including development-stage assets, clinical strategy, market access, medical affairs, commercial strategy, or related functions.
  • Deep understanding of autoimmune disease treatment paradigms, competitive dynamics, and unmet patient needs.
  • Experience in advanced therapies, including cell therapy and/or gene therapy, strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting market access, pricing, reimbursement, HEOR, commercial strategy, or related functions within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Experience supporting early and/or late-stage development programs and translating payer insights into development decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating payer, HTA, and health system requirements into clinical development and evidence generation strategies.
  • Experience supporting launch readiness activities, global launch planning, and lifecycle management.

title: Join Our Talent Pool
description:
Join Our Talent Pool

If you don’t see a current opening that fits your background, but you’re interested in working with SE3 Labs in the future, we invite you to join our Talent Pool. It’s the best way to stay connected and be considered for upcoming opportunities.

What Is the Talent Pool?

The SE3 Labs Talent Pool is a group of people who want to stay on our radar for future roles. It helps us connect with individuals who share our curiosity, values, and passion for building new technologies. When new positions become available, we look to our Talent Pool first.

How Does It Work?

Our Talent Pool is open to everyone. You can sign up at any time, and your profile will remain active for future searches. We regularly review submissions and reach out when there’s a match between your experience and our hiring needs.

Will I Hear About New SE3 Labs Roles Early?

Often, yes. We contact people in our Talent Pool before we post roles publicly. Joining gives you an early look at new opportunities and projects that fit your skills and interests.

Do I Need to Be an Engineer to Join?

No. Our work spans a wide variety of disciplines, and we welcome people from different backgrounds and areas of expertise. Whether you’re early in your career or highly experienced, you’re encouraged to register your interest.


Can I Speak With Someone on the Team?

We receive many applications and expressions of interest, so we can’t speak with everyone individually. If we see strong alignment, we’ll reach out directly to arrange a conversation.


How to Join

Click “Apply Here”, upload your resume, and share a few details about your background and interests. Once submitted, you’ll be part of our Talent Pool and we’ll be in touch when something relevant comes up.

title: Campus President
description:
Campus President

Position Summary:

The position objective is to fulfill the school’s obligation to students by administering and facilitating the mission and philosophy of the institution. The Campus President is responsible for the overall administration and supervision of the total operation of the school on a day-to-day basis in the following areas: admissions, financial aid, registrar, business office, career services, student services, and education/training.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Hire and retain qualified and caring staff and faculty.
  • Provide guidance and formal training to all staff and faculty.
  • Communicate effectively (by both written and oral methods) institutional and corporate goals/objectives to all staff, faculty, and students.
  • Monitor the work of all staff and faculty on a regular basis to ensure quality and accuracy in all tasks performed.
  • Hold regularly scheduled weekly meetings with each direct report to gain feedback, gather ideas, assign tasks, and provide direction regarding prioritizing work.
  • Attend and significantly contribute to staff/faculty meetings within the school and school director meetings at the corporate level.
  • Be (or learn to be) computer literate. Use email and Internet systems proficiently. Ensure that important files are properly saved and backed up.
  • Monitor and maintain the institution’s computerized data system to ensure that information contained therein is accurate, entered in a timely fashion, and backed up to guard against loss of crucial data.
  • Monitor the institution’s collection efforts for the purpose of ensuring that students participating in loan programs are making timely payments and students who are late with payments are receiving effective counseling.
  • Monitor the institution’s default and cohort rates on a regular and timely basis.
  • Monitor the institution’s placement rates and provide guidance and direction to the institution’s career services director on a regular and timely basis for the purpose of meeting institutional goals and objectives.
  • Monitor the institution’s externship program by frequently visiting externship sites in order to ensure that students are gaining maximum benefit from the experience.
  • Monitor educational effectiveness by frequently sitting in on various classes offered by the institution to ensure that each student is receiving quality training and that instructors are following approved guidelines for classroom instruction. Monitor retention percentage in each program.
  • Provide computerized reports to corporate management on a regular basis with regard to placement, accounts receivable/accounts payable, cash flow, retention rates, licensure percentages, (for those programs which emphasize licensure for placement purposes),student attendance, and marketing/admission’s results.
  • Be knowledgeable of and follow all state, accrediting, and financial aid compliance standards in a timely and complete manner and ensure that all other school and corporate personnel are made aware of these compliance standards.
  • Maintain and secure institutional procedural manuals and other documentation required by state, accrediting, and federal agencies.
  • Conduct and attend regular student services activities including: new student orientation, graduation ceremonies, holiday parties, student education achievement award ceremonies, and provide students with information in areas such as child care and transportation.
  • Monitor student attendance/performance for the purpose of ensuring that students are successfully meeting the goals and objectives of each program, and advise and provide guidance to students who are not meeting the designated requirements of the program in which they are enrolled.
  • Be readily accessible for meetings requested by students, staff, and faculty and “manage by walking around”.
  • Assist and support the admission’s team by being available to meet prospective new students.
  • Create an atmosphere within the school where all staff and faculty are aware that admissions personnel are trustworthy and that it is crucial to the success of the school that everyone is available to assist admissions to bring in new students.
  • Monitor marketing and admission’s activities on a daily basis.
  • Be interested in and knowledgeable of departmental details in all areas of the school’s operation.
  • Follow all procedures and standards as defined by Education Affiliates Inc.
  • Meet or exceed the bottom line requirements of the approved school budget.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Skills/Competencies/Qualifications:

The Campus President must have a college degree at a higher level than any conferred by the institution and/or at least three years of significant supervisory and management work experience, preferably within the private school industry.

Classification: Exempt

Work Hours: Forty per week but may vary daily. Significant evening hours are required in order that evening students may have the same high level of service as day students.

Travel: This position requires periodic travel.

Working Environment: Interior/Office

description:

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

STACK APAC is expanding its Australian Engineering team, and the Design Manager role is key to this expansion. Detailed and design process orientated, you will remain strategically focused while being able to deep dive and support the project teams on any and all issues as they may arise, in a culture of support and collaboration.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills.

  • Strong spoken and written English.

title: Short-Term Paid Research Study for Danish-Speaking Students - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Danish speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Danish actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Danish speaker who grew up in Denmark.
  • You use Danish in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.

Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

title: Director of Admissions
description:
Director of Admissions

About The Job

Fortis College in Baton Rouge, LA is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Director for its Admissions Department. If you possess a desire to help others succeed, this is an opportunity for you to positively impact the lives and careers of our students and graduates.

Fortis provides educational programs that provide essential career skills in high-demand occupations that lead to employment upon graduation and a lifetime of professional growth.
