We are seeking an energetic and enthusiastic leader to manage the Admissions Department. This is a full-time, professional position reporting directly to the Campus President. As a member of the school’s leadership team, the Director of Admissions is responsible for managing the department using sound business principles and ensuring compliance with all governmental, accreditation and company policies and procedures. This position may require some evening and Saturday hours.

The Director of Admissions will be responsible for the overall administration of interviewing, enrolling, starting, and retaining new students for the school. This includes communicating with other departments to convey the needs of students while participating as a team player with the campus’ executive team and within the college environment; upholding and ensuring representatives uphold the core values of the school and the highest standards of ethics and truthfulness in providing information to prospective students regarding educational programs, facilities, educational costs, financial aid and completion/graduation/placement and earning data; and documenting representatives’ reviews through interviews and phone observations and conducting annual reviews with representatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, education, or related field with at least 3 years of admissions and/or sales management experience. Direct educational admissions leadership experience required.
  • Demonstration of the highest levels of integrity and professionalism in all aspects, including appearance, demeanor, and attitude
  • Demonstrated leadership skills including the ability to develop, motivate, and lead staff
  • Capability to prioritize, accept responsibility, and work within deadlines
  • Ability to lead and work in an observation/coaching training style environment
  • Creativity and ability to work independently
  • Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills with demonstrated success in collaborating with diverse groups of employees and customers
  • Strong computer software skills including Microsoft Office
  • Must have a past record of integrity that would ensure compliance with accrediting standards and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.

title: Associate Director, Enterprise Data Governance
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


BeOne is seeking an Associate Director, Enterprise Data Governance to build, enable, and scale enterprise data governance and stewardship capabilities across the organization. This role is a key member of the Enterprise Data Governance function and is responsible for operationalizing data stewardship within a federated governance model.


Working closely with the Head of Enterprise Data Governance, this position will serve as a subject matter expert (SME), translating governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable business processes. The Associate Director will lead domain onboarding, drive stewardship adoption, and oversee strategic governance initiatives.


This role partners across business, technology, security, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to establish trusted, compliant, and well-governed data assets that support analytics, AI readiness, regulatory compliance, and business decision-making. The position will also provide leadership to managed service providers and junior governance resources while monitoring stewardship effectiveness through defined metrics and reporting.


Essential Functions of the Job:


  • Serve as a SME for enterprise data governance and data stewardship, contributing to governance operating models, policies, standards, processes, and best practices.
  • Lead onboarding of business and data domains into the federated governance framework, including role enablement, stewardship adoption, and governance process implementation.
  • Enable enterprise data discovery, transparency, and reuse through metadata management, data catalog, and data marketplace capabilities.
  • Implement metadata management, business glossary curation, and stewardship workflows.
  • Integrate governance processes across enterprise platforms and business workflows.
  • Influence the adoption of governance and stewardship practices without direct authority by building trusted relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared objectives.
  • Leverage automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve stewardship efficiency and governance effectiveness.
  • Establish, monitor, and report governance KPIs, initiative progress, stewardship outcomes, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Partner with platform owners, architects, and data teams to ensure governance technologies effectively support stewardship, metadata management, data quality, and compliance requirements.
  • Author governance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models aligned with enterprise data management best practices.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement sessions, governance working groups, and training programs that drive accountability, stewardship, and sustained adoption.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, enterprise data management, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a data governance SME within a federated, matrixed, or enterprise-scale operating model.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive adoption of governance processes, standards, and platforms without formal authority.
  • Experience leading cross-functional governance initiatives involving business, technology, and compliance stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and driving adoption of enterprise data governance platforms such as Informatica, Atlan, Alation, or similar solutions.
  • Experience enabling and training data stewards, data owners, and business stakeholders on governance processes and tools.
  • Experience with data classification, metadata management, data quality, and regulatory-aligned governance practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate competing priorities across business and technology organizations.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating team members, managed service providers, or governance resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate governance strategy, policy, and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable operating processes.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience leading governance platform implementations and stewardship adoption initiatives (Informatica, Atlan, Collibra, Alation, etc…).
  • Strong facilitation skills, including governance workshops, onboarding sessions, and working groups.
  • Experience supporting Data-as-a-Product operating models on modern data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake.
  • Experience governing data within regulated environments, including GxP, clinical, R&D, or pharmaceutical domains.
  • Experience defining and reporting governance and stewardship KPIs to senior leadership.
  • Understanding of how metadata, stewardship, and data quality capabilities enable analytics, AI, and business outcomes.
  • Relevant certifications such as CDMP, DGSP, DCAM, DAMA, or equivalent credentials.

Supervisory Responsibilities:


  • Supervisory responsibilities are delivery-focused and include leading and providing direction for our managed service providers on certain projects, while providing strategic oversight and direction to junior data governance resources.


Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

Salary Range: $143,700.00 - $193,700.00 annually

title: Director, Integrity and Compliance
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.


The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


The Legal team helps Snap do the right thing the right way, make better decisions, understand and manage risks, and creatively navigate challenges, both external and internal.


We partner with Snap team members on a wide array of matters, including privacy, product, IP, commercial transactions, corporate governance, employment, acquisitions, litigation, policy, and social impact.


We value the power of diversity, as we continually strive to build an innovative and inclusive leadership culture centered on Snap’s values of Kind, Smart, and Creative.


We’re looking for a Director, Integrity and Compliance to join Snap’s Legal Team! In this role, reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, you will lead Snap’s global Integrity & Compliance program and oversee the strategy, design, and continuous improvement of the company’s compliance framework across business conduct, enterprise compliance, controls and assurance, investigations, awareness and culture, sustainability-related compliance processes, and other key risk areas. Your responsibilities will span a wide range of high-impact areas, including anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, investigations, policy governance, risk assessments, training and communications, trade and cross-border compliance, records governance, reporting, and program effectiveness. You will also supervise and support a cross-functional compliance team, own governance for a management-level Risk and Compliance Committee, and partner closely with Legal, Sales, Partnerships, Finance, HR, Internal Audit, Information Security, Public Policy, Sustainability, and senior business leaders across Snap. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role that offers the opportunity to help shape a values-driven culture of compliance across Snap while helping the company identify, assess, and mitigate legal and regulatory risk in a practical, business-focused way.


What You’ll Do

  • Global Compliance Program Leadership: Lead Snap’s global Integrity & Compliance program and work with the Chief Compliance Officer and regional leaders to set the overall strategy, priorities, and operating model for the function.
  • Team Leadership & Management: Supervise and develop leaders and team members across enterprise compliance, business conduct compliance, controls and assurance, investigations, awareness and training, and related program areas.
  • Anti-Bribery & Anti-Corruption: Oversee and evolve Snap’s anti-bribery and anti-corruption program, including training, communications, risk assessments, controls, reporting, and mitigation strategies.
  • Investigations Program Oversight: Oversee Snap’s investigations framework, including reporting channels, case-management processes, escalation standards, trends reporting, outside-counsel coordination, and remediation follow-through.
  • Third-Party Risk Management: Oversee and enhance Snap’s compliance-related third-party risk management program, including diligence frameworks, risk indicators, operating models, escalations, and mitigation strategies.
  • Risk Assessment, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement: Lead enterprise compliance risk assessments and support the continued maturation of monitoring, testing, controls mapping, reporting, and lessons-learned processes across the compliance program.
  • Policy Governance & Codes of Conduct: Oversee Snap’s Code of Conduct, related conduct frameworks, and the company’s broader policy-governance approach, including clear ownership and implementation standards.
  • Business Records & Governance: Support records governance, employee communications governance, and related business-process expectations needed to meet legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Trade, Sanctions & Cross-Border Compliance: Oversee Snap’s approach to trade, sanctions, export controls, and other cross-border compliance risks, including coordination with relevant legal and business stakeholders.
  • Training, Communications & Culture: Lead compliance training, outreach, executive messaging, and culture-building efforts designed to promote ethical decision-making and reinforce Snap’s values globally.
  • Metrics, Reporting & Governance Forums: Oversee compliance metrics, dashboards, and reporting for executives, the Board, the Audit Committee, and other governance forums, including Integrity & Compliance strategic plans, investigations trends, program effectiveness, and emerging risks.
  • Management-Level Governance: Own governance for a management-level Risk and Compliance Committee, including agenda-setting, material preparation, escalation pathways, and follow-through on key decisions and action items.
  • Strategic Business Partnership: Advise senior leaders and business teams on significant compliance risks and help design practical solutions that enable business activities in a compliant manner.
  • M&A Compliance Due Diligence: Coordinate compliance due diligence for acquisitions, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions. Identify material risks, recommend mitigation measures, and support post-closing compliance integration.
  • Program Growth & Innovation: Identify and build scalable compliance processes, systems, controls, and governance frameworks as Snap’s products, markets, and risk profile continue to evolve.

Minimum Qualifications

  • J.D. degree from an accredited law school
  • 10+ years of experience in public company compliance, ideally with expertise in trade compliance, product safety compliance, legal, investigations, or related corporate risk functions
  • Demonstrated knowledge of core compliance topics such as anti-bribery and anti-corruption, third-party risk management, investigations, trade or sanctions, policy governance, records retention, corporate ethics, and enterprise compliance program design
  • Experience developing, leading, or substantially enhancing risk-based compliance programs in a global or multinational environment
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams or complex compliance workstreams across multiple risk areas

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience advising senior business leaders and Board members in technology, media, platform, or other global consumer-facing companies
  • Experience leading investigations, anti-bribery, third-party risk, policy governance, controls, or enterprise risk-assessment functions
  • Familiarity with established compliance frameworks, such as the U.S. Department of Justice’s Evaluation of Corporate Compliance Programs
  • Strong analytical and organizational capabilities, including experience with compliance metrics, dashboards, and program analytics
  • Experience with compliance platforms and tools, such as third-party diligence systems, employee disclosures systems, case-management tools, risk applications, and training learning management systems
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • A proactive and practical approach to compliance in fast-paced, dynamic environments
  • Strong work ethic and a team-first mindset — willing to take on tasks both big and small to get the job done
  • Excellent judgment and the ability to provide practical, business-focused advice in fast-paced and evolving environments

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

title: Intern, Client Experience Strategy & Operations
description:
Build something people love

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual and learn more about how we work.

Intern, Client Experience Strategy & Operations (Winter 2027)

Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Term: 8 months, beginning January 11, 2027.

This is an 8 month internship designed for co-op students, non-co-op students, and recent graduates who are ready to ship impactful work.

During your internship, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects that are changing the landscape of financial services for Canadians. You will be on a team that supports your growth, provides mentorship, and connects you to the broader Wealthsimple community!

Our internship program operates on a hybrid model, where you’ll be working from our Toronto headquarters on Wednesdays and Thursdays. This structure offers the flexibility of remote work, while also providing the collaboration, connection, and mentorship that come from being together in person.

This posting covers two tracks: Workflow Optimization and Enablement. Please apply to the one that best fits your interests.

Please note: the role you apply for is the role you will be assessed on throughout the interview process. We are unable to accommodate requests to switch between Workflow Optimization and Enablement tracks after submission.

About the CX Operations Team

The CX Operations team is responsible for enabling exceptional client and agent experiences across Wealthsimple through optimized systems, content, AI solutions, and strategic initiatives. We manage the technology, knowledge, and processes that power our customer experience organization, driving continuous improvement in efficiency and effectiveness.

Choose your track:

Workflow Optimization, Intern

Workflow Optimization (WFO) streamlines the workflows, systems, and automations that span our entire ecosystem of tools. We partner with teams across the organization to identify and simplify toilsome workflows through process mapping, automation, and AI tool implementations.

As a WFO Intern, you'll partner with WFO managers and internal SMEs to: design and build AI tools for analysis; audit and improve automations; map and redesign workflows; and deliver measurable improvements in containment, resolution time, and operational risk.

You'll develop core skills in project planning, process design, AI tool deployment, and AI‑enhanced automation while contributing directly to CX efficiency and client experience.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to

  • Partner with the AI Experiences team to launch net-new features to our clients and support agents.

  • Map current-state workflows with SMEs, identify optimization opportunities, and implement AI-enhanced changes across macros, automations, and documentation.

  • Build comprehensive automation inventories across multiple systems, to propose consolidations and net-new automations and AI optimizations.

What you’ll bring

  • Structured problem solving and process thinking, with the ability to translate ambiguous workflows into clear maps and requirements

  • Basic familiarity with AI concepts (LLM, RAG, context windows, hallucination, etc.)

  • Basic familiarity with customer operations tools or ticketing systems (Zendesk, JIRA)

  • Basic familiarity with data and testing concepts – to be applied in the context of testing the accuracy of AI models (A/B testing, sample sizes, statistical significance, etc.)

  • Strong documentation and communication skills to collaborate with SMEs and present proposals

  • Bias to action and ownership to drive projects from discovery to implementation

Enablement, Intern

Our enablement group is responsible for how our support workforce learns, performs, and grows. We build the systems, programs, and culture that keep our support teams performing at a high bar. Quality, learning, change readiness, and performance measurement all sit within this group. Underneath all of it is a simple belief: every client interaction should be fast, high-quality, and trustworthy. Our job is to turn that belief into measurable reality.

As an Enablement Intern, you'll support the group's analytical work. You'll partner with the managers who own quality and performance measurement to test the data, run original analyses, spot trends early, and turn your findings into recommendations leaders can act on. This goes beyond reporting, the question is never only "what does the number say?" It's also "is this measuring the right thing, and what should we do about it?"

You'll build skills in analysis, metric design, and structured problem solving, and see up close how an AI-first quality and performance program runs in a regulated industry. The best person for this role doesn't only meet a high bar; they hold their own work to one.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to

  • Design and run trending analyses across scorecard metrics to inform target reviews, and build a repeatable way of doing them so each review doesn't start from scratch

  • Look for relationships between metrics, such as how quality, satisfaction and efficiency move together, and turn what you find into clear charts and recommendations

  • Help define and document metrics: what each one measures, where its data comes from, and where two metrics overlap or one is only raw input to another

  • Build checks and first-pass reviews that help the team catch errors in scorecards and reports before they’re finalized

  • Support analysis of quality data, such as sampling and summarizing results, as projects call for it

What you’ll bring

  • Strong quantitative and spreadsheet skills, and comfort cleaning, joining and pivoting messy data (SQL is a plus)

  • An understanding of how relational data fits together (tables, keys, joins). SQL is a plus but not required

title: Team Lead - Perception
description:
Join SE3 Labs as Team Lead - Perception

Build and lead the team that teaches SE3's autonomous systems to see, and ship perception that holds up on real missions.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Perception team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Perception Team Lead, you'll own SE3's perception stack end to end: the technical roadmap, the architecture and the core algorithmic decisions behind object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation and depth estimation. You'll hire and grow the team, set the engineering bar and stay hands-on, working closely with our founders and autonomy engineers as systems move from recorded data to field trials. What you build decides how well our platforms understand the world around them in real operations.

What You’ll Work On

  • Perception Roadmap: Own the technical roadmap for perception, deciding what we build, in which order and how we measure progress.

  • Architecture & Algorithms: Define the architecture of the perception stack and make the core algorithmic decisions across detection, tracking, segmentation and depth.

  • Detection & Tracking: Ship object detection and multi-object tracking that stay reliable on real mission data from our autonomous platforms.

  • Segmentation & Depth: Deliver semantic segmentation and depth estimation that give downstream autonomy a dependable picture of the scene.

  • Evaluation & Replay: Build the evaluation and replay loop so the team iterates mostly on recorded data, with clear metrics, benchmark datasets and regression tests.

  • Real-World Deployment: Take models from training to onboard compute and field trials, and improve them until they work under real operating conditions.

  • Team Building: Hire the perception team, set the bar for engineering quality and mentor engineers while staying hands-on in the code.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of hard technical problems and lead from the front, staying hands-on while setting direction for others.

  • You hold a Ph.D. with 3+ years of industry experience, or an . with 6+ years, in Computer Vision, Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

  • You have a proven record of building perception systems that shipped and worked in the real world, in robotics, autonomous driving, AR/VR, drones or adjacent domains.

  • You bring deep expertise across modern perception, including object detection, tracking, segmentation and depth estimation, and you base architecture decisions on evaluation data.

  • You have led engineering teams, including hiring, setting technical direction and growing people.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Publications at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS or similar venues.

  • Experience building a team or technical function at an early-stage company.

  • Supervising students or researchers and turning research into product.

  • Deploying models on real-time, resource-constrained compute such as Jetson-class platforms.

  • Field experience with UAVs or other robots that get tested outside the lab.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Coding / Algorithm Interview: (90 min): We work through a practical perception, estimation, or robotics software problem together

  3. Technical Interview (1 hr): We dive into perception systems you have built and shipped, the hardest technical decisions you have made and how you raise the bar for a team.

  4. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
The Cybersecurity Analyst supports day-to-day Security Operations and Incident Response by monitoring and investigating threats, coordinating incident response, conducting threat intelligence and threat hunting, managing operational vulnerability workflows, and maintaining accurate cases and security metrics. Security Engineering owns security-platform engineering and vulnerability-scanning platforms, while technology and application owners execute remediation.

This position is open to candidates in the Seattle, WA area. You will have a hybrid remote/in-office schedule where you will work from our casual, pet-friendly office at least 3 days a week.

Responsibilities:

Security Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor and triage alerts across identity, endpoint, email, network, cloud, application, vulnerability, and data-protection technologies.
  • Validate, enrich, classify, and prioritize security events and investigate phishing, account compromise, malware, ransomware, unauthorized access, data exposure, insider threat, and third-party events.
  • Execute approved containment actions within assigned permissions and coordinate infrastructure-level or production changes with Technology Operations.
  • Collect and preserve evidence, identify affected users, devices, accounts, systems, repositories, and data, and support eradication, recovery validation, heightened monitoring, and closure.

Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting

  • Collect and evaluate intelligence from commercial, government, industry, open-source, MDR, vendor, and internal sources.
  • Analyze threat actors, campaigns, tactics, techniques, procedures, indicators, exploited vulnerabilities, and targeted technologies for relevance to Trupanion.
  • Create tactical and operational intelligence products and operationalize findings through investigations, detections, hunting queries, watchlists, blocking actions, phishing simulation scenarios, and runbook updates.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven hunts across identity, endpoint, email, network, cloud, and application telemetry using MITRE ATT&CK and document scope, queries, evidence, findings, and follow-up actions.

Vulnerability Management Partnership

  • Validate vulnerability findings, assess risk and business exposure, prioritize remediation using threat intelligence and incident telemetry, identify indications of exploitation, and escalate urgent vulnerabilities.
  • Perform threat hunts against affected technologies and recommend temporary containment or monitoring when active exploitation or incident correlation is identified.
  • Partner with Security Engineering, which owns vulnerability-scanning platforms, integrations, technical configuration, and platform reliability.
  • Coordinate remediation assignments with technology and application owners, maintain the vulnerability ticket flow, track progress against defined service levels, report overdue exposure, and escalate ownership or delivery issues through the established governance process.
  • Maintain operational oversight of vulnerability validation, prioritization, ticketing, remediation follow-up, SLA reporting, and escalation; remediation execution remains with the technology or application owner responsible for the affected asset or service.

Automation, Forensics & Case Management

  • Develop and maintain approved automation workflows, scripts, and playbooks for alert enrichment, investigation, authorized response, and case consistency.
  • Preserve identity, endpoint, email, cloud, network, application, and audit-log evidence under approved forensic, legal-hold, integrity, and chain-of-custody procedures.
  • Maintain complete case records covering severity, affected assets, evidence, analysis, actions, decisions, communications, and closure rationale.
  • Validate incident containment and corrective actions through available telemetry, testing, or monitoring.

Breach, Identity, Third-Party & AI Investigations

  • Support breach investigations by identifying affected repositories, records, data types, individuals, business entities, and jurisdictions for Legal and Privacy review.
  • Investigate token theft, MFA changes, privilege escalation, malicious application consent, mailbox manipulation, and compromised user, privileged, service-principal, or workload identities.
  • Investigate third-party, supply-chain, and AI-related security notifications or suspected misuse and document potential Trupanion exposure.

Operating Model & Continuity

  • Execute alert triage, investigations, MDR service monitoring, threat-intelligence analysis, threat hunting, vulnerability validation and prioritization, remediation follow-up, security metrics and reporting, case documentation, and authorized security-tool actions.
  • Escalate architecture, complex integration, detection-platform design, routine vulnerability-management administration, and permanent engineering needs to Security Engineering.
  • Provide structured handovers of active alerts, incidents, intelligence, investigations, and urgent exploitation-driven vulnerability exposures across operating regions.
  • Provide technical evidence to Legal and Privacy and do not independently determine legal privilege, regulatory interpretation, or notification obligations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Digital Forensics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, IT operations, system administration, network security, or a related area.
  • Experience investigating alerts using SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, email, cloud, network, or vulnerability technologies.
  • Knowledge of common attacker techniques, phishing, malware, account compromise, privilege misuse, lateral movement, exfiltration, and vulnerability exploitation.
  • Demonstrated experience applying threat intelligence and incident telemetry to vulnerability prioritization and exploitation assessment.
  • Experience with security automation or scripting, digital-evidence handling, identity investigations, third-party incident analysis, and structured case management.

Skills:

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft 365, Azure, identity security, privileged access management, cloud security, and endpoint environments.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common detection, threat-hunting, and incident-response methodologies.
  • Understanding of vulnerability scanning and remediation workflows and the division of responsibility between vulnerability-program governance, threat-led escalation, and asset-owner remediation.
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NYDFS cybersecurity requirements, or privacy and breach-response obligations.
  • Relevant certification such as Security+, CySA+, SC-200, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent experience is preferred.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to support defined US business-hour coverage and participate in an escalation or on-call rotation.
  • Availability to assist with high-severity incidents outside normal working hours when required.
  • Ability to handle confidential, legally sensitive, and security-restricted information appropriately.

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $140,000 on a full-time schedule.
  • Along with base compensation, Trupanion employees are currently eligible for monthly bonuses.
  • We want all employees to be invested in Trupanion’s success, so we grant Restricted Stock Units to all new team members. Our new hire grants vest over 4 years.

#LI-HYBRID

Benefits and Perks:

  • Four weeks of paid time off and 9 paid float holidays (you can decide which days are most important to you!)
  • Five-week sabbatical after five years of employment

1. Chatbot Development & Configuration

title: Systems Administrator III (Server Engineering)
description:
Systems Administrator III (Server Engineering)


Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices.


Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices, or who are willing to relocate.


Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.


Who We Are Looking For:


Every day, Cambia’s Systems Administrators are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Server Engineering team, the Systems Administrator III position participates in a team environment for the installation, upgrades, testing and maintenance of new and existing computer systems, operating system, and/or software applications. This position provides technical, interpersonal and administrative skills in performing day-to-day work – all in service of making our members’ heath journeys easier.


Do you thrive as a part of a collaborative, caring team? Then this role may be the perfect fit.


What You Bring to Cambia:

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field. Appropriate additional experience beyond the minimum required experience may be substituted for education.


Skills and Attributes:


  • Five years experience in the implementation, operations, development and maintenance of IT systems and/or administration of Software functions in multi-platform and multi-system environments.
  • Highly proficient understanding of design, implementation and sustainment activities of Information Technology systems.
  • Must have experience with infrastructure management techniques such as change management, problem management, release management, configuration management and/or system lifecycle.
  • Has a strong understanding in MS and/or UNIX environment including common suites and core business applications.
  • Has a strong understanding of the appropriate environments for assigned applications.
  • Ability to develop efficient and effective program and system solutions in solving light to medium complex business problems.
  • Ability to automate tasks and document them for others to use; take direction from others.
  • Ability to analyze, diagnose and resolve system performance problems or outages.
  • Must be technically proficient in core technologies and methodologies used by the team.
  • Ability to effectively adapt to rapidly changing technologies and methodologies and apply them to technological and/or business needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to upgrade hardware operating system software and third party software.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and document medium to large product upgrades.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead Disaster Recovery team, including scripting and testing for operating systems, third party software and storage recovery.
  • Experience in project management techniques and the ability to lead projects to a timely successful outcome
  • Must have strong ability to project/forecast time allocation for project completion.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate with coworkers and all levels of management both verbally and written.


Preferred Skills:


  • Automation technologies, Ansible, Packer, Terraform.
  • Microsoft Azure platform and VM management

What You Will Do at Cambia:


  • As part of the Server Engineering team, support and manage AIX, RHEL, Windows and VMware infrastructure
  • Installs and configures computing systems and/or support software in support of business processes and objectives.
  • May be accountable for researching and solving highly complex software issues and collaborates with vendors and other support teams in regards to product or Infrastructure problems.
  • Perform hardware installation and configuration; operating system and support software installation, upgrade, and patches; performance tuning; and documentation.
  • Research, analyze and submit analysis and recommendations for software development, enhancement, replacement or purchase. This individual may lead project teams based on experience and knowledge.
  • Collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, and application architects to design and implement automated solutions that ensure high-quality, reliable, and secure business operations.
  • Administers the integration of licensed and/or in-house developed applications and writing programs and/or scripting to integrate with other systems.
  • Participates in the research and estimating of proposed work.
  • Responsible for initiating process and system improvements and monitoring industry trends
  • Provides support and coordination in the effective administration of computing systems and support software.

  • Provides technical training to team or Business partners through training sessions.
  • Acts as a consultant to manage, configure, implement, monitor, identify, diagnose, resolve problems and perform analysis in relation to the integrated IT environment and software.
  • Demonstrates knowledge in networked computing structure and architecture.
  • Prepares and/or directs program, system, operational and User documentation.
  • Prepares individual work plans and reports activities, tasks, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and status reports, as appropriate.
  • Works as an active team member for joint success of a project, taking responsibility, and providing timely updates for, assigned action items and deliverables.
  • May be required to maintain professional working relationships with vendors.

  • Uses common system maintenance tools, without assistance.
  • Provides leadership and mentoring to other team members.
  • Uses crossover knowledge into other technical disciplines, which facilitate the understanding, coordination and communication between technical areas.
  • Adapts to new technology and methodologies.

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

title: Associate Editor
description:
Inkitt is building the Operating System for Storytellers, standing at the forefront of technology and entertainment.

Leveraging AI and predictive algorithms, Inkitt discovers unknown stories and turns them into blockbuster hits, producing a new $1M ebook every 7 days and selling directly to consumers through its Inkitt Galatea app. Bestsellers are then translated onto the screen through Inkitt CandyJar, the #1 US-based microdrama platform with billions of episodes streamed to date, and Inkitt Ironblood, the world's first streaming app for superhero, sci-fi and action stories.

Inkitt has become the 11th most bestseller-generating publisher in the world, boasting a 40x higher hit-rate than traditional publishers.

Backed by some of the top VC’s such as: Khosla, Kleiner Perkins, and NEA Ventures, our recent expansion into Ironblood, the first AI Native streaming platform for action and adventure, is only the beginning of our journey to becoming the next-gen entertainment powerhouse.

The Role:
We’re building the best romance catalogue in the world, and we’re assembling a small team of creative people to do it. As an Associate Editor, you’ll take books that readers almost love and reimagine them: the characters, the stakes, the pacing, the plot, the emotional payoff. You’ll study how readers respond, work out what’s holding a story back, and rebuild it into something that hits far harder. Then you’ll put your version in front of real readers and see if you were right.

What You'll Do:

  • Read deeply and diagnose. Find where and why a story loses readers, using the manuscript, reader feedback and engagement data.
  • Write clear, bold editorial plans for major rewrites: new hooks, reworked arcs, sharper character motivation, payoffs readers can’t stop talking about.
  • Bring your vision to life. Execute those rewrites in collaboration with authors and agentic AI tools.
  • Test your instincts. Run reader tests on your revisions, interpret the results, and carry what you learn into the next book.
  • Build relationships with authors, freelance editors, marketing and the wider content team, who will be your collaborators in making each book better.

What You'll Bring:

  • You love romance and read widely in it. You know the tropes, heat levels and subgenres, and you have strong opinions on why readers keep coming back.
  • You have sharp editorial instincts. You can say exactly why a story isn’t working and what would fix it.
  • You’re a creative thinker with big story ideas, and you get excited by the chance to reinvent a book, not just repair it.
  • You’re comfortable with developing creative theories from quantitative data. You can look at reader data, form a hypothesis and explain it clearly.
  • You’re excited to use AI as a creative tool, with the taste to judge what it produces and make it better.
  • You’re smart, curious and hungry. You learn fast, take ownership, and want real responsibility early.
  • You have 1-3 years in editorial or publishing, an MFA, or similar. Your judgment and ideas matter more than your résumé.
  • You can work on-site in San Francisco 5 days a week.

Nice To Have:

  • Experience with serialized or web fiction (Wattpad, Galatea, Kindle Vella, webtoons)
  • Experience giving developmental feedback to writers
  • Your own fiction, playwriting, or screenwriting experience. We love people who make things.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Location: Remote, US-based. Full Time.

About the Role

Every day, pet owners walk out of a vet's office having just said no to a treatment their pet needed, not because they didn't care, but because they couldn't afford it. Pawlicy Advisor exists to eliminate this problem. Pawlicy Advisor is a profitable venture-backed startup building the infrastructure that connects pet owners to the right financial protection for their pets, starting with the most trusted pet insurance marketplace in the US, distributed through thousands of veterinary practices nationwide. The company has delivered over 1 million unique quotes, has raised $19M+, has found product-market fit, and is now scaling. Pawlicy Advisor is hiring a Senior Product Designer to own design end to end: research, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and the design system. You will own the design of the marketplace experience that helps pet parents make one of the most important decisions they face, working 1-2 sprints ahead of a fast-moving engineering team that loves to build high quality front end experiences. This is a high-ownership role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, on an outstanding team of five engineers, a data analyst, a senior product manager, and an engineering manager.

What You Own

Design Execution

  • Wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and design iteration for new features and experiments across the website.
  • Gathering feedback from internal stakeholders on new product features and resolving conflicting input.
  • Building and managing the design system in close collaboration with the senior marketing designer.
  • Design QA for engineering: reviewing shipped work against designs before release.

Content Ownership

  • First drafts of UX copy in product: quote flow language, plan explanations, error states, and making insurance terms understandable for pet parents.
  • Ensuring copy reviews are completed by legal and compliance.
  • Supporting Pawlicy's brand development across product, site, and marketing assets.

User Research

  • Deep competitive analysis of the pet insurance landscape and other marketplaces, feeding insights into the roadmap.
  • User testing for new product and feature development: talking to pet parents and veterinary staff, analyzing behavior, and translating findings intoProduct ideas and design decisions.

Where You Partner

  • Engineering: handoff and design QA with a team that loves building high quality front end experiences, working 1-2 sprints ahead of them.
  • Product: user research and competitive analysis with the senior product manager.
  • Marketing design: the design system and brand development in close collaboration with the senior marketing designer.
  • Legal and compliance: copy reviews on insurance language, keeping it plain without losing accuracy.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

  • Designing 1-2 sprints ahead of engineering with a queue you defined yourself; nobody assigns the work.
  • Design QA is running: shipped work is reviewed against designs before release.
  • Command of the competitive landscape: pet insurance and marketplace patterns feeding the roadmap.
  • First user tests with pet parents run, synthesized, and reflected in shipped designs.

First 12 months

  • The design system is adopted by engineering, and accelerating feature velocity.
  • Quote flow and plan language is measurably clearer, with insurance terms pet parents understand.
  • Product changes have increased increase quote to sale conversion at a statistically significant level
  • Research findings routinely change what gets built.
  • Craft holds at a high bar with no design reviewer above you.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product design experience with a track record of significant ownership, ideally at an early stage startup or fast-paced environment.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinking, from research and strategy through polished, shipped UI.
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a design system.
  • Strong UX writing skills: you can draft clear, plain-language product copy.
  • Proven experience running user research and competitive analysis independently and translating findings into product decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions: you have worked closely with engineers, marketers, and business stakeholders.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Must be based in the USA.
  • Preferred: experience in insurtech, fintech, or consumer marketplaces. Extra points if you love animals and believe pet healthcare is a serious, underserved problem.

How You Work

  • You do your best work with real autonomy and define your own work 1-2 sprints ahead of engineering, with no design director above you.
  • You initiate projects yourself, from spotting the problem to shipping.
  • You hold strong opinions, loosely held: a clear point of view on how to solve user problems without being precious about it.
  • You push back, disagree, and align without it becoming political.
  • You thrive in a high pace environment and love owning your craft.
  • You use AI tools daily to compound the company’s output

AI and the Hiring Process

We embrace AI at Pawlicy and our work still relies on what the humans bring to it.

So please leave the AI out of interviews and case studies. Prep with it all you like, but in the room, we want your thinking, your questions, your judgment. These stages exist so we can get to know you and how you'd work with our team. We're hiring you, not a model and it is you we want to see.

To be concrete: no AI assistants or chatbots on any device during interviews, and nobody else feeding you answers. Spell-check, autocomplete and notes you wrote yourself are all completely fine.

If it turns out AI was used where we've asked you not to, it may end your candidacy.

If any part of our process is a barrier because of how you read, write or communicate, email careers@pawlicy.com before that stage and we'll talk through the options. The skills we're assessing stay the same; what changes is the format. Asking has no bearing on how we assess you.

Benefits

  • Base salary range: $165,000 - $200,000
  • Startup equity grant.
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) employer contributions; flexible vacation.
  • Remote-first within the United States.

Career Path

This role is the only product designer seat at a company of ~20 today, growing to 25-30 in 2027, reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, with a path to design leadership as the team scales. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in NYC, Pawlicy Advisor is a licensed insurance agency and the leading pet insurance marketplace in the US.

If you do your best work with real autonomy, thrive in a high pace environment, and love owning your craft, Pawlicy would like to talk. Learn more at

title: Head of State Gov Relations
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About the Role

eBay is seeking an experienced Government Relations leader to lead our state and local government relations work across the United States. Reporting to the Head of Americas Government Relations, this role will develop and implement eBay’s state policy strategy. It will lead a team of state GR professionals and represent eBay with policymakers and external collaborators.

The successful candidate will be a strategic and creative advocate who understands how public policy intersects with business strategy. They will anticipate emerging legislative, regulatory and political developments, assess their potential impact on eBay, and interpret those developments as distinct business risks, opportunities and recommended actions. They will help set priorities across states and issues and develop proactive strategies to promote eBay’s interests.

This role goes beyond traditional lobbying. The ideal candidate will combine direct government engagement, grassroots and influential advocacy, alliances, public affairs, and thought leadership. They will also use events and other tools to develop policy discussions and deliver results. They will also be comfortable applying AI and new technologies to improve policy intelligence, strategy development and team efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and complete a coordinated state Government Relations strategy aligned with eBay’s business priorities and the broader Americas GR agenda.
  • Foresee developing legal, administrative, and governmental trends across the states; assess their implications for eBay; and recommend strategic responses.
  • Prioritize among states and topics, balancing immediate legislative needs with longer-term policy objectives.
  • Develop proactive policy campaigns and approaches to engagement that help build policy discussions before legislation or regulation is fully formed.
  • Translate complex policy developments into clear business risks, opportunities, and practical recommendations for business leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Find opportunities where public policy and outreach efforts can support eBay’s priorities, innovation, growth and seller community.
  • Represent eBay with governors’ offices, state legislators, attorneys general, regulators, trade associations and other key stakeholders, building durable relationships across the political spectrum.
  • Develop integrated advocacy strategies that combine direct government engagement with grassroots and grasstops advocacy, coalitions, public affairs, thought leadership, events and third-party voices.
  • Partner with Communications and other teams to develop narratives, thought leadership and external engagement strategies that advance eBay’s policy objectives.
  • Lead, develop and prioritize the state GR team, creating clear accountability and helping team members grow as strategic policy advisors and effective advocates.
  • Work closely with Legal, Communications, Tax, Product, Trust & Safety and other functions to develop strategies that are both politically effective and operationally workable.
  • Work with colleagues across Americas GR to identify broader policy trends, coordinate strategies and bring state insights into regional priorities.
  • Use AI, data and new technologies to improve policy intelligence, research, prioritization, collaborator engagement and team efficiency.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in Government Relations, public policy, public affairs, political strategy or a related field, with significant experience working on state policy.
  • Deep understanding of state legislative, regulatory and political processes and demonstrated success navigating complex multi-state policy environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to set policy priorities, develop strategy and anticipate emerging risks and opportunities rather than simply respond to legislation.
  • Proven ability to translate public policy issues into clear business implications and practical mentorship for business leaders.
  • Experience leading teams and setting priorities across multiple issues and jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to develop and carry out cohesive advocacy approaches that extend beyond direct lobbying, including grassroots or grasstops engagement, coalitions, public affairs, thought leadership and events.
  • Strong relationships and credibility with policymakers, political stakeholders and external organizations.
  • Strong business judgment and intellectual curiosity, with the ability to quickly understand new products, technologies and business models.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with senior business leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities and achieve outcomes in a fast paced environment.
  • Comfort using AI alongside new and developing technologies to enhance efficiency, analysis and decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate Government Relations, particularly within technology, ecommerce, marketplaces, retail or another consumer-facing industry.
  • Experience engaging governors’ offices, attorneys general and senior state officials.
  • Experience developing and executing multi-state advocacy campaigns.
  • Experience working closely with Communications or Public Affairs teams on integrated external strategies.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$195,200 - $260,600

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guideline.

title: Short-Term Paid Research Study for European Portuguese-Speaking Students
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native Portuguese speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in Portuguese actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

#LI-JC2 #LI-REMOTE

About the Role

Veeam is a leading provider of backup and recovery software for virtual, physical, and cloud environments. Our Corporate Technology team oversees the operation of the company’s information systems and supports the platforms and services that power Veeam’s business worldwide. We are seeking an AI Solutions Architect to design strategic, cross-functional, and cross-platform AI solutions that enable business transformation. In this role, you will partner with business and technology leaders to architect scalable AI solutions, drive implementation, and ensure successful adoption across the organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with business leadership and development teams managers to define the scope of the AI solution and clarify its functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Identify involved and affected systems and existing AI tools and solutions, perform an impact analysis.
  • Design technological solutions that satisfy identified business and technical requirements.
  • Help project managers identify technical experts and stakeholders and secure development team resources necessary to deliver project objectives.
  • Facilitate communication among technical experts and stakeholders while helping project managers coordinate development teams in their efforts to implement solutions and meet project objectives.
  • Ensure proper rollout of AI solutions.
  • Document AI solutions at a high level and ensure the appropriate low-level documentation is created and maintained by development teams.
  • Facilitate continuous improvement of designed solutions

Technologies You’ll Work With

  • AI platforms and solutions
  • AWS or other major cloud providers
  • Python, Go, TypeScript, or other programming languages
  • Distributed systems architectures
  • Integration platforms and technologies
  • UML
  • ITIL and ITSM frameworks
  • Agile development methodologies

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years of work experience as an AI Solution Architect and 5+ years in Software Engineering.
  • Knowledge of the design principles of distributed systems and modern integration approaches.
  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud provider.
  • Knowledge of UML.
  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Proficiency in English sufficient to read and write technical documentation and communicate effectively with English-speaking users and stakeholders.
  • Desire and ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Bonus Skills

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or TypeScript.
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise AI solutions.
  • Experience working across multiple platforms, systems, and business functions in large-scale environments.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day

  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong interest in building AI-first products who enjoys owning problems end-to-end – from vague client needs and early hypotheses to production-grade systems that actually get used.

**What You’ll Do

**You’ll join The Tech Collective (our Data & AI hub, specifically), where we help organisations design, build, and operationalise data- and AI-driven solutions.

This role is tailor-made for a systems thinker and builder – someone who has shipped real products, taken responsibility for technical direction, and is motivated by creating pragmatic solutions that combine data, software, and AI.

You’ll work closely with experienced AI specialists who bring deep model and ML expertise, while you focus on building robust products and software around those capabilities.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

  • End-to-end solution ownership: designing and implementing full-stack applications from early concepts and prototypes to scalable, production-grade systems, including architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud
  • Modern full-stack development: building high-quality frontend and backend services, applying sound software engineering principles, and using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and critically
  • AI-enabled product building: collaborating with AI specialists to integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and agentic patterns into real products, and translating AI potential into solutions that make sense for organisations
  • Data and systems thinking: designing data models, reasoning about distributed systems and trade-offs, and implementing event-driven or real-time features where they add value
  • Observability and evaluation: experience setting up the right observability and eval tooling to establish traceability and iteratively improve on products
  • Cloud, delivery, and collaboration: deploying and operating solutions in cloud environments, balancing speed, robustness, and security, and working closely with clients and stakeholders to create tangible business impact

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re looking for someone with an AI builder mentality and 5+ years of hands-on full-stack experience, who is comfortable owning applications end to end – from frontend and backend to data and deployment.

You don’t need to tick every box, but you should recognise yourself in most of the following:

  • Strong full-stack foundation: solid skills in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building and shipping production systems
  • Mentoring experience: helping other developers through technical sparring and code reviews
  • Outward curiosity: actively seeking to understand client problems in detail and working in close collaboration with them to solve them
  • Ownership and leadership: a track record of building substantial solutions from scratch (e.g., startup, scale-up, or personal ventures), taking responsibility for outcomes, and leading technical direction without relying on formal authority
  • System-level thinking: the ability to reason about architecture, data flows, trade-offs, and failure modes across the stack, and to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous contexts
  • Critical technical judgement: a keen eye for identifying weaknesses in existing architectures and tech stacks, and knowing where and how to improve them
  • Communication and collaboration: the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, work across disciplines, and learn from – and share knowledge with – others in the team and across Implement
  • Tool agnostic: capable of choosing the right tool for the job

**What We Offer

**We offer a role with technical ownership and influence, working in a 20-person team that feels much closer to a nerdy startup than a large corporation – while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group.

You’ll gain exposure to a wide range of data- and AI-driven problems across industries, all within a culture built on trust, curiosity, humility, resilience, and impact. You’ll also have great freedom to shape your own role, deepen your expertise, and grow in exactly the direction that motivates you.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Apply ASAP.

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

We’re expanding our team and look forward to meeting talented people who are curious about a career in information systems and management consulting at the intersection of business and technology.

(BCI) is a minority-owned, 9,000 employee, global service provider overseeing account services in food, environmental, facility maintenance, professional staffing, and security. title: Underwriting Program Leader - Property and Casualty
description:
Program Leader - Property & Casualty

Nirvana is on a mission to harness the power of data to revolutionize commercial insurance and enable a safer world. We're bringing much-needed innovation to the legacy, trillion-dollar commercial insurance industry with an AI-native platform that changes how an insurance company operates, from risk selection and pricing to underwriting, claims and loss prevention.

We proved the model in commercial auto, one of the toughest lines in insurance. Using real-time telematics data from more than 30 billion miles, we built predictive models that understand and price risk better. Since then we've grown to serve thousands of fleets and more than doubled written premium year over year, with a loss ratio, efficiency and customer experience that are redefining what's possible. Now we're taking the same platform (data, technology and underwriting discipline) into new lines of business and new programs.

With $270+ million raised, including our Series D round in December 2025, we’re only accelerating our growth, with strong support from top-tier VCs including Lightspeed, General Catalyst, and Valor. Nirvana’s leadership team has previously helped scale multi-billion-dollar companies from scratch, including Samsara, Glassdoor, and Flexport, and includes industry veterans from Nationwide, The Hartford, and RLI.

About the Role

Are you a property and casualty underwriting leader with deep expertise in a profitable P&C niche, and a clear view of the program you’d build if you had the capital, capacity, and right platform behind you? We’re opening this role to P&C program leaders who want to build and own a program of their choice on Nirvana’s platform. You bring the niche, the underwriting expertise and the relationships. We bring an AI-native platform, data science, engineering, capacity relationships, and the capital to launch and scale the program.

You’ll be accountable for the program’s P&L, top line and bottom line, and you’ll build it in close partnership with Nirvana’s leadership. We’re not looking to replicate a traditional program. Together, we’ll design one that uses our data, technology and AI-native operating model from day one, and you’ll grow your own team as the program scales. The role comes with meaningful financial upside tied to the program’s success.

What you’ll do:

  • Bring a focused P&C market thesis and develop it into the program’s strategy, risk appetite, underwriting guidelines and operating rhythm in partnership with senior leadership, turning a focused market thesis into a disciplined, profitable program.

  • Be the program’s lead line underwriter to get it off the ground, evaluating and pricing property and casualty risks and owning both new business and renewals.

  • Own the brokerage relationships that drive the program’s growth: build the wholesale and retail distribution network, set production goals and be the face of the program in the market.

  • Work closely with senior leadership, engineering, product and data science to shape the platform, underwriting workflows and operating procedures, so the program scales with technology instead of headcount.

  • Own the relationship with reinsurers and capacity partners, and be accountable to them for portfolio performance (including catastrophe and accumulation exposure), reporting and renewals.

  • Build and lead the program team (underwriting, distribution and operations) as the program grows.

About you:

  • 10+ years of underwriting in commercial property and casualty, with deep expertise in a defined niche.

  • A track record of managing a large P&C portfolio, ideally $50M+ in premium, profitably and at scale.

  • A clear program thesis. You can explain the P&C niche you’d target, why it’s profitable, why now, and how data and technology would give the program an edge.

  • Proven underwriting discipline. You’ve written underwriting guidelines and appetite before, and your results show you stick to them.

  • You’ve owned distribution. You’ve built and run broker relationships that drive production, and you enjoy getting on the road to meet partners.

  • An entrepreneur at heart. You think like an owner, are comfortable with ambiguity, and use AI and technology to underwrite smarter and scale faster.

  • You want to build something new, not repeat the old playbook. You’re excited to challenge traditional underwriting practices, work hand in hand with leadership and technologists, and do things the right way rather than the way they’ve always been done.

  • Nice to have: experience launching a P&C program or new segment, working directly with reinsurers or capacity partners, or leading an underwriting team.

How to apply

In your application, include a short note on the P&C program you’d build: the class of business or niche, the opportunity you see, and the distribution relationships you’d bring.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity.

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance.

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Unlimited PTO.

  • Work from home friendly.

We set our salary ranges using compensation data from companies similar to our stage and size. For this role, the estimated total compensation range for this position is $ 137,000 - 196,000. The actual base salary will vary depending on multiple factors unique to each candidate, including location, job-related knowledge, transferable skills, work experience and our assessment of your level during the interview process. Nirvana offers equity for all full-time employees, which is not included in the range listed above and will have an impact on your overall compensation.

Nirvana offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive benefits including 100% employer paid healthcare plans, an up to 4% 401k match program, paid time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursement, work-from-home stipend and more.Nirvana is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We'd like to consider you for this position and roles that may be a fit in the future.

Nirvana is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Nirvana considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
About Us:

PUNCH Cyber Analytics Group (PUNCH) is a Virginia-based, small business founded in 2012 operating as a cohesive team that incorporates the sum of our group’s diverse skills, talents, and resources toward our collective passion: advancing data analytics to impact cyber operations. PUNCH is a two-time Inc. Magazine ‘Best Workplaces’ awardee offering unique benefits and personal touches to provide a positive work-life experience for our team. PUNCH brings unique qualifications, resources, and past-performance that make us suitable to address the goals of our diverse customer-base. Further, we have past and current experience supporting cyber operations and cyber ML-based research, with well over 100 years of collective experience from our collaborative, multi-disciplinary team.

Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the organization’s Zero Trust security architecture and strategy aligned with business and security objectives.
  • Provide recommendations regarding the Agency's perimeter UTM devices IAW NIST 800-53 and industry best practices for Cisco, Juniper, Riverbed, and Fortinate
  • Develop Zero Trust roadmaps, maturity models, and implementation plans across people, processes, applications, data, devices, and infrastructure.
  • Establish identity-centric security controls, including strong authentication, MFA, SSO, identity governance, and least-privilege access.
  • Design network segmentation and micro-segmentation to limit lateral movement and reduce attack surfaces.
