  • Identify security gaps, vulnerabilities, architectural risks, and legacy dependencies that prevent Zero Trust adoption.

  • Continuously evolve the architecture based on new threats, technologies, business requirements, and emerging Zero Trust capabilities.

title: Dutch Speaker in NYC - Join a 3-Day Paid Phone Study - $100/hr

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native Dutch speaker who grew up in the Netherlands.
  • You use Dutch in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.

Simple and transparent

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

title: AI Software Staff Engineer
description:
AI Software Staff Engineer

Location: Campbell, CA

Arteris connects innovation.
Our technology helps the world’s most visionary companies—from startups to Fortune 500 leaders—build smarter, faster semiconductors, specifically SoCs and chiplets. From the car you drive, to the AI in the cloud, Arteris connects the innovative tech that shapes tomorrow.

What You’ll Do as a AI Software Staff Engineer at Arteris

Join our innovative team and help shape the future of semiconductor technology, specifically system-on-chip (SoC) and chiplets. In this role, you will contribute to [insert a high-level purpose or function of the role], collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive impact across cutting-edge products and solutions.

You will work at the intersection of software engineering, AI application development, and deployment infrastructure, within a technology environment focused on EDA, security, semiconductors, and SoC design.

You will collaborate with our research and development team who develop cutting edge applications of AI towards security solutions, with the objective of transforming these solutions into robust, reliable, production-ready applications and services.

This is not primarily an AI research or model-development role. We are looking for a Software Engineer with a strong understanding of AI technologies who can build the systems required to bring them into production.

You will work with applications based on LLMs, chatbots, RAG systems, AI assistants, and AI agents, while addressing the technical challenges involved in their application, integration and deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Turn AI/ML and LLM proof-of-concepts into production-grade software applications and services. Design, develop, and maintain software components surrounding AI models, including APIs, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and user-facing applications.
  • Develop and deploy LLM-powered applications, including chatbots, RAG systems, AI assistants, and agent-based applications.
  • Integrate existing AI/ML models and services into broader software products and workflows.
  • Deploy AI applications in cloud and/or on-premises environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Work with containerized and distributed environments and contribute to deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Address production engineering requirements including security, networking, authentication, authorization, monitoring, logging, observability, and resource management.
  • Collaborate with Software, Infrastructure, Hardware, and Application teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing EDA, security, semiconductor, and SoC design workflows.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues related to AI services, applications, deployment, performance, and integration.
  • Contribute to software architecture and make pragmatic technical decisions that balance development speed, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, well-tested production code and contribute to engineering best practices.

What You Bring

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

Join a data infrastructure and analytics team building a platform that turns information from many sources into reliable, current company intelligence. You will own the platform end to end, from architecture and ingestion through production operations, helping power downstream products with trusted data.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

  • Ingest data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping, with rate limiting and robust failure handling.

  • Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

  • Build messaging and task queue workflows with retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay.

  • Preserve original payloads in Google Cloud Storage and transform data with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers.

  • Develop idempotent upserts, data contracts, automated quality checks, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns for reliable downstream use.

  • Integrate data enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction into the platform.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 to 10 or more years of experience, including production ownership of multi-source data platforms from architecture through deployment and ongoing operation.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools, dbt, and Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience building event-driven systems with messaging or task queues and asynchronous processing.

  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading.

  • Proficiency in Python and concurrent or asynchronous processing, such as asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

  • Practical web scraping experience with tools such as Scrapy, Playwright, or Selenium.

  • Experience with data contracts, storage layers, and automated data quality checks. Entity resolution is valuable; BigQuery, Dataform, and LLM-based structured extraction are helpful.

  • Comfort working in a startup or small team with broad ownership and adaptability.

Compensation & Benefits

Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Remote.

description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team, fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
Site:

Job Description Summary:

Job Description:


Location: Candidates must be based in Brazil’s Northeast (state capitals preferred), the Central-West, or São Paulo.


The Medical Science Liaison I (MSL I) is a field base position of Medical Affairs that supports and represents PTC and its products with, and to, key opinion leaders (KOLs), clinicians, academic institutions, and professional organizations. The incumbent addresses the specific needs of these clients by responding to unsolicited requests for information about PTC marketed and developing products.

As the clinical and medical expert on the company’s products, he/she builds long-term relationships and establishes rapport with clinicians and doctors, clinics and academic centers through highly scientific product and disease state discussions that support or expand current therapeutic concepts and ensures safe and effective utilization of products. The incumbent is also a resource to company management regarding market dynamics, business development and client feedback.

The MSL I supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


  • Attends international, national and regional medical meetings and symposia as a representative of PTC and engages in discussions with attendees as appropriate; attends scientific sessions and poster presentations, gathers information, and summarizes findings; as possible, and when appropriate, cultivates professional relationships from these contacts.
  • Delivers, and may develop/design, fair-balanced and objective clinical and scientific presentations to healthcare professionals (HCPs), payors, patients organizations in response to unsolicited requests for information on the use of company products.
  • Identifies and trains speakers for advisory boards symposia, and educational programs with regulatory approved materials, slides sets, abstracts, posters, etc.
  • Identifies, organizes and carry outs regional medical initiatives e.g. advisory board as need.
  • Provides input to management regarding alternative therapies, business development opportunities/risks, and client feedback.
  • Establishes, manages and maintains successful relations with relevant health authorities, including but not limited to: KOLs, HCPs, academic institutions, payors, patient organizations, etc.
  • Facilitates the accurate and timely submissions of applications for unrestricted educational grants or research initiatives and requests for support of studies, per company policy.
  • Maintains a thorough awareness of medical/clinical, regulator, compliance and quality issues and processes as they apply to the PTC therapeutic areas and adheres to, and supports, the standards established by the company.
  • Maintains competitors information relevant to company’s therapeutic areas, goals/objectives, project activities and/product team priorities and stays current on therapeutic advances and competing therapies or products; analyses and applies relevant intelligence findings and communicates and presents insightful data/impact in an efficient format to appropriate internal stake holders.
  • Work closely with key HCPs, such as a field medical team, to identify new opportunities and contribute to the design of the strategic medical plan aligned with the company's objectives to meet stakeholder needs. Evaluate the results and consolidate them as best practices.
  • Work in partnership with the marketing department to contribute to the conception of innovative medical/marketing projects and, consequently, execute them in their own territory.
  • Participate in regular internal meetings with the brand teams, providing insight from the medical field to collaborate on the brand strategy and propose solutions whenever appropriate.
  • Budget planning required to conduct Medical Affairs projects.
  • Provide cross-functional technical support to different departments. Conduct and/or assist with training for PTC's internal clients to better understand the scientific understanding of the molecule.
  • Be able to conduct medical-scientific classes for payers and healthcare providers in other areas to support Market Access, Patient Organization, and Government Affairs strategies.
  • Support in developing the field medical-scientific communication plan.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in health sciences or related scientific discipline
  • Be based in Brazil’s Northeast (state capitals preferred), the Central-West, or São Paulo.
  • Previous experience in similar positions in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related environment
  • Rare disease experience within a pharmaceutical company is required.
  • Advanced English is required (oral and written).
  • Experience in clinical research is an asset.
  • Knowledge in project management and excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical delivery process.
  • Hands-on experience working with KOLs, clinicians, HCPs, payors and/or academic institutions
  • Must posses a valid driver’s license
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and skills, including scientific/technical writing and presentations

title: Director, Analytics - B2B Growth (Remote)
description:
Company Overview:

At Snap Finance, we believe everyone deserves access to the things they need, regardless of credit history. Since 2012, we've used data, machine learning, and a more human approach to create flexible financing solutions that help people move forward. We're proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, built on empowering our customers, partners, and team members alike. When our people thrive, so does our innovation.

If you're looking to make an impact and grow with a team that values you, come join us!

Job Description

Join the Consumer Growth Analytics team at Snap, where we leverage data to accelerate revenue and partner growth across the business. We’re seeking a senior leader to own analytics for a broad range of revenue-driving teams—including SMB Sales, Large Market Sales, Strategic Partnerships, Sales Ops, Rev Ops, and B2B Marketing. In this high-impact role, you’ll lead forecasting, opportunity sizing, and partner performance analysis; support enterprise deal development with market intelligence and RFP analytics; and improve lead qualification and onboarding efficiency to better serve our core ALICE customer (Asset Limited, Income Constrained, Employed). This is a strategic, cross-functional role on a collaborative, high-ownership team where innovative thinking, partnership, and measurable impact are the standard.

How you’ll make an impact:

Strategic Sales Analytics for Partner Growth

  • Identify and quantify opportunities across existing and potential partners, including whitespace analysis and share-of-wallet opportunity sizing.
  • Develop and own frameworks for tracking and improving key sales performance metrics across partner lifecycle stages—from onboarding through growth and retention.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to RevOps, Sales Leadership, Partner Strategy, and B2B Marketing, providing the analytical foundation for revenue-driving initiatives.

Large Market & Enterprise Team Support

  • Conduct partner-level forecasting to project performance based on historical trends, cohort modeling, and macroeconomic indicators.
  • Lead market research and prospect intelligence efforts for potential enterprise partnerships, including:
    • Web scraping and secondary data gathering to assess market footprint, business scale, and potential vertical integration.
    • Estimating current and potential volume and revenue impact for use in executive-level partnership pitches.
  • Collaborate with sales team members to produce high-impact, data-driven materials in response to RFPs, including tailored opportunity sizing and performance projections.

SMB Sales & Growth Optimization

  • Design lead scoring and qualification models to improve top-of-funnel lead quality and reduce disqualification rates.
  • Partner with SMB Sales and Customer Success teams to identify behavioral and operational signals for successful onboarding and partner retention.
  • Support territory planning, rep-level performance optimization, and resource allocation across inside sales, field teams, and customer success groups.
  • Analyze marketing and sales funnel effectiveness to drive improvements in campaign targeting, messaging, and ROI.

Campaign, Funnel & Lifecycle Analytics

  • Analyze B2B marketing campaign effectiveness across acquisition, onboarding, and retention, with a focus on optimizing lifetime value.
  • Build predictive models for churn risk, engagement trends, and bottlenecks in the sales funnel.
  • Evaluate the impact of onboarding, training, and enablement initiatives on partner performance and revenue contribution.

Predictive Modeling & Advanced Analytics

  • Collaborate with Data Science teams to build and deploy machine learning models for lead prioritization, partner segmentation, location-based targeting, and behavior forecasting.
  • Apply advanced techniques such as probabilistic matching, multi-touch attribution, and geographic optimization to enhance partner insights.

Experimentation & Strategic Testing

  • Design and evaluate experiments aimed at improving sales performance, partner onboarding, product adoption, and campaign strategy.
  • Synthesize experimental results into actionable insights that improve conversion rates and increase sales team effectiveness.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 3+ years of direct people management experience, leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, or growth roles within B2B, fintech, or financial services environments, with demonstrated success across both enterprise and SMB sales models.
  • Proven ability to generate revenue impact through analytics in sales, marketing, and partner growth contexts.
  • Deep experience supporting enterprise partnership development—including forecasting, RFP response analytics, and market research.
  • Strong understanding of lead qualification, funnel conversion, and lifecycle management in SMB contexts.
  • Expertise in SQL and familiarity with Python or R for analytics and predictive modeling; ability to partner effectively with Data Engineering and Data Science teams.
  • Experience conducting web scraping and third-party data acquisition for market intelligence and strategic research.
  • Proficiency with modern analytics tools (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, Tableau, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Excellent storytelling, communication, and executive influence skills; capable of turning complex data into business-aligned insights.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Engineering); Master’s degree or MBA preferred


Why Join Us:

  • Generous paid time off

  • Competitive medical, dental & vision coverage

  • 401K with company match for US

  • Company-paid life insurance

  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability

  • Access to mental health and wellness resources

  • Company-paid volunteer time to do good in your community

  • Legal coverage and other supplemental options

  • A value-based culture where growth opportunities are endless

title: Relationship Specialist
description:
Who We Are:

At AFC (Automotive Finance Corporation) we fuel the entrepreneurial dream in our community. For more than 35 years, we’ve been committed to making dreams come true for independent car dealers. AFC’s finance solutions work with more than 12,000 independent dealerships across North America freeing up cash flow to give them more time to focus on building their business. Our solutions amplify purchasing power so dealers can stock their dealership lot with vehicles their customers seek. Learn more about AFC, here: https://www.autofinance.com/

AFC is proud to be a subsidiary of OPENLANE. AFC's core business complements the other business units within the OPENLANE group of companies. For more information, visit https://corporate.openlane.com/.

AFC’s Core Values:

Elevating Relationships. We connect deeply with our customers - celebrating their wins and supporting their struggles as if they were our own.

Powered by Passion. We believe that “passion is our superpower” and that every success is built upon the commitment and perseverance of our employees.

Vision-driven. We look ahead to the bigger picture so our customers can be prepared; after all, their success is our destination.

Dedicated to You. We demonstrate value and appreciation by recognizing and validating each other’s efforts. We stand committed to the success of our customers.

We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a Relationship Specialist who enjoys and is energized by building relationships through meaningful interactions with current and prospective customers. You will be part of a local team responsible for providing financing (floorplanning) for independent auto dealers. You will be involved in elevating customer relationships, attracting new business, and growing AFC revenue while balancing risk. The ideal candidate will have three years of experience in customer-facing, sales, or sales support roles.


Where You’ll Work:

The ideal candidate will reside within the greater Toledo, OH area and travel within their assigned territory.


You Are:

  • Focused on Elevating Relationships: you believe integrity and honesty build long-lasting relationships; connecting with your customers as well as your peers, celebrating their wins, and supporting them through their struggles.
  • Powered by Passion. you are obsessed with customer service and helping our customers realize their unlimited potential. You understand our dealer’s success is built upon the commitment and perseverance of your efforts.
  • Vision-Driven. you focus on understanding your customers’ future needs and are dedicated to continuous improvement; making it easier for customers to do business while preparing for what’s to come.
  • Dedicated. you have an unwavering “people-first” commitment to ensure success and provide support to your customers and team.

You Will:

  • Use critical thinking to assess business and risk situations and make decisions with little oversight
  • Develop an understanding of customer needs by using customer relationship management (CRM) tools and work queues
  • Grow the portfolio organically and assist in promotional efforts to new and existing accounts for product campaigns and cross-platform partnerships
  • Manage, service, and balance risk on customer accounts
  • Manage existing accounts and drive new growth opportunities
  • Embrace our culture of supporting others' success as they grow in their role

Must Have’s:

  • A minimum of three to five years of experience in customer-facing, sales, or sales support roles
  • A valid driver's license with reliable and dedicated transportation
  • Ability and desire to frequently travel (50-75%) within your market to support our current and prospective customer base
  • Desire and experience working in a multi-faceted environment, effectively managing multiple tasks with a strong focus on productivity, and the ability to adapt
  • Proficiently apply sales expertise, adapt to audiences, maintain curiosity, and effectively resolve core dealer issues
  • A strong understanding of portfolio management, risk, and new business development
  • Ability to work independently and autonomously when needed as well as part of a team
  • Ability to use and understand technology required for your position such as mobile applications and software
  • High level of accountability towards local goals and business targets

Nice to Have’s:

  • Previous auto industry or financial services experience
  • Experience with Google Workspace, Salesforce, Tableau
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is preferred


What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

  • Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

  • Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program

  • Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

  • Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

  • Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

  • Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

title: Sr. Cell Therapy Account Specialist, Rochester
description:
Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to treating and, one day, curing life-threatening diseases. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Legend Biotech entered into a global collaboration agreement with Johnson & Johnson to jointly develop and commercialize CARVYKTI® (ciltacabtagene autoleucel; cilta-cel). Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

Legend Biotech is seeking Sr. Cell Therapy Account Specialist as part of the Sales team based in Rochester, NY.

Role Overview

The Cell Therapy Account Specialist is responsible for representing Legend’s products and services to a defined customer base, generating and growing sales and consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets within a specific geographic area

Key Responsibilities

  • Drives multiple myeloma CAR-T brand choice amongst institution-based oncology customers.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Legend and competitor products in our therapeutic area, and an in-depth knowledge of the complexities associated with the disease state
  • Ability to navigate a complex account environment and understand the needs/issues of various stakeholders at all levels within the account and triage to appropriate internal
    stakeholders for support.
  • Develops an understanding of the issues and opportunities unique to each geography.
  • Provides any and all insights to the cross functional team on appropriate and timely feedback from interactions with healthcare professionals (HCPs), including account
    business trends and potential changes in therapeutic landscape.
  • Leverages intel and insights to develop and assertively implements an account business plan to meet customer needs and achieve corporate goals.
  • Works cooperatively with internal team members on various cross-functional projects related to specific accounts or physicians. May work in collaboration with outside partner companies to co-promote products or services.
  • Assists in the identification and resolution of issues and opportunities, and communicates proactively to marketing and sales management. Prepares territory budget plans for customer contacts, unrestricted educational grants, speaker events and other miscellaneous external expenditures.
  • Represents Legend at National and/or local symposiums/conventions.
  • Demonstrates initiative and willingness to work hands-on with a sense of urgency, in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.
  • Demonstrates leadership among peers by consistent application and modeling of the appropriate compliance, behavior, and conduct.
  • Performs all administrative functions required for the position, including reporting call activity and customer information into the appropriate call reporting system in a timely
    manner, submitting expenses, etc.
  • Reports adverse events to Legend’s Drug Safety department and other internal departments as appropriate per required guidelines.
  • Actively promotes the appropriate use of Legend’s products to healthcare professionals in accordance with Corporate, PhRMA, and OIG guidelines.
  • Strict compliance with all regulatory agencies, state, and federal law is required.
  • Adheres to company policies, procedures and business ethics.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree from accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of 4 years Oncology healthcare sales experience .
  • Proven and consistent track record of meeting/exceeding sales objectives, preferably in specialty markets.
  • Experienced managing and executing in large accounts including strategic planning and problem solving.
  • Previous sales experience in cell therapy/bone marrow transplant.
  • Experience with Multiple Myeloma.
  • Previous product launch experience in a highly competitive environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, communication (written and presentation) skills.
  • Possess superior selling skills honed in highly competitive markets.
  • Proven expertise in building relationships and influencing.
  • Aptitude for rapid learning and retention of technical and scientific product related information.
  • Must set high goals and standard of performance and be self-motivated and able to work with a general level of autonomy.
  • Demonstrated team work/collaboration.
  • Demonstrated ability to read situations quickly, anticipate and adjust for problems and roadblocks.
  • Valid driver’s license ac.
  • Agility in multi-tasking.
  • Able to travel 75% of the time.
  • Proven track record of attaining organizational objectives.
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to perform administrative responsibilities accurately and on time.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

title: Analyst, Acquiring AR&I, Preventive Fraud (6 months contract)
description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an Alert Review analyst you’ll be:

  • Undertaking full profile reviews based on potentially suspicious triggers or periodic timeframes.
  • Own the analysis of risk data, identify trends, red flags and develop an in-depth understanding of the risk profile of our acquiring products.
  • Monitor compliance with the acquiring products’ risk appetite, acceptance and risk performance.
  • Monitor real-time and post-transaction activity for both acquiring merchants and issuing cardholders.
  • Identify unusual merchant behaviors using Merchant Category Codes (MCCs), velocity checks, and transaction anomalies.
  • Identify and manage Compromised Cards scenarios through data analysis and alert trends. Recommend card-blocking or merchant suspension actions where necessary.
  • Document investigation findings accurately within the case management system.
  • Prepare clear and concise SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) narratives, ensuring regulatory and internal standards are met.
  • Maintain thorough records of evidence, decision-making rationale, and case progression steps.
  • Ensure timely closure of assigned cases while meeting quality and compliance expectations.
  • Contact cardholders/members through outbound calls to validate suspicious transactions and gather additional information.
  • Communicate professionally with merchants when clarification or additional data is required.
  • Provide clear explanations and support to cardholders regarding fraud concerns or next steps.
  • Ensure adherence to internal fraud risk policies, card network rules, and regulatory guidelines. Stay updated on fraud trends and emerging threats in the digital payments ecosystem.
  • Actively identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities within current workflows.
  • Provide process improvement suggestions to enhance fraud detection accuracy, reduce false positives, and improve customer experience.
  • Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy
  • Participate in internal and external training programs related to fraud offences detection and prevention and other subjects that may form part of the day-to-day work requirements.
  • Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

What makes you a great fit:

  • 1-3 years of experience in transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, financial crime, Money Laundering and card operations (Acquiring and Issuing).
  • Have a strong understanding of risks and relevant controls involved in B2B merchant onboarding, payments transaction monitoring (incl. declines/chargebacks/disputes) and ongoing in-life monitoring.
  • Worked in cross-functional set up with strong analytical skills, data driven mindset and ability to work independently
  • You have strong understanding and experience of CDD and EDD processes.
  • Proficiency with analytical tools and visualisation software (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Looker)
  • Attention to detail and quality of the deliverables with growth mindset & extreme ownership.
  • A growth, can-do and customer oriented mindset with extreme ownership.
  • Willing to work in flexible shift schedules and rotational week-offs.

Strong knowledge of:

  • Payment processes
  • Merchant Category Codes (MCCs)
  • Fraud patterns and indicators
  • Regulatory reporting standards (e.g., SAR)
  • Proficiency in case management tools and transaction monitoring platforms.
  • Experience contacting cardholders/members through outbound verification calls.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

  • Competitive salary
  • Self & Family Health Insurance
  • Term & Life Insurance
  • OPD Benefits
  • Mental wellbeing through Plumm
  • Learning & Development Budget
  • WFH Setup allowance
  • 25 Annual leaves
  • Family & Friendly Leaves

title: Sr. Staff IP Program Manager
description:
About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.


Introduction:

As an IP Program Manager within the GF Power BCDx organization, you will be responsible for ensuring that IPs meet the technical, quality and schedule requirements for customer products. This role focuses on cross-functional communication, working directly with customers and internal process and design engineering teams, operations, legal and third-party vendors to coordinate releases and drive, track and resolve issues associated with IP development, design integration and silicon validation. A solid understanding of analog and/or digital IP development workflows, post-silicon validation, testing and qualification will be essential for success in this role.



Your Job:

  • Work closely with silicon engineering teams to coordinate high-level milestones for IP development and integration
  • Ability to multi-task and manage IPs across several projects simultaneously
  • Drive resolution of technical and post-silicon issues between cross-functional teams and external IP providers
  • Planning and tracking silicon validation schedule, testplan reviews and spec signoff with cross-functional teams
  • Coordinate meetings with process engineering, IP development teams, vendors, and IP consumers to resolve technical/schedule issues
  • Assemble regular project status presentations for cross-functional executive reviews
  • Focused issue reporting, bug tracking and communication of program risks and status
  • Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and facilitate conflict resolution

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in a technical field
  • 6+ years’ experience in semiconductor industry
  • Prior experience or formal training in project, program, or product management
  • Validation Knowledge: Familiarity with the full IP lifecycle, including post-silicon validation and debug skills
  • Experience working with IP vendors or IP providers
  • Highly reliable and execution-focused, with disciplined follow-through on emails, action items, commitments, and details of every size
  • Strong interpersonal skills - influence without authority
  • Excellent communication (written and oral) skills – confidence in leading calls with various execs, technical experts, and/or vendors and customers.
  • Detail-oriented - can identify what’s missing in planning and execution.
  • Resourceful - solves non-routine issues.
  • Personal and professional drive for continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ability to distill complex issues and information into simple narratives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in program management in semiconductor industry
  • Strong technical background with knowledge of semiconductor device physics and processes.
  • Strong knowledge of the IP development process, tools/flows and methodologies, silicon validation of the IP and the life cycle in a SOC
  • Proficiency in Mandarin.
  • PhD in technical field.
  • Have a record of successfully delivering high-profile, complex technical projects against tight deadlines.
  • Experience leading initiatives, onboarding, and mentoring other peers.

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.

title: Deployment Strategist - US Government
description:
A World-Changing Company
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.

If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.

What We Do

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

  • Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest pain points.
  • Identify relevant datasets through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
  • Work with the customer to build bespoke workflows for new user groups.
  • Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs, and to ensure it is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
  • Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
  • Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
  • Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.

What We Value

  • We value team members who aren’t satisfied with surface-level answers. We value the desire to dive into the details of the data because that’s the core of our work. And we value low ego because the outcome matters more than who gets the credit.
  • Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
  • Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow.
  • Ability to travel 25 – 75% required. Varies by location and team.
  • Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.

What We Require

  • Active US Security Clearance at or above the Top Secret level.
Salary
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $110,000 - $170,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
Benefits
• Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
• Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
• Commuter benefits
• Relocation assistance
• Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
• 2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
• 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
• Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
• Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
• Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
• Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
• Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
Life at Palantir
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Distinguished Engineer
description:
Company Overview
AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website

Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview

Job Role
Provide technical leadership across AutoRABIT products and shared platform capabilities. Combine exceptional hands-on engineering with a strong view of customer needs, product differentiation and long-term technical direction. Your mandate is to improve the company’s ability to build products customers trust and choose, and to translate that direction into working software.

Key Responsibilities
  • Company-level product direction. Work with Product, the CTO, VP of Engineering and customer-facing leaders to identify the technical capabilities that matter most to customer value and product differentiation. Use customer evidence and market understanding to shape investment options, build-versus-buy decisions and long-term platform direction.
  • Cross-product architecture. Guide architecture across product boundaries, shared services and integrations. Simplify dependencies, clarify interfaces and reduce systemic risks. Define staged modernisation plans that protect existing customers while enabling future capabilities. Establish decision principles with accountable product and engineering owners.
  • Hands-on execution. Personally design and implement critical components, reference solutions and technically demanding capabilities. Lead complex initiatives through validation and rollout. Resolve the highest-impact systemic engineering problems without becoming the default owner of every difficult implementation task.
  • Production AI leadership. Guide reliable AI-enabled capabilities and engineering practices. Establish evaluation methods, tenant and data boundaries, safe tool execution, oversight, observability and cost controls appropriate to each use case. Demonstrate where AI improves outcomes and where simpler approaches are preferable.
  • Engineering capability. Mentor Principal Engineers, architects and senior technical leaders. Establish reusable practices for secure, reliable and maintainable delivery. Improve the quality of engineering decisions across teams and build leadership capacity that persists beyond your direct involvement.
  • Executive influence and accountability. Communicate technical trade-offs in terms of customer impact, investment and risk. Partner with the CTO on enterprise direction and the VP of Engineering on execution. Agree decision rights for cross-product initiatives and make outcomes visible to leadership and the teams delivering them.
  • Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.
Pride of Ownership
We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.

Experience & Desired Skills
Required Skills (Mandatory)
  • 15+ years delivering complex enterprise software, with sustained evidence of company-wide or multi-product technical impact.
  • Exceptional hands-on expertise in Java, distributed systems, enterprise APIs and SaaS architecture.
  • Experience leading major initiatives across multiple teams and bringing them into reliable production use.
  • Demonstrated production AI delivery, including evaluation, security, operational performance and economic trade-offs.
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, modern delivery practices, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong judgment in security, scalability, reliability, observability and architectural modernisation.
  • Evidence of influencing product direction and translating technical investments into customer or business outcomes.
  • Ability to mentor Principal-level engineers and influence executive decisions without relying on reporting authority.
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
  • Salesforce ecosystem products, DevSecOps, release orchestration, code analysis, security or data protection.
  • Experience with regulated enterprise customers and globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Major product achievements or other evidence of external-grade technical impact; patents, publications and open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory.
What success looks like
  • Within 90 days, establish a shared view of the most important cross-product technical opportunities, risks and decision boundaries.
  • Within six months, lead agreed milestones for a strategic platform initiative and demonstrate evidence of improved customer, engineering or business outcomes.
  • Strengthen Principal-level technical leadership and establish a practical, prioritised investment agenda with Product and Engineering.
Why join AutoRABIT
You will influence the future of AutoRABIT’s platform while remaining an active builder. The opportunity is to create lasting product advantage, simplify difficult engineering problems and grow the people who will deliver the next generation of capabilities.

Experience: 15+ Years
Compensation: 110 - 140 Lakhs per annum

title: Director of Content
description:
About Mimecast


The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.


Overview


Mimecast secures humans, data & AI. As Director of Content, you'll tell that story in a voice that sounds like a person with a point of view, not a press release. You'll lead our editorial thought leadership program, shape campaign content strategy, direct our social media program, and build an operating model where human creators and AI agents work side by side to scale content without losing what makes it ours.


Reporting to the Vice President of Brand and Communications, you'll raise Mimecast's profile with customers, partners, security researchers, the threat intelligence community, influencers, and the broader security ecosystem. Your goal is clear, data-driven content that makes Mimecast the source people, and the AI answer engines they ask, turn to on humans, data, and AI risk. Security expertise helps. Curiosity, and the discipline to get fluent fast, matter more.


What You'll Do


  • Lead an editorial strategy and calendar built on proprietary insight and Mimecast's Human Risk, AI Risk, and Data Protection pillars to drive brand awareness, equity, and demand.
  • Define integrated campaign content strategies across paid, earned, social, and owned channels, connecting the Mimecast APEX Platform story to the needs of growth, channel, field, customer, and partner marketing.
  • Direct the social media program and its creator, including video-first channels, so our voice engages target audiences and builds authentic connections.
  • Lead content creation, production, and publication across research and reports, case studies, blogs, webinars, podcasts, and videos. Bring together executive subject-matter experts, threat intelligence analysts, product marketing, and external contributors, and oversee the company's blog strategy.
  • Develop content around the real problems security and business leaders face, from risky behavior and AI adoption to data protection and compliance. Stay close to security, AI, and data trends to inform strategy and rapid response.
  • Hold the line on voice and guide written, visual, and multimedia work that is creative, consistent with Mimecast's brand, and useful to technical and business audiences.
  • Partner with web and SEO teams to optimize content for search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), engagement, and conversion. Manage distribution across social media, email, the website, and industry publications so content is discoverable and accurately cited in AI-generated answers.
  • Build AI-human workflows for ideation, drafting, optimization, and personalization, with humans owning editorial judgment, brand voice, and strategic direction. Coach the team, evaluate emerging tools and agents, and hold AI-assisted work to the same quality standard as human-created content.
  • Set and report on KPIs for audience engagement, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and visibility in AI answer engines. Use analytics to refine content strategy and AI workflows.
  • Manage the content budget, freelance contributors, vendors, and external agencies as needed.

What You'll Bring


  • A record of leading content teams and programs in content marketing, journalism, or technical writing, with the judgment and autonomy to set strategy, direct creators, and own program performance in cybersecurity, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B category.
  • Experience overseeing social media strategy and creators, alongside a firm grasp of the marketing funnel and how content supports it.
  • Hands-on experience using AI to scale content programs, including prompt engineering, workflow design, and AI-human collaboration models.
  • A working understanding of cybersecurity and enterprise technology, plus the curiosity and discipline to learn quickly from subject-matter experts.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics for different audiences and cut corporate jargon so content stays authentic, conversational, and engaging.
  • The creative judgment to guide visual content and maintain a consistent brand identity across written, visual, and multimedia formats.
  • Knowledge of SEO, AEO, content distribution, and analytics, and experience working collaboratively with stakeholders, content creators, and subject-matter experts.
  • A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.

The base salary range for this position is $156,000−$234,000 plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role overview

STACK APAC is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Tax Director to lead its regional tax function. Based in Singapore and reporting to the CFO, APAC, the Tax Director will be responsible for tax strategy, structuring, governance and compliance across the Group’s operations in Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.

This will be an individual contributor role working closely with local finance teams and regional finance leadership.

Key responsibilities

Tax strategy, structuring and advisory

  • Lead the development and implementation of the Group’s APAC tax strategy, aligned with the Group’s commercial, investment and financing objectives.

  • Advise on the tax-efficient structuring of investments, development projects, acquisitions, disposals, reorganisations, financing arrangements and intercompany transactions.

  • Provide practical, timely advice on cross-border tax matters, including withholding taxes, permanent establishment risk, treaty access, repatriation of profits, indirect tax and transfer pricing.

  • Support Legal and commercial teams in reviewing contracts, customer arrangements, procurement structures and other transactions with material tax implications.

  • Identify tax risks and planning opportunities arising from changes in legislation, tax authority practice, business operations and new markets.

  • Manage external tax advisers on material advisory, structuring and transaction work, ensuring advice is commercially focused, proportionate and implemented effectively.

Tax compliance, reporting and governance

  • Own and oversee the regional tax compliance calendar and ensure accurate, complete and timely filing, payment and reporting across Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.

  • Oversee corporate income tax compliance and provisioning, including current and deferred tax reporting, tax disclosures and coordination with the financial reporting and audit process.

  • Oversee indirect tax compliance, including GST, consumption tax, sales and service tax, stamp duty and other transaction taxes, as applicable.

  • Oversee employment tax compliance, including payroll taxes, fringe benefits tax, employee share plan tax matters, social security-related obligations and expatriate tax matters where relevant.

  • Lead the Group’s transfer pricing framework, including intercompany pricing policies, local-file/master-file documentation, country-by-country reporting where applicable, and implementation of intercompany agreements.

  • Establish and maintain a robust regional tax control framework, tax risk register, policies, documentation standards and governance processes.

  • Ensure appropriate tax accounting positions are taken, documented and supported, including uncertain tax positions and tax contingencies.

Tax authority, audit and stakeholder management

  • Lead tax audits, reviews, enquiries, rulings and disputes, working with local finance teams and advisers to resolve matters efficiently and protect the Group’s position.

  • Develop constructive working relationships with relevant tax authorities, where appropriate.

  • Act as the central tax contact for the CFO, senior leadership, external auditors, lenders, investors and advisers on APAC tax matters.

  • Present concise tax updates, material risks, cash tax forecasts and key decisions to senior management and governance forums.

Team, process and capability building

  • Build a scalable regional tax operating model, including clear ownership between the central tax function, country finance teams and external advisers.

  • Drive process improvement, automation and use of technology to improve the quality, efficiency and visibility of tax compliance and reporting.

  • Manage the tax budget and adviser spend across the region.

Experience and qualifications

  • 10+ years’ relevant tax experience, gained in a combination of a Big Four or leading professional services firm and an in-house regional or multinational environment.

  • Strong technical knowledge of corporate income tax, international tax, transfer pricing and indirect taxes in an APAC context.

  • Demonstrated experience advising on cross-border structuring, financing, acquisitions, disposals and complex intercompany arrangements.

  • Experience managing tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including tax accounting and audit processes.

  • Direct experience in Australia, Japan, Malaysia and/or Singapore is strongly preferred. Experience navigating tax matters in Japan and Malaysia, including working effectively with local advisers, would be particularly valuable.

  • Experience in infrastructure, real estate, data centres, energy, construction or another capital-intensive project environment is advantageous.

You'll sit on the Data team, which is where this work belongs. Our team already operates at the seam between the business and its systems — we partner daily with RevOps, Customer Success, Sales, and Product, and we own the data infrastructure these workflows depend on. AI-in-the-business is a data problem with a model attached, and you'll have the pipelines, the warehouse, and the domain relationships already in place.

What you'll do

You are a senior individual contributor. Your job is to take business workflows that are slow, manual, or inconsistent, and make them fast, automated, and measurably better — then do it again, and leave behind enough shared scaffolding that the third one is easier than the first.

Ship automated workflows end to end

  • Partner with department leaders to identify the highest-leverage workflows in their orgs, and go deep enough on how the work actually happens to know where a model helps and where it doesn't.
  • Define success before you build: cycle time, quality, cost, risk. Instrument it. Report on it honestly, including when the answer is "this didn't work."
  • Deliver working systems, not prototypes, with evaluation harnesses, human-in-the-loop review where the stakes call for it, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Iterate on adoption the way a product manager would: user research, documentation, and a real plan for getting people to use the thing.

Build the shared substrate as you go

  • Establish patterns for model access, orchestration and agents, prompt and tool management, evaluation, logging, and cost control — derived from what real workflows needed, not designed in advance.
  • Build on the Data team's existing infrastructure rather than standing up parallel systems.
  • Co-own shared components with your counterpart in Engineering; identify dependencies early and bring them into partner roadmaps collaboratively.

Make the company fluent

  • Create templates, playbooks, and golden paths: prompt patterns, agent patterns, safety checklists, evaluation patterns.
  • Run office hours, demos, and community-of-practice sessions that make adoption feel accessible rather than intimidating.
  • Develop enablement material for distinct audiences — GTM, operations, leadership — from fundamentals through advanced workflows.
  • Help people build judgment about AI: when to use it, when not to, and how to tell whether it worked.

Keep it safe and governable

  • Partner with Security, IT, and Legal on access control, data handling, vendor risk, and policy — so that employees have a clear, fast, safe path to experiment.
  • Work with the Data team to apply our data classification standards to AI use cases: what data can be used for retrieval and context, and what audit trails are required when sensitive data flows through LLM pipelines.

What you'll bring

  • Deep experience shipping systems into real business workflows — you've owned something end to end, in production, that non-technical people depended on daily.
  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI stacks: LLMs, retrieval, tool use and agents, evaluation, guardrails — plus the pragmatism to keep things shippable.
  • The ability to learn someone else's job well enough to improve it. This role lives or dies on understanding how support, sales, or finance actually work.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives without formal authority, bringing clarity, momentum, and crisp decision-making.
  • Comfort navigating security, privacy, and compliance tradeoffs in real organizations: data classification, retention, access controls, vendor risk.
  • Strong teaching instincts — you explain complex things simply, write clear docs, and meet people where they are.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay current as the landscape shifts, and to change your mind in public when the evidence does.

Nice to have

  • SQL fluency and comfort in a modern data stack (dbt, a cloud warehouse, BI tooling).
  • Experience with workflow automation or enterprise systems: case management, ticketing, CRM, knowledge bases.
  • Familiarity with observability practices for AI systems: monitoring, quality signals, evaluation pipelines, cost and latency analysis.
  • Change management experience across a distributed, multi-function company.
  • Interest in external evangelism — writing, speaking, podcasts, peer groups.

Base Salary based on level of experience

$225,000 – $265,000 USD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success – generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are – our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more…

Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:

  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. title: Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist for Drones & Embedded Electronics
description:
Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist for Drones & Embedded Electronics

Own the supplier network, logistics and trade-compliance backbone that gets our autonomy hardware built and fielded. Your work will help strengthen Europe’s defense with real capability.


About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models (LLMs). We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defense.

Now, we’re building the physical platform to bring Spatial AI to life. That means high-performance, real-world robotic systems (starting with UAVs) and we’re looking for a skilled, hands-on procurement specialist who’s ready to power the foundation of these systems and have them communicate, update and perform reliably in the real world.


About the Role

As Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist, you’ll own sourcing, procurement and material planning for the hardware behind our UAV and defense systems. From standard parts and COTS electronics to designed components and contract-manufactured assemblies, you’ll make sure the right parts arrive on time, on quality and fully compliant.

You’ll collaborate closely with colleagues developing electronics, software, and AI together pushing to deliver vertically integrated and well-balanced solutions. Supply resilience, supplier performance, logistics and import/export execution will be your domain, and as the first dedicated owner of this function, you’ll be trusted to build the systems and supplier base we scale on. This is an on-site role with occasional travel to suppliers and partners.

What You’ll Work On

  • Procure & Plan: Coordinate and execute procurement plus material planning for standard, COTS and designed parts across electronics, sensors, mechanical components and assemblies

  • Source the Best Options: Identify and acquire best-in-market components by translating engineering requirements into structured supplier choices, RFQs and trade-off decisions

  • Own Supplier Execution: Hold suppliers, contractors and contract manufacturers accountable for on-time, on-quality delivery and drive issues through to resolution

  • Build Resilience: Strengthen our European supply chain through on-shoring, second-sourcing, forward-thinking contracting and stockpiling

  • Handle Logistics & Compliance: Organize shipping and external logistics while ensuring compliant handling of customs, end-use declarations, permits, BAFA-related topics and Incoterms

Your Profile

  • You bring 2+ years of end-to-end experience in supply chain management for embedded systems, ideally in avionics, UAVs or similarly demanding hardware

  • You’re skilled to rank sensors, electronics and other technical components against engineering specs and practical system needs

  • You communicate clearly and effectively across engineering, suppliers, logistics partners and contractors

  • You’re highly dependable in how you structure projects, procurement flows and data

  • You’re familiar with contract manufacturing, BAFA-relevant workflows and Incoterms

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, proactive and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect conditions. You build resilient systems that keep critical hardware moving.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Prior experience with export regulations for dual-use and military goods

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing documentation

  • Strong negotiation skills with a holistic approach balancing pricing goals with supplier relations, quality and long-term needs

  • Familiarity with ERP systems, supplier scorecards or defense / aerospace supply chains

Perks & Benefits

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • Real Ownership: Get early, real stock to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy, Greece and Spain

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other (conducted by our Talent Team)

  2. Technical Interview (60 min): Diving deeper into your experience, skills and problem-solving process with practical examples (with Lukas, our Hardware Lead)

  3. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides (can be integrated into the Onsite to accommodate long journeys)

title: Principal Product Manager, Intelligent Field Systems
description:
Job Description:

Nextpower is a leading provider of intelligent solar tracking systems, delivering advanced solutions that optimize the performance and reliability of utility-scale solar power plants worldwide. Our global team is transforming PV plant performance every day through smart technology, data monitoring, and advanced analytics.

About the Role

The Principal Product Manager, Intelligent Field Systems is responsible for helping define the strategy, roadmap, and development of technologies that enable intelligent field operation across Nextpower’s solar controls platform.

This role will focus on how connected devices, communications technology, sensing, and data come together to create a more intelligent solar plant—one that can better understand changing site conditions and take action to improve performance, reliability, and resilience.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and contribute to product and technology strategies across Nextpower’s intelligent field systems portfolio.
  • Lead evaluation and adoption of next-generation wired and wireless communications technologies for utility-scale solar plants.
  • Identify and develop new sensing capabilities that improve awareness of environmental, equipment, and site conditions.
  • Work closely with software and firmware Product Managers to develop coordinated product strategies and define system-level requirements for implementation.
  • Help define the long-term vision for how connected devices, sensing, communications technology, software, and data come together as an integrated smart-plant platform.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead build, buy, or partner recommendations and early technology incubation.
  • Engage customers and internal stakeholders to identify unmet needs and translate them into product and system requirements.
  • Develop business cases connecting technology investments to energy yield, reliability, O&M efficiency, installation simplicity, and lifecycle value.
  • Provide Staff-level product leadership across programs, influencing platform strategy and mentoring other Product Managers.

What You’ll Need (Required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in product management, product development, systems engineering, or technical leadership.
  • Strong technical background in IoT, wireless communications, embedded systems, networking, sensors, or industrial controls.
  • Experience developing products combining hardware, firmware/software, communications, and data.
  • Demonstrated ability to define technology strategy and translate emerging technologies into commercial products.
  • Strong systems thinking and ability to influence multidisciplinary engineering and business teams.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to operate effectively across global organizations.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RF/wireless technologies, edge computing, IoT platforms, or distributed intelligence.
  • Experience with industrial communications and connected-device architectures.
  • Renewable energy, smart grid, industrial automation, or critical infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with technology partnerships, industry alliances, and build/buy/partner decisions.
  • MBA or advanced engineering degree.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

We are Nextpower
