title: Lead Product Owner (m/f/d) - AI Workspace
Data Centre Shift Technician (Malaysia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Shift Technician is the on‑shift technical role responsible for ensuring safe, stable and consistent operation of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems. The role provides elevated technical capability, supports first-response incident actions, verifies plant condition after maintenance or resets, and executing operational tasks with accuracy and discipline. This position supports STACK’s 100% uptime commitment through strong operational judgement, trend awareness, structured troubleshooting and the ability to stabilise plant conditions within authorised boundaries. The Shift Technician also enhances shift performance by coaching team members, refining documentation quality and maintaining a concierge‑level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Essential Functions – Critical Operations

  • Support STACK’s 100% uptime objective through disciplined operational control, proactive monitoring and accurate technical response.

  • Maintain real-time awareness of plant condition through BMS/EPMS, alarms and inspections, taking timely actions within authorised limits.

  • Provide and assisting the shift ‘s Team with prioritisation, procedural clarity and execution quality.

  • Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems (UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CRAC/CRAH, CDU/FWU, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant) strictly within approved procedures and authorisations.

  • Perform structured diagnostics on abnormal conditions, apply permitted stabilisation actions and escalate with clear technical detail and recommended next steps.

  • Support operational event response, including immediate containment actions, technical communication and accurate event documentation.

  • Conduct enhanced rounds including thermal, capacity, vibration/noise, leak detection and set‑point verification, ensuring findings are recorded and actioned.

  • Identify trends, weak signals and reliability concerns using BMS/EPMS data and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.

  • Manage on‑shift work execution with strict adherence to permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO, vendor access and operational handbacks.

  • Coordinate vendor activities during shift, ensuring safe execution, clear understanding of plant impacts and thorough return-to-service verification.

  • Validate operational readiness following maintenance, resets or configuration changes, confirming alarms, redundancy, load paths and expected operating conditions.

  • Review and improve quality of shift logs, event notes, CMMS entries and handovers to ensure accuracy, clarity and traceability.

  • Raise and escalate recurring defects, reliability risks and improvement opportunities through appropriate channels.

  • Contribute to procedure reviews, readiness activities, drills and documentation improvements with practical, shift-based insights.

  • This role does not perform licensed electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade‑restricted activities are completed by appropriately qualified and licensed personnel. The Shift Technician focuses on operational system management, first-response stabilisation, verification and coordination.

People

  • Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.

  • Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.

  • Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.

  • Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.

  • Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.

  • Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and Vendors personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.

  • Demonstrate a concierge‑level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Strong operational discipline and sound judgement in a critical facility environment.

  • High technical capability in electrical and/or mechanical systems within authorised boundaries.

  • Effective structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.

  • Ability to interpret alarms, telemetry, trends and technical documentation.

  • Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational workflow tools.

  • Strong written and verbal communication for shift documentation, incidents and customer updates.

  • Contractor coordination skills with strong permit-to-work and LOTO awareness.

  • Ability to coach others and improve team execution quality.

  • Calm, methodical approach during alarms and operational events.

  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on reliability and operational quality.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, defence or industrial facilities.

  • Demonstrated capability operating and monitoring critical power and cooling systems (UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, controls, fire systems).

  • Hands-on experience conducting operational inspections and first-response stabilisation actions.

  • Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools for monitoring, work management and operational documentation.

  • Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, technical drawings and OEM documentation.

  • Familiarity with permit-to-work, isolations/LOTO and basic operational risk assessment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication suitable for logs, handovers and customer-facing updates.

Work Environment/Conditions

  • Role operates on a 24×7 rotating shift roster including nights, weekends and public holidays.

  • Work occurs in data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required as per site policy.

  • Participation in emergency response activities and incident exercises is required.

Travel Required

  • Not required or minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.

  • Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.

  • Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.

  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorization/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Malaysia.

  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements (as applicable), including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.

  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.

  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Construction Project Manager, Residential Remodeling
description:
Building Dreams. Creating Value. At DBHD, you will be part of a team of dream builders. We celebrate customization, care, and customer experience by recognizing those who make homes come to life. With stories from the field, the 'Dream Builder' spotlight, and onboarding tied directly to our brand mission, you will be connected to our purpose from design to delivery.

Reports to: Head of Operations

Location: Elk Grove, CA - On-site

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with occasional flexibility as job site needs require.

About the Role

Our Sacramento-region kitchen and bath remodeling operation needs a Project Manager who can own every job from signed design through final walkthrough, managing licensed general contractors and trades, protecting margin, and keeping homeowners informed at every stage.

As Project Manager, you will oversee multiple active remodeling projects simultaneously, serving as the single point of accountability for scope, budget, schedule, and quality. In your first six months, success means running a full portfolio of jobs with tight cost control, earning the trust of our GC partners and homeowners, and closing projects with clean walkthroughs and margins on target.

What You'll Do

  • Review every customer proposal for scope and cost accuracy before contract execution; convert approved scope into clear work orders for general contractors and trades.
  • Manage licensed general contractors and specialty trades across multiple active kitchen and bath remodeling projects, building and maintaining schedules, coordinating suppliers, deliveries, inspections, and permits.
  • Own the budget on every job: track margin throughout construction, approve GC and subcontractor invoices against work orders, coordinate change order pricing, and close each project with a cost-vs-budget review with accounting.
  • Visit active job sites regularly to verify progress, quality, safety, and adherence to scope; hold contractors and trades accountable to standards.
  • Drive punch lists through to completion and conduct clean final walkthroughs with homeowners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for homeowners, providing proactive updates on progress, changes, and costs; resolve concerns promptly and assist with collections when needed.
  • Provide input to Designers during homeowner and builder interactions when scope or constructability questions arise.
  • Collaborate across design, sales, and showroom teams to solve problems and improve processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Active or readily reactivatable CSLB Class B (General Building) license.
  • Minimum 3 years of residential construction project management, including kitchen and bath remodeling.
  • Hands-on trade experience (cabinetry, flooring, drywall, tile, plumbing, or electrical) with the field credibility to direct general contractors and trades confidently.
  • Proficiency reading plans, construction drawings, and cabinet layouts; skilled in estimating and job costing.
  • Experience with BuilderTrend or similar construction project management software.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple active jobs concurrently with close attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and customer management skills with a visible, positive presence when dealing with homeowners and external parties.
  • Valid driver's license.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual English/Spanish.
  • Own truck for job site visits.

Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Team Impact: You will lead the execution side of every remodeling project, working directly with department leadership and managing the GC and trade partners who bring designs to life.
  • Growth & Development: Direct exposure to leadership, professional development support, and the chance to shape how the operations team works as the company grows.
  • Ownership: You own every project from signed contract to final walkthrough. Budget, schedule, quality, and client satisfaction are yours to drive.
  • Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Head of Operations focused on your project management approach, trade experience, and budget management track record.
  3. Panel Interview - Meet with cross-functional team members to discuss how you collaborate with design, sales, and field teams.
  4. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Elk Grove showroom. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
  5. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
  6. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact hrbenefits@cscshared.com.

title: Architect, Enterprise Data
description:
We're looking for an Architect, Enterprise Data to join Procore's Enterprise Data Engineering team. In this role, you'll be a force multiplier for the business: designing and building the data platform that puts trusted data directly in the hands of stakeholders so they can make faster, better decisions. AI is central to that mission, and you'll lead how we use it to help every team do more with their data.


As an Architect, Enterprise Data, you'll own the end-to-end architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, warehousing, analytics, data science/ML, and AI agents. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll author the architecture and also write the code, build reference implementations, and create the self-service tools and patterns that let both engineers and business teams unlock business outcomes faster using data. You'll partner with technical and business leaders across the company and lead the data platform side of mergers and acquisitions.


This position reports to the Director, Enterprise Data Engineering and will be based in our Austin, TX office.

  • Lead the platform AI strategy for enterprise data, enabling us to build agents and natural-language interfaces that let business users explore data, automate routine analysis, and move from insight to action

  • Contribute hands-on to building the platform: write production code, build proofs of concept, and prove out new approaches before scaling them
  • Own the data platform strategy for M&A, from assessing acquired companies' data landscapes to leading integration into the enterprise platform

What we're looking for

  • 15+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or software engineering, including significant time architecting enterprise-scale data platforms
  • Deep hands-on experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks, including performance tuning, cost optimization, and security model design

233,360.00 - 320,870.00 USD Annual

title: QA Engineer 2
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Join us in empowering people to take control of their health! You will join a collaborative team at the heart of Dexcom’s products. Our quality engineering team plays a crucial role in cross-site and cross-functional alignment for the future of Dexcom and for the future of our customers’ health. You will support Dexcom in bringing state-of-the-art innovative technology to patients and will help to define, support, and improve the processes that get us there. A positive and team-oriented attitude is important while working in a fast-paced environment and dealing with shifting priorities.

  • You support and independently execute quality investigations, including root cause analysis, CAPAs, NCMRs, and MRB/disposition activities, and implement corrective actions that improve product quality and compliance.
  • You apply quality engineering and continuous improvement methodologies, such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, process capability analysis (Cpk/Ppk), Gage R&R, sampling plans, and risk-based problem solving.

  • You develop, review, and execute validation and qualification documentation for equipment, processes, test methods, and software, following applicable procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • You provide quality engineering support for cross-functional projects, partnering with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, and global teams to meet project and quality objectives.
  • You support design transfer and commercialization activities by reviewing requirements, evaluating manufacturing readiness, identifying quality risks, and helping transition new products and processes into manufacturing.
  • You perform and document risk assessments, evaluate process and design changes, and recommend appropriate controls to support product performance and regulatory compliance.
  • You represent Quality during audits and inspections within your assigned areas of responsibility.

What makes you successful:

  • Your Engineering, Chemistry or similar degree from accredited College/University with experience supporting regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Your quality engineering knowledge, including risk management, root cause analysis, Six Sigma, process capability analysis (Cpk/Ppk), statistical analysis, sampling plans, AQL, and data-driven decision-making.

title: Infrastructure Engineer, Customer Delivery
description:
About Distyl AI

Distyl is an applied AI technology company partnering with the world’s most ambitious institutions to rearchitect critical operations for the frontier of AI. Our customers include the largest companies in telecom, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, consumer goods, and global social organizations.

We research and deploy technologies that power AI-native operations — both for our partners and for Distyl itself. Our work spans research into self-constructing systems, the development of the most reliable execution of AI systems, and products that transform mission-critical workflows. As a result, Distyl's technologies affect some of the world's largest operations — from hundreds of millions of consumer interactions to tens of millions of supply chain transactions and millions of patient journeys.

Distyl is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Coatue, DST Global, and the board-members of 20+ F500s.

What We Are Looking For

We're hiring a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to lead cloud architecture and delivery of Distyl's AI platform across Distyl-hosted, customer VPC, and on-premises environments. You'll partner with customers, platform engineering, and forward-deployed AI engineers from discovery through production. Scope will reflect your experience, from leading complex deployments to setting technical direction across teams.

You'll translate complex customer architectures and requests into working infrastructure, building reusable patterns and automation that make each launch easier.

You'll own customer deployments end to end and help shape a growing delivery team's practices. Success means faster launches, reliable operations, and less repeated work as deployments scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture ownership. Own portable reference architectures across Distyl-hosted, customer VPC, and on-premises deployments, with clear control-plane/data-plane boundaries. Distinguish necessary customer adaptations from avoidable variation across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Integrate identity, networks, data, and model providers with appropriate access, routing, and audit controls

  • Platform and on-premises delivery. Work with forward-deployed AI engineers to deploy and upgrade Distyl's platform using infrastructure as code, Docker, Kubernetes, and shared CI/CD tooling. Support private registries, restricted egress, offline installs/upgrades, and alternatives to cloud-managed dependencies. Validate compatibility and recovery within customer change controls

  • Automation mindset. Turn recurring delivery friction into shared automation. Build provisioning services, controllers, and reusable deployment APIs in Python or Go to make future deployments faster and more reliable

  • Customer relationships and communication. Build trust, clarify requests, explain tradeoffs, and own commitments through production acceptance. Keep customers and developers aligned on readiness, upcoming changes, dependencies, and blockers; escalate risks early

  • Production security and reliability. Implement network segmentation, data-residency controls, and audit trails with security and infrastructure partners. Establish SLOs, observability, actionable alerts, and tested disaster recovery. Own infrastructure incident resolution in assigned environments, coordinating with relevant engineering owners. Use incident and deployment data to improve reliability, runbooks, and support handoffs

  • Hosted infrastructure. Build and operate tenant isolation, provisioning, quotas, autoscaling, metering, and cost attribution for Distyl-hosted deployments, in partnership with platform engineering

  • AI runtime infrastructure. Partner with Runtime on agent sandboxing, workload identity, scoped credentials, network controls, and resource limits across supported deployments

  • AI-assisted engineering. Build agent-assisted workflows for environment checks, troubleshooting, and infrastructure changes. Scope access, verify outputs, and measure improvements in delivery effort and reliability

  • Technical leadership. Set delivery standards, mentor engineers, and help build the delivery team's technical practices. Partner with forward-deployed AI and platform engineers to unblock delivery and turn customer lessons into product improvements

Who You Are

  • 7+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, SRE, or related technical delivery roles

  • Deep production experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus working experience in a second cloud

  • Customer-facing engineering experience with direct responsibility for technical delivery and stakeholder communication. You build trust, clarify requirements, negotiate scope, and keep stakeholders aligned

  • Hands-on experience with networking, IAM, Docker, Kubernetes, and observability, including workload identity, scoped credentials, and resource limits

  • Proven experience writing and maintaining production infrastructure as code

  • Strong production Python or Go experience building reusable infrastructure software, such as provisioning services, controllers, or deployment APIs

  • Experience operating hosted infrastructure with tenant isolation, provisioning, capacity controls, and usage/cost visibility

  • Experience turning customer requirements into production architectures, with clear control-plane/data-plane boundaries, CI/CD, and identity, network, and data integrations

  • Experience delivering under strict access, network, security, and change controls, including private registries or restricted egress

  • Experience implementing network segmentation, data-residency controls, audit trails, SLOs, disaster recovery, and incident response

  • Strong troubleshooting and automation skills. You balance speed with reliability, handle upgrades and stateful changes carefully, and verify AI-assisted work

  • Technical leadership. You lead complex deployments independently. Experience setting technical direction and leading adoption of reusable systems and standards across teams is especially valued

  • Strongly preferred: Building or scaling infrastructure delivery and operations across enterprise customer environments, including production deployments across multiple clouds

  • Preferred: On-premises installs/upgrades, offline operation, or replacing cloud-managed dependencies

  • Preferred: Agent sandboxing or technical AI governance, including model access, routing, data-handling, and audit controls

What We Offer

  • The base salary range for this role is $200,000-$250,000, depending on experience, location, and level. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for meaningful equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package

  • 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible time off

  • Retirement and financial planning benefits, including access to pre-tax HSA, FSA, and commuter accounts, 401(k), and financial coaching resources

  • Comprehensive wellness benefits, including physical fitness, mental well-being, and fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot

  • Complimentary in-office lunches and snacks provided

  • Access to state-of-the-art AI models, generous usage of modern AI tools, and real-world business problems

  • Ownership of high-impact projects across top enterprises

  • A mission-driven, fast-moving culture that values curiosity, pragmatism, and excellence

Distyl has offices in San Francisco and New York. This role follows a hybrid collaboration model with 3+ days per week (Tuesday–Thursday) in‑office.

  • Atlanta, US

  • Lisbon, Portugal
  • London, UK
  • Seattle, US

Applications will be accepted until November 23, 2026.

About the Role

Cloudflare’s Data Org builds the systems that ingest, process, store, and retrieve data generated across our global network. These systems power the logs, analytics, and alerts that give customers near real-time visibility into the security, reliability, and performance of their Internet properties.

We are looking for systems-oriented backend engineers who enjoy solving distributed-systems problems at large scale. You will build primarily in Go, operate the systems you create, and work across the data lifecycle, from high-throughput ingestion and delivery to analytical storage and customer-facing retrieval.

Engineers in this role typically develop depth in one of two areas:

  1. Analytical database systems: Building and operating our ClickHouse-based analytical platform, improving database performance, reliability, and scalability.
  2. Data delivery and retrieval: Building streaming pipelines, public APIs, log delivery integrations, and alerting systems that make customer data accessible and actionable.

We are looking for strong backend and systems fundamentals, production operational experience, and demonstrated depth in at least one of these areas.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate reliable distributed systems that process very large volumes of data.
  • Develop and optimise backend services and data platform components, primarily in Go.
  • Improve data integrity, delivery latency, query performance, availability, and operational efficiency.
  • Build systems that handle failure safely through techniques such as backpressure, retries, idempotency, replication, and graceful degradation.
  • Define service-level objectives, monitor production health, plan capacity, and respond to incidents.
  • Diagnose performance bottlenecks across ingestion, processing, storage, and retrieval.

Depending on your area of focus:

  • Build and operate large-scale ClickHouse clusters and contribute improvements to the ClickHouse ecosystem.
  • Develop data delivery pipelines that route data from Cloudflare’s global network to customer destinations.
  • Build and scale GraphQL APIs, log delivery integrations, and near real-time alerting products.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand their data needs and design pragmatic solutions.
  • Evaluate technologies and contribute to the next generation of Cloudflare’s data platform.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for the production systems owned by your team.

What We’re Looking For

  • At least three years of professional software engineering experience building backend, infrastructure, database, or distributed-data systems.
  • Strong Go programming skills, or substantial systems programming experience (Rust, C++) with the ability to become productive in Go quickly.
  • Experience building and operating production services, including deployment, monitoring, capacity planning, incident response, and debugging.
  • A solid understanding of distributed-systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, fault tolerance, partitioning, and data integrity.
  • Experience with high-throughput or low-latency data processing.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, including monitoring high-cardinality workloads.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly for complex production problems.
  • Clear communication and an ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams.

Demonstrated depth in at least one of the following areas:

  • Database systems: SQL, analytical databases, database internals, query optimisation, performance tuning, or operating large database clusters.
  • Data delivery and retrieval: Streaming systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, API development, or customer-facing data integrations.

Helpful Experience

  • ClickHouse or another large-scale analytical database.
  • Kafka, Flink, or similar streaming technologies.
  • GraphQL or other high-volume API technologies.
  • Terraform, Salt, or other Infrastructure as Code tooling.
  • Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux container technologies.
  • Contributions to open-source database or distributed-systems projects.

If you enjoy building efficient systems, understanding how they behave in production, and solving data problems at global scale, we would like to hear from you.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €91,000.
  • For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $215,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

title: Team Leader, Engineering
description:
As a Team Leader, Engineering within Servicing Technology, you’ll lead a team of software engineers in Default Loan Services, responsible for the hardship client experience on . Your team builds the web experiences that help homeowners in difficult moments, from requesting payment assistance to getting support after a natural disaster. The work is high-stakes and deeply human: when clients are under pressure, the technology has to make the path to help simple and reliable. Servicing Technology is accelerating through a full-scale System of Record modernization, and strong engineering leadership is a strategic asset.

This is a people-leadership role for someone who has grown as an engineer and now wants to multiply their impact through the team they lead. You will own delivery, coach and develop engineers, and stay close enough to the technology — a full-stack stack spanning Next.js or React, a NestJS GraphQL integration layer, and .NET / C# services deployed on AWS and Amazon EKS — to make sound technical and staffing decisions.

You will partner with product, design, and business stakeholders across distributed teams, and you’ll help define what AI-native engineering looks like in practice — setting the expectation that AI is a core part of how your team designs, codes, tests, reviews, and ships software.

About the role

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of full-stack engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, performance, and career growth.
  • Own your team’s delivery: planning, prioritization, execution, and predictable, high-quality outcomes.
  • Set technical direction alongside your engineers across the front end (Next.js or React with a NestJS GraphQL integration layer) and back end (.NET / C# and NestJS GraphQL).
  • Ensure applications are reliably built, deployed, and operated on AWS and Amazon EKS through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Champion AI-native engineering — driving adoption of AI tools and agentic development workflows to raise team speed and quality.
  • Partner with product, design, data, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into a clear, achievable roadmap.
  • Remove blockers, manage risk, and communicate status, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, inclusion, continuous learning, and healthy engineering practices.
  • Collaborate effectively across distributed engineering teams, including partners in India.

About you
You are a leader who measures success through your team’s outcomes and the growth of the engineers you lead. You set a high bar, create clarity in ambiguity, and give people the context and coaching they need to do their best work.

You remain technically credible — able to engage in architecture and design discussions and make informed decisions — while trusting your engineers to own the details. You are curious about AI and committed to helping your team adopt it seriously.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on full-stack work.
  • 2+ years of experience leading or managing software engineers (people leadership, not solely tech-lead responsibilities).
  • Working knowledge of a modern front-end framework (Next.js or React) and a NestJS GraphQL integration layer.
  • Working knowledge of back-end development in .NET / C# and NestJS GraphQL.
  • Experience delivering software deployed on AWS with Amazon EKS / Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop engineers, manage performance, and deliver through a team.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading teams through AI-native engineering adoption (AI coding agents, AI-assisted reviews, prompt-driven or multi-agent workflows).
  • Track record of hiring and building high-performing engineering teams.
  • Experience leading delivery in greenfield, early-stage, or rapidly evolving product environments.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or mortgage servicing.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About us

Rocket is a Detroit-based company made up of businesses that provide simple, fast and trusted digital solutions for complex transactions. The name comes from our flagship business, now known as Rocket Mortgage®, which was founded in 1985. Today, we’re a publicly traded company involved in many different industries, including mortgages, fintech, real estate and more. We’re insistently different in how we look at the world and are committed to an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard. Apply today to join a team that offers career growth, amazing benefits and the chance to work with leading industry professionals.

This job description is an outline of the primary responsibilities of this position and may be modified at the discretion of the company at any time. Decisions related to employment are not based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. The company provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodations in completing the application and/or participating in the application process should contact a member of the Human Resources team, at Careers@Rocket.com.

title: Senior Project Manager (Osaka, Japan)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

The Position:

The Japan Data Center market is rapidly growing and has been identified as a key market for STACK APAC. As such, we are building out our in-country business and delivery capability to support our current market opportunities in Tokyo and Osaka.

STACK’s Senior Project Manager, Japan is a key role to manage and develop data center facilities as part of a robust and market leading Design & Delivery team. As an experienced Project Delivery Professional, the successful candidate will be a detailed focused, forward-thinking manager who is able to be strategic and see the big picture as well as being able to dive into the technical details of the project design, procurement & Construction activities and actions.

· Manage the end-to-end delivery of assigned Projects, working collaboratively with the various Project Contributors, Stakeholders and associated project team members to ensure a successful outcome.

· Ensure compliance with STACK standard delivery best practice, project governance & Stage-gate approvals, utilizing our Project Delivery Tools and Technology Platform.

· Manage appointed General Contractors, Suppliers, Vendors and Consultants on key projects from award through to completion, ensuring delivery aligned to key project goals and requirements.

· Maintain and manage cost control and change control processes ensuring project cost control throughout with all contractors and vendors.

· Develop and maintain project schedules / programs, identifying key critical path activities, manage and agree programs with all parties and monitor providing regular updates.

· Identify, track and report on all key risks which may be affecting the projects. Develop and implement mitigation plans to address and mitigate risks.

· Develop and maintain working relationships with both consultants, contractors and supply vendors in market.

· Be client facing, interacting with local client teams, developing tailored solutions aligned to their requirements, structured and regular reporting cadence on project deliverables, progress, Safety & Cost as relevant.

· Passionate about the Data Center industry and be an innovator, always looking to bring the forefront of technology into our projects to achieve and exceed our Sustainability, Safety & Efficiency goals.

· Be Safety Focused on all times and stages of project delivery, work collaboratively with STACK Safety Leadership, embody and lead by example our in Safety Best Practices and Conduct.

· Experienced in Lean Project Management methodologies, tools & processes to drive highly efficient and empowered project teams on fast-track delivery.

· 10+ years in project delivery in Data Centers with at least 5 years within the Japan Market.

· Reporting directly to the project director of Delivery, and well communication paths to other stakeholders.

· Support project director to ensure that assigned tasks and project to be succeeded.

· Maintain yourself and your staff for STACK guidelines and corporate policy that Teamwork, Hard Work, Excellence, and fine quality.

· Act as team leader of the project, prompt reporting to your supervisors.

Key Details:

Location: Osaka, Japan.

Travel: 15-20%.

Language: Japanese; Secondary English (Business Level - Spoken & Written).

Must-have Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineer, Project Management, or relevant built environment field.

· 5+ years progressive experience in Data Center delivery, with a minimum of 5 years delivering in Japan.

· Deep experience in data centers; familiarity with hyperscale clients.

· Work Experience of Project Controls and Implementing Project Controls during both Design and Construction phases of projects.

· Working experience leading and collaborating on 3D Design Tools, BIM process & methodology and implementation of 4D/5D design principles.

· Experience in Project Management Platforms such as Procore, Clarizen or equivalent.

· Experienced and competent in MS Project or Primavera P6, equivalent softwares.

· Strong presentation and communication skills.

This might be right for you if:

· You don’t get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple high-level priorities with competing timelines while welcoming a new, urgent challenge with ease.

· Are culturally sensitive and enjoy working with a diverse group of individuals from multiple regions.

· You pay attention to the details – meticulously, and every time. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.

· You’re collaborative. You enjoy working with others to solve problems – and people enjoy working with you. You can shift from being a leader to a contributor when needed.

· You’re smart. You think five steps ahead and see issues from multiple angles. You’re not just a problem solver – you’re a problem preventer.

Why STACK:

· We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits.

· We have a culture of appreciation and recognition.

· We are passionate about what we do and have fun doing it.

· Be part of the growing business and make an impact.

STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ALL qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify and expression, age, national origin, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

GET TO KNOW US:

FM Industries can promise you an environment that not only encourages your best, but also rewards it with plenty of room to grow. FM industries is a premier manufacturing solutions provider. We specialize in build to print, precision machined components, anodizing and engineered thermal spray coatings. We provide customers leading edge support from protype to production.

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

The Production Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating the activities of departmental workers.

Swing Shift - Monday-Friday 2:30PM to 12:30PM

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  • Schedule functional areas to achieve optimal usage on machines
  • Inspect products to verify conformance to specifications
  • Direct setup and adjustment of machines
  • Study production schedules and estimate worker hour requirements for completion of job assignments.
  • Interpret company policies to workers and enforce safety regulations, specifications, blueprints, and job orders to workers and assign duties as needed.
  • Establish or adjust work procedures to meet production schedules. Analyze and resolve work problems or assist workers in solving work problems.
  • Suggest changes in working conditions and use of equipment to increase the efficiency of shop, department, or work crew
  • Initiate or suggest plans to motivate workers to achieve work goals and maintain time and production records.
  • Estimate, requisition, and inspect materials. Confer with other supervisors to coordinate activities of individual departments.
  • Perform administrative duties such as regular employee meetings, timekeeping/attendance/vacation requests, performance appraisals, disciplinary actions, interviewing, training and development.
  • Comply with applicable environmental, health, and safety laws and regulations. Company policy, and accepted safe work practices.
  • Executes necessary precautions to ensure safety and compliance with company, OSHA, and other standards and regulations.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Machine Tool Technologies or a minimum 2 years of trade school, vocation education, or four years of formal apprenticeship (or equivalent combination of education and 2+ years of working related experience)
  • Must be reliable and have excellent attendance
  • Comprehensive knowledge of theoretical and practical aspects of blueprint reading as well as mid to high level GD&T working experience.
  • Working knowledge of CNC programming and accepted inspection practices
  • Demonstrated ability at operating computer numerical control machines.
  • Ability to read blueprints to ensure accuracy in part making
  • Ability to speak basic English language
  • Must be well organizes and able to effectively present information in one-on-one and large group situations.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES AND REGISTRATIONS:

  • Completion of NTMA apprenticeship preferred

PHYSICAL DEMANDS WHILE PERFORMING THE JOB:

  • Frequently standing, walking, pushing, pulling, stooping, kneeling, or bending to the floor.
  • Visual acuity: near acuity and accommodation are required for reading machine dial gauges, blueprints and precision measuring used in the inspection parts.
  • Hearing ability: ability to monitor machine sounds to identify and diagnose changes in order to take appropriate action
  • Occasionally lifting and/or moving items up to 40 pounds.
  • Frequently required to site and use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT OF THE JOB:

  • Regularly exposed to moving equipment and mechanical parts.
  • Physical hazards while working near moving equipment and mechanical parts
  • Occasionally exposed to oils and cutting fluids
  • Possible breathing of fumes, odors, dust and mist.
  • High noise levels from operating machines
  • The employee will be required to use personal protective equipment (PPE) to prevent exposure to hazardous materials commonly used in a manufacturing environment (i.e., safety glasses and shoes, gloves, ear plugs/covers, mask, cleanroom suit)

CULTURE:

At FM Industries our success is powered by people and technology. Our culture is what makes FM a fun and rewarding place to work. We champion diversity and we are always seeking new ways to amaze our customers. Success is celebrated and integrity is the core of who we are at FM Industries.

FM Industries Values:

  • CUSTOMER FOCUS - Partnering to deliver excellence and innovation
  • SAFETY - Prioritizing the wellbeing of our people
  • INTEGRITY - Achieving our best through mutual respect and teamwork
  • QUALITY - Investing in our People, Processes, and Products
  • ACCOUNTABILITY - Taking ownership of our words, actions and results

Give us your best and we'll give you ours!!

title: German Speaker in NYC - Join a 3-Day Paid Phone Study - $100/hr
description:
Mindrift is running a research study on how people use their phones, apps and everyday digital tools, and how that differs across languages and cultures. We’re looking for native German speakers in New York to join a paid, 3-day in-person study in Midtown Manhattan.

Why your language matters

Most technology is still designed with English speakers in mind. This study helps researchers understand how people who communicate in German actually use their devices, so future products work better for them.

What you’ll do

  • Spend 1-3 days with our research team in Midtown Manhattan.
  • Walk us through how you use your phone and favourite apps in daily life.
  • Share examples of your everyday phone activity with the research team. You decide what’s included.
  • Fill in a short questionnaire about your habits.


Who we’re looking for

  • 18+ and currently living in NYC.
  • A native German speaker who grew up in Germany.
  • You use German in everyday life: texting friends, email, notes.
  • You’ve used a smartphone as your main personal phone for 3+ years.
  • Comfortable communicating in English.
  • Available for 3 consecutive days (Mon–Wed or Thu–Sat), starting October 16 on Friday.
  • Not currently employed by a tech or AI company.


Great fit for international students, people new to NYC, and anyone between jobs or with a flexible schedule.

Compensation

$100/hour, up to $2,400 for the full study.

Simple and transparent

Participation is voluntary and covered by a signed consent form that explains exactly what’s involved. You can ask questions at any point and stop whenever you like.

How to apply

Register on Mindrift and complete a short screening questionnaire. We’ll confirm your session dates once you’re shortlisted.

Apply now

title: Senior Supply Chain Planner, Wafer & Backend
description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world’s most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at .

The Senior Supply Chain Planner is responsible for planning and executing wafer fabrication, assembly, and test operations to support customer demand while achieving supply chain performance objectives. This role manages supply commitments, inventory, production planning, and supplier delivery performance across outsourced manufacturing partners. The planner works closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure timely product delivery, optimize inventory levels, and proactively mitigate supply risks.


Key Responsibilities

Supply Planning & Execution

  • Plan, release, and monitor wafer fabrication, assembly, and test production based on customer demand, inventory targets, and manufacturing capacity.
  • Monitor daily WIP, production output, and shipment status across manufacturing partners.
  • Identify production bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and supply risks; drive timely resolution with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Analyze demand and supply changes and adjust production priorities accordingly.
  • Ensure customer orders are fulfilled according to committed schedules and service level targets.

Supplier Performance Management

  • Drive supplier performance against key metrics including Factory On-Time Delivery (FOTD), cycle time, backlog management, and inventory accuracy.
  • Generate and communicate production priorities to suppliers and follow through to ensure timely execution.
  • Lead operational reviews and regular meetings with wafer fabs, assembly houses, and test subcontractors.
  • Coordinate escalation and recovery plans for supply shortages, schedule slips, and production issues.

Inventory Management

  • Manage wafer, die bank, unique material, and finished goods inventory to support business objectives.
  • Monitor inventory health and recommend actions to improve inventory turns while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Perform inventory reconciliation and audit activities with subcontractors and internal teams.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and implement corrective actions.

Systems & Process Management

  • Maintain planning parameters and master data in SAP, APS, and related systems to ensure planning accuracy.
  • Execute SAP transactions including purchase orders, inventory adjustments, RMAs, lot scrapping, and material movements.
  • Manage B2B data transactions with subcontractors and resolve data integrity issues.
  • Support planning system enhancements and process improvement initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Demand Planning, Product Management, Operations, Procurement, Logistics, and Quality teams to support supply chain objectives.
  • Provide timely updates on supply status, delivery commitments, and potential risks.
  • Support new product introductions (NPI), product transfers, engineering builds, and qualification activities.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving supply chain efficiency and operational performance.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience in semiconductor supply chain, production planning, operations planning, or manufacturing planning.
  • Experience supporting wafer fabrication, assembly, and test operations in a fabless or outsourced semiconductor manufacturing environment.
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes, production control, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

title: Director of Data
description:
Role

helps businesses scale. We hold data from thousands of client businesses, including company profiles, purchases, product usage, and live connections to bank, CRM, and advertising accounts. Our founders have said the company must be data-first before it can be AI-first. This role makes that true.

We are hiring our first Director of Data, the first leader solely accountable for the data function. Three Senior Data Engineers and a half-time analyst run the warehouse, single-client-record pipelines, and reporting used by Finance and Leadership, supporting two client-facing products in daily use. What is missing is one owner for accurate numbers, one reliable client record, AI-ready data, and one data program.

The mandate is to make data reliable and usable by people, products, and AI systems. You own the data platform, single client record, governed business metrics, and data used to train, evaluate, and ground AI systems. You lead the team and data quality program while remaining hands-on enough to write SQL, inspect models, and diagnose failures. You report to the CTO; Platform owns infrastructure and application engineering; AI Engineering owns model architecture and runtime; and you own the data those systems train on, evaluate against, and retrieve from. The existing team reports to you on day one, and you set the standards every data-producing team must meet.

Responsibilities

  • Own the data platform end to end, including the warehouse, ingestion, transformation, semantic layer, orchestration, observability, vendors, and cost.

  • Build the governed data systems behind production ML and LLM products, including versioned training, evaluation, feature, and retrieval datasets, embeddings and vector indexes, and controls for labeling, lineage, leakage, drift, and retrieval quality.

  • Establish one authoritative client record across source systems with identity resolution, field-level provenance, and enforceable data contracts.

  • Create the governed metrics layer and data quality program that Leadership and Finance use, including one definition per metric, published freshness standards, automated reconciliation, and named ownership by domain.

  • Enforce privacy and access controls in the data layer with Security and Legal, including retention, deletion, cataloging, lineage, and boundaries between operating companies and partners.

  • Lead the data team as one program through a published roadmap, clear operating cadence, documented on-call, talent development, and hands-on technical leadership when the work requires it.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform experience, including leading a data function and directly managing senior engineers; experience as a company's first or primary data leader is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience building or rebuilding a modern cloud data stack, with advanced SQL skills and practical experience with warehouse architecture, data modeling, transformation, orchestration, and observability.

  • Experience owning data systems used by production ML or LLM products, including versioned training, evaluation, and retrieval datasets, embeddings and vector search, labeling, leakage prevention, drift monitoring, and retrieval-quality evaluation. Must be able to explain how data quality decisions affected model performance in production.

  • Experience building a customer master or identity resolution model across multiple source systems, including matching logic, survivorship rules, and field-level provenance.

  • Experience delivering governed business metrics used by executives and Finance, including automated reconciliation, published data-quality standards, clear remediation ownership, and the ability to explain data tradeoffs in plain language.

  • Experience implementing data governance and privacy controls, including retention, deletion, lineage, role-based access, and working knowledge of CCPA and CPRA; financial transaction or multi-entity data experience is preferred.

Results

  • Within 60 days, publish one data roadmap, review it monthly with the CTO and quarterly with the founders, and assign an owner to every data initiative.

  • AI assistants answer the top 20 leadership metric questions; every AI product has a team-owned evaluation set; and no model ships without testing it with AI Engineering.

  • The client record covers every active client, core fields are at least 95% complete, connected-source data uses the same model, and every material field has provenance.

  • Every executive KPI and Finance statement uses governed metrics; reconciliation runs weekly; unmatched payment volume falls below 1% from $9.8 million; and critical failures are detected within one hour and resolved within one business day.

  • Retention and deletion are automated, deletion requests complete within 45 days with an audit record, and warehouse access is reviewed quarterly.

  • Every data engineer has a level, growth plan, and on-call; no critical pipeline depends on one person; and platform spend and unit cost are reported monthly.

Schedule

  • Full-time, standard Pacific Time business hours, Monday through Friday.

  • Flexibility to support security incidents and critical business needs.

Location

  • Remote, USA.

  • Some travel to Las Vegas will be required.

Compensation:

  • $250,000-$275,000 base salary + 15% performance bonus max.

  • The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary, not benefits (more details below).

Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive, evolving benefits package designed to support your health, family, and wellbeing. Some key offerings:

  • Flexible Unlimited Paid Time Off and Company-wide Holidays

  • Employer sponsored Medical, Dental, & Vision plans

    • $1,950 annual Employer HSA contribution

    • FSA options including dependent care

    • Employee assistance program and mental health resources

  • Employer match program for 401(k), eligible for both Traditional and Roth accounts

  • $1,200 annual wellness reimbursement through JOON that supports health, family care, pet care, fitness, and more!

  • For local or visiting team members, enjoy access to a state of the art gym at our HQ in Las Vegas

* Benefits eligibility applies only to full-time exempt roles.

ACQ Core Values:

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

Competitive Greatness

Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns.

Sincere Candor

Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally.

Unimpeachable Character

Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.

title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer
description:
About Beazley Security

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

Summary

Beazley Security has Claude and Microsoft Copilot deployed across the company. The next step is putting agents to work across every team in the business. This is our first hire dedicated to making that happen.

You’ll work with operations, sales, finance, and other non-technical teams to find manual work worth automating. You’ll build agents in Claude and Copilot Studio, get them into daily use, and measure the time they save. Early on you’ll build most of them yourself, while teaching teams to build their own.


You’ll have a big say in what we tackle first and how we build it. This is the first hire for what we plan to grow into a team, so a lot of what you set up early will stick.


Beazley Security protects client data and systems for a living, so you’ll build security and privacy into every agent from the start. You’ll help us establish safeguards to ensure that agents can go into production quickly and safely, by building upon our existing agentic security tooling and capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Spend time with teams across the business, watch how the work gets done, and pick the problems where an agent saves hours or removes a manual, error-prone step. Agree on what success looks like before you build.
  • Turn a stream of AI ideas into a short, ranked backlog with a clear call on each: build it, help the team build it, or leave it alone.
  • Estimate what each agent will cost to run, including licensing and token consumption. Use our pre-agreed guardrails so low-risk agents go live quickly, and bring in Security, IT, Legal, or Privacy when a use case needs a closer look.
  • Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and supporting automation using the Claude Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  • Build a group of champions across the business, run hands-on build sessions and office hours, and create the templates and playbooks teams use to build their own agents safely.
  • Help maintain a record of every agent in production with its owner, data sources, and access. Evaluate new AI tools when teams ask about them and recommend whether we adopt them.

Your First 90 Days

  • Days 1 to 30: Get to know Beazley Security. Sit with at least three teams, map their most painful workflows, and build your first agent yourself. Get it into real use, even if it’s small.
  • Days 31 to 60: Two or three agents in production, each measured against a baseline of “value”. A published intake process, and your first AI champions identified.
  • Days 61 to 90: At least one team can point to manual work that’s gone. The agent register and build playbook are live.
  • After that: Champions build their own agents using your patterns, and your results justify the next hire onto this team.

What You'll Have

  • Executive buy-in and support. You report to our Chief Product and Technology Officer, who uses AI every day and has built several agents for internal use. Expect quick decisions and direct help when a project gets stuck.
  • A first project. A business sponsor and workflow lined up before day one.
  • A fast review path. Guardrails agreed with Security and Legal before you start, so low-risk agents don’t sit in a queue.

Qualifications

  • You’ve built AI agents or automations that are in daily use, with low-code tools like Copilot Studio or with code (Python, TypeScript, and the Claude API).
  • You have hands-on experience with prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and evaluating agent output, and you know where LLMs fail.
  • You’ve integrated with REST APIs, MCP servers, connectors, and enterprise authentication.
  • You’ve typically spent four or more years in a business-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, solutions consulting, business analysis, automation, or platform delivery.
  • You can learn a finance or sales operations workflow from the people who run it and build something that improves it.
  • You know when a use case needs a security or privacy review before it goes anywhere, and you can estimate what an agent will cost to run on Copilot credits or Claude API usage.
  • You’ve run workshops or training for non-technical audiences, and you write clearly.
  • You’d rather ship a small agent that works than constantly plan and iterate on a big one.

Preferred

  • Experience in cybersecurity.
  • Experience running an AI champions program, community of practice, or citizen developer program.
  • Experience setting up lightweight AI guardrails, like an agent inventory or risk tiers, that keep teams moving quickly.
  • Familiarity EU data protection requirements.
  • When you apply, please include a link or a short screen recording of something you built.

Beazley Security Offers

  • Competitive salary and bonus.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental.
  • 100% of employee-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision).
  • Up to 5% matched 401k contribution.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training.
  • Participation in industry conferences and events.
